-- Retire TP Ragdoll workers from an earlier execution before continuing.
-- This does not affect Anti Ragdoll, Bat Counter, or Auto Play.
pcall(function()
  local oldTPRagdoll = _G.CalciumTPRagdoll
  if type(oldTPRagdoll) == "table" and type(oldTPRagdoll.stop) == "function" then
    oldTPRagdoll.stop()
  end
end)
_G.CalciumTPRagdoll = nil
_G.CalciumTPRagdollEnabled = false
_G.CalciumTPRagdollBusy = false

-- Persist pending settings before an executor re-run tears down the previous UI.
-- This call is intentionally before all runtime cleanups and is guarded on first run.
pcall(function()
  if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow() end
end)
-- Unique session ensures a delayed save from the previous script cannot overwrite
-- the new execution's loaded preferences.
_G.CalciumConfigSession = {}
-- Stop any older bypass runner before replacing the Calcium UI.
pcall(function()
  if type(_G.SpeedCloseBypass) == "function" then _G.SpeedCloseBypass() end
  if type(_G.CalciumStandaloneBypassCleanup) == "function" then
    _G.CalciumStandaloneBypassCleanup()
    _G.CalciumStandaloneBypassCleanup = nil
  end
end)
-- Stop stale movement workers from a previous execution before rebuilding the UI.
-- Globals can survive re-execution in some executors, so explicitly sever their connections.
pcall(function()
  local state = _G.CalciumAutoPathState
  if state then
    if state.leftConn then pcall(function() state.leftConn:Disconnect() end); state.leftConn = nil end
    if state.rightConn then pcall(function() state.rightConn:Disconnect() end); state.rightConn = nil end
    state.leftPhase, state.rightPhase = 1, 1
  end
  if _G.CalciumAutoTPConnection then
    pcall(function() _G.CalciumAutoTPConnection:Disconnect() end)
    _G.CalciumAutoTPConnection = nil
  end
  if type(_G.CalciumStopAutoLeft) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumStopAutoLeft) end
  if type(_G.CalciumStopAutoRight) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumStopAutoRight) end
  if type(_G.CalciumAutoPlay) == "table" and type(_G.CalciumAutoPlay.stop) == "function" then
    pcall(_G.CalciumAutoPlay.stop)
  end
  -- Critical: do not let a previous run's deferred Auto-TP restore turn itself back on.
  _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreWanted = false
  _G.CalciumAutoTPUserDisabled = true
  _G._CalciumAutoTPUserTouched = false
  _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
  _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
  -- Default to the original complete 4-phase path; config can override it.
  _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled = true
end)

-- Calcium Hub FFlags: automatic conservative profile.
-- Intentionally avoids network/scheduler/debug flags that can cause hitching or instability.
do
  local flags = {
    {"DFFlagTextureQualityOverrideEnabled", "true"},
    {"DFIntTextureQualityOverride", "0"},
    {"FIntFRMMinGrassDistance", "0"},
    {"FIntFRMMaxGrassDistance", "0"},
  }
  local env = _G
  if type(getgenv) == "function" then
    local ok, value = pcall(getgenv)
    if ok and type(value) == "table" then env = value end
  end
  local setter = setfflag or set_fflag or rawget(env, "setfflag") or rawget(env, "set_fflag")
  local report = {enabled = true, attempted = 0, applied = 0, skipped = #flags, supported = type(setter) == "function", lastError = nil}
  _G.CalciumFFlags = report
  _G.CalciumFFlagsEnabled = true -- always-on status; no user toggle
  task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.25)

    -- Mobile clients/executors can hard-crash when runtime flags are changed.
    -- Do not call the setter at all on touch devices; pcall cannot catch a native crash.
    local isTouchDevice = false
    pcall(function()
      isTouchDevice = game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled == true
    end)
    if isTouchDevice then
      report.mobileSkipped = true
      report.enabled = false
      _G.CalciumFFlagsEnabled = false
      report.lastError = "FFlags were skipped on a touch device to avoid executor/client crashes."
      warn("[Calcium] Mobile detected; runtime FFlags skipped for stability.")
      return
    end

    if type(setter) ~= "function" then
      report.lastError = "This executor does not expose setfflag; safe FFlags were not applied."
      warn("[Calcium] Safe FFlags unavailable on this executor.")
      return
    end
    for i, flag in ipairs(flags) do
      report.attempted += 1
      local ok, result = pcall(setter, flag[1], flag[2])
      if ok and result ~= false then
        report.applied += 1
        report.skipped -= 1
      end
      -- Small batches keep desktop startup responsive.
      if i % 2 == 0 then task.wait(0.05) end
    end
    if report.applied == 0 then
      report.lastError = "Executor rejected the safe FFlag profile."
      warn("[Calcium] Safe FFlags were not accepted by this executor.")
    elseif report.skipped > 0 then
      report.lastError = tostring(report.skipped) .. " safe FFlag(s) were rejected."
    end
  end)
end

-- Desktop-only conservative FPS cap. Never force an extreme FPS cap on touch devices.

  local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  if UIS.TouchEnabled then return end
  local capper = setfpscap or set_fps_cap
  -- Leave the client FPS cap unchanged for stability.
end)


-- Lightweight HTTP helpers (no anti-spy overhead)
local function __CaSafeGet(url)
	local ok, res = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
	return ok and res or nil
end
local function __CaSafeRequest(opts)
	local r = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request)
	if not r then return nil end
	local ok, res = pcall(r, opts)
	return ok and res or nil
end
_G.__CalciumSafeGet = __CaSafeGet
_G.__CalciumSafeRequest = __CaSafeRequest

-- ============================================================
--  CALCIUM · LIVE WINS
--  Wiki image → Discord (80x80 corner thumbnail)
--  Worker: https://calcium-live-wins.eugenedingleberry986.workers.dev
-- ============================================================
task.defer(function()
    task.wait(0.15)
    pcall(function()

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  CONFIG
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local WORKER_URL = "https://calcium-live-wins.eugenedingleberry986.workers.dev"
    local WINS_FILE  = "LiveWins_TotalWins.txt"
    local COOLDOWN   = 10
    local POLL       = 2.5

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  SERVICES
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local Players           = game:GetService("Players")
    local HttpService       = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local lp                = Players.LocalPlayer

    local req = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request)

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  DATA MODULES
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local mutationsData = {}
    pcall(function() mutationsData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Datas.Mutations) or {} end)

    local traitsData = {}
    pcall(function() traitsData = require(ReplicatedStorage.Datas.Traits) or {} end)

    local function getMutationColor(mutationName)
        if not mutationName or mutationName == "" or mutationName == "None" then
            return nil
        end
        local entry = mutationsData[mutationName]
        if type(entry) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local c = entry.MainColor or entry.Color or entry.mainColor or entry.color
        if typeof(c) == "Color3" then return c end
        return nil
    end

    local function mutationColorString(mutationName)
        local c = getMutationColor(mutationName)
        if not c then return nil end
        return string.format("%d,%d,%d",
            math.floor(c.R * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(c.G * 255 + 0.5),
            math.floor(c.B * 255 + 0.5))
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  WIN COUNTER
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local totalWins = 0
    pcall(function()
        if readfile and isfile and isfile(WINS_FILE) then
            totalWins = tonumber(readfile(WINS_FILE)) or 0
        end
    end)
    local function saveWins()
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then writefile(WINS_FILE, tostring(totalWins)) end
        end)
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  NUMBER FORMATTING
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local function num(str)
        str = tostring(str):gsub("[%s,$]", "")
        local n, suf = str:match("([%d%.]+)([%a]*)")
        n = tonumber(n) or 0
        suf = (suf or ""):upper()
        if suf == "K" then n = n * 1e3
        elseif suf == "M" then n = n * 1e6
        elseif suf == "B" then n = n * 1e9
        elseif suf == "T" then n = n * 1e12 end
        return n
    end
    local function short(n)
        if n >= 1e12 then return string.format("%.1fT", n/1e12) end
        if n >= 1e9  then return string.format("%.1fB", n/1e9)  end
        if n >= 1e6  then return string.format("%.1fM", n/1e6)  end
        if n >= 1e3  then return string.format("%.1fK", n/1e3)  end
        return tostring(math.floor(n))
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  BASE64
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local function b64encode(s)
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            if type(crypt) == "table" and crypt.base64encode then
                return crypt.base64encode(s)
            end
            if type(syn) == "table" and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64
               and syn.crypt.base64.encode then
                return syn.crypt.base64.encode(s)
            end
            if type(base64_encode) == "function" then
                return base64_encode(s)
            end
        end)
        if ok and type(res) == "string" and #res > 0 then return res end

        local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
        local out = {}
        local bytes = { string.byte(s, 1, #s) }
        for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
            local b1, b2, b3 = bytes[i], bytes[i+1] or 0, bytes[i+2] or 0
            local n = b1 * 65536 + b2 * 256 + b3
            local c1 = math.floor(n / 262144) % 64 + 1
            local c2 = math.floor(n / 4096)  % 64 + 1
            local c3 = math.floor(n / 64)    % 64 + 1
            local c4 = n % 64 + 1
            out[#out+1] = b:sub(c1,c1)
            out[#out+1] = b:sub(c2,c2)
            out[#out+1] = (i+1 <= #bytes) and b:sub(c3,c3) or "="
            out[#out+1] = (i+2 <= #bytes) and b:sub(c4,c4) or "="
        end
        return table.concat(out)
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  WIKI IMAGE LOOKUP
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local wikiCache = {}

    local function wikiSlug(name)
        return (tostring(name):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub(" ", "_"))
    end

    local function tryFandomOgImage(slug)
        local url = "https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/" .. slug
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return req({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
        end)
        if ok and res and res.Body then
            local img = res.Body:match('<meta%s+property="og:image"%s+content="([^"]+)"')
                     or res.Body:match('<meta%s+content="([^"]+)"%s+property="og:image"')
            if img and img ~= "" then
                img = img:gsub("/scale%-to%-width%-down/[^/]+/", "/")
                return img
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function tryFandomMedia(slug)
        local url = "https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/api.php?action=query&titles="
                 .. slug
                 .. "&prop=pageimages&format=json&pithumbsize=600"
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return req({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
        end)
        if ok and res and res.Body then
            local ok2, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(res.Body) end)
            if ok2 and data and data.query and data.query.pages then
                for _, page in pairs(data.query.pages) do
                    local thumb = page.thumbnail
                    if thumb and thumb.source then return thumb.source end
                    if page.pageimage then
                        return "https://stealabrainrot.fandom.com/wiki/Special:FilePath/"
                               .. page.pageimage
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function fetchWikiImageURL(brainrotName)
        if not brainrotName or brainrotName == "" then return nil end
        local key = brainrotName:lower()
        if wikiCache[key] ~= nil then return wikiCache[key] or nil end

        local slug = wikiSlug(brainrotName)
        local url = tryFandomOgImage(slug) or tryFandomMedia(slug)

        wikiCache[key] = url or false
        return url
    end

    local function downloadImage(url)
        if not url or url == "" then return nil end
        local ok, res = pcall(function()
            return req({ Url = url, Method = "GET" })
        end)
        if ok and res and res.Body and #res.Body > 100 then
            return res.Body
        end
        return nil
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  TRAIT EXTRACTION
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local function extractTraits(model, sgui)
        local out, seen = {}, {}
        local function add(t)
            if type(t) ~= "string" then return end
            t = t:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
            if t == "" or t == "None" or t == "Template"
               or t == "Traits" or t == "TraitsPerAnimal" then return end
            if #t > 40 then return end
            if seen[t] then return end
            seen[t] = true
            table.insert(out, t)
        end

        if model and model:IsA("Model") then
            for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
                local traitName = child.Name:match("^_Trait%.(.+)$")
                if traitName then add(traitName) end
            end
        end

        if #out == 0 and sgui then
            local overhead = sgui:FindFirstChild("AnimalOverhead")
            local tFrame = (overhead and overhead:FindFirstChild("Traits"))
                        or sgui:FindFirstChild("Traits", true)
            if tFrame then
                for _, c in ipairs(tFrame:GetChildren()) do
                    if c:IsA("ImageLabel")
                       and c.Name ~= "" and c.Name ~= "Template"
                       and c.Visible then
                        add(c.Name)
                    elseif c:IsA("TextLabel")
                       and c.Name ~= "Template"
                       and c.Visible
                       and c.Text ~= "" then
                        add(c.Text)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        table.sort(out)
        return out
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  MUTATION EXTRACTION
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local function extractMutationName(adornee, sgui)
        if adornee then
            local m = adornee:GetAttribute("Mutation")
            if m and tostring(m) ~= "" and tostring(m) ~= "None" then
                return tostring(m)
            end
            local m2 = adornee:GetAttribute("__mutation")
            if m2 and tostring(m2) ~= "" and tostring(m2) ~= "None" then
                return tostring(m2)
            end
        end

        if sgui then
            local mLbl = sgui:FindFirstChild("Mutation")
            if mLbl and mLbl:IsA("TextLabel")
               and mLbl.Visible
               and mLbl.Text ~= "" and mLbl.Text ~= "None" then
                return mLbl.Text
            end
        end

        return "None"
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  BRAINROT DETECTION
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local P3 = Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.464, 7.107)
    local P7 = Vector3.new(-476.752, 10.464, 114.107)

    local function findMyPlot()
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") or workspace
        for _, v in ipairs(plots:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Name == "PlotSign" then
                local d3 = (v.Position - P3).Magnitude
                local d7 = (v.Position - P7).Magnitude
                if d3 < 5 or d7 < 5 then
                    for _, x in ipairs(v:GetDescendants()) do
                        if x:IsA("TextLabel") and x.Text ~= ""
                           and (x.Text:find(lp.Name, 1, true)
                                or x.Text:find(lp.DisplayName, 1, true)) then
                            return d3 < 5 and 3 or 7
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local function scanBrainrot()
        local db = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debris")
        if not db then return nil, 0, "None", {}, nil end
        local myPlot = findMyPlot()
        if not myPlot then return nil, 0, "None", {}, nil end

        local targetPos = (myPlot == 3) and P7 or P3
        local best = { name = nil, val = 0, mutation = "None", traits = {}, model = nil }

        for _, v in ipairs(db:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name == "FastOverheadTemplate" then
                local sgui = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("SurfaceGui")
                local ad   = sgui and sgui.Adornee
                if ad and (ad.Position - targetPos).Magnitude <= 50 then
                    local gen = sgui:FindFirstChild("Generation")
                    if gen and gen:IsA("TextLabel") then
                        local val = num(gen.Text)
                        if val > best.val then
                            local dn = sgui:FindFirstChild("DisplayName")
                            local nameText = (dn and dn:IsA("TextLabel") and dn.Text ~= "")
                                             and dn.Text or nil
                            if nameText then
                                local m = ad
                                for _ = 1, 10 do
                                    if not m then break end
                                    if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= workspace then break end
                                    m = m.Parent
                                end
                                if m == workspace or not (m and m:IsA("Model")) then m = nil end

                                best.val      = val
                                best.name     = nameText
                                best.mutation = extractMutationName(ad, sgui)
                                best.traits   = extractTraits(m, sgui)
                                best.model    = m
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return best.name, best.val, best.mutation, best.traits, best.model
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  POST TO WORKER
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local function postWin(brainrotName, mutation, traits, value, png)
        if not req then
            warn("[LiveWins] no request API in this executor")
            return
        end

        local payload = {
            brainrot      = tostring(brainrotName or "Unknown"),
            mutation      = tostring(mutation or "None"),
            mutationColor = mutationColorString(mutation),
            traits        = traits or {},
            generation    = short(value) .. "/s",
            totalWins     = totalWins,
            displayName   = lp.DisplayName,
        }
        if png and #png > 100 then
            payload.pngBase64 = b64encode(png)
        end

        local ok, res = pcall(req, {
            Url = WORKER_URL,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json" },
            Body = HttpService:JSONEncode(payload),
        })

        if not ok then
            warn("[LiveWins] post failed:", res)
        elseif res and res.StatusCode and res.StatusCode >= 400 then
            warn("[LiveWins] worker rejected:", res.StatusCode, res.Body)
        end
    end

    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    --  WIN DETECTION
    -- ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
    local lastBrainrot, lastVal, lastTick = "", 0, 0
    local myN, myD = lp.Name:lower(), lp.DisplayName:lower()

    local function isWinText(txt)
        if type(txt) ~= "string" or #txt < 10 then return false end
        local low = txt:lower()
        if not low:find("won the duel", 1, true) then return false end
        return low:find(myN, 1, true) ~= nil or low:find(myD, 1, true) ~= nil
    end

    local _winBusy = false
    local function handleWin()
        if _winBusy then return end
        _winBusy = true
        task.spawn(function()
            local brainrotName, value, mutation, traits = scanBrainrot()

            if not brainrotName then
                task.wait(0.5)
                brainrotName, value, mutation, traits = scanBrainrot()
            end

            if brainrotName
               and (brainrotName ~= lastBrainrot or value ~= lastVal)
               and tick() - lastTick >= COOLDOWN then

                local png, err
                local imgURL = fetchWikiImageURL(brainrotName)
                if imgURL then
                    png = downloadImage(imgURL)
                    if not png then err = "download failed" end
                else
                    err = "not on wiki"
                end

                totalWins = totalWins + 1
                saveWins()
                postWin(brainrotName, mutation, traits, value, png)

                if err then warn("[LiveWins] wiki:", err) end

                lastBrainrot, lastVal, lastTick = brainrotName, value, tick()
            end
            _winBusy = false
        end)
    end

    local guiRoot = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local function scanContainer(container)
        for _, o in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
            if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") then
                if isWinText(o.Text) then
                    handleWin()
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
        return false
    end

    guiRoot.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o)
        if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") then
            task.defer(function()
                if o.Parent and isWinText(o.Text) then handleWin() end
            end)
        end
    end)

    local function hookTextSignal(o)
        if o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") then
            o:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
                if o.Parent and isWinText(o.Text) then handleWin() end
            end)
        end
    end
    for _, o in ipairs(guiRoot:GetDescendants()) do hookTextSignal(o) end
    guiRoot.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookTextSignal)

    while _G.CalciumRunning and task.wait(POLL) do
        for _, c in ipairs(guiRoot:GetChildren()) do
            if c.Name ~= "CalciumHub" and c.Name ~= "CalciumScreenButtons" then
                if scanContainer(c) then break end
            end
        end
    end

    end)
end)

if _G.CalciumRunning then
  pcall(function()
    local names = {"CalciumHub","CalciumScreenButtons","CalciumBgGallery","CalciumPingLaggerGui","CalciumLaggerGui","CalciumStealBar","CalciumSpeedBB","CalciumSafeNoticeHost"}
    local parents = {}
    pcall(function() table.insert(parents, _G.CalciumGuiParent) end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
    pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")) end)
    pcall(function() if typeof(gethui)=="function" then table.insert(parents, gethui()) end end)
    for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
      if parent then
        for _, name in ipairs(names) do
          pcall(function()
            local o = parent:FindFirstChild(name)
            if o then o:Destroy() end
          end)
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  _G.CalciumRunning = false
  task.wait(0.05)
end
_G.CalciumRunning = true
-- mark local character so others ESP "USING CALCIUM"
task.spawn(function()
  local function mark(c)
    if c then pcall(function() c:SetAttribute("UsingCalcium", true) c:SetAttribute("CalciumHubUser", true) end) end
  end
  local LP0 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
  if LP0 then
    if LP0.Character then mark(LP0.Character) end
    LP0.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.delay(0.5, mark, c) end)
    while _G.CalciumRunning do task.wait(6) mark(LP0.Character) end
  end
end)

if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end

_G.CalciumHornEnabled = _G.CalciumHornEnabled or { false, false, false }
_G.CalciumPoisonHornsOn = _G.CalciumPoisonHornsOn or false

local _accCache, _accFail, _accWanted = {}, {}, {}
local _accConn, _accMaintain = nil, false
local function _accLoadTemplate(id)
  id = tonumber(id)
  if not id then return nil end
  if _accCache[id] then return _accCache[id] end
  if _accFail[id] and tick() < _accFail[id] then return nil end
  local acc
  pcall(function()
    if type(game.GetObjects) == "function" then
      local objs = game:GetObjects("rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id))
      if objs then
        for _, o in ipairs(objs) do
          if o:IsA("Accessory") or o:IsA("Accoutrement") then acc = o; break end
          local a = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true) or o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accoutrement", true)
          if a then acc = a; break end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
  if not acc then
    pcall(function()
      local m = game:GetService("InsertService"):LoadAsset(id)
      if m then
        acc = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accessory", true) or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Accoutrement", true)
      end
    end)
  end
  if acc then acc.Parent = nil; _accCache[id] = acc else _accFail[id] = tick() + 8 end
  return acc
end
local function _accHas(c, tag)
  for _, a in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if (a:IsA("Accessory") or a:IsA("Accoutrement")) and a:GetAttribute("__dhTag") == tag then return true end
  end
  return false
end
local function _accRemove(tag)
  local c = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
  if not c then return end
  for _, a in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if (a:IsA("Accessory") or a:IsA("Accoutrement")) and (a:GetAttribute("__dhTag") == tag or a:GetAttribute("CalciumHorn")) then
      pcall(function() a:Destroy() end)
    end
  end
end
local function _accRemoveAllHorns()
  local c = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
  if not c then return end
  for _, a in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if a:IsA("Accessory") or a:IsA("Accoutrement") then
      local n = a.Name or ""
      if a:GetAttribute("__dhTag") or a:GetAttribute("CalciumHorn") or n:find("Horns") or n:find("CalciumHorn") then
        pcall(function() a:Destroy() end)
      end
    end
  end
end
local function _accEquip(id, tag)
  local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return end
  if _accHas(c, tag) then return end
  local template = _accLoadTemplate(id)
  if not template then return end
  local acc = template:Clone()
  acc:SetAttribute("__dhTag", tag)
  for _, d in ipairs(acc:GetDescendants()) do
    if d:IsA("BaseScript") then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
  end
  local handle = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
  local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local ok = false
  if hum then ok = pcall(function() hum:AddAccessory(acc) end) end
  if not ok or not acc.Parent then acc.Parent = c end
  task.delay(0.05, function()
    if not (acc.Parent and handle and handle.Parent) then return end
    if handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Weld") or handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D") or handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("WeldConstraint") then return end
    local accAtt = handle:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Attachment")
    local charAtt = accAtt and c:FindFirstChild(accAtt.Name, true)
    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
    w.Name = "dhAccWeld"
    w.Part1 = handle
    if accAtt and charAtt and charAtt:IsA("Attachment") and charAtt.Parent then
      w.Part0 = charAtt.Parent
      w.C0 = charAtt.CFrame
      w.C1 = accAtt.CFrame
    else
      local anchor = c:FindFirstChild("Head") or c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not anchor then w:Destroy(); return end
      w.Part0 = anchor
      if accAtt then w.C1 = accAtt.CFrame end
    end
    handle.Anchored = false
    w.Parent = handle
  end)
  -- Ensure visual FX (fire / particles) stay on for horns
  task.defer(function()
    if not acc or not acc.Parent then return end
    for _, d in ipairs(acc:GetDescendants()) do
      pcall(function()
        if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Fire") or d:IsA("Smoke")
          or d:IsA("Sparkles") or d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") then
          d.Enabled = true
        end
        if d:IsA("PointLight") or d:IsA("SpotLight") or d:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
          d.Enabled = true
        end
      end)
    end
    -- Center fire effect between horns (Fiery / Poisoned / Frozen)
    local handle2 = acc:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if handle2 and not handle2:FindFirstChild("CalciumHornCenterFire") then
      local fire = Instance.new("Fire")
      fire.Name = "CalciumHornCenterFire"
      fire.Size = 2.2
      fire.Heat = 8
      fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)
      fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 20)
      if tag == "horns_poison" then
        fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 100)
        fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(30, 180, 60)
      elseif tag == "horns_frozen" then
        fire.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 110)
        fire.SecondaryColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 40)
      end
      fire.Parent = handle2
    end
  end)
end
local function _accStartMaintain()
  if _accMaintain then return end
  _accMaintain = true
  task.spawn(function()
    while _accMaintain do
      task.wait(1)
      local c = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Character
      if c then
        for t, aid in pairs(_accWanted) do
          if not _accHas(c, t) then _accEquip(aid, t) end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
local function _accSet(id, tag, on)
  local LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
  if on then
    _accWanted[tag] = id
    task.spawn(function() _accEquip(id, tag) end)
    _accStartMaintain()
    if not _accConn then
      _accConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        task.wait(0.6)
        for t, aid in pairs(_accWanted) do _accEquip(aid, t) end
      end)
    end
  else
    _accWanted[tag] = nil
    _accRemove(tag)
    if not next(_accWanted) then
      _accMaintain = false
      if _accConn then _accConn:Disconnect(); _accConn = nil end
    end
  end
end

function applyHornIndex(idx, state)
  idx = math.clamp(tonumber(idx) or 2, 1, #_G.CalciumHornDefs)
  state = state and true or false
  _G.CalciumHornEnabled = _G.CalciumHornEnabled or { false, false, false }
  -- exclusive
  if state then
    for i = 1, 3 do _G.CalciumHornEnabled[i] = (i == idx) end
  else
    _G.CalciumHornEnabled[idx] = false
  end
  _G.CalciumPoisonHornsOn = (_G.CalciumHornEnabled[2] == true)
  -- clear all horn tags then equip active
  for _, def in ipairs(_G.CalciumHornDefs) do
    _accSet(nil, def.tag, false)
  end
  _accRemoveAllHorns()
  if state then
    local def = _G.CalciumHornDefs[idx]
    if def then _accSet(def.id, def.tag, true) end
  end
  pcall(function()
    local vs = _G.CalciumHornSetVisual
    if type(vs) == "table" then
      for i = 1, 3 do
        if type(vs[i]) == "function" then pcall(vs[i], _G.CalciumHornEnabled[i] == true) end
      end
    end
  end)
end
_G.applyHornIndex = applyHornIndex
function applyPoisonHorns(state)
  applyHornIndex(2, state and true or false)
end
_G.applyPoisonHorns = applyPoisonHorns

game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
  task.wait(1.2)
  pcall(function()
    local en = _G.CalciumHornEnabled or {}
    for i, on in ipairs(en) do
      if on then applyHornIndex(i, true) break end
    end
    if not en[1] and not en[2] and not en[3] and _G.CalciumPoisonHornsOn then
      applyHornIndex(2, true)
    end
  end)
end)

local _calciumClickSnd = nil
local function playClick()
  local now = os.clock()
  if now - (_G._CalciumLastClickTime or -math.huge) < 0.08 then return end
  _G._CalciumLastClickTime = now
  pcall(function()
    local ss = game:GetService("SoundService")
    if not _calciumClickSnd or not _calciumClickSnd.Parent then
      _calciumClickSnd = Instance.new("Sound")
      _calciumClickSnd.Name = "CalciumClick"
      _calciumClickSnd.SoundId = "rbxassetid://88073348503000"
      _calciumClickSnd.Volume = 1.5
      _calciumClickSnd.Parent = ss
    end
    _calciumClickSnd.TimePosition = 0.7
    _calciumClickSnd:Play()
  end)
end
_G.playClick = playClick

-- ============================================================
-- CONTENITORE GUI DELL'HUB
-- gethui() restituisce un contenitore protetto (di solito dentro CoreGui),
-- non ispezionabile dagli anticheat che scansionano PlayerGui e non
-- azzerato ai reset del personaggio. Fallback in ordine: gethui ->
-- get_hidden_gui -> CoreGui -> PlayerGui, cosi' lo script gira anche su
-- executor che non espongono nessuna delle tre.
-- ATTENZIONE: le GUI DEL GIOCO (Duels timer, bottone jump mobile) restano
-- su PlayerGui, non vanno cercate qui.
-- ============================================================
local HubGui = PlayerGui
do
  local ok, res = pcall(function()
    if type(gethui) == "function" then return gethui() end
    if type(get_hidden_gui) == "function" then return get_hidden_gui() end
    return game:GetService("CoreGui")
  end)
  if ok and typeof(res) == "Instance" then HubGui = res end
end
_G.CalciumGuiParent = HubGui
_G.CalciumProtectGui = function(gui)
  if not gui then return end
  pcall(function()
    if syn and type(syn.protect_gui) == "function" then syn.protect_gui(gui) end
    if type(protect_gui) == "function" then protect_gui(gui) end
    if type(protectgui) == "function" then protectgui(gui) end
  end)
end

-- Free-executor safe toggle arm (debounce). Was referenced but never defined.

-- Bind toggle button for free executors + mobile (Activated + Click + Touch)
_G.CalciumWireToggle = function(btn, fn)
  if not btn or type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
  local last = 0
  local function fire()
    local now = tick()
    if now - last < 0.12 then return end
    last = now
    if _G._CalciumToggleArm and not _G._CalciumToggleArm(btn) then return end
    pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    pcall(fn)
  end
  btn.Activated:Connect(fire)
end

_G._CalciumToggleArm = function(btn)
  local now = tick()
  _G._CalciumToggleArmLast = _G._CalciumToggleArmLast or setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
  local key = btn
  if not key then return false end
  local last = _G._CalciumToggleArmLast[key] or 0
  if now - last < 0.12 then return false end
  _G._CalciumToggleArmLast[key] = now
  return true
end

_G.CalciumBindButton = function(btn, fn)
  if not btn or type(fn) ~= "function" then return end
  local last = 0
  local function fire()
    local now = tick()
    if now - last < 0.05 then return end
    last = now
    pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    pcall(fn)
  end
  pcall(function() btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fire) end)
  pcall(function() btn.Activated:Connect(fire) end)
end


local _SV = {} -- setVisual callbacks (merged to save local slots)

-- ============================================================
-- WAIT CHARACTER READY (condiviso)
-- Al respawn il character esiste prima delle sue parti. Aspettare un
-- tempo fisso e' inaffidabile: qui si aspetta che Head, HumanoidRootPart
-- e Humanoid esistano davvero. Ritorna false se scade il timeout o se il
-- character viene sostituito nel frattempo.
-- ============================================================
function _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(character, timeout)
  character = character or LP.Character
  if not character then return false end
  local deadline = os.clock() + (tonumber(timeout) or 5)
  while os.clock() < deadline do
    if not character.Parent then return false end
    if LP.Character and LP.Character ~= character then return false end
    if character:FindFirstChild("Head")
       and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
       and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
      return true
    end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
  return false
end
_G.CalciumIsMobile = false
pcall(function()
  local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  _G.CalciumIsMobile = (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled) or (UIS.TouchEnabled and UIS.GyroscopeEnabled)
  -- tablet with keyboard still counts as mobile-touch primary
  if UIS.TouchEnabled and UIS.TouchEnabled then
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and cam.ViewportSize.X < 900 then
      _G.CalciumIsMobile = true
    end
  end
end)
-- Device-aware scale helper (phone / tablet / pc)
_G._CalciumS = function(n)
  n = tonumber(n) or 0
  if not _G.CalciumIsMobile then return n end
  local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
  local short = vp and math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) or 400
  -- phones (~360-430 short edge) get slightly smaller UI; larger phones/tablets closer to 1
  local mul = 0.88
  if short < 380 then mul = 0.82
  elseif short < 430 then mul = 0.86
  elseif short < 700 then mul = 0.92
  else mul = 0.96 end
  return math.floor(n * mul + 0.5)
end

end

autoSwingEnabled = false
mirrorTPDownEnabled = false

-- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
-- ============================================================
-- ANTI VOID
-- Sempre attivo dall'esecuzione. Un thread per giocatore tiene 0.07s
-- di storico dei CFrame: se in quella finestra copre 150 stud totali
-- oppure 100 stud di sola Y, e' un teletrasporto. La posizione buona e'
-- quella del campione piu' vecchio dello storico, e il TP viene contato
-- solo se partiva dalla Safe Zone. Da li' in poi TP Bat, aimbot V1/V2,
-- Bat Counter, Look At Enemy, ESP e tracker puntano al punto d'origine.
-- ============================================================
do
  -- Limiti di coordinate della Safe Zone
  local MAP_BOUNDS = {
    MinX = -535.7,
    MaxX = -422.0,
    MinY = -7.9,
    MaxY = 115.0,
    MinZ = -72.0,
    MaxZ = 193.3,
  }

  -- Finestra UNICA da 0.07s per tutti gli assi:
  --   150 stud di distanza totale (X/Z/Y)  oppure  100 stud di sola Y
  local TP_TOTAL   = 150
  local TP_DELTA_Y = 100
  local WINDOW     = 0.07
  -- Il fantasma non sparisce rientrando nella zona: sparisce quando il
  -- giocatore ha camminato WALK_CLEAR stud ORIZZONTALI dentro la zona.
  -- La Y e' esclusa dal conteggio: cadere o salire non lo cancella.
  local WALK_CLEAR = 15
  local STEP_MAX   = 50   -- oltre questo non e' camminata, non si accumula

  local function enabled() return _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled == true end

  local ghost   = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [player] = posizione d'origine
  local ghostCF = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [player] = CFrame d'origine
  local isOutOf = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [player] = bool
  local tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })  -- [player] = true (thread gia' avviato)

  local function isWithinBounds(pos)
    if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
    return pos.X >= MAP_BOUNDS.MinX and pos.X <= MAP_BOUNDS.MaxX
       and pos.Y >= MAP_BOUNDS.MinY and pos.Y <= MAP_BOUNDS.MaxY
       and pos.Z >= MAP_BOUNDS.MinZ and pos.Z <= MAP_BOUNDS.MaxZ
  end
  -- Richiamata SOLO quando un teleport viene confermato
  local function onTeleportDetected(player, originCFrame)
    isOutOf[player] = true
    ghostCF[player] = originCFrame
    ghost[player]   = originCFrame.Position
  end
  -- ============================================================
  -- RESCUE (rete di sicurezza per LP)
  -- Se LP finisce fuori dalla Safe Zone (void part assente, fling,
  -- micro-bug) viene riportato all'ultima posizione sicura a terra.
  -- Attivo solo quando Anti Void e' acceso. Cooldown zero: interviene
  -- ad ogni Heartbeat finche' LP non e' rientrato nella zona.
  -- ============================================================
  local _rescueLastSafePos = nil   -- ultima pos a terra dentro la zona
  local _rescueSpawnOrigin = nil   -- prima pos sicura rilevata all'accensione
  local _rescueLastRescue  = 0     -- os.clock() dell'ultimo rescue
  local RESCUE_COOLDOWN    = 0     -- istantaneo (come in Calcium_2_)
  local RESCUE_UPDATE_INT  = 0.1   -- ogni quanto aggiornare il checkpoint
  local _rescueLastUpdate  = 0

  local function _rescueUpdateCheckpoint()
    local c   = LP.Character
    local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (hrp and hum) then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - _rescueLastUpdate < RESCUE_UPDATE_INT then return end
    _rescueLastUpdate = now
    local pos = hrp.Position
    if not _rescueSpawnOrigin and isWithinBounds(pos) then
      _rescueSpawnOrigin = pos
    end
    -- salva checkpoint solo se e' a terra (non in aria) e dentro la zona
    if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and isWithinBounds(pos) then
      _rescueLastSafePos = pos
    end
  end
  local function _rescueTryRescue()
    local c   = LP.Character
    local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (hrp and hrp.Parent) then return end
    if isWithinBounds(hrp.Position) then return end
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - _rescueLastRescue < RESCUE_COOLDOWN then return end
    _rescueLastRescue = now
    local dest = _rescueLastSafePos or _rescueSpawnOrigin
    if dest and isWithinBounds(dest) then
      pcall(function()
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.zero
        hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(dest + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
      end)
    end
  end
  -- Heartbeat dedicato al rescue LP. Si registra una sola volta
  -- e controlla enabled() ogni frame: zero overhead quando spento.
  -- LP rescue disabled (was teleporting / "resetting" players)
  RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not enabled() then return end
    _rescueUpdateCheckpoint()
    -- _rescueTryRescue() disabled
  end)

  -- Resetta il checkpoint al respawn di LP: la nuova vita riparte da zero
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    _rescueLastSafePos = nil
    _rescueSpawnOrigin = nil
    _rescueLastRescue  = 0
    _rescueLastUpdate  = 0
  end)
  -- ============================================================
  -- FINE RESCUE
  -- ============================================================

  local function trackPlayer(player)
    if player == LP then return end
    if tracked[player] then return end
    tracked[player] = true

    local history      = {}
    local walkedXZ     = 0     -- spostamento orizzontale accumulato a piedi
    local lastCheckPos = nil

    task.spawn(function()
      while player and player.Parent do
        -- Poll passivo finche' l'Anti Void e' spento: nessun overhead.
        -- Il giocatore e' gia' in tracked, quindi se viene acceso basta
        -- uscire dal poll e il ciclo attivo riparte immediatamente.
        if not enabled() then
          -- Resetta lo stato in modo che la prima rilevazione sia pulita
          isOutOf[player] = false
          history      = {}
          walkedXZ     = 0
          lastCheckPos = nil
          task.wait(0.5)
        else
          local char = player.Character
          local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

          if hrp and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local now = tick()
            local currentCFrame = hrp.CFrame
            local currentPos = currentCFrame.Position

            if isOutOf[player] then
              -- FASE 1: fantasma attivo, si misura solo la camminata X/Z
              if lastCheckPos then
                local moveVector = currentPos - lastCheckPos
                local moveXZ = Vector3.new(moveVector.X, 0, moveVector.Z).Magnitude
                if moveXZ < STEP_MAX and isWithinBounds(currentPos) then
                  walkedXZ = walkedXZ + moveXZ
                end
              end
              lastCheckPos = currentPos

              if walkedXZ >= WALK_CLEAR then
                isOutOf[player] = false
                ghost[player]   = currentPos
                ghostCF[player] = currentCFrame
                history      = {}
                walkedXZ     = 0
                lastCheckPos = nil
              end
            else
              -- FASE 2: nessun fantasma, si cerca il teletrasporto
              walkedXZ     = 0
              lastCheckPos = currentPos
              ghost[player]   = currentPos
              ghostCF[player] = currentCFrame

              table.insert(history, {time = now, cframe = currentCFrame})
              while #history > 0 and (now - history[1].time) > WINDOW do
                table.remove(history, 1)
              end
              local oldest = history[1]
              if oldest then
                local totalDistance = (currentPos - oldest.cframe.Position).Magnitude
                local deltaY = math.abs(currentPos.Y - oldest.cframe.Position.Y)

                if totalDistance >= TP_TOTAL or deltaY >= TP_DELTA_Y then
                  local refCFrame = oldest.cframe
                  local refPos = refCFrame.Position
                  local studsTraveledVector = currentPos - refPos
                  local exactOriginPos = currentPos - studsTraveledVector
                  local exactCFrame = CFrame.new(exactOriginPos) * (refCFrame - refCFrame.Position)

                  if isWithinBounds(exactOriginPos) then
                    onTeleportDetected(player, exactCFrame)
                  end
                  history = {}
                end
              end
            end
          else
            -- morto o senza character: niente fantasma
            isOutOf[player] = false
            history      = {}
            walkedXZ     = 0
            lastCheckPos = nil
          end
          RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
        end
      end
      tracked[player] = nil
    end)
  end
  Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(trackPlayer)

  -- I thread partono all'accensione e muoiono allo spegnimento: da spento
  -- il modulo non tiene niente in esecuzione.
  local function startAll()
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do trackPlayer(plr) end
  end
  local function stopAll()
    for plr in pairs(isOutOf) do isOutOf[plr] = false end
  end
  local function posFor(player, rawPos)
    if not player or not enabled() then return rawPos, false end
    if isOutOf[player] then
      local g = ghost[player]
      if g then return g, true end
    end
    return rawPos, false
  end
  -- Come sopra ma partendo da una BasePart del nemico
  local function posForPart(part, rawPos)
    if not part then return rawPos, false end
    local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local player = model and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    return posFor(player, rawPos or part.Position)
  end
  _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled = false -- force off (was causing teleports/resets)

  -- Avvia subito un thread per ogni giocatore gia' presente.
  -- I thread fanno poll passivo se Anti Void e' spento, tracking attivo
  -- se e' acceso: nessun giocatore viene perso indipendentemente dallo stato.
  startAll()

  _G.CalciumAntiVoid = {
    setEnabled = function(on)
      on = on and true or false
      local was = _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled == true
      _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled = on
      if on and not was then
        -- Per sicurezza: aggiunge thread per giocatori entrati nel frattempo
        startAll()
      elseif (not on) and was then
        stopAll()
      end
    end,
    isEnabled  = function() return _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled == true end,
    bounds     = MAP_BOUNDS,
    posFor     = posFor,
    posForPart = posForPart,
    isOut      = function(player) return player and isOutOf[player] == true end,
    ghostOf    = function(player) return player and ghost[player] or nil end,
  }

  -- ---------- REPLICA ESP SULLA POSIZIONE FANTASMA ----------
  -- Al TP si congela una copia del corpo sul CFrame d'origine calcolato
  -- dal tracker, con lo stesso contorno e overhead dell'ESP. L'ESP vero
  -- viene nascosto, cosi' non lo segue nel void.
  -- NB: ghostCF e' quello dichiarato sopra dal tracker, non ridichiararlo
  -- qui o la replica leggerebbe una tabella sempre vuota.
  local replicas   = {}
  local ghostFolder = nil

  local function ensureFolder()
    if ghostFolder and ghostFolder.Parent then return ghostFolder end
    ghostFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
    ghostFolder.Name = "CalciumAntiVoid"
    ghostFolder.Parent = workspace
    return ghostFolder
  end
  -- Mostra o nasconde l'ESP reale del nemico
  local function setRealESP(char, visible)
    if not char then return end
    local hl = char:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubESP")
    if hl then pcall(function() hl.Enabled = visible end) end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local tag = head and head:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubESPTag")
    if tag then pcall(function() tag.Enabled = visible end) end
  end
  local function clearReplica(plr)
    local r = replicas[plr]
    if r then pcall(function() r:Destroy() end) end
    replicas[plr] = nil
  end
  local function buildReplica(plr, char, cf)
    clearReplica(plr)
    -- ESP spento: non si crea niente. Il resto (TP Bat, aimbot, tracker,
    -- Look At Enemy) continua a funzionare sulla posizione fantasma.
    if not char:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubESP") then return end
    local ok, clone = pcall(function()
      char.Archivable = true
      return char:Clone()
    end)
    if not ok or not clone then return end

    -- Congela la copia: niente script, niente fisica, niente collisioni
    for _, d in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("Script") or d:IsA("LocalScript") or d:IsA("Humanoid") then
        pcall(function() d:Destroy() end)
      elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
        d.Anchored   = true
        d.CanCollide = false
        d.CanQuery   = false
        d.CanTouch   = false
      end
    end
    clone.Name = "GhostReplica_" .. tostring(plr.Name)
    clone.Parent = ensureFolder()
    pcall(function() clone:PivotTo(cf) end)

    -- L'ESP e il suo overhead sono figli del personaggio, quindi la copia
    -- se li porta dietro identici e congelati sull'ultimo valore.
    local hl = clone:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubESP")
    if hl then pcall(function() hl.Enabled = true end) end

    local cloneHead = clone:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local tag = cloneHead and cloneHead:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubESPTag")
    if tag then
      pcall(function() tag.Enabled = true end)
      -- scritta VOID sotto la velocita', al posto dove stava il nome
      local box = tag:FindFirstChildOfClass("Frame") or tag
      local vl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      vl.Name = "VoidTag"
      vl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16)
      vl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 19)
      vl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      vl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      vl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
      vl.TextSize = 16
      vl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
      vl.Text = "VOID"
      vl.Parent = box
    end
    replicas[plr] = clone
  end
  -- Repliche ESP: lo stato lo tiene gia' il thread di tracciamento
  local lastMarkerTick = 0
  RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastMarkerTick < 0.1 then return end
    lastMarkerTick = now

    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if plr ~= LP then
        local c   = plr.Character
        local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local out = enabled() and (hrp ~= nil) and (hum ~= nil) and hum.Health > 0 and isOutOf[plr] == true
        if out and ghostCF[plr] then
          setRealESP(c, false)
          if not replicas[plr] or not replicas[plr].Parent then
            buildReplica(plr, c, ghostCF[plr])
          end
        else
          if replicas[plr] then
            clearReplica(plr)
            setRealESP(c, true)
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end)

  Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    ghost[plr] = nil
    isOutOf[plr] = nil
    ghostCF[plr] = nil
    tracked[plr] = nil
    clearReplica(plr)
  end)
end

-- >>> ANTI DROP BEGIN (Adrast S2 EXACT)
-- ============================================================
-- Adrast exact anti-drop: hook HRP instance metatable __index only.
-- Non-checkcaller reads of AssemblyLinearVelocity/Velocity with
-- Magnitude > 20 return Unit * 20 so game scripts force-drop less.
-- NEVER hooks __newindex — all velocity writes go through (no desync).
-- Critical: getrawmetatable(hrp) not game — game-wide hook caused resets.
-- ============================================================
do
	local S2_velChecked = {}
	local S2_hookedVelParts = {}
	local function S2_setupVelChecked(char)
		S2_velChecked = {}
		if not char then return nil end
		local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		if hrp then S2_velChecked[hrp] = true end
		return hrp
	end
	local function S2_hookVelHRP(hrp)
		if not hrp or S2_hookedVelParts[hrp] then return end
		S2_hookedVelParts[hrp] = true
		pcall(function()
			if type(getrawmetatable) ~= "function" or type(setreadonly) ~= "function" then return end
			local mt = getrawmetatable(hrp)
			if not mt then return end
			setreadonly(mt, false)
			local originalVelIndex = rawget(mt, "__index")
			local hookFn = function(self, key)
				if (type(checkcaller) ~= "function" or not checkcaller())
					and S2_velChecked[self]
					and (key == "AssemblyLinearVelocity" or key == "Velocity") then
					local real
					if type(originalVelIndex) == "function" then
						real = originalVelIndex(self, key)
					elseif type(originalVelIndex) == "table" then
						real = originalVelIndex[key]
					end
					if typeof(real) == "Vector3" and real.Magnitude > 12 then
						-- Stronger spoof: external readers always see max 12 studs/s
						-- (game drop checks usually threshold around 16-20)
						return real.Unit * 12
					end
					return real
				end
				if type(originalVelIndex) == "function" then
					return originalVelIndex(self, key)
				elseif type(originalVelIndex) == "table" then
					return originalVelIndex[key]
				end
			end
			if type(newcclosure) == "function" then
				mt.__index = newcclosure(hookFn)
			else
				mt.__index = hookFn
			end
			setreadonly(mt, true)
		end)
	end
	local function markAndHook(char)
		S2_hookedVelParts = {}
		task.defer(function()
			local hrp = S2_setupVelChecked(char)
			S2_hookVelHRP(hrp)
		end)
	end
	pcall(function()
		if LP.Character then
			S2_hookVelHRP(S2_setupVelChecked(LP.Character))
		end
		LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
			markAndHook(char)
		end)
	end)
	-- keep hook alive (respawn / tool equip can drop the mark)
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(1.5)
			pcall(function()
				local char = LP.Character
				if not char then return end
				local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if hrp then
					S2_velChecked[hrp] = true
					if not S2_hookedVelParts[hrp] then
						S2_hookVelHRP(hrp)
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	_G._CalciumS2MarkHRP = function(char)
		char = char or (LP and LP.Character)
		if char then markAndHook(char) end
	end
	_G._CalciumS2SetupVelChecked = S2_setupVelChecked
	_G._CalciumS2HookVelHRP = S2_hookVelHRP
end
-- <<< ANTI DROP END

-- ============================================================
-- RAGDOLL TRICK — best-effort: make local/server checks think
-- you are not ragdolled while Physics/Ragdoll is still active.
-- Uses RagdollEndTime spoof + GettingUp spam + constraint cleanup.
-- Instant Reset remains the only Anti Die override.
-- ============================================================
do
  local function trickOnce(char)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not hrp then return end
    -- Spoof end time so scripts reading RagdollEndTime think it ended
    pcall(function()
      LP:SetAttribute("RagdollEndTime", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - 0.05)
    end)
    pcall(function()
      hum.PlatformStand = false
      hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
      hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, true)
      hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, true)
    end)
    pcall(function()
      local st = hum:GetState()
      if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
        or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
        or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
      end
    end)
    -- Strip common client ragdoll constraints (does not always replicate)
    pcall(function()
      for _, v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if v:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") or v:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
          if tostring(v.Name):lower():find("ragdoll") then
            pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
          end
        end
        if v:IsA("Attachment") and tostring(v.Name):find("RagdollAttachment") then
          pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
        end
      end
    end)
  end

  RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    do return end -- ragdoll trick removed
if not (false) then return end
    if _G._CalciumInstantResetBusy then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local st = hum:GetState()
    local need = hum.PlatformStand
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    local et = LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
    if typeof(et) == "number" and et > workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then need = true end
    if need then
      trickOnce(char)
    end
  end)
end
