function getIntroSongName()
  local opt = INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[selectedIntroMusic]
  if not opt then return "No Songs Added" end
  if opt.kind == "spotify" then return "Spotify" end
  return opt.name or "Song"
end
introPreviewSound = nil
introPlaybackSound = nil
introPreviewToken = 0
introPlaybackToken = 0
introSongCache = introSongCache or {}
introSongDownloading = introSongDownloading or {}

function stopIntroPreview()
  introPreviewToken = introPreviewToken + 1
  if introPreviewSound then
    local sound = introPreviewSound
    local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
      Volume = 0
    })
    fadeTween:Play()
    task.delay(1.6, function()
      pcall(function()
        if sound and sound.Parent then
          sound:Stop()
          sound:Destroy()
        end
      end)
    end)
    introPreviewSound = nil
  end
end
function stopIntroPlayback()
  introPlaybackToken = introPlaybackToken + 1
  
  -- Fade away del volume prima di distruggere il sound
  if introPlaybackSound then
    local sound = introPlaybackSound
    local startVol = sound.Volume
    
    -- Crea un tween per abbassare il volume gradualmente in 1.5 secondi
    local fadeTween = TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
      Volume = 0
    })
    
    fadeTween:Play()
    
    -- Distrugge il sound dopo che il fade è completato
    task.delay(1.6, function()
      pcall(function()
        if sound and sound.Parent then
          sound:Stop()
          sound:Destroy()
        end
      end)
    end)
    
    introPlaybackSound = nil
  end
end
-- Premium toast notifications (replaces skidded default look)
function showActionNotification(msg)
  msg = tostring(msg or "")
  if msg == "" then return end
  local parent = HubGui or (LP and LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
  pcall(function()
    local old = parent:FindFirstChild("CalciumToastHost")
    if not old then
      old = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      old.Name = "CalciumToastHost"
      old.ResetOnSpawn = false
      old.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      old.DisplayOrder = 100000
      old.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
      old.Parent = parent
    end
    local host = old
    -- stack from top
    local y = 56
    for _, ch in ipairs(host:GetChildren()) do
      if ch:IsA("Frame") and ch.Name == "Toast" then
        y = math.max(y, ch.Position.Y.Offset + ch.Size.Y.Offset + 8)
      end
    end
    local toast = Instance.new("Frame")
    toast.Name = "Toast"
    toast.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    toast.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, y - 20)
    toast.Size = UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(#msg * 8 + 48, 160, 360), 0, 40)
    toast.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 10, 8)
    toast.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    toast.BorderSizePixel = 0
    toast.ZIndex = 200
    toast.Parent = host
    Instance.new("UICorner", toast).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", toast)
    st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 55)
    st.Thickness = 1.2
    st.Transparency = 0.35
    local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
    accent.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.6, 0)
    accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.2, 0)
    accent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60)
    accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
    accent.ZIndex = 201
    accent.Parent = toast
    Instance.new("UICorner", accent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextSize = 13
    lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 245, 255)
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.Text = msg
    lbl.ZIndex = 201
    lbl.Parent = toast
    toast.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.TextTransparency = 1
    TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, y),
      BackgroundTransparency = 0.08,
    }):Play()
    TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
    task.delay(2.1, function()
      if not toast or not toast.Parent then return end
      local tw = TweenService:Create(toast, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, y - 16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
      })
      TweenService:Create(lbl, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
      TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.2), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
      tw:Play()
      tw.Completed:Connect(function() pcall(function() toast:Destroy() end) end)
    end)
  end)
end
_G.showActionNotification = showActionNotification
function _safeNotify(msg)
  pcall(function() showActionNotification(msg) end)
end
function cacheIntroSong(option, allowDownload)
  if not option or not option.url or option.url == "" then return nil end
  local fileName = option.file or ("CalciumHubIntroSong_" .. tostring(option.name or "song") .. ".mp3")
  -- Mobile + multi-executor: resolve write/read/asset APIs
  local function getWrite()
    return writefile or (syn and syn.writefile) or writefile
  end
  local function getIsFile()
    return isfile or (syn and syn.isfile) or isfile
  end
  local function getAsset()
    return getcustomasset or getsynasset or (syn and syn.getcustomasset) or getcustomasset
  end
  local function loadExisting()
    if introSongCache[fileName] then return introSongCache[fileName] end
    local hasFile = false
    local isf = getIsFile()
    pcall(function() if isf then hasFile = isf(fileName) end end)
    if hasFile then
      local ga = getAsset()
      if ga then
        local ok, id = pcall(function() return ga(fileName) end)
        if ok and type(id) == "string" and #id > 0 then
          introSongCache[fileName] = id
          return id
        end
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local cached = loadExisting()
  if cached then return cached end
  if allowDownload == false then return nil end
  if introSongDownloading[fileName] then
    local waitStart = tick()
    while introSongDownloading[fileName] and tick() - waitStart < 20 do task.wait(0.05) end
    cached = loadExisting()
    if cached then return cached end
  end
  introSongDownloading[fileName] = true
  local wf = getWrite()
  local ga = getAsset()
  local ok = false
  if wf and ga then
    ok = pcall(function()
      local data = nil
      pcall(function() data = game:HttpGet(option.url) end)
      if (not data or #data == 0) and type(request) == "function" then
        local res = request({Url = option.url, Method = "GET"})
        if res and (res.Body or res.body) then data = res.Body or res.body end
      end
      if (not data or #data == 0) and syn and type(syn.request) == "function" then
        local res = syn.request({Url = option.url, Method = "GET"})
        if res and res.Body then data = res.Body end
      end
      if data and #data > 0 then
        wf(fileName, data)
        introSongCache[fileName] = ga(fileName)
      end
    end)
  end
  introSongDownloading[fileName] = nil
  if ok and introSongCache[fileName] then return introSongCache[fileName] end
  return loadExisting()
end
function preloadIntroSongs()
_G.playIntroMusic = playIntroMusic
_G.stopIntroPlayback = stopIntroPlayback
  task.spawn(function()
    cacheIntroSong(INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[selectedIntroMusic], true)
    for _, option in ipairs(INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS) do
      if option ~= INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[selectedIntroMusic] then
        cacheIntroSong(option, true)
        task.wait(0.05)
      end
    end
  end)
end
function makeIntroSoundFromId(soundId, name, parent)
  if not soundId then return nil end
  local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
  sound.Name = name or "CalciumHubIntroMusic"
  sound.Volume = 0.65
  sound.Looped = false
  sound.SoundId = soundId
  sound.Parent = parent or SoundService
  return sound
end
function createIntroSound(option, fileName, parent, allowDownload)
  if not option then return nil end
  local soundId = cacheIntroSong(option, allowDownload)
  if not soundId then return nil end
  return makeIntroSoundFromId(soundId, fileName, parent)
end
function previewIntroMusic(index)
  stopIntroPreview()
  stopIntroPlayback()
  if not INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[index] then _safeNotify("ADD SONG LINKS"); return end
  local token = introPreviewToken
  task.spawn(function()
    local option = INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[index]
    local sound = createIntroSound(option, "CalciumHubIntroPreview_" .. tostring(token), SoundService, true)
    if token ~= introPreviewToken then if sound then sound:Destroy() end; return end
    introPreviewSound = sound
    if not sound then _safeNotify("SONG LOADING..."); return end
    sound.TimePosition = 0
    pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
    task.delay(13, function() if token == introPreviewToken then stopIntroPreview() end end)
  end)
end
function playIntroMusic()
  stopIntroPreview()
  stopIntroPlayback()
  if not _introEnabled then return end
  local option = INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[selectedIntroMusic]
  if not option then return end
  -- Spotify mode: open Spotify library so user can pick / plays last radio track if any
  if option.kind == "spotify" then
    task.spawn(function()
      pcall(function()
        if type(_G.CalciumOpenSpotify) == "function" then
          _G.CalciumOpenSpotify()
        elseif type(_G.DelSpotifyToggle) == "function" then
          _G.DelSpotifyToggle()
        end
      end)
      -- Try play first saved radio track as intro bed
      pcall(function()
        local tracks = nil
        if type(_G.S) == "table" and type(_G.S.radioTracks) == "table" then tracks = _G.S.radioTracks end
        -- common spotify state tables
        if not tracks and type(_G.__OpiumRadio) == "table" then tracks = _G.__OpiumRadio end
      end)
    end)
    return
  end
  local token = introPlaybackToken
  -- Kick download immediately (mobile needs head-start before intro visuals)
  task.spawn(function() pcall(cacheIntroSong, option, true) end)
  task.spawn(function()
    -- Prefer already-cached; retry download a few times for mobile lag
    local sound = nil
    for attempt = 1, 4 do
      if token ~= introPlaybackToken or not _introEnabled then return end
      sound = createIntroSound(option, "CalciumDuelsIntroMusic_" .. tostring(token), SoundService, true)
      if sound then break end
      task.wait(0.35 * attempt)
    end
    if token ~= introPlaybackToken or not _introEnabled then if sound then pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end) end; return end
    if not sound then
      -- last-chance: try again with longer download window
      pcall(cacheIntroSong, option, true)
      task.wait(0.5)
      sound = createIntroSound(option, "CalciumDuelsIntroMusic_" .. tostring(token), SoundService, true)
    end
    introPlaybackSound = sound
    if not sound then
      pcall(function() if _safeNotify then _safeNotify("SONG LOADING...") end end)
      return
    end
    -- Mobile-safe: parent to Workspace if SoundService fails to play
    pcall(function()
      sound.Volume = 0.75
      sound.TimePosition = 0
      if not sound.Parent then sound.Parent = SoundService end
    end)
    local loadStart = tick()
    while sound and sound.Parent and not sound.IsLoaded and tick() - loadStart < 15 do
      task.wait(0.05)
    end
    if token ~= introPlaybackToken then return end
    local played = pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
    if not played or sound.Playing ~= true then
      pcall(function()
        sound.Parent = workspace
        sound:Play()
      end)
    end
    -- Ensure audible on delayed mobile load
    task.delay(0.4, function()
      if token == introPlaybackToken and sound and sound.Parent and not sound.IsPlaying then
        pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
      end
    end)
    task.delay(22, function() if token == introPlaybackToken then stopIntroPlayback() end end)
  end)
end
preloadIntroSongs()

-- Play custom sound from rbxassetid (music player)
_G.CalciumCustomSoundId = _G.CalciumCustomSoundId or ""
function _G.CalciumPlayCustomSoundId(id)
  id = tostring(id or ""):gsub("%s", "")
  id = id:gsub("rbxassetid://", "")
  if id == "" or not tonumber(id) then
    pcall(function() if _safeNotify then _safeNotify("Invalid sound asset id") end end)
    return
  end
  _G.CalciumCustomSoundId = id
  pcall(function()
    if type(stopMusicPlayer) == "function" then stopMusicPlayer() end
  end)
  local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
  sound.Name = "CalciumCustomSound"
  sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
  sound.Volume = (musicVolume or 0.5)
  sound.Looped = true
  sound.Parent = SoundService or game:GetService("SoundService")
  pcall(function()
    if _G._CalciumMusicSound and _G._CalciumMusicSound.Parent then
      _G._CalciumMusicSound:Stop()
      _G._CalciumMusicSound:Destroy()
    end
  end)
  _G._CalciumMusicSound = sound
  pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
  pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
end


selectedMusicSong = selectedMusicSong or 1
musicPlayerVolume = musicPlayerVolume or 1
-- Velocita' di riproduzione: 1 = normale, passo 0.1, da 0.1 a 2.
musicPlayerSpeed = musicPlayerSpeed or 1
musicAutoPlayNext = musicAutoPlayNext == true
musicShuffleEnabled = musicShuffleEnabled == true
musicLoopEnabled = musicLoopEnabled == true
_musicPlayerSound = nil
_musicPlayerToken = 0
musicSongCache = musicSongCache or {}
musicSongDownloading = musicSongDownloading or {}
-- Revisioni gia' ripulite in questa esecuzione, per non ricontrollare
-- il disco a ogni canzone caricata.
musicRevCleaned = musicRevCleaned or {}
_G.CalciumMusicRefreshUI = nil
_G.CalciumMusicCloseUI = nil

function getMusicSongName()
  local opt = MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[selectedMusicSong]
  return opt and opt.name or "No Song"
end
-- Indice casuale garantito diverso da quello corrente
function musicRandomIndex()
  local total = #MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS
  if total <= 1 then return 1 end
  local r = math.random(1, total - 1)
  if r >= selectedMusicSong then r = r + 1 end
  return r
end
function _musicRefreshUI()
  if _G.CalciumMusicRefreshUI then pcall(_G.CalciumMusicRefreshUI) end
end
function cacheMusicSong(option, allowDownload)
  if not option or not option.url or option.url == "" then return nil end
  if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then return nil end
  local baseName = option.file or ("CalciumHubMusic_" .. tostring(option.name or "song") .. ".mp3")
  -- REVISIONE DEL FILE.
  -- Se cambia il link di una canzone, chi ha gia' scaricato la vecchia se
  -- la ritrova in cache per sempre: il nome del file e' lo stesso e non c'e'
  -- modo di accorgersi che il contenuto non e' piu' quello giusto.
  -- Invece di storpiare il nome (o di scrivere una cancellazione una-tantum
  -- per quella singola canzone, che resterebbe li' come codice morto), la
  -- voce porta un campo "rev": alzarlo di 1 basta e avanza.
  --   rev assente o 1 -> CalciumHubMusic45.mp3
  --   rev = 2         -> CalciumHubMusic45_r2.mp3
  -- La prima volta che si tocca una canzone con rev > 1 si cancellano dal
  -- disco tutte le revisioni precedenti, quindi non si accumula niente.
  -- E' generico: la prossima volta che cambi un link non serve altro codice.
  local rev = math.max(math.floor(tonumber(option.rev) or 1), 1)
  local stem = baseName:gsub("%.mp3$", "")
  local fileName = (rev > 1) and (stem .. "_r" .. rev .. ".mp3") or baseName

  if rev > 1 and not musicRevCleaned[baseName] then
    musicRevCleaned[baseName] = true
    for r = 1, rev - 1 do
      local oldName = (r > 1) and (stem .. "_r" .. r .. ".mp3") or baseName
      musicSongCache[oldName] = nil
      pcall(function()
        if isfile and isfile(oldName) and delfile then delfile(oldName) end
      end)
    end
  end
  local function loadExisting()
    if musicSongCache[fileName] then return musicSongCache[fileName] end
    local hasFile = false
    pcall(function() hasFile = isfile and isfile(fileName) end)
    if hasFile then
      local ok = pcall(function() musicSongCache[fileName] = getcustomasset(fileName) end)
      if ok and musicSongCache[fileName] then return musicSongCache[fileName] end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local cached = loadExisting()
  if cached then return cached end
  if allowDownload == false then return nil end
  if musicSongDownloading[fileName] then
    local waitStart = tick()
    while musicSongDownloading[fileName] and tick() - waitStart < 15 do task.wait(0.05) end
    cached = loadExisting()
    if cached then return cached end
  end
  musicSongDownloading[fileName] = true
  local ok = pcall(function()
    local data = game:HttpGet(option.url)
    if data and #data > 0 then
      writefile(fileName, data)
      musicSongCache[fileName] = getcustomasset(fileName)
    end
  end)
  musicSongDownloading[fileName] = nil
  if ok and musicSongCache[fileName] then return musicSongCache[fileName] end
  return loadExisting()
end
function createMusicSound(option, name)
  if not option then return nil end
  local soundId = cacheMusicSong(option, true)
  if not soundId then return nil end
  local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
  sound.Name = name or "CalciumHubMusicPlayer"
  sound.Volume = musicPlayerVolume
  sound.PlaybackSpeed = musicPlayerSpeed
  sound.Looped = false
  sound.SoundId = soundId
  sound.Parent = SoundService
  return sound
end
-- Fade away identico a quello dell'intro
function fadeOutMusicSound(sound, dur)
  if not sound then return end
  dur = dur or 1.5
  pcall(function()
    TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0}):Play()
  end)
  task.delay(dur + 0.1, function()
    pcall(function()
      if sound and sound.Parent then
        sound:Stop()
        sound:Destroy()
      end
    end)
  end)
end
function stopMusicPlayback(fade)
  _musicPlayerToken = _musicPlayerToken + 1
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  _musicPlayerSound = nil
  if sound then
    if fade == false then
      pcall(function() sound:Stop(); sound:Destroy() end)
    else
      fadeOutMusicSound(sound, 1.5)
    end
  end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end
function playMusicSong(index)
  index = tonumber(index) or selectedMusicSong
  local total = #MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS
  if total <= 0 then return end
  if index < 1 then index = total end
  if index > total then index = 1 end
  if not MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[index] then return end
  selectedMusicSong = index
  stopMusicPlayback(true)
  local token = _musicPlayerToken
  _musicRefreshUI()
  task.spawn(function()
    local option = MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[index]
    local sound = createMusicSound(option, "CalciumHubMusicPlayer_" .. tostring(token))
    if token ~= _musicPlayerToken then
      if sound then pcall(function() sound:Destroy() end) end
      return
    end
    if not sound then _safeNotify("SONG FAILED"); return end
    sound.Volume = musicPlayerVolume
    sound.PlaybackSpeed = musicPlayerSpeed
    sound.TimePosition = 0
    _musicPlayerSound = sound
    local loadStart = tick()
    while sound and sound.Parent and not sound.IsLoaded and tick() - loadStart < 15 do task.wait(0.05) end
    if token ~= _musicPlayerToken then
      pcall(function() if sound and sound.Parent then sound:Destroy() end end)
      return
    end
    pcall(function() sound:Play() end)
    _musicRefreshUI()

    local endedConn
    endedConn = sound.Ended:Connect(function()
      if endedConn then pcall(function() endedConn:Disconnect() end) end
      if token ~= _musicPlayerToken then return end
      if musicLoopEnabled then
        playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong)
      elseif musicShuffleEnabled then
        playMusicSong(musicRandomIndex())
      elseif musicAutoPlayNext then
        playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong + 1)
      else
        stopMusicPlayback(false)
      end
    end)

    -- Fade away sul finale della traccia (come l'intro)
    task.spawn(function()
      while token == _musicPlayerToken and sound and sound.Parent do
        local len = sound.TimeLength
        if len and len > 1 then
          local remaining = len - sound.TimePosition
          if remaining <= 1.6 and sound.IsPlaying and sound:GetAttribute("_amFaded") ~= true then
            sound:SetAttribute("_amFaded", true)
            local d = math.clamp(remaining - 0.05, 0.2, 1.5)
            pcall(function()
              TweenService:Create(sound, TweenInfo.new(d, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Volume = 0}):Play()
            end)
          end
        end
        task.wait(0.1)
      end
    end)
  end)
end
function toggleMusicPause()
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if not sound or not sound.Parent then
    playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong)
    return
  end
  if sound.IsPlaying then
    pcall(function() sound:Pause() end)
  else
    pcall(function() sound:Resume() end)
  end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end
function musicNextSong()
  if musicShuffleEnabled then
    playMusicSong(musicRandomIndex())
  else
    playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong + 1)
  end
  saveCalciumConfig()
end
function musicPrevSong()
  if musicShuffleEnabled then
    playMusicSong(musicRandomIndex())
  else
    playMusicSong(selectedMusicSong - 1)
  end
  saveCalciumConfig()
end
function musicSeek(delta)
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if not sound or not sound.Parent then return end
  local len = sound.TimeLength or 0
  -- Il delta arriva in secondi "di ascolto": va convertito in secondi di
  -- traccia, altrimenti a 2x un salto di 10s ne farebbe 10 sul display ma
  -- 10 sulla traccia, cioe' 5 percepiti.
  local sp = tonumber(musicPlayerSpeed) or 1
  if sp <= 0 then sp = 1 end
  local newPos = sound.TimePosition + ((tonumber(delta) or 0) * sp)
  if newPos < 0 then newPos = 0 end
  if len > 0 and newPos > (len - 0.2) then newPos = math.max(len - 0.2, 0) end
  pcall(function() sound.TimePosition = newPos end)
  if len > 0 and (len - newPos) > 1.8 then
    pcall(function()
      sound:SetAttribute("_amFaded", false)
      sound.Volume = musicPlayerVolume
    end)
  end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end
-- Velocita': stesso schema del volume. Si arrotonda al decimo cosi' i
-- click di < e > non accumulano errore in virgola mobile (0.1 + 0.2 ...).
function setMusicSpeed(v)
  v = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 1) * 10 + 0.5) / 10, 0.1, 2)
  musicPlayerSpeed = v
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if sound and sound.Parent then
    pcall(function() sound.PlaybackSpeed = v end)
  end
  if saveCalciumConfig then pcall(saveCalciumConfig) end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end
function setMusicVolume(v)
  v = math.clamp(math.floor((tonumber(v) or 1) * 100 + 0.5) / 100, 0, 2)
  musicPlayerVolume = v
  local sound = _musicPlayerSound
  if sound and sound.Parent and sound:GetAttribute("_amFaded") ~= true then
    pcall(function() sound.Volume = v end)
  end
  if saveCalciumConfig then pcall(saveCalciumConfig) end
  _musicRefreshUI()
end

function udim2ToTable(u)
  return {xs = u.X.Scale, xo = u.X.Offset, ys = u.Y.Scale, yo = u.Y.Offset}
end
function tableToUDim2(t, fallback)
  if type(t) == "table" then
    return UDim2.new(tonumber(t.xs) or 0, tonumber(t.xo) or 0, tonumber(t.ys) or 0, tonumber(t.yo) or 0)
  end
  return fallback
end
function collectCalciumMobileButtonPositions()
  local out = {}
  for key, entry in pairs(_G.CalciumMobileButtonRefs or {}) do
    local holder = entry and entry.holder
    if holder then out[key] = udim2ToTable(holder.Position) end
  end
  if next(out) == nil and type(_G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions) == "table" then
    return _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions
  end
  _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions = out
  return out
end
function keyToString(key)
  if not key then return "None" end
  if key == "MB3" then return "MB3" end
  return tostring(key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "")
end
function stringToKeyCode(value)
  if type(value) ~= "string" or value == "" or value == "None" then return nil end
  if value == "MB3" then return "MB3" end
  local ok, key = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[value] end)
  return ok and key or nil
end
function keybindsToTable()
  local out = {}
  for keyId in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    out[keyId] = keyToString(speedKeybinds[keyId])
  end
  for keyId, key in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
    out[keyId] = keyToString(key)
  end
  return out
end
function collectCalciumKeybindConfig()
  return {
    keybinds = keybindsToTable(),
    tpDownKeybind = keyToString(tpDownKeybind),
  }
end
function applySavedKeybinds(t)
  if type(t) ~= "table" then return end
  -- Migrate Auto Left's saved key only if a dedicated Auto Play key is absent.
  local previousAutoPlay = t.AutoPlay
  if previousAutoPlay == nil then previousAutoPlay = t.AutoLeft end
  for keyId in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    local saved = (keyId == "AutoPlay") and previousAutoPlay or t[keyId]
    if saved ~= nil then
      speedKeybinds[keyId] = stringToKeyCode(saved)
    end
  end
  speedKeybinds.AutoLeft = nil
  speedKeybinds.AutoRight = nil
end
function applyDefaultCalciumKeybinds()
  for keyId, key in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    speedKeybinds[keyId] = key
  end
  tpDownKeybind = DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND
end

_G.CalciumLookAtEnabled = false
_G.CalciumLookAtRadius  = _G.CalciumLookAtRadius  or 20

_G._CalciumLookAt = _G._CalciumLookAt or {}
do
  local S = _G._CalciumLookAt
  local hiddenLAE    = workspace:FindFirstChild("Terrain") or workspace
  S.externalPart     = nil
  S.alignObj         = nil
  S.alignConn        = nil
  S.diedConn         = nil

  local function _laeGetClosest()
    local char  = LP.Character
    local myHRP = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return nil end
    local radius = tonumber(_G.CalciumLookAtRadius) or 20
    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if player ~= LP then
        local tc = player.Character
        if tc then
          local tHRP = tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local tHum = tc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
          if tHRP and tHum and tHum.Health > 0 then
            -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
            -- Nel void la distanza si misura sulla posizione fantasma,
            -- altrimenti il nemico esce dal raggio e non lo si aggancia.
            local tPos = tHRP.Position
            if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
              tPos = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posForPart(tHRP, tPos)
            end
            local dist = (myHRP.Position - tPos).Magnitude
            -- <<< ANTI VOID END
            if dist <= radius and dist < closestDist then
              closestDist = dist
              closest = tHRP
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return closest
  end
  local function _laeStop()
    if S.alignConn  then S.alignConn:Disconnect();  S.alignConn  = nil end
    if S.diedConn   then S.diedConn:Disconnect();   S.diedConn   = nil end
    for _, obj in ipairs(hiddenLAE:GetChildren()) do
      if obj.Name:find("LAEAnchor_") or obj.Name == "LAEOrientation" then
        obj:Destroy()
      end
    end
    S.externalPart = nil
    S.alignObj     = nil
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if hum then hum.AutoRotate = true end
    end
  end
  local function _laeStart()
    _laeStop()
    local char  = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local myHRP = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum   = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not myHRP or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    S.diedConn = hum.Died:Connect(function() _laeStop() end)

    local ep = Instance.new("Part")
    ep.Name = "LAEAnchor_" .. tostring(math.random(1000,9999))
    ep.Size = Vector3.new(1,1,1)
    ep.Transparency = 1
    ep.CanCollide = false
    ep.Anchored = true
    ep.CFrame = myHRP.CFrame
    ep.Parent = hiddenLAE
    S.externalPart = ep

    local attExt   = Instance.new("Attachment", ep)
    local attLocal = myHRP:FindFirstChild("RootAttachment")
    if not attLocal then
      attLocal      = Instance.new("Attachment")
      attLocal.Name = "RootAttachment"
      attLocal.Parent = myHRP
    end
    local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    ao.Name               = "LAEOrientation"
    ao.Mode               = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.TwoAttachment
    ao.Attachment0        = attLocal
    ao.Attachment1        = attExt
    ao.MaxTorque          = 999999
    ao.MaxAngularVelocity = 999999
    ao.Responsiveness     = 200
    ao.Enabled            = false
    ao.Parent             = hiddenLAE
    S.alignObj = ao

    S.alignConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      local cc  = LP.Character
      local cHRP = cc and cc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local cHum = cc and cc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not cHRP or not cHum or cHum.Health <= 0 then _laeStop(); return end
      local tHRP = _laeGetClosest()
      if tHRP and S.externalPart and S.alignObj then
        cHum.AutoRotate = false
        S.alignObj.Enabled = true
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        local _laePos = tHRP.Position
        if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
          _laePos = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posForPart(tHRP, _laePos)
        end
        local flat = Vector3.new(_laePos.X, cHRP.Position.Y, _laePos.Z)
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END
        S.externalPart.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cHRP.Position, flat)
      else
        cHum.AutoRotate = true
        if S.alignObj then S.alignObj.Enabled = false end
      end
    end)
  end
  function _G.CalciumToggleLookAt(state)
    if state ~= nil then
      _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled = state
    else
      _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled = not _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled
    end
    if _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled then _laeStart() else _laeStop() end
  end
  function _G.CalciumStopLookAt() _laeStop() end
  function _G.CalciumStartLookAt() _laeStart() end

  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    _laeStop()
    if _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled then
      local hrp = newChar:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
      local hum2 = newChar:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
      if hrp and hum2 then task.wait(0.1); _laeStart() end
    end
  end)

  LP.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() _laeStop() end)
end

function saveCalciumConfig()
  if not canSaveConfig then return end
  pcall(function()
    _calcium_writefile(CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(collectCalciumConfig()))
    _calcium_writefile(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode(collectCalciumKeybindConfig()))
  end)
end

-- Config writes and reads share the same primary/fallback locations.
do
  local persistenceSession = _G.CalciumConfigSession
  local pending, revision, attempts = false, 0, 0
  local function timestamp()
    local ok, value = pcall(function() return DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis end)
    return ok and value or math.floor(os.time() * 1000 + (os.clock() % 1) * 1000)
  end
  local function appendFunction(list, fn)
    if type(fn) == "function" then
      for _, existing in ipairs(list) do
        if existing == fn then return end
      end
      table.insert(list, fn)
    end
  end
  local function fileApiCandidates(name, cached)
    local list = {}
    appendFunction(list, cached)
    local ok, direct = pcall(function() return _G[name] end)
    if ok then appendFunction(list, direct) end
    if name == "readfile" then appendFunction(list, readfile) end
    if name == "writefile" then appendFunction(list, writefile) end
    if name == "makefolder" then appendFunction(list, makefolder) end
    local s = syn
    if type(s) == "table" then appendFunction(list, s[name]) end
    if type(getgenv) == "function" then
      pcall(function()
        local env = getgenv()
        if type(env) == "table" then appendFunction(list, env[name]) end
      end)
    end
    return list
  end
  local function decodeSavedConfig(reader, path)
    local ok, raw = pcall(reader, path)
    if not ok or type(raw) ~= "string" then return nil end
    local decodeOK, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw) end)
    if decodeOK and type(data) == "table" then return data end
    return nil
  end
  _G.CalciumReadSavedConfig = function(filename)
    local readers = fileApiCandidates("readfile", _calcium_readfile)
    if #readers == 0 then
      _G.CalciumConfigReadError = "Executor has no readfile API; cross-execution persistence is unavailable"
      return nil
    end
    local newest, newestStamp
    local paths = {filename, "YZNDuels/" .. filename}
    for _, path in ipairs(paths) do
      for _, reader in ipairs(readers) do
        local data = decodeSavedConfig(reader, path)
        if data then
          local stamp = tonumber(data._savedAt) or 0
          if not newest or stamp > (newestStamp or 0) then
            newest, newestStamp = data, stamp
          end
        end
      end
    end
    if not newest then
      _G.CalciumConfigReadError = "No readable saved config found for " .. tostring(filename)
    else
      _G.CalciumConfigReadError = nil
    end
    return newest
  end
  local function sanitizeConfigValue(value, seen, depth)
    local kind = type(value)
    if kind == "nil" or kind == "boolean" or kind == "string" then return value end
    if kind == "number" then
      if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then return nil end
      return value
    end
    if kind ~= "table" or depth > 20 then return nil end
    if seen[value] then return nil end
    seen[value] = true

    local maxIndex, isArray = 0, true
    for key in pairs(value) do
      if type(key) ~= "number" or key < 1 or key % 1 ~= 0 then
        isArray = false
      elseif key > maxIndex then
        maxIndex = key
      end
    end

    local out = {}
    if isArray then
      for i = 1, maxIndex do
        local cleaned = sanitizeConfigValue(value[i], seen, depth + 1)
        if cleaned ~= nil then out[#out + 1] = cleaned else out[#out + 1] = false end
      end
    else
      for key, item in pairs(value) do
        local cleanKey
        if type(key) == "string" then cleanKey = key
        elseif type(key) == "number" then cleanKey = tostring(key) end
        if cleanKey then
          local cleaned = sanitizeConfigValue(item, seen, depth + 1)
          if cleaned ~= nil then out[cleanKey] = cleaned end
        end
      end
    end
    seen[value] = nil
    return out
  end
  local function writePayload(filename, payload)
    local writers = fileApiCandidates("writefile", _calcium_writefile)
    if #writers == 0 then
      _G.CalciumConfigSaveError = "This executor has no writefile API; cross-execution persistence is unavailable"
      return false, _G.CalciumConfigSaveError
    end
    local paths = {filename, "YZNDuels/" .. filename}
    for pathIndex, path in ipairs(paths) do
      if pathIndex == 2 then
        local folders = fileApiCandidates("makefolder", nil)
        for _, makeDir in ipairs(folders) do pcall(makeDir, "YZNDuels") end
      end
      for _, writer in ipairs(writers) do
        local ok, result = pcall(writer, path, payload)
        if ok and result ~= false then
          _calcium_writefile = writer
          return true
        end
        _G.CalciumConfigSaveError = tostring(ok and "writefile returned false" or result)
      end
    end
    return false, _G.CalciumConfigSaveError or "Every config write attempt failed"
  end
  local flush
  flush = function()
    if _G.CalciumConfigSession ~= persistenceSession then return end
    local targetRevision = revision
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
      local stamp = timestamp()
      local configRaw = collectCalciumConfig()
      local keysRaw = collectCalciumKeybindConfig()
      if type(configRaw) ~= "table" or type(keysRaw) ~= "table" then
        error("Config collector did not return tables")
      end
      local config = sanitizeConfigValue(configRaw, {}, 0)
      local keys = sanitizeConfigValue(keysRaw, {}, 0)
      if type(config) ~= "table" or type(keys) ~= "table" then
        error("Config could not be converted to JSON-safe tables")
      end
      config._savedAt, keys._savedAt = stamp, stamp
      local encodeOK, configJSON = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(config) end)
      if not encodeOK or type(configJSON) ~= "string" then error("Main config JSON encoding failed: " .. tostring(configJSON)) end
      local keyEncodeOK, keysJSON = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(keys) end)
      if not keyEncodeOK or type(keysJSON) ~= "string" then error("Keybind config JSON encoding failed: " .. tostring(keysJSON)) end
      local mainOk, mainErr = writePayload(CONFIG_FILE, configJSON)
      local keysOk, keysErr = writePayload(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE, keysJSON)
      if not mainOk or not keysOk then error(tostring(mainErr or keysErr)) end
    end)
    pending = false
    if _G.CalciumConfigSession ~= persistenceSession then return end
    if ok then
      attempts, _G.CalciumConfigSaveError = 0, nil
      if revision ~= targetRevision then pending = true; task.delay(0.15, flush) end
    else
      _G.CalciumConfigSaveError = tostring(err)
      attempts = attempts + 1
      if attempts < 3 then pending = true; task.delay(attempts * 0.3, flush) end
    end
  end
  saveCalciumConfig = function()
    if _G.CalciumConfigSession ~= persistenceSession then return end
    revision = revision + 1
    if pending then return end
    attempts, pending = 0, true
    task.delay(0.15, flush)
  end
  _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow = function()
    if _G.CalciumConfigSession ~= persistenceSession then return end
    revision = revision + 1
    pending = true
    attempts = 0
    flush()
  end
end

-- Fallback persistence for toggles that do not explicitly request a save.
-- Run only once per execution and stop when the script is replaced.
do
  local sessionToken = {}
  _G._CalciumAutosaveToken = sessionToken
  task.spawn(function()
    while _G.CalciumRunning and _G._CalciumAutosaveToken == sessionToken do
      task.wait(12)
      if _G.CalciumRunning and _G._CalciumAutosaveToken == sessionToken
         and type(saveCalciumConfig) == "function" then
        pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
      end
    end
  end)
end

-- ========== STRETCH REZ (GLOBALE) ==========
stretchPresets = {
    ["0.8"] = CFrame.new(0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,0.45,0, 0,0,1),
    ["1.0"] = CFrame.new(0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,0.65,0, 0,0,1),
    ["1.2"] = CFrame.new(0,0,0, 1,0,0, 0,0.82,0, 0,0,1),
}
stretchPresetMapping = {
    ["X1"]   = nil,
    ["X1.5"] = "1.2",
    ["X2"]   = "1.0",
    ["X3"]   = "0.8",
}
stretchPresetOrder = {"X1", "X1.5", "X2", "X3"}
stretchCurrentIndex = 1          -- reso globale (non local)
stretchEnabled = false           -- reso globale
currentStretch = nil
stretchRezConn = nil

local function applyStretchPreset(index)
    -- Se il tracker è attivo, non siamo in fase di forzatura (lock) e l'utente sceglie un valore diverso da X1,
    -- aggiorna l'indice salvato in modo che il salvataggio usi quello.
    if not _G._calciumStretchUILock and _G.CalciumTrackerActive then
        _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex = index
    end
    stretchCurrentIndex = index
    local label = stretchPresetOrder[index]
    local key = stretchPresetMapping[label]
    if key then
        currentStretch = stretchPresets[key]
        stretchEnabled = true
    else
        currentStretch = nil
        stretchEnabled = false
    end
    if stretchRezConn then stretchRezConn:Disconnect(); stretchRezConn = nil end
    if stretchEnabled then
        stretchRezConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not stretchEnabled or not currentStretch then
                if stretchRezConn then stretchRezConn:Disconnect(); stretchRezConn = nil end
                return
            end
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            if cam and currentStretch then
                cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame * currentStretch
            end
        end)
    end
    if not _G._calciumStretchUILock and _G.CalciumRefreshStretchSelector then
        _G.CalciumRefreshStretchSelector()
    end
end
local function cycleStretch(direction)
    local newIdx = stretchCurrentIndex + direction
    if newIdx < 1 then newIdx = #stretchPresetOrder end
    if newIdx > #stretchPresetOrder then newIdx = 1 end
    applyStretchPreset(newIdx)
end
local function setStretchEnabled(on)
    if on then
        applyStretchPreset(stretchCurrentIndex == 1 and 2 or stretchCurrentIndex)
    else
        applyStretchPreset(1)
    end
end
-- Esponiamo le funzioni per usarle nella UI
_G.StretchRez = {
    apply = applyStretchPreset,
    cycle = cycleStretch,
    setEnabled = setStretchEnabled,
    getIndex = function() return stretchCurrentIndex end,
    isEnabled = function() return stretchEnabled end,
    getOrder = function() return stretchPresetOrder end,
}

function loadCalciumConfig()
  local data = _G.CalciumReadSavedConfig(CONFIG_FILE)
  if type(data) ~= "table" then
    _G.CalciumAutoTPSavedPreference = false
    _G.CalciumAutoTPUserDisabled = true
    autoTPEnabled = false
    return
  end
  savedConfig = data
  local keybindData = _G.CalciumReadSavedConfig(KEYBINDS_CONFIG_FILE)
  if type(keybindData) ~= "table" then keybindData = data end
  if tonumber(data._savedAt) and tonumber(keybindData._savedAt)
     and tonumber(data._savedAt) > tonumber(keybindData._savedAt) then
    keybindData = data
  end
  savedMainPositionTable = data.mainPosition
  savedMiniPositionTable = nil
  savedStealBarPositionTable = type(data.stealBarPosition) == "table" and data.stealBarPosition or nil
  _G.CalciumGuiLocked = data.guiLocked == true
  _G.CalciumHideMobileButtons = data.hideMobileButtons == true
  _G.CalciumMobileHideList = (type(data.mobileHideList) == "table") and data.mobileHideList or {}
  _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale = math.clamp(tonumber(data.calciumMobileButtonScale) or tonumber(_G.CalciumMobileButtonScale) or 0.75, 0.30, 1.35)
  _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions = type(data.mobileButtonPositions) == "table" and data.mobileButtonPositions or {}
  if not _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions.autoPlay then
    _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions.autoPlay = _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions.autoLeft
  end
  _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions.autoLeft = nil
  _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions.autoRight = nil
  applySavedKeybinds(keybindData.keybinds)
  if keybindData.tpDownKeybind ~= nil then
    if tostring(keybindData.tpDownKeybind) == "None" then
      tpDownKeybind = nil
    else
      tpDownKeybind = stringToKeyCode(keybindData.tpDownKeybind) or DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND
    end
  end
  for keyId, defaultKey in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    local savedKeys = keybindData and keybindData.keybinds
    if (not savedKeys or savedKeys[keyId] == nil) and speedKeybinds[keyId] == nil then
      speedKeybinds[keyId] = defaultKey
    end
  end
  NS = tonumber(data.NS) or NS
  CS = tonumber(data.CS) or CS
  LAGGER_SPEED = tonumber(data.LAGGER_SPEED) or LAGGER_SPEED
  LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED = tonumber(data.LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) or LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED
  currentSpeedMode = data.currentSpeedMode or currentSpeedMode
  if currentSpeedMode ~= "Normal" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Carry" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger Carry" then currentSpeedMode = "Normal" end
  autoCarrySpeedEnabled = data.autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true
  _G._CalciumAutoCarryMode = (data.autoCarryMode == "SOFT") and "SOFT" or "NORMAL"
  _G.CalciumAutoTPSavedPreference = data.autoTPEnabled == true
  autoTPEnabled = _G.CalciumAutoTPSavedPreference
  _G.CalciumAutoTPUserDisabled = not autoTPEnabled
  _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreWanted = false
  autoTPHeight = tonumber(data.autoTPHeight) or autoTPHeight
  -- >>> TP DOWN METHOD <<<
  local _tpm = data.tpDownMethod
  -- V2 and legacy SLOW/ZIGZAG all map to slowfall V2
  if _tpm == "V2" or _tpm == "SLOW" or _tpm == "ZIGZAG" then
    _G._CalciumTPDownMethod = "V2"
  else
    _G._CalciumTPDownMethod = "NORMAL"
  end
  infJumpEnabled = data.infJumpEnabled == true
  if data.infJumpMode == "MANUAL" then infJumpMode = "MANUAL" else infJumpMode = "HOLD" end
  _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled = data.lookAtEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumLookAtRadius  = math.clamp(tonumber(data.lookAtRadius) or 20, 1, 200)
  antiRagdollEnabled = data.antiRagdollEnabled == true
  _G._CalciumAntiRagdollMode = (data.antiRagdollMode == "V2") and "V2" or "V1"
  antiDieEnabled = data.antiDieEnabled == true
  _G._CalciumAntiDieUserWanted = antiDieEnabled
  selectedDropMode = data.selectedDropMode or selectedDropMode
  _G.CalciumInstantResetVersion = math.clamp(tonumber(data.instantResetVersion) or 1, 1, 2)
  if _G.CalciumAfterDrop then
    _G.CalciumAfterDrop.enabled = data.afterDropEnabled == true
    local action = data.afterDropAction
    _G.CalciumAfterDrop.action = (action == "TPBAT") and "TPBAT" or "AIMBOT"
  end
  selectedDropMode = "Stand Still"
  selectedStealMode = data.selectedStealMode or selectedStealMode
  if selectedStealMode ~= "Semi" and selectedStealMode ~= "NormalV2" then selectedStealMode = "Normal" end
  _G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled = false -- permanently removed
  if type(data.radiusCircleColor) == "table" then
    _G.CalciumRadiusCircleColor = Color3.fromRGB(
      math.clamp(tonumber(data.radiusCircleColor[1]) or 230, 0, 255),
      math.clamp(tonumber(data.radiusCircleColor[2]) or 230, 0, 255),
      math.clamp(tonumber(data.radiusCircleColor[3]) or 230, 0, 255)
    )
  end
  selectedSemiMode = data.selectedSemiMode or selectedSemiMode
  selectedNormalMode = data.selectedNormalMode or selectedNormalMode
  if selectedNormalMode ~= "V2" then selectedNormalMode = "V1" end
  if selectedSemiMode ~= "V2" and selectedSemiMode ~= "V3" then selectedSemiMode = "V1" end
  autoStealEnabled = data.autoStealEnabled == true

  if type(data.hornEnabled) == "table" then
    _G.CalciumHornEnabled = {
      data.hornEnabled[1] == true,
      data.hornEnabled[2] == true,
      data.hornEnabled[3] == true,
    }
    task.defer(function()
      for i, on in ipairs(_G.CalciumHornEnabled) do
        if on then pcall(applyHornIndex, i, true) break end
      end
    end)
  elseif data.poisonHornsEnabled == true then
    _G.CalciumPoisonHornsOn = true
    task.defer(function() pcall(applyHornIndex, 2, true) end)
  end

  _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.enabled = data.syncAfterHitEnabled == true
  if type(data.calciumStealRadii) == "table" then
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal = tonumber(data.calciumStealRadii.Normal) or _G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal or 62
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi = tonumber(data.calciumStealRadii.Semi) or _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi or 60
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius = tonumber(data.calciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius) or _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius = tonumber(data.calciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius or 8
  end
  -- Fix: aggiorna il corretto slot di StealRadii in base al modo selezionato
  local _loadedRadius = tonumber(data.autoStealRadius) or autoStealRadius
  if not (type(data.calciumStealRadii) == "table") then
    -- Config vecchio senza calciumStealRadii: usa autoStealRadius per il modo corretto
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
      _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi = _loadedRadius
    else
      _G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal = _loadedRadius
    end
  end
  autoStealRadius = _loadedRadius
  -- Ripristina valori semi steal
  -- (CalciumSemiSteal non è ancora inizializzato qui, li salviamo in pending)
  _G._CalciumSemiStealPending = {
    autoGrabStopTime       = math.clamp(tonumber(data.semiAutoGrabStopTime) or 1.29, 0.01, 1.29),
    autoGrabStopPercent    = math.clamp(tonumber(data.semiAutoGrabStopPercent) or 75, 1, 100),
    autoGrabSetDelayRadius = tonumber(data.semiAutoGrabDelayRadius) or 8,
  }
  if _G.CalciumSemiSteal then
    local A = _G.CalciumSemiSteal
    A.autoGrabStopTime       = _G._CalciumSemiStealPending.autoGrabStopTime
    A.autoGrabStopPercent    = _G._CalciumSemiStealPending.autoGrabStopPercent
    A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = _G._CalciumSemiStealPending.autoGrabSetDelayRadius
    A.autoGrabStopEnabled    = true
  end
  -- Applica i radii SemiV2 all'engine se già inizializzato
  if _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal then
    local B = _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal
    B.radius     = _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius     or B.radius     or 60
    B.semiRadius = _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius or B.semiRadius or 8
  end
  if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal = _G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal or autoStealRadius or 62
    autoStealRadius = _G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal
  elseif selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
    -- In Semi V2 autoStealRadius non viene usato per il radius del loop; usa SemiV2Radius
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius = _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60
    autoStealRadius = _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius
  else
    _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi = _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi or autoStealRadius or 60
    autoStealRadius = _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi
  end
  selectedAimbotMode = data.selectedAimbotMode or selectedAimbotMode
  -- compatibilita' con le config salvate prima della rinomina in Bat Aimbot V1/V2
  -- V2 / bypass removed — force V1 only
  selectedAimbotMode = "V1"
  AIMBOT_SPEED = tonumber(data.AIMBOT_SPEED) or AIMBOT_SPEED
  LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED = tonumber(data.LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED
  local _v2Spd = data.BAT_AIMBOT_V2_SPEED or data.ANTI_BYPASS_AIMBOT_SPEED
  local _v2Lag = data.BAT_AIMBOT_V2_LAGGER_SPEED or data.ANTI_BYPASS_LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED
  _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Speed = tonumber(_v2Spd) or _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Speed or 58
  if _v2Lag == nil or tonumber(_v2Lag) == 58 then
    _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed = 40
  else
    _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed = tonumber(_v2Lag) or 40
  end
  TP_BAT_SPEED = tonumber(data.TP_BAT_SPEED) or TP_BAT_SPEED or 58
  autoSwingEnabled = data.autoSwingEnabled == true
  mirrorTPDownEnabled = data.mirrorTPDownEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn = data.normalAimbotEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = data.batAimbotV2Enabled == true or (data.batAimbotV2Enabled == nil and data.antiBypassAimbotEnabled == true)
  -- >>> AIMBOT CHASE MODE BEGIN
  _G._CalciumAimbotChase = _G._CalciumAimbotChase or { V1 = "NORMAL", V2 = "NORMAL" }
  _G._CalciumAimbotChase.V1 = (data.aimbotChaseV1 == "BYPASS") and "BYPASS" or "NORMAL"
  _G._CalciumAimbotChase.V2 = (data.aimbotChaseV2 == "BYPASS") and "BYPASS" or "NORMAL"
  -- <<< AIMBOT CHASE MODE END
  tpBatAutoSwingEnabled = data.tpBatAutoSwingEnabled == true
  -- Il do-block TP Bat viene eseguito DOPO loadCalciumConfig, quindi il bridge
  -- _G._CalciumSetTPBatCameraLock non esiste ancora qui. Usiamo un pending value
  -- (stesso pattern di _CalciumSemiStealPending) che il do-block consuma all'avvio.
  if _G._CalciumSetTPBatCameraLock then
    _G._CalciumSetTPBatCameraLock(data.tpBatCameraLockEnabled == true)
  else
    _G._CalciumTPBatCameraLockPending = data.tpBatCameraLockEnabled == true
  end
  _G.CalciumTPBatOn = data.tpBatEnabled == true
  -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS <<<
  _G.CalciumTPBatVersion = math.clamp(tonumber(data.tpBatVersion) or 1, 1, 2)
  batCounterEnabled = data.batCounterEnabled == true
  if data.batCounterMode == "V2" then batCounterMode = "V2" else batCounterMode = "V1" end
  medCounterEnabled = data.medCounterEnabled == true

  _G.CalciumAntiBatEnabled = false -- removed

  antiKickEnabled = data.safeMode == true
  espEnabled = data.espEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumESPOn = espEnabled   -- >>> ANTI VOID <<<
  showTrackerEnabled = data.showTrackerEnabled == true
  ragdollCountdownEnabled = data.ragdollCountdownEnabled == true
  fpsBoostEnabled = data.fpsBoostEnabled == true
  antiLagVisualEnabled = data.antiLagVisualEnabled == true
  if data.ragdollStealEnabled ~= nil then ragdollStealEnabled = data.ragdollStealEnabled == true end
  if data.galaxySkyBrightEnabled ~= nil then galaxySkyBrightEnabled = data.galaxySkyBrightEnabled == true end
  vividGraphicsEnabled = data.vividGraphicsEnabled == true
  if data.vividSaturation then _G._CalciumVivid.saturation = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividSaturation) or 0.6, 0, 2) end
  if data.vividBloomIntensity then _G._CalciumVivid.bloomIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividBloomIntensity) or 0.8, 0, 3) end
  if data.vividBloomSize then _G._CalciumVivid.bloomSize = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividBloomSize) or 24, 1, 56) end
  if data.vividDofFocus then _G._CalciumVivid.dofFocus = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividDofFocus) or 25, 1, 100) end
  if data.vividSunIntensity then _G._CalciumVivid.sunIntensity = math.clamp(tonumber(data.vividSunIntensity) or 0.2, 0, 1) end
  xrayEnabled = data.xrayEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumBrainrotXRayEnabled = data.brainrotXRayEnabled == true   -- >>> BRAINROT X-RAY <<<
  highPingWarningEnabled = data.highPingWarningEnabled == true
  _G._CalciumKickWarn.enabled = data.kickWarningEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumUAKEnabled = data.ultimateAntiKick == true
  fovEnabled = data.fovEnabled == true
  fovValue = tonumber(data.fovValue) or fovValue
  noCamCollisionEnabled = data.noCamCollisionEnabled == true
  motionBlurEnabled = data.motionBlurEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = data.noPlayerCollisionEnabled == true
  unwalkEnabled = data.unwalkEnabled == true
  skyTheme = (type(data.skyTheme) == "string" and data.skyTheme) or skyTheme
  -- Migrazione: vecchio preset "Tech" rinominato in "Cyber"
  if skyTheme == "Tech" then skyTheme = "Cyber" end
    -- Stretch Rez state
  do
      local savedIdx = data.stretchCurrentIndex and math.max(1, math.min(data.stretchCurrentIndex, #stretchPresetOrder)) or 1
      local savedOn  = data.stretchEnabled == true
      -- >>> STRETCH REZ <<< il valore scelto nella tendina: X1 non e' una
      -- scelta possibile, quindi si ricade su X1.5.
      _G.CalciumStretchPick = (savedIdx > 1) and savedIdx or 2
      -- Ripristina l'indice e lo stato (X1 = off, qualsiasi altro = on)
      if savedOn and savedIdx ~= 1 then
          applyStretchPreset(savedIdx)
      else
          stretchCurrentIndex = savedIdx
          stretchEnabled = false
      end
  end
  autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
  autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
  if data and data.autoPlayFullEnabled ~= nil then
    _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled = data.autoPlayFullEnabled and true or false
    autoPlayFullEnabled = _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled
  end
  -- >>> AUTO PLAY <<< si mette da parte quello che era stato salvato; a
  -- decidere se vale ancora (posto giusto, stesso server) ci pensa
  -- restore(), che e' dove sta tutta la regola.
  _G._AmbAutoPlaySavedJob  = (type(data.autoPlayJob) == "string" and data.autoPlayJob ~= "") and data.autoPlayJob or nil
  _G._AmbAutoPlaySavedSide = (data.autoPlaySide == "L" or data.autoPlaySide == "R") and data.autoPlaySide or nil
  if _G.CalciumAutoPlay and _G.CalciumAutoPlay.restore then
    pcall(_G.CalciumAutoPlay.restore)
  end
  headlessEnabled = data.headlessEnabled == true
  korbloxEnabled = data.korbloxEnabled == true

  -- >>> ANTI TP BAT <<<
  _G.CalciumAntiTPBatEnabled        = data.antiTPBatEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumAntiTPBatSpam           = data.antiTPBatSpam == true
  _G.CalciumAntiTPBatVersion        = math.clamp(tonumber(data.antiTPBatVersion) or 1, 1, 3)
  _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled         = data.antiVoidEnabled == true   -- >>> ANTI VOID <<<
  -- >>> RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK BEGIN
  -- Qui si legge soltanto: il modulo non esiste ancora a questo punto del
  -- file, l'avvio avviene subito dopo la sua definizione.
  _G.CalciumRainbowJoystickEnabled  = data.rainbowJoystickEnabled == true
  -- <<< RAINBOW MOBILE JOYSTICK END
  _G.CalciumRainbowToolsEnabled     = data.rainbowToolsEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumTransparentToolsEnabled = data.transparentToolsEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumCustomToolsEnabled      = data.customToolsEnabled == true
  _G.CalciumCustomToolSkins = _G.CalciumCustomToolSkins or {}
  _G.CalciumCustomToolSkins.Bat    = data.customToolSkinBat or "DiamondSword"
  _G.CalciumCustomToolSkins.Medusa = data.customToolSkinMedusa or "GoldenDesertEagle" 
  _G.CalciumCustomSoundsEnabled     = false -- feature removed

  if type(data.avatarChanger) == "table" then
    -- _G._CalciumAvatarChanger non esiste ancora (viene creato dopo),
    -- salviamo i dati in pending e li applichiamo all'inizializzazione del blocco
    _G._CalciumAvatarChangerPending = data.avatarChanger
  end
  selectedAnimPackIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.selectedAnimPackIndex) or 1, 1, 10)
  if data.customSoundId then _G.CalciumCustomSoundId = tostring(data.customSoundId) end
  _animPackSavedIndex = math.clamp(tonumber(data.animPackSavedIndex) or 1, 1, 7)
  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  if type(data.customAnimIds) == "table" then
    for _, slot in ipairs(_G.CalciumCustomAnimSlots) do
      local v = data.customAnimIds[slot]
      -- Solo cifre: qualsiasi altra cosa e' spazzatura e va scartata.
      _G.CalciumCustomAnimIds[slot] =
        (type(v) == "string" and v:match("^%d+$")) and v or ""
    end
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END
  if data.introEnabled ~= nil then _introEnabled = data.introEnabled == true end
  do
    local gt = tostring(data.guiType or data.GuiType or _G.CalciumGuiType or "Normal")
    if gt ~= "Phone" and gt ~= "Pumpkin" and gt ~= "Normal" then gt = "Normal" end
    _G.CalciumGuiType = gt
  end
  if data.selectedIntroMusic and INTRO_MUSIC_OPTIONS[data.selectedIntroMusic] then selectedIntroMusic = data.selectedIntroMusic end
  if data.musicSelectedSong and MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS and MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS[data.musicSelectedSong] then selectedMusicSong = data.musicSelectedSong end
  if data.musicVolume ~= nil then musicPlayerVolume = math.clamp(tonumber(data.musicVolume) or 1, 0, 2) end
  if data.musicSpeed ~= nil then musicPlayerSpeed = math.clamp(tonumber(data.musicSpeed) or 1, 0.1, 2) end
  if data.musicAutoPlayNext ~= nil then musicAutoPlayNext = data.musicAutoPlayNext == true end
  if data.musicShuffleEnabled ~= nil then musicShuffleEnabled = data.musicShuffleEnabled == true end
  if data.musicLoopEnabled ~= nil then musicLoopEnabled = data.musicLoopEnabled == true end
  if autoLeftEnabled and autoRightEnabled then autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false end
  if data.trackerColor then
    BoxedESPOptions = BoxedESPOptions or {}
    if typeof(data.trackerColor) == "Color3" then
      BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = data.trackerColor
    elseif type(data.trackerColor) == "table" then
      local r = tonumber(data.trackerColor.r) or tonumber(data.trackerColor.R) or 230
      local g = tonumber(data.trackerColor.g) or tonumber(data.trackerColor.G) or 230
      local b = tonumber(data.trackerColor.b) or tonumber(data.trackerColor.B) or 230
      BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
    end
  end
end

-- Auto TP Down is a user-saved persistent toggle and must be restored after load.
-- Other route/chase movement workers retain their existing startup behavior.
pcall(function()
  -- Movement-producing automation must be user-started after execution; don't
  -- let saved runtime flags launch a chase/velocity loop before the user acts.
  autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
  autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
  _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn = false
  _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = false
  _G.CalciumTPBatOn = false
  _G.CalciumAntiBatEnabled = false
  if type(_G.CalciumStopAutoLeft) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumStopAutoLeft) end
  if type(_G.CalciumStopAutoRight) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumStopAutoRight) end
