  if type(_G.CalciumAntiBat) == "table" and type(_G.CalciumAntiBat.setEnabled) == "function" then
    pcall(_G.CalciumAntiBat.setEnabled, false)
  end
  -- Do not call saveCalciumConfig here: startup cleanup must not overwrite the user's file.
end)

_G.CalciumCounterState = _G.CalciumCounterState or {}
_G.CalciumCounterState.batConn = nil
_G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = false
_G.CalciumCounterState.medConns = _G.CalciumCounterState.medConns or {}
_G.CalciumCounterState.medDebounce = false
_G.CalciumCounterState.medLastUsed = _G.CalciumCounterState.medLastUsed or 0
_G.CalciumMedusaCooldown = 25

function _G.CalciumFindMedusa()
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return nil end
  for _, t in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if t:IsA("Tool") then
      local n = t.Name:lower()
      if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
    end
  end
  local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
  if bp then
    for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
      if t:IsA("Tool") then
        local n = t.Name:lower()
        if n:find("medusa") or n:find("head") or n:find("stone") then return t end
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function _G.CalciumUseMedusaCounter()
  if not medCounterEnabled then return end
  if _G.CalciumCounterState.medDebounce then return end
  if tick() - (_G.CalciumCounterState.medLastUsed or 0) < _G.CalciumMedusaCooldown then return end
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return end
  _G.CalciumCounterState.medDebounce = true
  local med = _G.CalciumFindMedusa()
  if not med then
    _G.CalciumCounterState.medDebounce = false
    return
  end
  if med.Parent ~= c then
    local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(med) end) end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
  pcall(function() med:Activate() end)
  _G.CalciumCounterState.medLastUsed = tick()
  _G.CalciumCounterState.medDebounce = false
end
function _G.CalciumOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part)
  return part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
    if part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then
      if medCounterEnabled then
        _G.CalciumUseMedusaCounter()
      end
    end
  end)
end
function _G.CalciumStartMedCounter(char)
  _G.CalciumStopMedCounter()
  char = char or LP.Character
  if not char then return end
  for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
      table.insert(_G.CalciumCounterState.medConns, _G.CalciumOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part))
    end
  end
  table.insert(_G.CalciumCounterState.medConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
      table.insert(_G.CalciumCounterState.medConns, _G.CalciumOnMedusaAnchorChanged(part))
    end
  end))
end
function _G.CalciumStopMedCounter()
  for _, c in pairs(_G.CalciumCounterState.medConns or {}) do
    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
  end
  _G.CalciumCounterState.medConns = {}
  _G.CalciumCounterState.medDebounce = false
end
-- true SOLO durante la finestra di counter del Bat Counter V2:
-- fa ignorare al TP Bat la distanza minima di snap (come il Bat Aimbot V2)
_G.CalciumBatCounterV2On = false

_G.CalciumBatCounterSlapList = {"Bat", "Slap", "Iron Slap", "Gold Slap", "Diamond Slap", "Emerald Slap", "Ruby Slap", "Dark Matter Slap", "Flame Slap", "Nuclear Slap", "Galaxy Slap", "Glitched Slap"}

function _G.CalciumFindBatForCounter()
  local c = LP.Character
  if not c then return nil end
  local bp = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
  for _, name in ipairs(_G.CalciumBatCounterSlapList) do
    local t = c:FindFirstChild(name) or (bp and bp:FindFirstChild(name))
    if t then return t end
  end
  for _, ch in ipairs(c:GetChildren()) do
    if ch:IsA("Tool") and ch.Name:lower():find("bat") then return ch end
  end
  if bp then
    for _, ch in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
      if ch:IsA("Tool") and ch.Name:lower():find("bat") then return ch end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function _G.CalciumSwingBatForCounter(bat, char)
  if not bat or not char then return end
  local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if bat.Parent ~= char then
    if hum then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
    task.wait(0.05)
  end
  local remote = bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteEvent") or bat:FindFirstChildOfClass("RemoteFunction")
  if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
    task.wait(0.15)
    pcall(function() remote:FireServer() end)
  else
    pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
    task.wait(0.15)
    pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
  end
end
function _G.CalciumCounterIsRagdoll(hum)
  if not hum then return false end
  local st = hum:GetState()
  return st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
    or hum.PlatformStand == true
end
-- Versione usata dal bat counter: esclude FallingDown (piccoli bump non devono triggerare)
function _G.CalciumCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum)
  if not hum then return false end
  local st = hum:GetState()
  return st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
    or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
    or hum.PlatformStand == true
end
-- ============================================================
-- BAT COUNTER V2: LOCK RAGDOLL NEMICO
-- Watcher identico a quello del Ragdoll Countdown nemico
-- (DescendantAdded -> BallSocketConstraint), ma indipendente:
-- funziona anche col Ragdoll Countdown spento.
-- Quando il nemico viene ragdollato parte un lock di 2.6s.
-- Se durante quei 2.6s veniamo ragdollati, il Bat Counter V2
-- IGNORA l'evento e non parte (nessuna attesa, si salta e basta).
-- Il lock e' a TEMPO, non sullo stato: se il watcher non vede nulla
-- il counter parte normalmente.
-- ============================================================
_G.CalciumBatCounterRagdollSeconds = _G.CalciumBatCounterRagdollSeconds or 2.6
_G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock = _G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock or {}
_G.CalciumBatCounterWatchConns = _G.CalciumBatCounterWatchConns or {}

function _G.CalciumBCMarkEnemyRagdoll(plr)
  if not plr or plr == LP then return end
  local secs = tonumber(_G.CalciumBatCounterRagdollSeconds) or 2.6
  _G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock[plr] = tick() + secs
end
function _G.CalciumStopBatCounterWatcher()
  local conns = _G.CalciumBatCounterWatchConns
  for k, c in pairs(conns) do
    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    conns[k] = nil
  end
  for k in pairs(_G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock) do
    _G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock[k] = nil
  end
end
function _G.CalciumStartBatCounterWatcher()
  _G.CalciumStopBatCounterWatcher()
  local conns = _G.CalciumBatCounterWatchConns

  local function hookChar(plr, char)
    if not char then return end
    local key = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_char"
    if conns[key] then pcall(function() conns[key]:Disconnect() end) end
    conns[key] = char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
        _G.CalciumBCMarkEnemyRagdoll(plr)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function watchPlayer(plr)
    if plr == LP then return end
    local key = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_added"
    if conns[key] then pcall(function() conns[key]:Disconnect() end) end
    conns[key] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      hookChar(plr, char)
    end)
    if plr.Character then hookChar(plr, plr.Character) end
  end
  conns["_playerAdded"] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
  conns["_playerRemoving"] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    _G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock[plr] = nil
    local ka = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_added"
    local kc = tostring(plr.UserId) .. "_char"
    if conns[ka] then pcall(function() conns[ka]:Disconnect() end) conns[ka] = nil end
    if conns[kc] then pcall(function() conns[kc]:Disconnect() end) conns[kc] = nil end
  end)

  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    watchPlayer(plr)
  end
end
-- Giocatore piu' vicino a noi (vivo), senza limiti di distanza
function _G.CalciumGetNearestEnemy()
  local char = LP.Character
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not hrp then return nil end
  local myPos = hrp.Position
  local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP then
      local ec = plr.Character
      local ehrp = ec and ec:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local ehum = ec and ec:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if ehrp and ehum and ehum.Health > 0 then
        local d = (ehrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude
        if d < bestDist then
          bestDist = d
          best = plr
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return best
end
-- true se il nemico piu' vicino e' stato ragdollato da meno di 2.6s
function _G.CalciumIsNearestEnemyRagdolled()
  local plr = _G.CalciumGetNearestEnemy()
  if not plr then return false end
  local lockUntil = _G.CalciumBatCounterEnemyLock[plr]
  return lockUntil ~= nil and lockUntil > tick()
end
function _G.CalciumStartBatCounter()
  if _G.CalciumCounterState.batConn then return end
  _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = false
  if _G.CalciumStartBatCounterWatcher then pcall(_G.CalciumStartBatCounterWatcher) end
  _G.CalciumCounterState.batConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not batCounterEnabled then return end
    if _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    -- Morto, o Instant Reset in corso: il ragdoll che si vede in questi due
    -- casi non e' un colpo preso, e' il nostro stesso reset (o la morte).
    -- Di regola il counter risponde a un hit, quindi qui non deve partire.
    -- Vale per V1 e V2: passano tutte e due da questo punto.
    if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    if _G._CalciumInstantResetBusy then return end
    if _G.CalciumCounterIsRagdollForBat(hum) then
      _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = true
      -- ANTI DIE QUI, non dentro il task.spawn piu' sotto. Li' arrivava
      -- 0.05s dopo, e questo ramo parte proprio perche' sei GIA' a terra
      -- ragdollato: 0.05s in quella situazione sono un'eternita'. Ora la
      -- protezione sale nello stesso frame in cui il ragdoll viene visto,
      -- prima di qualunque attesa, teletrasporto o swing.
      if _G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow) end
      if batCounterMode == "V2" then
        -- Se il nemico e' dentro il lock di 2.6s il counter NON parte e questo
        -- hit viene SALTATO del tutto (niente attesa, niente ricontrollo):
        -- il debounce si riapre solo quando usciamo dal nostro ragdoll,
        -- cosi' e' pronto per la volta successiva.
        if _G.CalciumIsNearestEnemyRagdolled then
          local okRag, enemyRag = pcall(_G.CalciumIsNearestEnemyRagdolled)
          if okRag and enemyRag then
            task.spawn(function()
              local t0 = tick()
              while tick() - t0 < 10 do
                local c2 = LP.Character
                local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                if not h2 or not _G.CalciumCounterIsRagdollForBat(h2) then break end
                task.wait(0.1)
              end
              task.wait(0.2)
              _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = false
            end)
            return
          end
        end
        -- V2: salva CFrame, avvia tp bat in parallelo, dopo 0.4s ferma e ritorna
        task.spawn(function()
          task.wait(0.05)
          local wasTPBatOn = _G.CalciumTPBatOn == true
          local hrpNow = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          local savedCF = hrpNow and hrpNow.CFrame or nil
          -- tp bat parte. Il flag dice al TP Bat di ignorare la distanza minima
          -- di 8 stud, esattamente come fa il Bat Aimbot V2.
          _G.CalciumBatCounterV2On = true
          if _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync then _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync() end
          if not wasTPBatOn then
            _G.CalciumTPBatSilent = true
            if _G.CalciumStartTPBat then pcall(_G.CalciumStartTPBat) end
            if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
          end
          local bat = _G.CalciumFindBatForCounter()
          if bat then task.spawn(function() _G.CalciumSwingBatForCounter(bat, char) end) end

          -- SNAP PROPRIO DEL COUNTER (non dipende dal loop del TP Bat).
          -- Il loop del TP Bat puo' non partire (Safe Mode), essere bloccato
          -- dall'Anti-Void o venire spento dal suo watcher ragdoll appena il
          -- nemico va a terra: in tutti quei casi lo snap non avveniva.
          -- Qui teletrasportiamo noi, ogni frame, senza nessuna soglia di
          -- distanza, esattamente come la fase 2 del Bat Aimbot V2.
          local snapConn
          snapConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local c2 = LP.Character
            local h2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum2 = c2 and c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not h2 or not hum2 or hum2.Health <= 0 then return end
            local t2 = _G.CalciumGetNearestEnemy and _G.CalciumGetNearestEnemy() or nil
            local tc2 = t2 and t2.Character
            local tr2 = tc2 and tc2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not tr2 then return end
            -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
            -- Se il nemico si e' tpato nel void si va sul punto d'origine,
            -- altrimenti lo snap ci porterebbe fuori mappa dietro di lui.
            local _bcPos = tr2.Position
            if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
              _bcPos = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posForPart(tr2, _bcPos)
            end
            -- <<< ANTI VOID END
            pcall(function()
              h2.CFrame = CFrame.new(_bcPos + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
              h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
              h2.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end)
          end)

          task.wait(0.4)
          if snapConn then pcall(function() snapConn:Disconnect() end) snapConn = nil end
          _G.CalciumBatCounterV2On = false
          if _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync then _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync() end
          if not wasTPBatOn then
            if _G.CalciumStopTPBat then pcall(_G.CalciumStopTPBat) end
            _G.CalciumTPBatSilent = false
            if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
          end
          if savedCF then
            local hrpBack = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrpBack then
              pcall(function()
                hrpBack.CFrame = savedCF
                hrpBack.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
              end)
            end
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
          _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = false
        end)
      else
        -- V1: look at + bat partono insieme, dopo 0.7s si ripristina look at
        task.spawn(function()
          local wasLookAtEnabled = _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled
          local savedRadius = _G.CalciumLookAtRadius
          _G.CalciumLookAtRadius = math.huge
          -- look at e bat partono insieme
          if _G.CalciumStartLookAt then pcall(_G.CalciumStartLookAt) end
          local bat = _G.CalciumFindBatForCounter()
          if bat then task.spawn(function() _G.CalciumSwingBatForCounter(bat, char) end) end
          task.wait(0.7)
          _G.CalciumLookAtRadius = savedRadius
          if wasLookAtEnabled then
            if _G.CalciumStartLookAt then pcall(_G.CalciumStartLookAt) end
          else
            if _G.CalciumStopLookAt then pcall(_G.CalciumStopLookAt) end
          end
          task.wait(0.5)
          _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = false
        end)
      end
    end
  end)
end
function _G.CalciumStopBatCounter()
  if _G.CalciumCounterState.batConn then
    _G.CalciumCounterState.batConn:Disconnect()
    _G.CalciumCounterState.batConn = nil
  end
  _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce = false
  _G.CalciumBatCounterV2On = false
  if _G.CalciumStopBatCounterWatcher then pcall(_G.CalciumStopBatCounterWatcher) end
end
startBatCounter = _G.CalciumStartBatCounter
stopBatCounter = _G.CalciumStopBatCounter
setupMedusaCounter = _G.CalciumStartMedCounter
stopMedusaCounter = _G.CalciumStopMedCounter

-- ============================================================
-- NO PLAYER COLLISION v3 (event-driven)
-- Sostituisce il vecchio blocco a polling. Differenze:
--   1. ZERO loop. Ogni BasePart e' registrata una volta con
--      GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"): se qualcosa la riaccende
--      torna a false nello STESSO frame, non dopo 0.2s.
--   2. DescendantAdded sul character: accessori, tool equipaggiati e
--      arti che arrivano tardi al respawn vengono presi subito.
--   3. Copre anche l'assembly esterna (brainrot trasportato, hitbox
--      weldate ma parented in workspace), che prima era ignorata.
--   4. Spegne anche le TUE parti: sono le uniche di cui hai il network
--      ownership, quindi replicano davvero sul client dell'altro.
--   5. Ref-count: TP Bat e toggle utente possono tenerla accesa insieme
--      senza pestarsi i piedi (CalciumNoCollisionAcquire/Release).
-- Tutto dentro un do-end: non consuma slot locals nel main chunk.
-- ============================================================
_G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionState = _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionState or {}

do
  local NPC = _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionState
  NPC.connections = NPC.connections or {}
  NPC.parts       = NPC.parts or {}       -- part -> {conn, destroy, cc, ct}
  NPC.charConns   = NPC.charConns or {}   -- character -> {conns}
  NPC.holders     = NPC.holders or {}     -- tag -> true
  NPC.running     = NPC.running or false

  -- Parti del corpo R6 + R15
  local BODY = {
    HumanoidRootPart = true, Head = true, Torso = true, UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
    ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true,
    LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
    RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
    LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true,
    RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true,
  }

  local function isOn() return NPC.running == true end

  -- Rete di sicurezza per le scritture interne del motore che non emettono
  -- GetPropertyChangedSignal. Passa su tutti i giocatori, ma UNA VOLTA AL
  -- SECONDO, non ad ogni frame come faceva il vecchio TP Bat.
  -- Abbassalo a 0.25 se vedi ancora micro-spinte entrando nei nemici;
  -- mettilo a 0 per restare puramente event-driven.
  local SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL = 1

  -- ---------- registro parti ----------
  local function lockPart(part, killTouch)
    if not part or not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if NPC.parts[part] then return end

    local e = {cc = part.CanCollide, ct = part.CanTouch}
    NPC.parts[part] = e

    pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end)
    if killTouch then pcall(function() part.CanTouch = false end) end

    -- Cuore del fix: reazione immediata, non ogni 0.2s.
    e.conn = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      if part.CanCollide then pcall(function() part.CanCollide = false end) end
    end)

    e.destroy = part.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
      if part:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
      if e.conn then pcall(function() e.conn:Disconnect() end) end
      if e.destroy then pcall(function() e.destroy:Disconnect() end) end
      NPC.parts[part] = nil
    end)
  end
  local function unlockPart(part)
    local e = NPC.parts[part]
    if not e then return end
    if e.conn then pcall(function() e.conn:Disconnect() end) end
    if e.destroy then pcall(function() e.destroy:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.parts[part] = nil
    if part and part.Parent then
      pcall(function() part.CanCollide = e.cc end)
      pcall(function() part.CanTouch = e.ct end)
    end
  end
  local hookHumanoid

  -- Riscrive CanCollide = false sulle parti gia' registrate di un character.
  -- Serve quando il motore le rimette a true senza emettere il segnale.
  local function reassert(char, isSelf)
    if not char then return end
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      if obj:IsA("BasePart") and NPC.parts[obj] then
        if not (isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
          if obj.CanCollide then pcall(function() obj.CanCollide = false end) end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  hookHumanoid = function(hum, char, isSelf)
    if not NPC.charConns[char] then NPC.charConns[char] = {} end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hum.StateChanged:Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      -- differita di un frame: l'Humanoid scrive dopo il cambio di stato
      task.defer(function()
        if isOn() and char.Parent then reassert(char, isSelf) end
      end)
    end))
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hum:GetPropertyChangedSignal("FloorMaterial"):Connect(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      task.defer(function()
        if isOn() and char.Parent then reassert(char, isSelf) end
      end)
    end))
  end
  -- ---------- aggancio character ----------
  -- isSelf: sul tuo character l'HRP resta collidibile o l'Humanoid sprofonda.
  local function hookCharacter(char, isSelf)
    if not char then return end
    if NPC.charConns[char] then return end
    NPC.charConns[char] = {}

    local function handle(obj)
      if not isOn() then return end
      if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
      if isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then return end
      lockPart(obj, not isSelf)
    end
    for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do handle(obj) end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], char.DescendantAdded:Connect(handle))

    -- Salto, caduta, atterraggio, ragdoll: l'Humanoid rimette mano alle
    -- collisioni. Qui le riportiamo giu' subito dopo, senza polling.
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then
      local hc
      hc = char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if c:IsA("Humanoid") then
          hc:Disconnect()
          hookHumanoid(c, char, isSelf)
        end
      end)
      table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], hc)
    else
      hookHumanoid(hum, char, isSelf)
    end
    table.insert(NPC.charConns[char], char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
      if parent == nil then
        for _, c in ipairs(NPC.charConns[char] or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        NPC.charConns[char] = nil
      end
    end))
  end
  -- ---------- assembly esterne (brainrot trasportato, hitbox) ----------
  local function ownedByOtherPlayer(part)
    local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
    if not root then return false end
    local model = root:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    if not model then return false end
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(model)
    return plr ~= nil and plr ~= LP
  end
  local function hookWorkspacePart(obj)
    if not isOn() then return end
    if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    if NPC.parts[obj] then return end
    -- il weld arriva un frame dopo il parenting
    task.defer(function()
      if not isOn() then return end
      if not obj.Parent then return end
      if ownedByOtherPlayer(obj) then lockPart(obj, true) end
    end)
  end
  -- ---------- start / stop interni ----------
  local function startCore()
    if NPC.running then return end
    NPC.running = true

    for _, c in ipairs(NPC.connections or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.connections = {}
    local function track(c) table.insert(NPC.connections, c) end

    local function watchPlayer(plr)
      if plr == LP then return end
      if plr.Character then hookCharacter(plr.Character, false) end
      track(plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if isOn() then hookCharacter(char, false) end
      end))
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(plr) end
    track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer))

    if LP.Character then hookCharacter(LP.Character, true) end
    track(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      if isOn() then hookCharacter(char, true) end
    end))

    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do hookWorkspacePart(obj) end
    track(Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(hookWorkspacePart))

    if SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL > 0 then
      local acc = 0
      track(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
        if not isOn() then return end
        acc = acc + (dt or 0)
        if acc < SELF_VERIFY_INTERVAL then return end
        acc = 0
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          local char = plr.Character
          if char then
            local isSelf = (plr == LP)
            reassert(char, isSelf)
            -- parti mai registrate (comparse in una finestra scoperta)
            for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
              if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not NPC.parts[obj] then
                if not (isSelf and obj.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
                  lockPart(obj, not isSelf)
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end))
    end
  end
  local function stopCore()
    if not NPC.running then return end
    NPC.running = false

    for _, c in ipairs(NPC.connections or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    NPC.connections = {}

    for char, conns in pairs(NPC.charConns) do
      for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
      NPC.charConns[char] = nil
    end
    for part in pairs(NPC.parts) do unlockPart(part) end
    NPC.parts = {}
  end
  -- Ripassata completa: riaggancia character e parti gia' presenti.
  -- Serve dopo un cambio di holder, per non restare in attesa del
  -- prossimo DescendantAdded.
  local function rescan()
    if not isOn() then return end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      local char = plr.Character
      if char then
        if plr == LP then
          for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then lockPart(obj, false) end
          end
        else
          for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("BasePart") then lockPart(obj, true) end
          end
        end
        hookCharacter(char, plr == LP)
      end
    end
  end
  -- ---------- API ref-count ----------
  -- Permette a TP Bat e toggle utente di tenerla accesa insieme.
  function _G.CalciumNoCollisionAcquire(tag)
    NPC.holders[tag or "default"] = true
    startCore()
  end
  function _G.CalciumNoCollisionRelease(tag)
    NPC.holders[tag or "default"] = nil
    -- Il toggle utente vince sempre: finche' e' acceso non si spegne nulla,
    -- anche se il tag "user" si fosse perso per strada.
    if _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true then
      NPC.holders["user"] = true
      rescan()
      return
    end
    if next(NPC.holders) == nil then stopCore() end
  end
end
-- Toggle utente (chiamato dalla UI e da applyCalciumConfig)
function enableNoPlayerCollision()
  _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = true
  _G.CalciumNoCollisionAcquire("user")
end
function disableNoPlayerCollision()
  _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = false
  _G.CalciumNoCollisionRelease("user")
end
-- Compatibilita' con il vecchio nome usato altrove nello script
function _G.CalciumSetOtherPlayerCollision(state)
  if state == false then
    _G.CalciumNoCollisionAcquire("legacy")
  else
    _G.CalciumNoCollisionRelease("legacy")
  end
end
-- ===== UNWALK (logica da uranium.lua) =====
-- startUnwalk/stopUnwalk dichiarate outer: servono dopo il do-block (toggle UI, apply-config)
-- Le helper interne stanno nel do-block: i loro registri vengono liberati subito,
-- evitando il "out of local limits" al main chunk.
startUnwalk, stopUnwalk = nil, nil
do
  local unwalkLoopConnection = nil

  local function killAllAnimations(char)
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if animator then
      for _, track in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function() track:Stop() end)
      end
    end
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then animate.Disabled = true end
    if hum and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running then
      pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end)
    end
  end
  local function restoreAnimations(char)
    if not char then return end
    local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") then
      animate.Disabled = false
    end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
      task.wait()
      pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
    end
  end
  local function startUnwalkLoop()
    if unwalkLoopConnection then return end
    unwalkLoopConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not unwalkEnabled then return end
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not hum then return end
      local hasAnim = false
      local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
      if animator then
        local tracks = animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()
        if #tracks > 0 then
          hasAnim = true
          for _, t in pairs(tracks) do pcall(function() t:Stop() end) end
        end
      end
      local animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
      if animate and animate:IsA("LocalScript") and not animate.Disabled then
        animate.Disabled = true
        hasAnim = true
      end
      if hasAnim then pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running) end) end
    end)
  end
  local function stopUnwalkLoop()
    if unwalkLoopConnection then
      unwalkLoopConnection:Disconnect()
      unwalkLoopConnection = nil
    end
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then restoreAnimations(char) end
  end
  startUnwalk = function()
    if unwalkEnabled then return end
    unwalkEnabled = true
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then killAllAnimations(char) end
    startUnwalkLoop()
  end
  stopUnwalk = function()
    if not unwalkEnabled then return end
    unwalkEnabled = false
    stopUnwalkLoop()
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then restoreAnimations(char) end
  end
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10)
    -- Animate arriva dopo Head/HRP/Humanoid: senza questa attesa
    -- lo script non verrebbe disabilitato e le animazioni resterebbero.
    pcall(function() char:WaitForChild("Animate", 3) end)
    if unwalkEnabled then
      killAllAnimations(char)
    else
      restoreAnimations(char)
    end
  end)
end

-- ===== ANIMATION PACKS =====
do
  local ANIM_PACKS = {
    -- NONE (index 1)
    [1] = nil,
    -- Pack 1 - Classic (Duels style)
    [2] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://10921344533",
      walk = "rbxassetid://10921355261",
      run  = "rbxassetid://616163682",
      jump = "rbxassetid://10921351278",
      fall = "rbxassetid://10921350320",
    },
    -- Pack 2 - Ninja (Duels)
    [3] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://656117400",
      walk = "rbxassetid://656121766",
      run  = "rbxassetid://656118852",
      jump = "rbxassetid://656117878",
      fall = "rbxassetid://656115606",
    },
    -- Pack 3 - Robot (Duels)
    [4] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://616088211",
      walk = "rbxassetid://616095330",
      run  = "rbxassetid://616091570",
      jump = "rbxassetid://616090535",
      fall = "rbxassetid://616087089",
    },
    -- Pack 4 - Stylish (Duels)
    [5] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://616136790",
      walk = "rbxassetid://616146177",
      run  = "rbxassetid://616140816",
      jump = "rbxassetid://616139451",
      fall = "rbxassetid://616134815",
    },
    -- Pack 5 - Bubbly
    [6] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://910004836",
      walk = "rbxassetid://910034870",
      run  = "rbxassetid://910025107",
      jump = "rbxassetid://910016857",
      fall = "rbxassetid://910001910",
    },
    -- Pack 6 - Levitation (Duels)
    [7] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://616006778",
      walk = "rbxassetid://616013216",
      run  = "rbxassetid://616010382",
      jump = "rbxassetid://616008936",
      fall = "rbxassetid://616005863",
    },
    -- Pack 7 - Cartoon (Duels)
    [8] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://742637544",
      walk = "rbxassetid://742640026",
      run  = "rbxassetid://742638842",
      jump = "rbxassetid://742637942",
      fall = "rbxassetid://742637151",
    },
    -- Pack 8 - Vampire (Duels)
    [9] = {
      idle = "rbxassetid://10921315373",
      walk = "rbxassetid://10921326949",
      run  = "rbxassetid://10921320299",
      jump = "rbxassetid://10921322186",
      fall = "rbxassetid://10921321317",
    },
  }


  local function _animLoadTrack(animator, id)
    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    local success, result = pcall(function()
      local objects = game:GetObjects(id)
      for _, obj in pairs(objects) do
        if obj:IsA("Animation") then return obj.AnimationId end
        local deep = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animation", true)
        if deep then return deep.AnimationId end
      end
    end)
    animation.AnimationId = (success and result) and result or id
    return animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
  end
  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  -- Le connessioni agli eventi dell'Humanoid non venivano MAI chiuse.
  -- Ogni ricarica del sistema (cambio pack, o cambio di un asset custom)
  -- ne aggiungeva un altro set sopra ai precedenti: i vecchi restavano
  -- vivi e continuavano a comandare Play/Stop sulle tracce, quindi la
  -- nuova animazione non prendeva il controllo finche' non respawnavi,
  -- perche' solo allora l'Humanoid vecchio moriva insieme alle connessioni.
  -- Ora si tengono in una lista e si chiudono a ogni stop.
  _G._CalciumAnimPackConns = _G._CalciumAnimPackConns or {}
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

  local animGeneration = 0
  local function _animStopAll()
    animGeneration += 1
    _animPackCurrentAnim = nil
    for _, track in pairs(_animPackTracks) do
      pcall(function() track:Stop(0); track:Destroy() end)
    end
    _animPackTracks = {}
    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
    for _, c in ipairs(_G._CalciumAnimPackConns) do
      pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
    end
    _G._CalciumAnimPackConns = {}
    -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END
  end
  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  -- L'indice 7 non ha una tabella fissa: si costruisce al volo dagli ID
  -- che l'utente ha inserito, e contiene SOLO gli slot valorizzati. Per
  -- gli altri movimenti resta l'animazione del gioco, esattamente come
  -- fa Uranium: non si forza niente su uno slot vuoto.
  local function _animCustomPack()
    local t, any = {}, false
    for _, slot in ipairs(_G.CalciumCustomAnimSlots) do
      local id = _G.CalciumCustomAnimIds[slot]
      if id and id ~= "" then
        t[slot] = "rbxassetid://" .. id
        any = true
      end
    end
    if not any then return nil end
    return t
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

  local function _animStartSystem(char)
    _animStopAll()
    local generation = animGeneration
    if not _animPackSystemEnabled then return end
    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
    local pack
    if selectedAnimPackIndex == 10 then
      pack = _animCustomPack()
      -- Nessun ID impostato: si lascia il sistema nativo acceso invece di
      -- spegnere Animate e restare senza animazioni.
      if not pack then return end
    else
      pack = ANIM_PACKS[selectedAnimPackIndex]
    end
    if not pack then return end
    -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

    local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    local animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
    if generation ~= animGeneration or LP.Character ~= char then return end
    local Animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")

    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
    -- COPERTURA PARZIALE.
    -- Lo script Animate del gioco si accende o si spegne per TUTTO il
    -- personaggio: non esiste un modo di spegnerlo solo per l'idle. Finche'
    -- un pack copre tutti e cinque i movimenti la cosa non si nota, ma col
    -- pack CUSTOM puoi lasciare uno slot vuoto. Spegnendo Animate lo slot
    -- vuoto non aveva NIENTE da suonare, e la traccia custom precedente
    -- restava in loop: sembrava che l'asset venisse riapplicato di nascosto,
    -- mentre in realta' non era mai stato fermato.
    -- Se la copertura non e' completa, Animate resta ACCESO e le tracce
    -- custom girano sopra con priorita' Action, che vince su Idle e
    -- Movement del gioco. Dove non c'e' una traccia custom riemerge quella
    -- originale, che e' esattamente il comportamento voluto.
    local partial = false
    if selectedAnimPackIndex == 10 then
      for _, sl in ipairs({"idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "fall"}) do
        if not pack[sl] then partial = true break end
      end
    end
    if not partial then
      if Animate then Animate.Disabled = true end
    elseif Animate then
      Animate.Disabled = false
    end
    task.wait(0.1)
    if generation ~= animGeneration or LP.Character ~= char then return end
    if not partial then
      for _, t in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
        pcall(function() t:Stop(0) end)
      end
    end
    -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

    for name, id in pairs(pack) do
      local loaded, track = pcall(_animLoadTrack, animator, id)
      if generation ~= animGeneration or LP.Character ~= char then
        if loaded and track then track:Destroy() end
        return
      end
      if not loaded or not track then
        _animStopAll()
        if Animate then Animate.Disabled = false end
        warn("[Calcium] Animation asset could not load:", name)
        return
      end
      track.Looped = (name == "idle" or name == "walk" or name == "run" or name == "fall")
      if partial then
        -- Sopra a tutto quello che suona il gioco.
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
      elseif name == "idle" then
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Idle
      elseif name == "walk" or name == "run" then
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
      else
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
      end
      _animPackTracks[name] = track
    end
    local function playAnim(name, forceRestart)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled then return end
      -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
      if not _animPackTracks[name] then
        -- Slot senza asset: si FERMA la traccia custom in corso, altrimenti
        -- resta in loop e copre l'animazione del gioco. Prima si usciva e
        -- basta, ed e' per questo che togliendo l'idle continuavi a vedere
        -- l'animazione custom.
        local cur = _animPackTracks[_animPackCurrentAnim]
        if cur then pcall(function() cur:Stop(0.15) end) end
        _animPackCurrentAnim = name
        return
      end
      -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END
      if _animPackCurrentAnim == name and not forceRestart then return end
      if _animPackTracks[_animPackCurrentAnim] and _animPackCurrentAnim ~= name then
        pcall(function() _animPackTracks[_animPackCurrentAnim]:Stop(0.15) end)
      end
      _animPackCurrentAnim = name
      if forceRestart then _animPackTracks[name]:Stop() end
      _animPackTracks[name]:Play(0.15)
    end
    -- Hookiamo gli eventi PRIMA del play iniziale
    -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN: ogni connessione va registrata <<<
    local _conns = _G._CalciumAnimPackConns
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local moving = false
    local sampleElapsed = 0
    local function updateLocomotion()
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled or generation ~= animGeneration then return end
      local state = humanoid:GetState()
      if humanoid.Health <= 0 or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated
        or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
        for _, track in pairs(_animPackTracks) do if track.IsPlaying then track:Stop(0.12) end end
        _animPackCurrentAnim = nil
        return
      end
      if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then playAnim("jump"); return end
      if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then playAnim("fall"); return end
      root = root and root.Parent and root or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local v = root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
      local speed = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
      -- Velocity jitter alone must not make an idle character run.
      local directed = humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
        or (_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true and _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.target ~= nil)
      moving = directed and speed > (moving and 0.6 or 1.2)
      if not moving then playAnim("idle")
      else
        local name = speed > 14 and "run" or "walk"
        playAnim(name)
        local track = _animPackTracks[name]
        if track then track:AdjustSpeed(math.clamp(speed / (name == "run" and 20 or 10), 0.65, 1.65)) end
      end
    end
    table.insert(_conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
      sampleElapsed += dt
      if sampleElapsed < 0.05 then return end
      sampleElapsed = 0
      updateLocomotion()
    end))
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.Jumping:Connect(function(active)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled or not active then return end
      playAnim("jump", true)
    end))
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.FreeFalling:Connect(function(active)
      if not _animPackSystemEnabled or not active then return end
      playAnim("fall")
    end))
    table.insert(_conns, humanoid.StateChanged:Connect(function()
      updateLocomotion()
    end))
    updateLocomotion()
  end
  local function _animRestoreDefault()
    _animStopAll()
    local char = LP.Character
    if char then
      local Animate = char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
      if Animate then Animate.Disabled = false end
      local humanoid = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
      if humanoid then
        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChild("Animator")
        if animator then
          for _, t in pairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do t:Stop(0) end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  -- Flag condiviso tra CalciumSetAnimPack e stopUnwalk override:
  -- alzato quando è il pack stesso a chiamare stopUnwalk (non l'utente),
  -- così stopUnwalk non fa il ripristino automatico in quel caso.
  local _packCallingStop = false

  -- Funzione pubblica: applica un pack per indice (1=NONE, 2-6=pack 1-5)
  _G.CalciumSetAnimPack = function(index)
    index = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(index) or 1), 1, 10) -- 10 = CUSTOM

    if index == 1 then
      -- L'utente ha cliccato NONE manualmente
      _animPackSystemEnabled = false
      _animRestoreDefault()
      selectedAnimPackIndex = 1

      if unwalkEnabled then
        -- Unwalk è attivo: l'utente ha confermato NONE esplicitamente
        -- Azzera il pack salvato così quando unwalk si spegne non ripristina niente
        _animPackSavedIndex = 1
        _animPackUnwalkWasActive = false
        -- Unwalk rimane ON, aggiornamento visivo già corretto (unwalk toggle è già acceso)
      else
        -- Unwalk non è attivo: torno a NONE normalmente
        -- Se c'era un flag unwalk pendente (unwalk era stato forzato OFF da un pack),
        -- lo riattivo perché l'utente è tornato a NONE
        if _animPackUnwalkWasActive then
          _animPackUnwalkWasActive = false
          _animPackSavedIndex = 1
          startUnwalk()
          if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(true) end
        end
      end
    else
      -- L'utente ha selezionato pack 1-5
      if unwalkEnabled then
        _animPackSavedIndex = index
        _animPackUnwalkWasActive = true
        _packCallingStop = true
        stopUnwalk()
        if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(false) end
      end
      selectedAnimPackIndex = index
      _animPackSystemEnabled = true
      local char = LP.Character
      if char then
        task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(char) end)
      end
    end
    if setAnimPackVisual then setAnimPackVisual(selectedAnimPackIndex) end
    -- >>> VISIBILE SOLO CON CUSTOM <<<
    if _G.CalciumCustomAnimSetRowVisible then
      _G.CalciumCustomAnimSetRowVisible(selectedAnimPackIndex == 10, true)
    end
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end
  -- Override di startUnwalk/stopUnwalk per gestire l'interazione col pack
  -- Si aggiunge alla logica esistente, non la sostituisce
  local _origStartUnwalk = startUnwalk
  local _origStopUnwalk  = stopUnwalk

  startUnwalk = function()
    -- Se c'è un pack attivo, salvalo e torna a NONE prima di avviare unwalk
    if selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 then
      _animPackSavedIndex = selectedAnimPackIndex
      _animPackUnwalkWasActive = true
      _animPackSystemEnabled = false
      _animRestoreDefault()
      selectedAnimPackIndex = 1
      if setAnimPackVisual then setAnimPackVisual(1) end
    end
    _origStartUnwalk()
  end
  stopUnwalk = function()
    _origStopUnwalk()
    -- Se chiamato internamente dal pack, non fare niente
    if _packCallingStop then
      _packCallingStop = false
      return
    end
    -- Se c'era un pack salvato prima che unwalk lo coprisse, ripristinalo
    if _animPackSavedIndex ~= 1 then
      local idx = _animPackSavedIndex
      _animPackSavedIndex = 1
      _animPackUnwalkWasActive = false
      task.delay(0.25, function()
        if not unwalkEnabled and _G.CalciumSetAnimPack then
          _G.CalciumSetAnimPack(idx)
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  -- >>> CUSTOM ANIM PACK BEGIN
  -- Chiamata dal picker ogni volta che un ID viene aggiunto o tolto:
  -- se CUSTOM e' la selezione attiva il sistema va ricaricato subito,
  -- altrimenti la modifica si vedrebbe solo al respawn.
  function _G.CalciumReloadCustomAnimPack()
    if selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 10 then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    if _G.CalciumHasCustomAnim() then
      -- Si riparte da zero: _animStartSystem chiama _animStopAll, che ora
      -- chiude anche le connessioni, quindi il set nuovo e' l'unico attivo
      -- e l'asset appena inserito si applica subito, senza reset.
      _animPackSystemEnabled = true
      task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(char) end)
    else
      _animPackSystemEnabled = false
      _animRestoreDefault()
    end
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM ANIM PACK END

  -- Avvio automatico del pack quando il personaggio riappare
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newChar)
    _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(newChar, 10)
    pcall(function() newChar:WaitForChild("Animate", 3) end)
    if _animPackSystemEnabled and selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 then
      task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(newChar) end)
    end
  end)

  -- Avvio immediato se il personaggio è già spawnato
  if LP.Character and _animPackSystemEnabled and selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 then
    task.spawn(function() _animStartSystem(LP.Character) end)
  end
end
-- ===== FINE ANIMATION PACKS =====



function _G.CalciumSafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
  local ok, label = pcall(function()
    return LP.PlayerGui
      and LP.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame")
      and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("DuelsMachineTopFrame")
      and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame.DuelsMachineTopFrame:FindFirstChild("Timer")
      and LP.PlayerGui.DuelsMachineTopFrame.DuelsMachineTopFrame.Timer:FindFirstChild("Label")
  end)
  return (ok and label) or nil
end
function _G.CalciumSafeModeCountdownNumber(text)
  local t = tostring(text or ""):upper():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  if t == "GO" or t == "START" or t == "READY" then return true end
  local n = tonumber(t)
  return n ~= nil and n >= 0 and n <= 10
end
-- Il numero che il cartello sta mostrando, oppure nil se non e' un conto
-- alla rovescia. "GO"/"START" valgono 0: il conto e' finito.
function _G.CalciumSafeModeCountdownValue()
  local label = _G.CalciumSafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
  if not label then return nil end
  local t = tostring(label.Text or ""):upper():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  if t == "GO" or t == "START" or t == "READY" then return 0 end
  local n = tonumber(t)
  if n ~= nil and n >= 0 and n <= 10 then return n end
  return nil
end
function _G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown()
  local label = _G.CalciumSafeModeGetCountdownLabel()
  return label and _G.CalciumSafeModeCountdownNumber(label.Text) or false
end
_G.CalciumSafeModeBlockedTools = {
  bat=true, slap=true, sword=true, gun=true, pistol=true, rifle=true,
  medusa=true, hammer=true, axe=true, knife=true, katana=true, blade=true, fist=true,
}

function _G.CalciumSafeModeIsCarryableTool(tool)
  if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
  local name = tool.Name:lower()
  for word in pairs(_G.CalciumSafeModeBlockedTools) do
    if name:find(word, 1, true) then return false end
  end
  return true
end
function _G.CalciumSafeModeHoldingBrainrot()
  local ok, val = pcall(function() return LP:GetAttribute("Stealing") end)
  if ok and val == true then return true end
  local ok2, val2 = pcall(function() return LP:GetAttribute("AntiKick") end)
  if ok2 and val2 == true then return true end
  local char = LP.Character
  if not char then return false end
  local ok3, val3 = pcall(function() return char:GetAttribute("Stealing") end)
  if ok3 and val3 == true then return true end
  if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and type(_G.AutoCarrySpeed.IsCarryingBrainrot) == "function" then
    local okCarry, carrying = pcall(function() return _G.AutoCarrySpeed.IsCarryingBrainrot(char) end)
    if okCarry and carrying then return true end
  end
  for _, name in ipairs({"Carrying", "IsCarrying", "Grabbed", "Holding", "StealHold", "HasGrab"}) do
    local v = char:FindFirstChild(name, true)
    if v then
      if v:IsA("BoolValue") and v.Value then return true end
      if v:IsA("ObjectValue") and v.Value then return true end
      if v:IsA("StringValue") and v.Value ~= "" then return true end
    end
  end
  for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) then
      local n = child.Name:lower()
      if n:find("brainrot") or n:find("animal") or n:find("carry") or n:find("grab") or n:find("steal") or n:find("hold") then
        return true
      end
    end
  end
  return false
end
-- Dedicated, low-overhead Safe Mode notice: distinct from general amber toasts.
-- Reuses one toast so repeated guards cannot flood the screen or lower FPS.
function _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify(heading, detail, isWarning)
  local now = os.clock()
  heading, detail = tostring(heading or "SAFE MODE"), tostring(detail or "")
  local signature = heading .. "|" .. detail
  if _G._CalciumSafeNoticeKey == signature and now - (_G._CalciumSafeNoticeAt or 0) < 2.5 then return end
  _G._CalciumSafeNoticeKey, _G._CalciumSafeNoticeAt = signature, now
  pcall(function()
    local parent = HubGui or PlayerGui
    local host = parent:FindFirstChild("CalciumSafeNoticeHost")
    if not host then
      host = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
      host.Name = "CalciumSafeNoticeHost"
      host.ResetOnSpawn = false
      host.IgnoreGuiInset = true
      host.DisplayOrder = 100001
      host.Parent = parent
    end
    local prior = host:FindFirstChild("Notice")
    if prior then prior:Destroy() end
    local notice = Instance.new("Frame")
    notice.Name = "Notice"
    notice.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    notice.Position = UDim2.new(1, 320, 0, 74)
    notice.Size = UDim2.new(0, 286, 0, 66)
    notice.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 19, 26)
    notice.BorderSizePixel = 0
    notice.Parent = host
    Instance.new("UICorner", notice).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", notice)
    stroke.Color = isWarning and Color3.fromRGB(247, 185, 92) or Color3.fromRGB(70, 214, 180)
    stroke.Transparency = 0.35
    stroke.Thickness = 1
    local accent = Instance.new("Frame")
    accent.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12)
    accent.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 42)
    accent.BackgroundColor3 = stroke.Color
    accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
    accent.Parent = notice
    Instance.new("UICorner", accent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 9)
    title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 24)
    title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    title.TextSize = 13
    title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 246, 251)
    title.Text = heading
    title.Parent = notice
    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 32)
    sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 25)
    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.TextWrapped = true
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    sub.TextSize = 11
    sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(167, 186, 198)
    sub.Text = detail
    sub.Parent = notice
    local tween = TweenService:Create(notice, TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 74)
    })
    tween:Play()
    task.delay(2.65, function()
      if not notice.Parent then return end
      local fade = TweenService:Create(notice, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.new(1, 320, 0, 74)
      })
      fade:Play()
      fade.Completed:Connect(function() if notice.Parent then notice:Destroy() end end)
    end)
  end)
end

function _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked()
  if not antiKickEnabled then return false end
  return _G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown() or _G.CalciumSafeModeHoldingBrainrot()
end
-- Safe Mode guards aim/TP tools; the explicit Full Auto Play route can finish.
function _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop(reason)
  local preserveFullRoute = _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true
  local stopped = false
  if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn and _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot then _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot(); stopped = true end
  if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On and _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2(false); stopped = true end
  if _G.CalciumTPBatOn and _G.CalciumStopTPBat then _G.CalciumStopTPBat(); stopped = true end
  if not preserveFullRoute then
    if autoLeftEnabled then
      autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
      if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
      if _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft then _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft() end
      stopped = true
    end
    if autoRightEnabled then
      autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
      if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(false) end
      if _G.CalciumStopAutoRight then _G.CalciumStopAutoRight() end
      stopped = true
    end
  end
  if stopped then
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual and _G.CalciumAutoPlay then
      _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual(_G.CalciumAutoPlay.running())
    end
    _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify("SAFE MODE PROTECTED",
      preserveFullRoute and "Combat action paused; Full Auto Play continues." or "Unsafe movement action was stopped.", true)
  end
end
-- Only Full Auto Play paths are exempt from the countdown/carry restriction.
function _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart(context)
  if context == "fullAutoPath" and _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true then return true end
  if _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked and _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked() then
    _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK")
    _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify("SAFE MODE BLOCKED", "Wait until the duel countdown or carry ends.", true)
    return false
  end
  return true
end
-- Low-cost guard: polling at 5 Hz is enough to stop unsafe actions;
-- Full Auto Play movement remains untouched while enabled.
if _G.CalciumSafeModeMonitorConn then
  pcall(function() _G.CalciumSafeModeMonitorConn:Disconnect() end)
  _G.CalciumSafeModeMonitorConn = nil
end
_G.CalciumSafeModeMonitorStarted = true
_G._CalciumSafeGuardElapsed = 0
_G.CalciumSafeModeMonitorConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
  _G._CalciumSafeGuardElapsed = (_G._CalciumSafeGuardElapsed or 0) + (dt or 0)
  if _G._CalciumSafeGuardElapsed < 0.2 then return end
  _G._CalciumSafeGuardElapsed = 0
  if antiKickEnabled and _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked and _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked() then
    _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK")
  end
end)
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
  _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10)
  if medCounterEnabled then _G.CalciumStartMedCounter(char) end
  if batCounterEnabled then _G.CalciumStartBatCounter() end
end)

_G.CalciumNormalAimbot = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot or {conn = nil, target = nil, swingCooldown = false}
-- V1 prediction memory (moving / inf jump / tp down targets)
_G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevPos = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevPos or nil
_G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevVel = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevVel or nil
_G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevT = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevT or 0
_G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevUserId = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot._prevUserId or 0

function _G.CalciumFindAimbotBat()
  local char = LP.Character
  if not char then return nil end
  for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
    if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name:lower():find("bat") or tool.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
      return tool
    end
  end
  local bp = LP:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
  if bp then
    for _, tool in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
      if tool:IsA("Tool") and (tool.Name:lower():find("bat") or tool.Name:lower():find("slap")) then
        return tool
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end
function _G.CalciumGetClosestAimbotTarget()
  local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root then return nil end
  local closest, minDist = nil, math.huge
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
      local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        -- Nel void la distanza va misurata sulla posizione fantasma,
        -- altrimenti il bersaglio risulta lontanissimo e il trigger
        -- dei 4 stud del V2 non scatta mai.
        local tPos = tRoot.Position
        if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
          tPos = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posFor(plr, tPos)
        end
        local dist = (tPos - root.Position).Magnitude
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END
        if dist < minDist then
          minDist = dist
          closest = tRoot
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return closest
end
-- Shared facing and bat activation: one state across the two modes.
-- A minimum requested delay of .008 is retained, but the bat needs time to
-- release and re-arm; nonstop Activate() calls can make later hits disappear.
_G.CalciumAimbotSwingInterval = 0.008
local calciumBatSwing = { last = 0, tool = nil, releaseId = 0 }
function _G.CalciumFaceAimbotTorso(myRoot, targetRoot, frameDt)
  if not myRoot or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then return end
  local enemy = targetRoot.Parent
  local torso = enemy:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or enemy:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    or enemy:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or targetRoot
  local mine = myRoot.Position
  local pos = torso.Position
  local facing = Vector3.new(pos.X, mine.Y, pos.Z)
  if (facing - mine).Magnitude < 0.25 then return end
  -- Rotate in place; don't zero physics angular velocity or change position.
  -- Lerp on every frame previously fought simulated movement and hit contact.
  myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mine, facing)
end

function _G.CalciumTryAimbotSwing()
  local char = LP.Character
  if not char then return false end
  local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
  local bat = _G.CalciumFindAimbotBat and _G.CalciumFindAimbotBat()
  if not bat then return false end
  local currentTool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
  if currentTool and currentTool ~= bat then
    -- Equip the actual bat instead of silently refusing while another tool is held.
    if os.clock() >= (calciumBatSwing.nextEquip or 0) then
      calciumBatSwing.nextEquip = os.clock() + 0.25
      pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
    end
    return false
  end
  if bat.Parent ~= char then
    if os.clock() >= (calciumBatSwing.nextEquip or 0) then
      calciumBatSwing.nextEquip = os.clock() + 0.25
      pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
    end
    return false
  end
  if bat.Enabled == false then return false end
  local now = os.clock()
  -- .008 is the minimum input delay, not a way to bypass tool/server cooldown.
  -- Give the normal bat's Activated/Deactivated cycle time to complete.
  if now - calciumBatSwing.last < math.max(_G.CalciumAimbotSwingInterval, 0.09) then return false end
  calciumBatSwing.last = now
  calciumBatSwing.tool = bat
  calciumBatSwing.releaseId += 1
  local releaseId = calciumBatSwing.releaseId
  local ok = pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
  task.delay(0.055, function()
    if calciumBatSwing.releaseId == releaseId and bat and bat.Parent == char then
      pcall(function() bat:Deactivate() end)
    end
  end)
  return ok
end
function _G.CalciumGetNormalAimbotSpeed()
  local boost = tonumber(SPEED_FEEL_BOOST) or tonumber(_G.CalciumSpeedFeelBoost) or 1.03
  if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    return (tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40) * boost
  end
  return (tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58) * boost
end
function _G.CalciumGetBatAimbotV2Speed()
  local boost = tonumber(SPEED_FEEL_BOOST) or tonumber(_G.CalciumSpeedFeelBoost) or 1.03
  if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    return (tonumber(_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed) or 40) * boost
  end
  return (tonumber(_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Speed) or 58) * boost
end
function _G.CalciumGetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues()
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    return tonumber(_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Speed) or 58, tonumber(_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed) or 40
  end
  return tonumber(AIMBOT_SPEED) or 58, tonumber(LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED) or 40
end
function _G.CalciumSetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues(normalValue, laggerValue)
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    if normalValue then _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Speed = normalValue end
    if laggerValue then _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2LaggerSpeed = laggerValue end
  else
    if normalValue then AIMBOT_SPEED = normalValue end
    if laggerValue then LAGGER_AIMBOT_SPEED = laggerValue end
  end
end
function _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotSpeedBoxes()
  local n, l = _G.CalciumGetSelectedAimbotSpeedValues()
  if _G.CalciumAimbotSpeedBox then _G.CalciumAimbotSpeedBox.Text = tostring(n) end
  if _G.CalciumLaggerAimbotSpeedBox then _G.CalciumLaggerAimbotSpeedBox.Text = tostring(l) end
end

-- ===== AIMBOT VFX (lock highlight, beam, swing rings) =====
do
  local vfxHL, vfxBeam, vfxAtt0, vfxAtt1, vfxLastT, vfxLastTarget = nil, nil, nil, nil, 0, nil
  local function clearVFX()
    pcall(function() if vfxHL then vfxHL:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() if vfxBeam then vfxBeam:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() if vfxAtt0 then vfxAtt0:Destroy() end end)
    pcall(function() if vfxAtt1 then vfxAtt1:Destroy() end end)
    vfxHL, vfxBeam, vfxAtt0, vfxAtt1, vfxLastTarget = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
  end
  _G._CalciumAimbotClearVFX = clearVFX

  _G._CalciumAimbotVFX = function(target, isBypass, dist)
    if not target or not target.Parent then clearVFX(); return end
    local char = target.Parent
    if not char then return end
    local now = tick()
    -- throttle create
    if vfxLastTarget ~= target or not vfxHL or not vfxHL.Parent then
      clearVFX()
      vfxLastTarget = target
      local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
      hl.Name = "CalciumAimbotLock"
      hl.Adornee = char
      hl.FillTransparency = 0.55
      hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
      hl.FillColor = isBypass and Color3.fromRGB(255, 40, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 50)
      hl.OutlineColor = isBypass and Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 220) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 180)
      hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
      hl.Parent = char
      vfxHL = hl

      local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local tpart = target
      if root and tpart then
        local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        a0.Name = "CalciumAimA0"
        a0.Parent = root
        local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        a1.Name = "CalciumAimA1"
        a1.Parent = tpart
        local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
        beam.Name = "CalciumAimBeam"
        beam.Attachment0 = a0
        beam.Attachment1 = a1
        beam.Width0 = 0.22
        beam.Width1 = 0.1
        beam.Segments = 12
        pcall(function()
          local pe = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
          pe.Name = "CalciumAimSparks"
          pe.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
          pe.Rate = isBypass and 28 or 18
          pe.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.15, 0.35)
          pe.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 6)
          pe.Size = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
          pe.Color = ColorSequence.new(isBypass and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 140) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 60))
          pe.LightEmission = 1
          pe.Parent = a1
        end)
        beam.FaceCamera = true
        beam.LightEmission = 1
        beam.LightInfluence = 0
        beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.25),
          NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.75),
        })
        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(
          isBypass and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 55)
        )
        beam.Parent = root
        vfxBeam, vfxAtt0, vfxAtt1 = beam, a0, a1
      end
    else
      if vfxHL then
        vfxHL.FillColor = isBypass and Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 100) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 135, 40)
        -- pulse
        local pulse = 0.62 + 0.12 * math.sin(now * 8)
        vfxHL.FillTransparency = pulse
      end
      if vfxBeam then
        local w = isBypass and 0.16 or 0.11
        vfxBeam.Width0 = w + 0.04 * math.sin(now * 10)
      end
    end
    vfxLastT = now
  end

  _G._CalciumAimbotSwingVFX = function(target, isBypass)
    pcall(function()
      local part = target
      if not part then return end
      local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
      att.Parent = part
      local p = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
      p.Parent = att
      p.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
      p.Color = ColorSequence.new(
        isBypass and Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 120) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 70)
      )
      p.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.35, 0)
      p.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.2, 0.4)
      p.Speed = NumberRange.new(4, 10)
      p.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
      p.Rate = 0
      p.LightEmission = 0.8
      p:Emit(isBypass and 18 or 12)
      task.delay(0.6, function()
        pcall(function() att:Destroy() end)
      end)
    end)
  end

  -- clear VFX when aimbot off
  task.spawn(function()
    while _G.CalciumRunning do
      task.wait(0.35)
      local on = (_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true)
      if not on then
        clearVFX()
      end
    end
  end)
end

-- IRISH bat rotation only: retain the original Calcium chase/movement/swing logic.
_G.CalciumApplyIrishBatRotation = function(myRoot, targetRoot, targetPosition)
  if not myRoot or not targetRoot or not targetRoot.Parent then return end
  local velocity = targetRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity
  local position = myRoot.Position
  local predictedPosition = targetPosition
    + velocity * math.clamp(velocity.Magnitude / 150, 0.05, 0.2)
  if (predictedPosition - position).Magnitude > 0.1 then
    local desired = CFrame.lookAt(position, predictedPosition)
    local x, y, z =
      (myRoot.CFrame:Inverse() * desired):ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
    myRoot.AssemblyAngularVelocity =
      myRoot.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(
        math.clamp(x, -2.5, 2.5) * 42,
        math.clamp(y, -2.5, 2.5) * 42,
        math.clamp(z, -2.5, 2.5) * 42
      ))
  end
end

function _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot(keepV2)
  -- Anti Die SUBITO, prima riga della funzione. Stava nel wrapper in fondo
  -- al file: funzionava solo per chi chiamava il nome globale DOPO che i
  -- wrapper erano stati installati, e chi entrava per altre strade (o
  -- prima) partiva scoperto. Qui non c'e' strada che lo salti.
  if _G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow) end
  if _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart and not _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart() then return false end
  if _G.CalciumStopAutoTPForAction then _G.CalciumStopAutoTPForAction() end
  -- keepV2 = true quando e' il Bat Aimbot V2 a usare questo chase come fase 1
  if not keepV2 then
    if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2(false) end
    _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = false
  end
  _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn = true
  if _G.CalciumStartChaseRagdollWatcher then _G.CalciumStartChaseRagdollWatcher() end
  if _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn then
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn:Disconnect()
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn = nil
  end
  local hum0 = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum0 then hum0.AutoRotate = false end
  _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not root then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum then return end
    local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or _G.CalciumFindAimbotBat()
    if bat and bat.Parent ~= char then
      pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end)
    end
    local target = _G.CalciumGetClosestAimbotTarget()
    if not target then return end
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.target = target

    local _isV2 = (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true)
    local myPos = root.Position
    local targetPos = target.Position
    if _G.CalciumAntiVoid and _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posForPart then
      local gp = select(1, _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posForPart(target, targetPos))
      if typeof(gp) == "Vector3" then targetPos = gp end
    end

    local chaseSpeed = tonumber(
      (_isV2 and _G.CalciumGetBatAimbotV2Speed and _G.CalciumGetBatAimbotV2Speed())
      or (_G.CalciumGetNormalAimbotSpeed and _G.CalciumGetNormalAimbotSpeed())
      or 58
    ) or 58

    -- NO prediction — aim at live position only (+2 Y). Close-range safe.
    local aim = targetPos + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    local flat = Vector3.new(aim.X - myPos.X, 0, aim.Z - myPos.Z)
    local flatDist = flat.Magnitude
    local fullDist = (aim - myPos).Magnitude
    -- When on top of / inside target, do NOT early-return (that caused point-blank misses)
    if flatDist >= 0.05 then
      flat = flat.Unit
      local yVel = math.clamp((aim.Y - myPos.Y) * 16, -90, 110)
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(flat.X * chaseSpeed, yVel, flat.Z * chaseSpeed)
      if _G.CalciumApplyIrishBatRotation then
        _G.CalciumApplyIrishBatRotation(root, target, targetPos)
      end
    else
      -- Point blank: face target head and stay glued
      pcall(function()
        root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(myPos, aim)
      end)
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, math.clamp((aim.Y - myPos.Y) * 12, -40, 40), 0)
    end

    if not _isV2 and bat then
      local NA = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot
      -- Wider swing window so close-range always connects
      if (not NA.swingCooldown) and (flatDist <= 22 or fullDist <= 24) then
        NA.swingCooldown = true
        pcall(function() bat:Activate() end)
        pcall(function()
          if bat:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
            -- extra activate for laggy remotes
            task.defer(function() pcall(function() bat:Activate() end) end)
          end
        end)
        task.delay(0.035, function()
          if _G.CalciumNormalAimbot then _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false end
        end)
      end
    end
  end)
  if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
end
function _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot()
  _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn = false
  if _G.CalciumStopChaseRagdollWatcher then _G.CalciumStopChaseRagdollWatcher() end
  -- Percorso buttato: al prossimo inseguimento si riparte da dove sei
  -- adesso, non da waypoint calcolati per un bersaglio vecchio.
  if _G.CalciumPathfind then pcall(_G.CalciumPathfind.reset, "aimbot") end
  if _G.CalciumNormalAimbot and _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn then
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn:Disconnect()
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn = nil
  end
  if _G.CalciumNormalAimbot then
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.target = nil
    _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.swingCooldown = false
  end
  local c = LP.Character
  local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if root then
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  local hum2 = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if hum2 then hum2.AutoRotate = true end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
end
-- ===== BAT AIMBOT V2 =====
-- Il V2 non ha piu' una logica di inseguimento propria: riusa il chase del
-- Bat Aimbot V1 (con le sue velocita' dedicate) e, appena arriva entro
-- BAT_AIMBOT_V2_TP_DISTANCE stud dal nemico, passa il controllo al TP Bat.
-- In questa fase il TP Bat ignora la sua distanza minima di 8 stud: lo snap
-- avviene comunque. Il TP Bat avviato a mano continua invece a rispettarla.
_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2State = _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2State or {conn = nil}
_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2TPDistance = 5.5

function _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2GetClosest()
  local root = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not root then return nil, math.huge end
  local closest, minDist = nil, math.huge
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then
      local tRoot = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if tRoot and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        -- Nel void la distanza va misurata sulla posizione fantasma,
        -- altrimenti il bersaglio risulta lontanissimo e il trigger
        -- dei 4 stud del V2 non scatta mai.
        local tPos = tRoot.Position
        if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
          tPos = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posFor(plr, tPos)
        end
        local dist = (tPos - root.Position).Magnitude
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END
        if dist < minDist then
          minDist = dist
          closest = tRoot
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return closest, minDist
end
-- Fase 1: chase con la logica del V1 (il flag keepV2 evita che il V1 spenga il V2)
function _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2StartChase()
  if _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot then _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot(true) end
end
-- ============================================================
-- BUBBLE BAT AIMBOT V2 — extracted predictive following logic
-- Bubble V1's chase is already the Calcium-style V1 present above.
-- Only V2 is replaced: Calcium GUI, keybinds, save state and
-- other combat/movement workers remain wired to the same API.
-- ============================================================
do
  local prediction = {
    lastTarget = nil, lastPosition = nil,
    velocity = Vector3.zero, smoothed = Vector3.zero,
    velocityHistory = {}, accelerationHistory = {}, aerialHistory = {},
    previousDirection = nil, lastDirectionTime = 0, airborneTime = 0,
    lastSwing = 0, pingSeconds = 0.1, lastPingCheck = 0,
    previousAutoRotate = nil, targetCheck = 0, currentTarget = nil,
  }
  local SETTINGS = {
    ACTIVATE_DISTANCE = 11,
    MIN_DISTANCE = 4,
    LEAD_TIME = 0.14,
    PREDICT_AHEAD = 1.25,
    MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE = 150,
    VELOCITY_SMOOTHING = 0.2,
    MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY = 80,
    SERVER_TICK = 1/60,
    MIN_PING = 0.03, MAX_PING = 0.25,
    ACCELERATION_WEIGHT = 0.3,
    DIRECTION_WINDOW = 0.12,
    DIRECTION_MULTIPLIER = 1.5,
    GRAVITY = 196.2,
    AIR_CONTROL = 0.8,
    MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME = 0.08,
  }

  local function pushSample(history, value, max)
    history[#history + 1] = value
    if #history > max then table.remove(history, 1) end
  end
  local function average(history)
    if #history == 0 then return Vector3.zero end
    local total = Vector3.zero
    for _, v in ipairs(history) do total += v end
    return total / #history
  end
  local function resetPrediction()
    prediction.lastTarget = nil
    prediction.lastPosition = nil
    prediction.velocity = Vector3.zero
    prediction.smoothed = Vector3.zero
    prediction.velocityHistory = {}
    prediction.accelerationHistory = {}
    prediction.aerialHistory = {}
    prediction.previousDirection = nil
    prediction.airborneTime = 0
    prediction.currentTarget = nil
    prediction.targetCheck = 0
  end
  local function refreshPing(now)
    if now - prediction.lastPingCheck < 0.5 then return end
    prediction.lastPingCheck = now
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
      return Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue()
    end)
    if ok and type(value) == "number" and value >= 0 then
      prediction.pingSeconds = math.clamp(value / 1000, SETTINGS.MIN_PING, SETTINGS.MAX_PING)
    end
  end
  local function closestTarget(root, now)
    if prediction.currentTarget and now - prediction.targetCheck < 0.12 then
      local player = prediction.currentTarget
      local c = player.Character
      local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      local part = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if part and hum and hum.Health > 0 then return player, part, hum end
    end
    prediction.targetCheck = now
    local nearest, part, targetHumanoid, bestDistance = nil, nil, nil, math.huge
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if p ~= LP then
        local c = p.Character
        local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if r and h and h.Health > 0 then
          local distance = (r.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
          if distance < bestDistance then
            nearest, part, targetHumanoid, bestDistance = p, r, h, distance
          end
        end
      end
    end
    prediction.currentTarget = nearest
    return nearest, part, targetHumanoid
  end

  function _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2()
    if _G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow then pcall(_G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow) end
    if _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart and not _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart() then return false end
    if _G.CalciumStopAutoTPForAction then _G.CalciumStopAutoTPForAction() end
    -- No overlapping V1 chase or old TP-Bat snapper.
    if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn and _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot then
      _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot()
    end
    if _G.CalciumTPBatOn and _G.CalciumStopTPBat then _G.CalciumStopTPBat() end
    local char = LP.Character
