    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or not root then return false end
    local state = _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2State
    if state.conn then state.conn:Disconnect(); state.conn = nil end
    resetPrediction()
    prediction.lastSwing = 0
    prediction.lastPingCheck = 0
    prediction.previousAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
    hum.AutoRotate = false
    _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = true
    selectedAimbotMode = "V2"

    -- The original Bubble predictive V2: latency-aware projected position,
    -- acceleration smoothing, aerial tracking and nearest-target following.
    state.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
      if not _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then return end
      local character = LP.Character
      local myRoot = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local myHum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not myRoot or not myHum or myHum.Health <= 0 then return end
      local now = os.clock()
      local frameDt = math.max(tonumber(dt) or (1/60), 1/240)
      refreshPing(now)
      myHum.AutoRotate = false
      local bat = _G.CalciumFindAimbotBat and _G.CalciumFindAimbotBat()
      if bat and bat.Parent ~= character and now >= (calciumBatSwing.nextEquip or 0) then
        calciumBatSwing.nextEquip = now + 0.25
        pcall(function() myHum:EquipTool(bat) end)
      end

      local player, targetRoot, targetHum = closestTarget(myRoot, now)
      if not player or not targetRoot or not targetHum then
        resetPrediction()
        return
      end
      if prediction.lastTarget ~= player then resetPrediction() end
      prediction.lastTarget = player
      local pos = targetRoot.Position
      if prediction.lastPosition then
        local measured = (pos - prediction.lastPosition) / frameDt
        local difference = measured - prediction.velocity
        if difference.Magnitude > SETTINGS.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE then
          measured = prediction.velocity + difference.Unit * SETTINGS.MAX_VELOCITY_CHANGE
        end
        local flat = Vector3.new(measured.X, 0, measured.Z)
        if flat.Magnitude > SETTINGS.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY then
          flat = flat.Unit * SETTINGS.MAX_HORIZONTAL_VELOCITY
          measured = Vector3.new(flat.X, measured.Y, flat.Z)
        end
        pushSample(prediction.accelerationHistory,
          (measured - prediction.velocity) / frameDt, 4)
        pushSample(prediction.velocityHistory, measured, 8)
        prediction.velocity = measured
        prediction.smoothed = prediction.smoothed:Lerp(measured, SETTINGS.VELOCITY_SMOOTHING)
      end
      prediction.lastPosition = pos
      local airborne = targetHum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
      prediction.airborneTime = airborne and prediction.airborneTime + frameDt or 0
      if airborne and prediction.airborneTime >= SETTINGS.MIN_AIRBORNE_TIME then
        pushSample(prediction.aerialHistory, prediction.velocity, 6)
      elseif not airborne then
        prediction.aerialHistory = {}
      end
      local velocity = prediction.smoothed
      if airborne and #prediction.aerialHistory > 0 then
        local aerial = average(prediction.aerialHistory)
        velocity = Vector3.new(aerial.X, prediction.velocity.Y, aerial.Z) * SETTINGS.AIR_CONTROL
      end
      local quickDirection = false
      local horizontal = Vector3.new(prediction.velocity.X, 0, prediction.velocity.Z)
      if horizontal.Magnitude > 5 then
        local direction = horizontal.Unit
        if prediction.previousDirection and prediction.previousDirection:Dot(direction) < 0.5 then
          quickDirection = now - prediction.lastDirectionTime < SETTINGS.DIRECTION_WINDOW
          prediction.lastDirectionTime = now
        end
        prediction.previousDirection = direction
      end
      local lead = prediction.pingSeconds + SETTINGS.SERVER_TICK
      if quickDirection then lead *= SETTINGS.DIRECTION_MULTIPLIER end
      local projected = pos + velocity * lead
        + average(prediction.accelerationHistory) * SETTINGS.ACCELERATION_WEIGHT * (lead * lead * 0.5)
      if airborne then
        projected += velocity * SETTINGS.LEAD_TIME
          + Vector3.new(0, -0.5 * SETTINGS.GRAVITY * SETTINGS.LEAD_TIME^2, 0)
      else
        projected += velocity * SETTINGS.LEAD_TIME
      end
      local planar = Vector3.new(velocity.X, 0, velocity.Z)
      if planar.Magnitude > 1 then
        projected += planar.Unit * SETTINGS.PREDICT_AHEAD
      end
      local distance = (pos - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
      -- Less prediction near contact: an over-led aim point used to carry us
      -- past the opponent on every frame even while supposedly in swing range.
      local weight = math.clamp((distance - 6) / 22, 0, 0.55)
      local chasePoint = pos:Lerp(projected, weight)
      local direction = chasePoint - myRoot.Position
      -- Face the actual torso during the swing; never face the over-led point.
      if _G.CalciumApplyIrishBatRotation then
        _G.CalciumApplyIrishBatRotation(myRoot, targetRoot, pos)
      end
      if distance <= SETTINGS.ACTIVATE_DISTANCE then
        -- Same reliable equip/activation/release path as V1.
        _G.CalciumTryAimbotSwing()
      end
      local flat = Vector3.new(direction.X, 0, direction.Z)
      local flatDistance = flat.Magnitude
      local speed = _G.CalciumGetBatAimbotV2Speed and _G.CalciumGetBatAimbotV2Speed() or 55
      -- Hold a ~4-stud standoff instead of constantly overshooting at 55+ speed.
      local planarSpeed = math.clamp((flatDistance - SETTINGS.MIN_DISTANCE) * 10, 0, math.clamp(speed, 1, 120))
      local planarVelocity = flatDistance > 0.1 and flat.Unit * planarSpeed or Vector3.zero
      local vy
      if distance <= 15 and myHum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
        and targetHum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then
        vy = math.min(myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
      else
        vy = math.clamp(direction.Y * 12 + velocity.Y * 0.3, -70, 95)
      end
      myRoot.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(planarVelocity.X, vy, planarVelocity.Z)
    end)
    if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    return true
  end

  function _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2(keepVisual)
    _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = false
    if _G.CalciumStopChaseRagdollWatcher then _G.CalciumStopChaseRagdollWatcher() end
    local state = _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2State
    if state.conn then state.conn:Disconnect(); state.conn = nil end
    resetPrediction()
    if _G.CalciumPathfind then pcall(_G.CalciumPathfind.reset, "aimbot") end
    local character = LP.Character
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
      hum.AutoRotate = (prediction.previousAutoRotate ~= nil) and prediction.previousAutoRotate or true
      hum.PlatformStand = false
    end
    prediction.previousAutoRotate = nil
    if root then
      root.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
      root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
    if keepVisual ~= false and _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
  end
end -- BUBBLE BAT AIMBOT V2


-- END IRISH AIMBOT CORE
-- ============================================================

function _G.CalciumToggleSelectedAimbot()
  if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
    if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then
      if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2() else _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = false end
    else
      if _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot then _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot() end
      if _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2() else _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = true end
    end
  else
    if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn then
      _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot()
    else
      if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2(false) else _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On = false end
      _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot()
    end
  end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  saveCalciumConfig()
end
function _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual()
  if _G.CalciumAimbotSetVisual then
    if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
      _G.CalciumAimbotSetVisual(_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true)
    else
      _G.CalciumAimbotSetVisual(_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true)
    end
  end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshIrishAimbotGui then pcall(_G.CalciumRefreshIrishAimbotGui) end
end
_G.CalciumNormalAimbotStart = _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot
_G.CalciumNormalAimbotStop = _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot
_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Start = _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2
_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop = _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2

-- Mirror TP Down
-- Helpers interne nel do-block: liberano 6 slot locals dal main chunk.
do
  local MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD = 3
  local MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y = -7.00
  local mirrorTPPreviousY = {}
  local mirrorTPLastTeleport = 0

  local function mirrorTPAimbotActive()
    return (_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true) or (_G.CalciumTPBatOn == true)
  end
  local function mirrorTPTeleportDown()
    local char=LP.Character
    local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not root or not hum or hum.Health<=0 then return end
    local now=tick()
    if now-(mirrorTPLastTeleport or 0)<0.08 then return end
    mirrorTPLastTeleport=now
    local _,yaw=root.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
    local y=(MIRROR_TP_DOWN_Y or -7)+(math.random()*0.6-0.3)
    root.CFrame=CFrame.new(root.Position.X,y,root.Position.Z)*CFrame.Angles(0,yaw,0)
    root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new((math.random()-0.5)*0.4,0,(math.random()-0.5)*0.4)
  end
  RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not mirrorTPDownEnabled or not mirrorTPAimbotActive() then
      if next(mirrorTPPreviousY) then table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY) end
      return
    end
    for _,plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      if plr~=LP and plr.Character then
        local root=plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if root then
          local currentY=root.Position.Y
          local previousY=mirrorTPPreviousY[plr.UserId]
          if previousY and previousY-currentY>=(MIRROR_TP_DROP_THRESHOLD or 3) then
            pcall(mirrorTPTeleportDown)
            table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY)
            return
          end
          mirrorTPPreviousY[plr.UserId]=currentY
        end
      end
    end
  end)

  function _G.CalciumSetMirrorTPDown(enabled)
    mirrorTPDownEnabled = enabled == true
    if not mirrorTPDownEnabled then table.clear(mirrorTPPreviousY) end
    if _G.CalciumMirrorTPDownSetVisual then _G.CalciumMirrorTPDownSetVisual(mirrorTPDownEnabled) end
  end
end -- fine do-block mirrorTP

-- ========================================================
-- TP BAT PAIRING NOTE: standalone counterpart mirrors the V1/V2 motion core below.
-- NUOVO SISTEMA TP BAT (stile Uranium)
-- ========================================================

tpBatEnabled = false
-- Tutte le variabili interne e le helper del blocco tpBat stanno nel do-end:
-- liberano ~11 slot locals dal main chunk evitando il limite di 200.
do
  local tpBatLoopConn = nil
  local tpBatAntiDieGuardConn = nil
  local tpBatAntiDieGuardCharacter = nil
  local tpBatRagdollConn = nil
  local tpBatResetConn = nil
  local tpBatSwingCooldown = 0
  local TP_BAT_SWING_COOLDOWN = 0.06
  local tpBatPlayerConns = {}
  -- Consuma il pending value lasciato da loadCalciumConfig (che gira prima di questo do-block)
  local tpBatCameraLockEnabled = _G._CalciumTPBatCameraLockPending == true
  _G._CalciumTPBatCameraLockPending = nil
  -- Bridge su _G per l'accesso esterno al do-block (save/load/UI/reset)
  _G._CalciumGetTPBatCameraLock = function() return tpBatCameraLockEnabled end
  _G._CalciumSetTPBatCameraLock = function(v) tpBatCameraLockEnabled = v end

  -- ============================================================
  -- NO-COLLISION: delegata al modulo No Player Collision v3.
  -- Prima il TP Bat rifaceva GetDescendants() su tutti i giocatori ad
  -- OGNI frame e al termine riaccendeva CanCollide/CanTouch su tutto,
  -- cancellando anche il lavoro del toggle No Player Collision (e
  -- riaccendendo parti che erano gia' false in origine, tipo accessori).
  -- Ora si limita a prenotare/rilasciare il modulo col tag "tpbat".
  -- ============================================================
  local function acquireNoCollision()
      if _G.CalciumNoCollisionAcquire then _G.CalciumNoCollisionAcquire("tpbat") end
  end
  local function releaseNoCollision()
      if _G.CalciumNoCollisionRelease then _G.CalciumNoCollisionRelease("tpbat") end
  end
  -- ============================================================
  -- GET CLOSEST ENEMY
  -- ============================================================
  local function getClosestEnemy()
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return nil, math.huge end
      local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not root then return nil, math.huge end
      local closest, dist = nil, math.huge
      for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
          if p ~= LP and p.Character then
              local tr = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if tr and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                  local d = (tr.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                  if d < dist then
                      dist = d
                      closest = p
                  end
              end
          end
      end
      return closest, dist
  end
  -- ============================================================
  -- AUTO SWING
  -- ============================================================
  local function trySwingBat()
      if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true then
        if tick() < (_G._CalciumV2SwingGate or 0) then return end
      end
      -- Always swing while TP Bat is running (hits more reliably)
      local now = tick()
      if now - tpBatSwingCooldown < TP_BAT_SWING_COOLDOWN then return end
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local bat = char:FindFirstChild("Bat") or LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat")
      if bat then
          if bat.Parent == LP.Backpack then
              local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if hum then hum:EquipTool(bat) end
          end
          pcall(function()
              bat:Activate()
              tpBatSwingCooldown = now
          end)
      end
  end
  -- ============================================================
  -- RAGDOLL DETECTOR: disattiva tp bat quando il nemico ragdolla
  -- ============================================================
  local function onEnemyRagdollStarted()
      if not tpBatEnabled then return end
      -- Disattivazione ISTANTANEA al rilevamento hit (nessun cooldown)
      if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then
          -- Questo TP Bat e' la fase 2 del Bat Aimbot V2: l'hit spegne tutto il V2,
          -- cosi' il chase non riparte piu' da solo.
          if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2() return end
      end
      _G.CalciumStopTPBat()
  end
  local function setupEnemyRagdollDetector(enemyChar)
      local conn = enemyChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
          if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then onEnemyRagdollStarted() end
      end)
      return conn
  end
  local function watchEnemyPlayer(plr)
      if plr == LP then return end
      if tpBatPlayerConns[plr] then
          pcall(function() tpBatPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
      end
      tpBatPlayerConns[plr] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
          if char then
              local detectorConn = setupEnemyRagdollDetector(char)
              char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                  if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
              end)
          end
      end)
      if plr.Character then
          local detectorConn = setupEnemyRagdollDetector(plr.Character)
          plr.Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
              if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
          end)
      end
  end
  -- ============================================================
  -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS BEGIN
  -- V1 = former Calcium V3 body pattern; V2 = Clean combat core.
  -- V2 = orbita fissa attorno al nemico.
  -- V3 = body spam pattern (spam di teleport ravvicinati).
  -- V4 = body spam 0.5 stud avanti rispetto alla direzione del nemico.
  -- V5 = vortex: spirale che si stringe/allarga (raggio max 3).
  --
  -- Tutte le versioni girano DENTRO questo do-block, quindi ereditano
  -- gratis l'infrastruttura gia' presente:
  --   * No Player Collision automatica (acquire/release col tag "tpbat")
  --   * Auto Stop sul ragdoll del nemico (detector condiviso)
  --   * Anti Void (posForPart + PhysicsRepRootPart a nil se il nemico e' nel void)
  --   * Auto Swing / Camera Lock / Safe Mode / save config / bottoni mobile
  --
  -- IMPORTANTE: Bat Aimbot V2 e Bat Counter V2 usano SEMPRE la V1.
  -- La versione scelta dall'utente viene ignorata mentre uno dei due comanda.
  -- Tutti i parametri stanno in una sola tabella per non consumare local slot.
  -- ============================================================
  local TPB = {
    velHist     = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
    orbitAngle  = 0,
    spinAngle   = 0,
    -- V2
    orbitRadius = 4.2,
    orbitSpeed  = 80,
    -- V3 / V4
    spinSpeed   = 48,
    -- Stesso numero di teleport della V5, cosi' V3 e V4 picchiano quanto lei
    teleports   = 300,
    -- V5
    v5Teleports = 300,
    v5SpinSpeed = 60,
    v5RadiusMin = 1.5,
    v5RadiusMax = 3,
  }
  _G._CalciumTPB = TPB   -- tuning esterno (facoltativo)

  -- Velocita' del bersaglio filtrata (stessa formula delle logiche V2..V5)
  local function tpBatTrackVel(tr)
      local now = os.clock()
      local pos = tr.Position
      local vel = tr.AssemblyLinearVelocity or Vector3.zero
      local h = TPB.velHist[tr]
      if h then
          local dt = now - h.t
          if dt > 0.004 and dt < 0.5 then
              local measured = (pos - h.p) / dt
              if measured.Magnitude < 180 then
                  local blend = math.clamp(dt * 12, 0.2, 0.85)
                  vel = (h.v or vel):Lerp(measured, blend)
              end
          end
      end
      TPB.velHist[tr] = { t = now, p = pos, v = vel }
      return vel
  end
  -- Snap "sicuro": evita CFrame.new(p, p) quando i due punti coincidono
  local function tpBatSnap(hrp, pos, lookAt)
      if (pos - lookAt).Magnitude > 0.001 then
          hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos, lookAt)
      else
          hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
      end
      hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
      hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
  end
  local function tpBatFrame(dt)
      if not tpBatEnabled then return end
      dt = (type(dt) == "number" and dt > 0 and dt < 0.1) and dt or (1 / 60)

      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
      if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

      local version = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.CalciumTPBatVersion) or 1, 1, 2)
      local target
      if version == 2 then
          local distance = 100
          for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
              local other = player ~= LP and player.Character
              local root = other and other:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
              local otherHum = other and other:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
              if root and otherHum and otherHum.Health > 0 then
                  local candidate = (hrp.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                  if candidate < distance then target, distance = player, candidate end
              end
          end
      else
          target = getClosestEnemy()
      end
      if not (target and target.Character) then return end
      local tr = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
      if not tr then return end

      -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
      -- Nemico tpato nel void: si lavora sul punto d'origine.
      local _tpRaw, _tpGhost = tr.Position, false
      if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
          _tpRaw, _tpGhost = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posForPart(tr, tr.Position)
      end
      -- PhysicsRepRootPart si aggancia al nemico solo se e' ancora in mappa.
      if sethiddenproperty then
          if _tpGhost then
              pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", nil) end)
          else
              pcall(function() sethiddenproperty(hrp, "PhysicsRepRootPart", tr) end)
          end
      end
      -- <<< ANTI VOID END

      if version == 1 then
          -- V1: Calcium's former V3 body pattern.
          local center = _tpRaw + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0)
          local tv = _tpGhost and Vector3.zero or tpBatTrackVel(tr)
          local flatVel = Vector3.new(tv.X, 0, tv.Z)
          if flatVel.Magnitude > 110 then flatVel = flatVel.Unit * 110 end
          local anchor = center + flatVel * 0.05
          local look, right = tr.CFrame.LookVector, tr.CFrame.RightVector
          TPB.spinAngle = (TPB.spinAngle or 0) + TPB.spinSpeed * dt * 4.4
          local spin = TPB.spinAngle
          local c, sine = math.cos(spin), math.sin(spin)
          for i = 1, TPB.teleports do
              local jx, jz, jy = ((i % 5) - 2) * 0.05, ((i % 7) - 3) * 0.04, ((i % 3) - 1) * 0.025
              local ox, oz = jx * c - jz * sine, jx * sine + jz * c
              tpBatSnap(hrp, anchor + right * ox + look * (0.12 + oz) + Vector3.new(0, jy, 0), anchor)
          end
          tpBatSnap(hrp, anchor + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0), anchor + Vector3.new(math.sin(spin) * 0.4, 0, math.cos(spin) * 0.4))
      else
          -- V2: Clean's nearest-target teleport and bat swing core.
          local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
          if animator then
              pcall(function() for _, animation in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do animation:Stop() end end)
          end
          pcall(function() if hrp.SetNetworkOwner then hrp:SetNetworkOwner(nil) end end)
          hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(_tpRaw + Vector3.new(0, 0.9, 0))
          hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = tr.AssemblyLinearVelocity
          pcall(function() if hrp.SetNetworkOwner then hrp:SetNetworkOwner(LP) end end)
          local bat
          for _, parent in ipairs({char, LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")}) do
              for _, tool in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
                  local name = tool.Name:lower()
                  if tool:IsA("Tool") and (name:find("bat") or name:find("slap")) then bat = tool; break end
              end
              if bat then break end
          end
          if bat then
              if bat.Parent ~= char then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bat) end) end
              if os.clock() >= (TPB.cleanNextHit or 0) then
                  TPB.cleanNextHit = os.clock() + 0.08
                  pcall(function()
                      bat:Activate()
                      local remote = bat:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent")
                      if remote then remote:FireServer() end
                  end)
              end
          end
          local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
          if camera then camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(camera.CFrame.Position, _tpRaw) end
      end
      -- Equip bat + camera + swing every frame
      pcall(function()
          local bat = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            or char:FindFirstChild("Bat")
            or (LP.Backpack and (LP.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Bat") or LP.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")))
          if bat and bat.Parent ~= char and hum then
              hum:EquipTool(bat)
          end
      end)
      -- Stronger target-centered camera shake while TP Bat is active.
      -- Rebuild from a target-facing base every frame so the rotation does not accumulate.
      do
          local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
          if camera then
              local now = os.clock()
              local shakePitch = math.sin(now * 39) * 0.038 + math.sin(now * 17) * 0.012
              local shakeYaw   = math.cos(now * 33) * 0.046 + math.sin(now * 21) * 0.010
              local shakeRoll  = math.sin(now * 45) * 0.020
              pcall(function()
                  local baseView = CFrame.lookAt(camera.CFrame.Position, _tpRaw)
                  camera.CFrame = baseView * CFrame.Angles(shakePitch, shakeYaw, shakeRoll)
              end)
          end
      end
      if version == 1 then trySwingBat() end
  end
  -- Cambio versione (UI / keybind). Non riavvia il TP Bat: il dispatcher
  -- legge _G.CalciumTPBatVersion ad ogni frame.
  function _G.CalciumSetTPBatVersion(v)
      v = math.clamp(tonumber(v) or 1, 1, 2)
      _G.CalciumTPBatVersion = v
      TPB.orbitAngle = 0
      TPB.spinAngle = 0
      table.clear(TPB.velHist)
      if _G._CalciumTPBatSetVersionVisual then _G._CalciumTPBatSetVersionVisual(v) end
      if saveCalciumConfig then saveCalciumConfig() end
      return v
  end
  -- <<< TP BAT VERSIONS END

-- ===== AVVIO / ARRESTO =====
local function calciumEnsureTPBatAntiDie()
    -- Prefer the full Calcium Anti Die implementation and wait until it
    -- confirms it is applied to the current character before TP Bat moves.
    if type(_G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow) == "function" then
        local ok, armed = pcall(_G.CalciumAntiDieArmNow, 0.85)
        if ok and armed == true then return true end
    end

    -- Synchronous fallback for unusual call order / respawn timing.
    _G._CalciumAntiDieAutoOn = true
    if not antiDieEnabled then pcall(startAntiDie, true) end
    local character = LP.Character
    if character and antiDieEnabled and not antiDieConnections[character] then
        pcall(applyGodMode, character)
    end
    return antiDieEnabled == true and (character == nil or antiDieConnections[character] ~= nil)
end

function _G.CalciumStartTPBat()
    if tpBatEnabled then return true end
    if _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart and not _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart() then return false end

    -- Anti Die MUST be active before the first teleport/swing. Do not start
    -- TP Bat if its protection cannot be confirmed for the current character.
    if not calciumEnsureTPBatAntiDie() then
        warn("[Calcium] TP Bat not started: Anti Die could not be confirmed.")
        return false
    end

    -- Ferma gli altri aimbot se attivi
    if _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot then _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot() end
    -- Se e' il Bat Aimbot V2 a chiamarci non spegniamo il V2: e' la sua fase 2.
    if not _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then
        if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2(false) end
    end
    tpBatEnabled = true
    _G.CalciumTPBatOn = true

    -- Guard the entire active period: if another module/respawn drops Anti Die,
    -- re-apply Calcium's protection before allowing TP Bat to continue unprotected.
    if tpBatAntiDieGuardConn then pcall(function() tpBatAntiDieGuardConn:Disconnect() end) end
    tpBatAntiDieGuardCharacter = nil
    tpBatAntiDieGuardConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not tpBatEnabled or _G.CalciumInstantResetOverride == true then return end
        local character = LP.Character
        if not antiDieEnabled then
            _G._CalciumAntiDieAutoOn = true
            pcall(startAntiDie, true)
        end
        -- CharacterAdded already reapplies Anti Die after respawn. This delayed,
        -- one-shot fallback avoids spawning duplicate protection tasks every frame.
        if character and antiDieEnabled and not antiDieConnections[character]
            and tpBatAntiDieGuardCharacter ~= character then
            tpBatAntiDieGuardCharacter = character
            task.delay(0.2, function()
                if tpBatEnabled and LP.Character == character and antiDieEnabled
                    and not antiDieConnections[character] then
                    pcall(applyGodMode, character)
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    -- Prenota la no-collision per tutta la durata del TP Bat
    acquireNoCollision()

    -- ============================================================
    -- LOOP PRINCIPALE (Heartbeat):
    --   Solo snap al target + camera + autoswing.
    --   La no-collision e' prenotata una volta sotto, non per-frame.
    -- ============================================================
    -- NO-COLLISION: gestita dal modulo v3 (event-driven), non serve
    -- rifarla ogni frame.
    -- Il dispatcher sceglie la versione (V1..V5) ad ogni frame.
    if tpBatLoopConn then tpBatLoopConn:Disconnect() end
    TPB.orbitAngle = 0
    TPB.spinAngle = 0
    table.clear(TPB.velHist)
    tpBatLoopConn = (RunService.RenderStepped or RunService.Heartbeat):Connect(tpBatFrame)

    -- Rilevamento ragdoll nemici (PlayerAdded + esistenti)
    if tpBatRagdollConn then tpBatRagdollConn:Disconnect() end
    tpBatRagdollConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchEnemyPlayer)
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        watchEnemyPlayer(plr)
    end
    -- Pulizia per-player quando qualcuno esce
    if tpBatResetConn then tpBatResetConn:Disconnect() end
    tpBatResetConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        if tpBatPlayerConns[plr] then
            pcall(function() tpBatPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
            tpBatPlayerConns[plr] = nil
        end
    end)

    if _G.CalciumTPBatSetVisual then _G.CalciumTPBatSetVisual(true) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    saveCalciumConfig()
    return true
end
function _G.CalciumStopTPBat()
    tpBatEnabled = false
    _G.CalciumTPBatOn = false
    if tpBatAntiDieGuardConn then
        pcall(function() tpBatAntiDieGuardConn:Disconnect() end)
        tpBatAntiDieGuardConn = nil
    end
    tpBatAntiDieGuardCharacter = nil
    if not (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true) and not (_G.CalciumCounterState and _G.CalciumCounterState.batDebounce == true) then
        _G.CalciumTPBatSilent = false
    end
    -- Disconnetti tutti i loop IMMEDIATAMENTE
    if tpBatLoopConn then
        tpBatLoopConn:Disconnect()
        tpBatLoopConn = nil
    end
    if tpBatRagdollConn then
        tpBatRagdollConn:Disconnect()
        tpBatRagdollConn = nil
    end
    if tpBatResetConn then
        tpBatResetConn:Disconnect()
        tpBatResetConn = nil
    end
    -- Disconnetti tutte le CharacterAdded per-player IMMEDIATAMENTE
    for plr, conn in pairs(tpBatPlayerConns) do
        pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(tpBatPlayerConns)

    -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS: azzera lo stato delle logiche V2..V5 <<<
    TPB.orbitAngle = 0
    TPB.spinAngle = 0
    table.clear(TPB.velHist)

    -- Aggiorna UI immediatamente
    if _G.CalciumTPBatSetVisual then _G.CalciumTPBatSetVisual(false) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    saveCalciumConfig()

    -- Rilascia la prenotazione. Se il toggle No Player Collision e' acceso
    -- il modulo resta attivo; altrimenti ripristina i valori ORIGINALI di
    -- ogni parte (non un CanCollide = true a tappeto).
    task.delay(0.5, function()
        releaseNoCollision()
    end)
end
function _G.CalciumToggleTPBat()
    -- Toggle manuale: il bottone mobile deve accendersi
    _G.CalciumTPBatSilent = false
    if tpBatEnabled then
        _G.CalciumStopTPBat()
    else
        _G.CalciumStartTPBat()
    end
end
end -- fine do-block tpBat

_G.CalciumTPBatOn = false  -- viene aggiornato dalle funzioni

-- ========================================================
-- RAGDOLL DETECTOR PER IL CHASE (Bat Aimbot V1 / V2)
-- Stessa identica logica del detector del TP Bat, ciclo di vita compreso:
-- le connessioni si creano allo start del chase e si staccano allo stop.
-- A chase spento non resta collegato nulla.
-- ========================================================
do
  local chaseRagdollEnabled = false
  local chaseRagdollPlayerConns = {}
  local chaseDetectorConns = {}
  local chaseRagdollAddedConn = nil
  local chaseRagdollRemovingConn = nil

  local function onChaseEnemyRagdollStarted()
    if not chaseRagdollEnabled then return end
    -- Se il TP Bat sta girando comanda il suo detector interno.
    if _G.CalciumTPBatOn then return end
    -- Disattivazione ISTANTANEA al rilevamento hit (nessun cooldown)
    if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then
      -- V2: si spegne tutto (chase + TP Bat), non riparte da solo.
      if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2() end
    elseif _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn then
      if _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot then _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot() end
    end
  end
  local function setupChaseRagdollDetector(enemyChar)
    local conn = enemyChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      local target = _G.CalciumNormalAimbot and _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.target
      if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and target and target.Parent == enemyChar then
        onChaseEnemyRagdollStarted()
      end
    end)
    table.insert(chaseDetectorConns, conn)
    return conn
  end
  local function watchChaseEnemyPlayer(plr)
    if plr == LP then return end
    if chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] then
      pcall(function() chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
    end
    chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
      if char and chaseRagdollEnabled then
        local detectorConn = setupChaseRagdollDetector(char)
        char.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
          if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
        end)
      end
    end)
    if plr.Character then
      local detectorConn = setupChaseRagdollDetector(plr.Character)
      plr.Character.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then pcall(function() detectorConn:Disconnect() end) end
      end)
    end
  end
  -- Avviato da StartNormalAimbot (vale sia per il V1 che per la fase 1 del V2)
  function _G.CalciumStartChaseRagdollWatcher()
    if chaseRagdollEnabled then return end
    chaseRagdollEnabled = true
    if chaseRagdollAddedConn then chaseRagdollAddedConn:Disconnect() end
    chaseRagdollAddedConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchChaseEnemyPlayer)
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
      watchChaseEnemyPlayer(plr)
    end
    if chaseRagdollRemovingConn then chaseRagdollRemovingConn:Disconnect() end
    chaseRagdollRemovingConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
      if chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] then
        pcall(function() chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr]:Disconnect() end)
        chaseRagdollPlayerConns[plr] = nil
      end
    end)
  end
  -- Fermato da StopNormalAimbot / StopBatAimbotV2
  function _G.CalciumStopChaseRagdollWatcher()
    chaseRagdollEnabled = false
    if chaseRagdollAddedConn then
      chaseRagdollAddedConn:Disconnect()
      chaseRagdollAddedConn = nil
    end
    if chaseRagdollRemovingConn then
      chaseRagdollRemovingConn:Disconnect()
      chaseRagdollRemovingConn = nil
    end
    for _, conn in pairs(chaseRagdollPlayerConns) do
      pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    table.clear(chaseRagdollPlayerConns)
    for _, conn in ipairs(chaseDetectorConns) do conn:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(chaseDetectorConns)
  end
end
-- Toggle del TP Bat "manuale" (keybind / bottone mobile).
-- Se il TP Bat attivo appartiene alla fase 2 del Bat Aimbot V2, il V2 viene
-- smontato del tutto e si riparte con un TP Bat normale, cosi' le due logiche
-- non si intrecciano.
function _G.CalciumToggleTPBatManual()
  -- Avvio manuale: il bottone mobile deve accendersi
  _G.CalciumTPBatSilent = false
  if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then
    if _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2() end
    if _G.CalciumStartTPBat then _G.CalciumStartTPBat() end
    return
  end
  if _G.CalciumToggleTPBat then
    _G.CalciumToggleTPBat()
  elseif _G.CalciumStartTPBat and _G.CalciumStopTPBat then
    if _G.CalciumTPBatOn then _G.CalciumStopTPBat() else _G.CalciumStartTPBat() end
  end
end
-- Bounded hold sessions: one owner, one completion, cleanup on every exit.
_G.CalciumHoldSessions = {}
function _G.CalciumCancelHold(owner)
  local session = _G.CalciumHoldSessions[owner]
  if session then
    session.cancelled = true
    if session.begun and session.prompt.Parent then pcall(function() session.prompt:InputHoldEnd() end) end
    _G.CalciumHoldSessions[owner] = nil
  end
end
function _G.CalciumRunHold(owner, prompt, options)
  if not options.enabled() then return "Cancelled" end
  _G.CalciumCancelHold(owner)
  local session = {prompt = prompt, cancelled = false}
  _G.CalciumHoldSessions[owner] = session
  local character = LP.Character
  local function valid()
    if session.cancelled or _G.CalciumHoldSessions[owner] ~= session then return false end
    if LP.Character ~= character or not prompt.Parent or not options.enabled() then return false end
    local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 or not root then return false end
    if _G.CalciumStealSlotOccupied and not _G.CalciumStealSlotOccupied(options.animal) then return false end
    local attachment = prompt.Parent
    local position = attachment:IsA("Attachment") and attachment.WorldPosition
      or (attachment:IsA("BasePart") and attachment.Position)
      or (attachment:IsA("Model") and attachment:GetPivot().Position)
    if not position then return false end
    local distance = (root.Position - position).Magnitude
    return distance <= options.radius(), distance
  end
  local function callbacks(signal)
    local result = {}
    if type(getconnections) == "function" then
      local ok, connections = pcall(getconnections, signal)
      if ok then
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
          if connection.Enabled ~= false and type(connection.Function) == "function" then
            table.insert(result, connection.Function)
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return result
  end
  local ok, result = pcall(function()
    local duration = math.max(tonumber(options.duration) or 1.3, 0.05)
    local cap = math.clamp(tonumber(options.cap) or 0.8, 0.01, 0.99)
    local preparedAt = os.clock()
    while valid() do
      local prepared = math.min((os.clock() - preparedAt) / duration, cap)
      options.update(prepared, prepared >= cap and "READY · LOCAL" or "PREPARING")
      local alive, distance = valid()
      if not alive then return "Cancelled" end
      if prepared >= cap and distance <= options.completeRadius() then break end
      task.wait(0.03)
    end
    if not valid() then return "Cancelled" end
    local holds = callbacks(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    local triggers = callbacks(prompt.Triggered)
    local custom = #holds > 0 and #triggers > 0
    if not custom then duration = math.max(prompt.HoldDuration, 0.05) end
    local function finishRadius()
      return custom and options.completeRadius() or math.min(options.completeRadius(), prompt.MaxActivationDistance)
    end
    -- Only start the real interaction at completion range. No ageing server hold.
    while valid() do
      local alive, distance = valid()
      if not alive then return "Cancelled" end
      if distance > finishRadius() then
        options.update(cap, "READY · LOCAL")
        task.wait(0.03)
      else
        session.begun = true
        if custom then
          for _, fn in ipairs(holds) do
            if not valid() then return "Cancelled" end
            task.spawn(function() if valid() then pcall(fn, LP) end end)
          end
        else prompt:InputHoldBegin() end
        local started, interrupted = os.clock(), false
        while os.clock() - started < duration do
          local active, currentDistance = valid()
          if not active then return "Cancelled" end
          if currentDistance > finishRadius() then interrupted = true; break end
          options.update(cap + (1 - cap) * math.clamp((os.clock() - started) / duration, 0, 1), "FINISHING")
          task.wait(0.02)
        end
        if interrupted then
          pcall(function() prompt:InputHoldEnd() end)
          session.begun = false
          -- This is a new attempt, never a claim of retained server progress.
          options.update(cap, "READY · LOCAL")
        else
          local active, finalDistance = valid()
          if not active or finalDistance > finishRadius() then return "Cancelled" end
          if custom then
            for _, fn in ipairs(triggers) do
              if not valid() then return "Cancelled" end
              local fired = pcall(fn, LP)
              if not fired then return "Trigger error" end
            end
          end
          options.update(1, "REQUESTED")
          if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup then pcall(_G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup, 1.25) end
          return "Requested"
        end
      end
    end
    return "Cancelled"
  end)
  if _G.CalciumHoldSessions[owner] == session then
    pcall(function() if session.begun and prompt.Parent then prompt:InputHoldEnd() end end)
    _G.CalciumHoldSessions[owner] = nil
  end
  if not ok then warn("[Calcium] hold session:", result); return "Error" end
  return result
end

_G.__CalciumSetupNormalAutoSteal = function()
  _G.CalciumNormalSteal = _G.CalciumNormalSteal or {
    enabled = false,
    radius = 62,
    duration = 1.3,
    animals = {},
    promptCache = {},
    internalCache = {},
    scannerStarted = false,
    scanning = false,
    isStealing = false,
    stealConn = nil,
    refreshThread = nil,
    lastSteal = 0,
    cooldown = 0.05,
  }
  if _G.CalciumNormalSteal.stealConn then pcall(function() _G.CalciumNormalSteal.stealConn:Disconnect() end); _G.CalciumNormalSteal.stealConn = nil end
  _G.CalciumNormalSteal.enabled = false
  _G.CalciumNormalSteal.isStealing = false

  local function barProgress(p)
    p = math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState("STEALING")
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(p)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function resetBar()
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end
    end)
  end
  local function getRoot()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
  end
  local function isMyBase(plotName)
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(plotName)
    if not plot then return false end
    local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local yourBase = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
    return yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled == true
  end
  local function scanPlots()
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    a.animals = {}
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plots then return end
    for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
      if plot:IsA("Model") and not isMyBase(plot.Name) then
        local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if podiums then
          for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
            if podium:IsA("Model") then
              local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
              local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
              if spawn then
                table.insert(a.animals, {
                  plot = plot.Name,
                  slot = podium.Name,
                  worldPosition = spawn.Position,
                  uid = plot.Name .. "_" .. podium.Name,
                })
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  local function ensureScanner()
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    if a.scannerStarted then return end
    a.scannerStarted = true
    task.spawn(function()
      task.wait(1)
      while _G.CalciumNormalSteal do
        if _G.CalciumNormalSteal.enabled then
          pcall(scanPlots)
        end
        task.wait(3)
      end
    end)
  end
  local function findPrompt(data)
    if not data then return nil end
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    local cached = a.promptCache[data.uid]
    if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
    local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(data.plot)
    local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    local podium = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(data.slot)
    local base = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    if not attach then return nil end
    for _, prompt in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
      if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        a.promptCache[data.uid] = prompt
        return prompt
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function cacheCallbacks(prompt)
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    if a.internalCache[prompt] then
      -- refresh connections (they can go stale)
      local data = a.internalCache[prompt]
      pcall(function()
        if not getconnections then return end
        if #data.hold == 0 then
          for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
            if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.hold, conn.Function) end
          end
        end
        if #data.trigger == 0 then
          for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
            if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.trigger, conn.Function) end
          end
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    local data = {hold = {}, trigger = {}, ready = true}
    pcall(function()
      if getconnections then
        for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
          if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.hold, conn.Function) end
        end
        for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
          if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.trigger, conn.Function) end
        end
      end
    end)
    -- ALWAYS cache so fireproximityprompt path works even without getconnections
    a.internalCache[prompt] = data
  end
  -- Stesso identico check delle modalita' Semi: distanza dal prompt vivo
  -- (prompt.Parent.Parent = la parte Spawn), non da una posizione salvata.
  local function stillInRange(prompt)
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root or not prompt.Parent or not prompt.Parent.Parent then return false end
    return (root.Position - prompt.Parent.Parent.Position).Magnitude <= (tonumber(a.radius) or 62)
  end
  local function doSteal(prompt)
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or a.isStealing then return end
    if tick() - (a.lastSteal or 0) < (a.cooldown or 0.08) then return end
    cacheCallbacks(prompt)
    local data = a.internalCache[prompt]
    if not data or not data.ready then return end
    data.ready = false
    a.isStealing = true
    a.lastSteal = tick()
    pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.SetState("STEALING") end end)
    task.spawn(function()
      -- hold began
      if #data.hold > 0 then
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do
          task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end)
        end
      elseif getconnections then
        pcall(function()
          for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)) do
            if type(conn.Function) == "function" then
              table.insert(data.hold, conn.Function)
              task.spawn(function() pcall(conn.Function) end)
            end
          end
        end)
      end

      local startTime = tick()
      local dur = 1.3
      a.duration = dur
      -- bar fills in 1.25s, holds full last 0.05s so 100% is visible before grab
      local fillDur = math.max(dur - 0.05, 0.05)
      local aborted = false
      while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and tick() - startTime < dur do
        local elapsed = tick() - startTime
        -- only abort if out of range early; last 0.15s always finish so 100% grabs
        if elapsed < (dur - 0.15) and not stillInRange(prompt) then
          aborted = true
          break
        end
        barProgress(math.min(elapsed / fillDur, 1))
        task.wait(0.02)
      end

      if aborted or not a.enabled or selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" then
        data.ready = true
        a.isStealing = false
        resetBar()
        return
      end

      barProgress(1)
      pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.SetState("STOLE") end end)

      -- re-cache triggers if empty
      if #data.trigger == 0 and getconnections then
        pcall(function()
          for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
            if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.trigger, conn.Function) end
          end
        end)
      end

      for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do
        task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end)
      end
      pcall(function()
        if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
      end)
      pcall(function() if prompt.InputHoldEnd then prompt:InputHoldEnd() end end)
      pcall(function()
        if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup then
          _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(1.25)
        end
      end)

      task.wait(0.08)
      data.ready = true
      a.isStealing = false
      resetBar()
    end)
  end

  local function doStealV2(prompt, animalData)
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or a.isStealing then return end
    if tick() - (a.lastSteal or 0) < (a.cooldown or 0.06) then return end
    cacheCallbacks(prompt)
    local data = a.internalCache[prompt]
    if not data or not data.ready then return end
    data.ready = false
    a.isStealing = true
    a.lastSteal = tick()
    local label = "STEALING..."
    pcall(function()
      if animalData then
        if type(animalData) == "table" then
          label = tostring(animalData.name or animalData.Name or animalData.slot or "STEALING...")
        end
      end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState(label)
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(0)
      end
    end)
    task.spawn(function()
      if #data.hold > 0 then
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.hold) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end
      end
      local FILL_CAP = 0.8
      local HOLD_TIME = 2
      local COMPLETE_RADIUS = 9
      local dur = tonumber(a.duration) or 1.3
      local function worldPos()
        if animalData and type(animalData) == "table" then
          if _G.CalciumStealAnimalPos then
            local p = _G.CalciumStealAnimalPos(animalData)
            if p then return p end
          end
          if animalData.worldPosition then return animalData.worldPosition end
        end
        if prompt and prompt.Parent and prompt.Parent.Parent then
          return prompt.Parent.Parent.Position
        end
        return nil
      end
      local function inRange()
        local root = getRoot()
        local pos = worldPos()
        if not root or not pos then return false end
        return (root.Position - pos).Magnitude <= COMPLETE_RADIUS
      end
      local t0 = tick()
      while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and selectedNormalMode == "V2" and tick() - t0 < dur do
        local p = math.min((tick() - t0) / dur, FILL_CAP)
        barProgress(p)
        pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.SetState(label) end end)
        if p >= FILL_CAP then break end
        task.wait(0.02)
      end
      if not a.enabled or selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" or selectedNormalMode ~= "V2" then
        data.ready = true; a.isStealing = false; resetBar(); return
      end
      local holdT0 = tick()
      local completed = false
      while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and selectedNormalMode == "V2" and tick() - holdT0 < HOLD_TIME do
        barProgress(FILL_CAP)
        if inRange() then completed = true; break end
        task.wait(0.02)
      end
      if not a.enabled or selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" or selectedNormalMode ~= "V2" or not completed then
        data.ready = true; a.isStealing = false; resetBar(); return
      end
      local t1 = tick()
      local fillDur = math.max(dur * (1 - FILL_CAP), 0.05)
      while a.enabled and selectedStealMode == "Normal" and selectedNormalMode == "V2" and tick() - t1 < fillDur do
        local p = FILL_CAP + math.min((tick() - t1) / fillDur, 1) * (1 - FILL_CAP)
        barProgress(p)
        task.wait(0.02)
      end
      if not a.enabled or selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" or selectedNormalMode ~= "V2" then
        data.ready = true; a.isStealing = false; resetBar(); return
      end
      barProgress(1)
      pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.SetState("STOLE") end end)
      if #data.trigger == 0 and getconnections then
        pcall(function()
          for _, conn in ipairs(getconnections(prompt.Triggered)) do
            if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.trigger, conn.Function) end
          end
        end)
      end
      for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end
      task.defer(function()
        for _, fn in ipairs(data.trigger) do pcall(fn) end
      end)
      pcall(function()
        if fireproximityprompt then
          fireproximityprompt(prompt)
          task.wait(0.05)
          pcall(fireproximityprompt, prompt)
        end
      end)
      pcall(function() if prompt.InputHoldEnd then prompt:InputHoldEnd() end end)
      pcall(function() if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup then _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(1.25) end end)
      task.wait(0.12)
      data.ready = true
      a.isStealing = false
      resetBar()
    end)
  end
  local function nearestAnimal()
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then return nil end
    local radius = tonumber(a.radius) or 62

    -- STESSA SCELTA DEL BERSAGLIO DELLA SEMI.
    -- Prima si guardava la lista costruita dallo scan della Normal, che
    -- contiene TUTTI i podi (anche quelli vuoti), e si usava la
    -- worldPosition salvata al momento della scansione. Due problemi in
    -- uno: si prendeva di mira un podio senza niente sopra, e anche
    -- quando l'animale spariva la posizione vecchia restava buona,
    -- quindi lo steal partiva lo stesso a vuoto.
    -- La lista della Semi nasce invece dall'AnimalList del plot (solo
    -- slot davvero occupati) e la posizione viene risolta ADESSO dal
    -- podio: se non c'e' piu' niente, animalPos ritorna nil e quella
    -- voce non e' un bersaglio.
    -- #list > 0 e non solo "e' una tabella": lo scan condiviso ci mette un
    -- attimo a partire (aspetta ReplicatedStorage), e con la lista ancora
    -- vuota si usciva subito senza bersaglio invece di ripiegare sulla
    -- scansione propria. Era per quello che la Normal sembrava morta
    -- finche' non passavi da Semi e tornavi indietro.
    if _G.CalciumStealAnimals then
      local list = _G.CalciumStealAnimals()
      if type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 then
        local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
        for _, data in ipairs(list) do
          local mine = _G.CalciumStealIsMyBase and _G.CalciumStealIsMyBase(data)
          local occupied = (not _G.CalciumStealSlotOccupied)
                           or _G.CalciumStealSlotOccupied(data)
          if not mine and occupied then
            local pos = _G.CalciumStealAnimalPos and _G.CalciumStealAnimalPos(data)
            if pos then
              local dist = (root.Position - pos).Magnitude
              if dist <= radius and dist < bestDist then
                best, bestDist = data, dist
              end
            end
          end
        end
        return best
      end
    end
    -- Ripiego: la Semi non e' ancora stata inizializzata. Anche qui la
    -- posizione si risolve dal vivo, non dalla worldPosition salvata.
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, data in ipairs(a.animals) do
      if not isMyBase(data.plot) then
        local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
        local plot = plots and plots:FindFirstChild(data.plot)
        local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        local podium = podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(data.slot)
        if podium then
          local dist = (root.Position - podium:GetPivot().Position).Magnitude
          if dist <= radius and dist < bestDist then
            best, bestDist = data, dist
          end
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end
  _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSetRadius = function(v)
    _G.CalciumNormalSteal.radius = tonumber(v) or _G.CalciumNormalSteal.radius or 62
  end
  _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop = function()
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    a.enabled = false
    a.isStealing = false
    if a.stealConn then a.stealConn:Disconnect(); a.stealConn = nil end
    resetBar()
  end
  _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStart = function()
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    a.radius = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or a.radius or 62
    a.duration = 1.3
    a.enabled = true
    ensureScanner()
    pcall(scanPlots)
    -- Lista condivisa con la Semi: va fatta partire, se no resta vuota e
    -- nearestAnimal non ha niente su cui lavorare.
    if _G.CalciumStealEnsureScan then pcall(_G.CalciumStealEnsureScan) end
    if a.stealConn then a.stealConn:Disconnect(); a.stealConn = nil end
    a.stealConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not a.enabled then return end
      if selectedStealMode ~= "Normal" then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop(); return end
      if a.isStealing then
        -- safety only if hung way past hold window
        if a.lastSteal and (tick() - a.lastSteal) > 3.5 then
          a.isStealing = false
          pcall(function()
            for _, d in pairs(a.internalCache) do
              if type(d) == "table" then d.ready = true end
            end
          end)
        end
        return
      end
      local target = nearestAnimal()
      if not target then return end
      local prompt = findPrompt(target)
      if not prompt or not prompt.Parent then return end
      if selectedNormalMode == "V2" then
        doStealV2(prompt, target)
      else
        doSteal(prompt)
      end
    end)
  end
  _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSync = function()
    if selectedStealMode == "Normal" and autoStealEnabled then
      _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStart()
    else
      _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop()
    end
  end
end
_G.__CalciumSetupNormalAutoSteal()

_G.__CalciumSetupSemiAutoSteal = function()
  _G.CalciumSemiSteal = _G.CalciumSemiSteal or {}
  local A = _G.CalciumSemiSteal
  if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end); A.conn = nil end
  A.enabled    = false
  A.cooldown   = A.cooldown   or 0.05
  A.primeRange = A.primeRange or 80
  A.radius     = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or A.radius or 60
  -- applica valori salvati dal config (loadCalciumConfig gira prima di questo setup)
  local pending = _G._CalciumSemiStealPending
  A.autoGrabStopTime       = (pending and pending.autoGrabStopTime)       or A.autoGrabStopTime       or 1.29
  A.autoGrabStopPercent    = (pending and pending.autoGrabStopPercent)    or A.autoGrabStopPercent    or 75
  A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = (pending and pending.autoGrabSetDelayRadius) or A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8
  A.autoGrabStopEnabled    = true
  _G._CalciumSemiStealPending = nil


  A.conn = A.conn
  A.scanThread = A.scanThread
  A.plotSync = A.plotSync or {caches = {}, connections = {}}
  A.animals = A.animals or {}
  A.promptCache = A.promptCache or {}
  A.internalCache = A.internalCache or {}
  A.state = A.state or {active = false, startTime = 0, phase = "idle", label = "", lastResult = "", lastResultTime = 0}

  local function barSet(p, label)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState(label or "STEALING")
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1))
      end
    end)
  end
  local function barReset()
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end
    end)
  end
  local function rootPart()
    local char = LP.Character
    return char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or nil
  end
  local function splitPath(path)
    if typeof(path) == "table" then return path end
    local out = {}
    for part in string.gmatch(tostring(path), "[^%.]+") do
      table.insert(out, tonumber(part) or part)
    end
    return out
  end
  local function resolvePath(path, root)
    local current, parent, key = root, nil, nil
    for _, part in ipairs(splitPath(path)) do
      parent = current
      key = part
      current = current and current[part] or nil
    end
    return current, parent, key
  end
  local function applySyncDiff(channelName, packet)
    local cache = A.plotSync.caches[channelName]
    if typeof(cache) ~= "table" then return end
    local path, action, a, b = packet[1], packet[2], packet[3], packet[4]
    local current, parent, key = resolvePath(path, cache)
    if action == "Changed" then
      if parent ~= nil then parent[key] = a end
    elseif action == "ArrayInsert" then
      if current ~= nil then table.insert(current, b, a) end
    elseif action == "ArrayRemoved" then
      if current ~= nil then table.remove(current, b) end
    elseif action == "DictionaryInsert" then
      if current ~= nil then current[b] = a end
    elseif action == "DictionaryRemoved" then
      if current ~= nil then current[b] = nil end
    end
  end
  local function attachPlotChannel(remote, plots, requestData)
    if A.plotSync.connections[remote] then return end
    local channelName = tostring(remote.Name)
    if not plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then return end
    if requestData and A.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
      local ok, data = pcall(function() return requestData:InvokeServer(channelName) end)
      A.plotSync.caches[channelName] = (ok and typeof(data) == "table") and data or {}
    elseif A.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
      A.plotSync.caches[channelName] = {}
    end
    A.plotSync.connections[remote] = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(queue)
      for _, packet in ipairs(queue) do applySyncDiff(channelName, packet) end
    end)
  end
  local function ensureSync()
    if A.syncReady then return true end
    local ok = pcall(function()
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      A.packages = rs:WaitForChild("Packages", 10)
      A.datas = rs:WaitForChild("Datas", 10)
      A.plots = workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 10)
      if not (A.packages and A.datas and A.plots) then return end
      A.animalsData = require(A.datas:WaitForChild("Animals", 10))
      local sync = A.packages:WaitForChild("Synchronizer", 10)
      A.channelFolder = sync:WaitForChild("Channel", 10)
      A.routeRemote = sync:WaitForChild("CommunicationRoute", 10)
      A.requestData = sync:FindFirstChild("RequestData")
      for _, child in ipairs(A.channelFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(child, A.plots, A.requestData) end
      end
      A.channelFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(child, A.plots, A.requestData) end
      end)
      A.routeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(actions)
        for _, action in ipairs(actions) do
          local kind, channelName = action[1], tostring(action[2])
          if A.plots and A.plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then
            if kind == "ListenerAdded" then
              local remote = A.channelFolder and A.channelFolder:FindFirstChild(channelName)
              if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(remote, A.plots, A.requestData) end
            elseif kind == "ListenerRemoved" then
              for remote, conn in pairs(A.plotSync.connections) do
                if tostring(remote.Name) == channelName then
                  pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
                  A.plotSync.connections[remote] = nil
                  A.plotSync.caches[channelName] = nil
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      A.syncReady = true
    end)
    return ok and A.syncReady == true
  end
  local function getPlotOwner(plot)
    local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local frame = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
    if not label or label.Text == "Empty Base" then return nil end
    return label.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  end
  local function isMyBaseAnimal(animalData)
    if not animalData or not animalData.plot or not A.plots then return false end
    local plot = A.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
    if not plot then return false end
    local owner = getPlotOwner(plot)
    return owner == LP.DisplayName or owner == LP.Name
  end
  local function podiumFor(animalData)
    local plot = A.plots and A.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
    local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    return podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(animalData.slot) or nil
  end
  local function animalPos(animalData)
    local podium = podiumFor(animalData)
    return podium and podium:GetPivot().Position or nil
  end
  local function distToAnimal(animalData)
    local root = rootPart()
    local pos = animalPos(animalData)
    return root and pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
  end
  local function findPromptForAnimal(animalData)
    if not animalData then return nil end
    local cached = A.promptCache[animalData.uid]
    if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
    local podium = podiumFor(animalData)
    local base = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    if not attach then return nil end
    for _, prompt in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
      if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        A.promptCache[animalData.uid] = prompt
        return prompt
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function scanAllPlots()
    if not ensureSync() then return 0 end
    local newCache = {}
    for _, plot in ipairs(A.plots:GetChildren()) do
      local cache = A.plotSync.caches[plot.Name]
      local animalList = cache and cache.AnimalList
      if typeof(animalList) == "table" then
        for slot, animalData in pairs(animalList) do
          if type(animalData) == "table" then
            local animalName = animalData.Index
            local info = A.animalsData and A.animalsData[animalName]
            if info then
              table.insert(newCache, {
                name = info.DisplayName or animalName,
                plot = plot.Name,
                slot = tostring(slot),
                uid = plot.Name .. "_" .. tostring(slot),
              })
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    A.animals = newCache
    return #newCache
  end
  local function pickClosest()
    local root = rootPart()
    if not root then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, animalData in ipairs(A.animals) do
      if not isMyBaseAnimal(animalData) then
        local pos = animalPos(animalData)
        local dist = pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
        if dist <= (A.primeRange or 80) and dist < bestDist then
          best, bestDist = animalData, dist
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end
  local function buildCallbacks(prompt)
    if A.internalCache[prompt] then return end
    local data = {holdCallbacks = {}, triggerCallbacks = {}, ready = true}
    local okHold, holds = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    if okHold and type(holds) == "table" then
      for _, conn in ipairs(holds) do
        if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.holdCallbacks, conn.Function) end
      end
    end
    local okTrigger, triggers = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
    if okTrigger and type(triggers) == "table" then
      for _, conn in ipairs(triggers) do
        if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.triggerCallbacks, conn.Function) end
      end
    end
    if #data.holdCallbacks > 0 or #data.triggerCallbacks > 0 then A.internalCache[prompt] = data end
  end
  -- Valori semi steal
  A.autoGrabStopTime       = A.autoGrabStopTime       or 1.29  -- punto in cui la barra si ferma (V1, secondi)
  A.autoGrabStopPercent    = A.autoGrabStopPercent    or 75    -- punto in cui la barra si ferma (V3, percento)
  A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius = A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8     -- raggio trigger del secondo step
  A.autoGrabStopEnabled    = true                              -- sempre attivo
  A.cooldown = A.cooldown or 0.05

  local function executeSemi(prompt, animalData)
    if A.state.active or not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not animalData then return false end
    if tick() - (A.state.lastResultTime or 0) < 0.15 then return false end
    A.holdGeneration = (A.holdGeneration or 0) + 1
    local generation, mode = A.holdGeneration, selectedSemiMode
    A.state.active, A.state.phase = true, "holding"
    A.state.startTime = tick()
    local cap = mode == "V3" and math.clamp(tonumber(A.autoGrabStopPercent) or 80, 1, 99) / 100
      or math.clamp((tonumber(A.autoGrabStopTime) or 1.29) / 1.3, 0.01, 0.99)
    task.spawn(function()
      local result = _G.CalciumRunHold("Semi", prompt, {
        animal = animalData, duration = 1.3, cap = cap,
        enabled = function() return A.enabled and A.holdGeneration == generation and selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == mode end,
        radius = function() return tonumber(A.radius) or 60 end,
        completeRadius = function() return tonumber(A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius) or 8 end,
        update = barSet,
      })
      if A.holdGeneration == generation then
        A.state.active, A.state.phase = false, "idle"
        A.state.lastResult, A.state.lastResultTime = result, tick()
        barReset()
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
  -- ---- lista bersagli condivisa con la modalita' Normal ----
  -- La Normal costruiva una lista sua scorrendo i podi: ci finiva DENTRO
  -- ogni podio esistente, pieno o vuoto che fosse. Questa invece nasce
  -- dall'AnimalList del plot, quindi contiene solo gli slot che hanno
  -- davvero un animale sopra. Esposta su _G perche' il blocco della
  -- Normal sta prima di questo nel file e non vede questi local.
  _G.CalciumStealAnimals   = function() return A.animals end
  _G.CalciumStealAnimalPos = function(d) return animalPos(d) end
  _G.CalciumStealIsMyBase  = function(d) return isMyBaseAnimal(d) end

  -- Lo slot ha ANCORA un animale sopra, adesso.
  -- La lista viene ricostruita ogni 5 secondi, quindi da sola non basta:
  -- un animale appena rubato resta in elenco fino al giro dopo, e il
  -- podio esiste comunque (vuoto), quindi anche la posizione risulta
  -- valida. Le cache dei plot sono invece aggiornate dal vivo dai
  -- RemoteEvent del Synchronizer: chiedendo a loro si sa in quell'istante
  -- se lo slot e' occupato.
  _G.CalciumStealSlotOccupied = function(d)
    if not d or not d.plot or not d.slot then return false end
    local cache = A.plotSync and A.plotSync.caches and A.plotSync.caches[d.plot]
    local list = cache and cache.AnimalList
    -- Cache non disponibile: non si puo' dire di no, se no con la sync
    -- non pronta la Normal non partirebbe mai.
    if typeof(list) ~= "table" then return true end
    -- Le chiavi possono essere numeri o stringhe a seconda di come
    -- arrivano dal server: si provano entrambe.
    local entry = list[d.slot] or list[tonumber(d.slot) or -1]
    return type(entry) == "table"
  end
  local function ensureScanThread()
    if A.scanThread then return end
    A.scanThread = task.spawn(function()
      while _G.CalciumSemiSteal do
        -- Lo scan gira anche per la Normal, che ora legge da qui.
        if A.enabled or selectedStealMode == "Semi"
           or (selectedStealMode == "Normal" and autoStealEnabled) then
          pcall(scanAllPlots)
        end
        task.wait(5)
      end
    end)
  end
  -- Avvio dello scan su richiesta. La Normal ora legge da questa lista,
  -- ma il thread che la riempie partiva SOLO dall'avvio della Semi: senza
  -- aver mai acceso la Semi la lista restava vuota e la Normal non
  -- trovava mai un bersaglio. Da qui la puo' far partire chiunque.
  _G.CalciumStealEnsureScan = function()
    ensureScanThread()
    task.spawn(function() pcall(scanAllPlots) end)
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSetRadius = function(v)
    local n = tonumber(v)
    if n then A.radius = n end
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop = function()
    A.holdGeneration = (A.holdGeneration or 0) + 1
    _G.CalciumCancelHold("Semi")
    A.enabled = false
    if A.conn then A.conn:Disconnect(); A.conn = nil end
    A.state.active = false
    A.state.phase = "idle"
    barReset()
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStart = function()
    A.radius = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or A.radius or 60
    A.enabled = true
    ensureSync()
    ensureScanThread()
    pcall(scanAllPlots)
    if A.conn then A.conn:Disconnect(); A.conn = nil end
    A.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not A.enabled then return end
      if selectedStealMode ~= "Semi" then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop(); return end
      if A.state.active then return end
      local target = pickClosest()
      if not target then return end
      local prompt = findPromptForAnimal(target)
      if prompt then executeSemi(prompt, target) end
    end)
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSync = function()
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and autoStealEnabled then
      _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStart()
    else
      _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop()
    end
  end
end
_G.__CalciumSetupSemiAutoSteal()

-- ===== SEMI V2 ENGINE (logica da Calcium.lua standalone) =====
_G.__CalciumSetupSemiV2AutoSteal = function()
  _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal = _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal or {}
  local B = _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal
  if B.conn then pcall(function() B.conn:Disconnect() end); B.conn = nil end
  B.enabled    = false
  -- Valori hardcoded (non mostrati in settings)
  B.holdMin    = 1.3
  B.holdMax    = 2.69
  B.entryDelay = 0.3
  B.cooldown   = 0.05
  -- Radius (prime range) e SemiRadius (steal range) presi da CalciumStealRadii
  B.radius     = tonumber(_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius) or B.radius or 60
  B.semiRadius = tonumber(_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or B.semiRadius or 8
  B.plotSync   = B.plotSync or {caches = {}, connections = {}}
  B.animals    = B.animals or {}
  B.promptCache = B.promptCache or {}
  B.internalCache = B.internalCache or {}
  B.state = B.state or {active = false, startTime = 0, phase = "idle"}

  local function barSet(p, label)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState(label or "STEALING")
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1))
      end
    end)
  end
  local function barReset()
    pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end end)
  end
  local function rootPart()
    local char = LP.Character
    return char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")) or nil
  end
  local function splitPath(path)
    if typeof(path) == "table" then return path end
    local out = {}
    for part in string.gmatch(tostring(path), "[^%.]+") do
      table.insert(out, tonumber(part) or part)
    end
    return out
  end
  local function resolvePath(path, root)
    local current, parent, key = root, nil, nil
    for _, part in ipairs(splitPath(path)) do
      parent = current; key = part
      current = current and current[part] or nil
    end
    return current, parent, key
  end
  local function applySyncDiff(channelName, packet)
    local cache = B.plotSync.caches[channelName]
    if typeof(cache) ~= "table" then return end
    local path, action, a, b = packet[1], packet[2], packet[3], packet[4]
    local current, parent, key = resolvePath(path, cache)
    if action == "Changed" then
      if parent ~= nil then parent[key] = a end
    elseif action == "ArrayInsert" then
      if current ~= nil then table.insert(current, b, a) end
    elseif action == "ArrayRemoved" then
      if current ~= nil then table.remove(current, b) end
    elseif action == "DictionaryInsert" then
      if current ~= nil then current[b] = a end
    elseif action == "DictionaryRemoved" then
      if current ~= nil then current[b] = nil end
    end
  end
  local function attachPlotChannel(remote, plots, requestData)
    if B.plotSync.connections[remote] then return end
    local channelName = tostring(remote.Name)
    if not plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then return end
    if requestData and B.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
      local ok, data = pcall(function() return requestData:InvokeServer(channelName) end)
      B.plotSync.caches[channelName] = (ok and typeof(data) == "table") and data or {}
    elseif B.plotSync.caches[channelName] == nil then
      B.plotSync.caches[channelName] = {}
    end
    B.plotSync.connections[remote] = remote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(queue)
      for _, packet in ipairs(queue) do applySyncDiff(channelName, packet) end
    end)
  end
  local function ensureSync()
    if B.syncReady then return true end
    local ok = pcall(function()
      local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
      B.packages = rs:WaitForChild("Packages", 10)
      B.datas    = rs:WaitForChild("Datas", 10)
      B.plots    = workspace:WaitForChild("Plots", 10)
      if not (B.packages and B.datas and B.plots) then return end
      B.animalsData = require(B.datas:WaitForChild("Animals", 10))
      local sync = B.packages:WaitForChild("Synchronizer", 10)
      B.channelFolder = sync:WaitForChild("Channel", 10)
      B.routeRemote   = sync:WaitForChild("CommunicationRoute", 10)
      B.requestData   = sync:FindFirstChild("RequestData")
      for _, child in ipairs(B.channelFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(child, B.plots, B.requestData) end
      end
      B.channelFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(child, B.plots, B.requestData) end
      end)
      B.routeRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(actions)
        for _, action in ipairs(actions) do
          local kind, channelName = action[1], tostring(action[2])
          if B.plots and B.plots:FindFirstChild(channelName) then
            if kind == "ListenerAdded" then
              local remote = B.channelFolder and B.channelFolder:FindFirstChild(channelName)
              if remote and remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then attachPlotChannel(remote, B.plots, B.requestData) end
