            elseif kind == "ListenerRemoved" then
              for remote, conn in pairs(B.plotSync.connections) do
                if tostring(remote.Name) == channelName then
                  pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
                  B.plotSync.connections[remote] = nil
                  B.plotSync.caches[channelName] = nil
                  break
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      B.syncReady = true
    end)
    return ok and B.syncReady == true
  end
  local function getPlotOwner(plot)
    local sign = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
    local frame = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui") and sign.SurfaceGui:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
    if not label or label.Text == "Empty Base" then return nil end
    return label.Text:gsub("'s [Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
  end
  local function isMyBaseAnimal(animalData)
    if not animalData or not animalData.plot or not B.plots then return false end
    local plot = B.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
    if not plot then return false end
    local owner = getPlotOwner(plot)
    return owner == LP.DisplayName or owner == LP.Name
  end
  local function podiumFor(animalData)
    local plot = B.plots and B.plots:FindFirstChild(animalData.plot)
    local podiums = plot and plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    return podiums and podiums:FindFirstChild(animalData.slot) or nil
  end
  local function animalPos(animalData)
    local podium = podiumFor(animalData)
    return podium and podium:GetPivot().Position or nil
  end
  local function distToAnimal(animalData)
    local root = rootPart()
    local pos = animalPos(animalData)
    return root and pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
  end
  local function findPromptForAnimal(animalData)
    if not animalData then return nil end
    local cached = B.promptCache[animalData.uid]
    if cached and cached.Parent then return cached end
    local podium = podiumFor(animalData)
    local base = podium and podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
    local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
    local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
    if not attach then return nil end
    for _, prompt in ipairs(attach:GetChildren()) do
      if prompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
        B.promptCache[animalData.uid] = prompt
        return prompt
      end
    end
    return nil
  end
  local function scanAllPlots()
    if not ensureSync() then return 0 end
    local newCache = {}
    for _, plot in ipairs(B.plots:GetChildren()) do
      local cache = B.plotSync.caches[plot.Name]
      local animalList = cache and cache.AnimalList
      if typeof(animalList) == "table" then
        for slot, animalData in pairs(animalList) do
          if type(animalData) == "table" then
            local animalName = animalData.Index
            local info = B.animalsData and B.animalsData[animalName]
            if info then
              table.insert(newCache, {
                name = info.DisplayName or animalName,
                plot = plot.Name,
                slot = tostring(slot),
                uid = plot.Name .. "_" .. tostring(slot),
              })
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
    B.animals = newCache
    return #newCache
  end
  local function pickClosest()
    local root = rootPart()
    if not root then return nil end
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, animalData in ipairs(B.animals) do
      if not isMyBaseAnimal(animalData) then
        local pos = animalPos(animalData)
        local dist = pos and (root.Position - pos).Magnitude or math.huge
        if dist <= (B.radius or 60) and dist < bestDist then
          best, bestDist = animalData, dist
        end
      end
    end
    return best
  end
  local function buildCallbacks(prompt)
    if B.internalCache[prompt] then return end
    local data = {holdCallbacks = {}, triggerCallbacks = {}, ready = true}
    local okHold, holds = pcall(getconnections, prompt.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
    if okHold and type(holds) == "table" then
      for _, conn in ipairs(holds) do
        if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.holdCallbacks, conn.Function) end
      end
    end
    local okTrigger, triggers = pcall(getconnections, prompt.Triggered)
    if okTrigger and type(triggers) == "table" then
      for _, conn in ipairs(triggers) do
        if type(conn.Function) == "function" then table.insert(data.triggerCallbacks, conn.Function) end
      end
    end
    if #data.holdCallbacks > 0 or #data.triggerCallbacks > 0 then B.internalCache[prompt] = data end
  end
  local function executeV2(prompt, animalData)
    if not prompt or not prompt.Parent or not animalData then return false end
    buildCallbacks(prompt)
    local data = B.internalCache[prompt]
    if not data or not data.ready then return false end
    data.ready = false
    B.state.active    = true
    B.state.startTime = tick()
    B.state.phase     = "holding"
    B.state.barHold   = false

    task.spawn(function()
      local holdMin    = B.holdMin    or 1.3
      local holdMax    = B.holdMax    or 2.69
      local entryDelay = B.entryDelay or 0.3
      local stealRange = B.semiRadius or 8   -- STEAL_RANGE
      local primeRange = B.radius     or 60  -- PRIME_RANGE

      -- avvia hold callbacks
      for _, fn in ipairs(data.holdCallbacks) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end

      -- fase 1: aspetta holdMin (con check radius: se esci dal primeRange, abort)
      local t0 = tick()
      while tick() - t0 < holdMin do
        if distToAnimal(animalData) > primeRange then
          barReset()
          B.state.active = false
          B.state.phase  = "idle"
          task.wait(B.cooldown or 0.05)
          data.ready = true
          return
        end
        task.wait()
      end
      B.state.phase = "waitingRange"

      -- fase 2: aspetta entrata nello stealRange o scadenza holdMax
      -- se esci dal primeRange durante l'attesa → abort come Semi V1
      local alreadyInRange = distToAnimal(animalData) <= stealRange
      local fired = false
      while true do
        if tick() - B.state.startTime > holdMax then break end
        if not prompt.Parent then break end
        if selectedStealMode ~= "Semi" or selectedSemiMode ~= "V2" or not B.enabled then break end
        if distToAnimal(animalData) > primeRange then
          -- uscito dal radius durante la barra → reset e stop (uguale a Semi V1)
          barReset()
          B.state.active = false
          B.state.phase  = "idle"
          task.wait(B.cooldown or 0.05)
          data.ready = true
          return
        end
        if distToAnimal(animalData) <= stealRange then
          if not alreadyInRange then task.wait(entryDelay) end
          -- barra piena al momento del trigger (nessuna attesa aggiunta)
          B.state.barHold = true
          barSet(1, "STEALING")
          for _, fn in ipairs(data.triggerCallbacks) do task.spawn(function() pcall(fn) end) end
          pcall(function() if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup then _G.AutoCarrySpeed.WatchPickup(1.25) end end)
          fired = true
          break
        end
        task.wait()
      end
      barReset()
      B.state.barHold = false
      B.state.active = false
      B.state.phase  = "idle"
      task.wait(B.cooldown or 0.05)
      data.ready = true
    end)
    return true
  end
  local function ensureScanThread()
    if B.scanThread then return end
    B.scanThread = task.spawn(function()
      while _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal do
        if B.enabled or (selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2") then pcall(scanAllPlots) end
        task.wait(5)
      end
    end)
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius = function(v)
    local n = tonumber(v)
    if n then B.radius = n end
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiV2SetSemiRadius = function(v)
    local n = tonumber(v)
    if n then B.semiRadius = n end
  end
  -- RenderStepped dedicato: aggiorna la barra continuamente mentre V2 è attivo
  if B.barConn then pcall(function() B.barConn:Disconnect() end); B.barConn = nil end
  B.barConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not B.state.active then return end
    if B.state.barHold then return end   -- barra piena in attesa del trigger
    local elapsed = tick() - B.state.startTime
    local holdMax = B.holdMax or 2.69
    -- la barra arriva a 1 con 0.05s di anticipo (es. 2.64 invece di 2.69)
    local barFull = math.max(holdMax - 0.05, 0.05)
    local p = math.clamp(elapsed / barFull, 0, 1)
    pcall(function()
      if _G.StealBar then
        _G.StealBar.SetState("STEALING")
        _G.StealBar.SetProgress(p)
      end
    end)
  end)

  _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop = function()
    B.enabled = false
    if B.conn then B.conn:Disconnect(); B.conn = nil end
    B.state.active  = false
    B.state.phase   = "idle"
    B.state.barHold = false
    barReset()
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStart = function()
    B.radius     = tonumber(_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius)     or B.radius     or 60
    B.semiRadius = tonumber(_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or B.semiRadius or 8
    B.enabled = true
    ensureSync()
    ensureScanThread()
    pcall(scanAllPlots)
    if B.conn then B.conn:Disconnect(); B.conn = nil end
    B.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
      if not B.enabled then return end
      local useV2 = (selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2")
      if not useV2 then _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop(); return end
      if B.state.active then return end
      local target = pickClosest()
      if not target then return end
      local prompt = findPromptForAnimal(target)
      if prompt then executeV2(prompt, target) end
    end)
  end
  _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealSync = function()
    local useV2 = autoStealEnabled and (selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2")
    if useV2 then
      _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStart()
    else
      _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop()
    end
  end
end
_G.__CalciumSetupSemiV2AutoSteal()

_G.CalciumAutoStealSync = function()
  if not autoStealEnabled or _ragdollStealPaused then
    if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop() end
    if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop() end
    if _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop() end
    return
  end
  if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
    if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop() end
    if selectedNormalMode == "V2" then
      -- Normal V2 = Adrast exact V2 logic (via CalciumNormalSteal.doStealV2)
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop() end
      if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop() end
      if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSync() end
    else
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop() end
      if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSync() end
    end
  elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
    if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStop() end
    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStop() end
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealSync then _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealSync() end
    else
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop then _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStop() end
      if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSync() end
    end
  end
end
-- ===== SYNC AFTER HIT =====
-- Al momento esatto del ragdoll (Physics o Ragdoll, FallingDown escluso):
--   1. Ferma il loop steal IMMEDIATAMENTE (disconnette conn, azzera stato interno)
--   2. Aspetta 1.45s (2.45s se medusa)
--   3. Riavvia il loop come se fosse appena stato attivato per la prima volta
-- Un token di generazione garantisce che hit multipli in rapida successione
-- schedulino un solo riavvio (l'ultimo vince).
-- Definita qui (prima di _doSyncAfterHit) per essere catturata come upvalue corretta.
local function _isMedusaHit() return (tick() - (_G._CalciumMedusaHitTime or 0)) < 4 end
_G._CalciumIsMedusaHit = _isMedusaHit

local function _doSyncAfterHit()
  -- 1) Stop immediato + reset completo stato interno
  if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
    local a = _G.CalciumNormalSteal
    if a then
      a.enabled = false
      a.isStealing = false
      if a.stealConn then pcall(function() a.stealConn:Disconnect() end); a.stealConn = nil end
      -- resetta i ready dei prompt così il prossimo ciclo riparte pulito
      for _, d in pairs(a.internalCache or {}) do d.ready = true end
      pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end end)
    end
  elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      local B = _G.CalciumSemiV2Steal
      if B then
        B.enabled = false
        if B.conn then pcall(function() B.conn:Disconnect() end); B.conn = nil end
        B.state.active = false
        B.state.phase  = "idle"
        for _, d in pairs(B.internalCache or {}) do d.ready = true end
        pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end end)
      end
    else
      local A = _G.CalciumSemiSteal
      if A then
        A.enabled = false
        if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end); A.conn = nil end
        A.state.active = false
        A.state.phase  = "idle"
        -- resetta i ready dei prompt
        for _, d in pairs(A.internalCache or {}) do d.ready = true end
        pcall(function() if _G.StealBar then _G.StealBar.Reset() end end)
      end
    end
  end
  -- 2) Aspetta poi riavvia (solo se il token non è cambiato = nessun altro hit).
  --    Se il ragdoll è causato da medusa aspetta 2.45s, altrimenti 1.45s.
  --    _isMedusaHit() controlla se l'Anchored è stato visto negli ultimi 4s:
  --    medusa freeze → Anchored → poi Physics/Ragdoll, tutto entro ~4s.
  local myGen = _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.gen
  local syncDelay = _isMedusaHit() and 2.45 or 1.45
  task.delay(syncDelay, function()
    if myGen ~= _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.gen then return end
    _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.wasRagdoll = false
    if _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.enabled and autoStealEnabled then
      if selectedStealMode == "Normal" then
        if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStart then pcall(_G.CalciumNormalAutoStealStart) end
      elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
        if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
          if _G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStart then pcall(_G.CalciumSemiV2AutoStealStart) end
        else
          if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStart then pcall(_G.CalciumSemiAutoStealStart) end
        end
      end
    end
  end)
end
local function _startSyncAfterHitWatcher()
  if _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn then
    pcall(function() _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn:Disconnect() end)
    _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn = nil
  end
  _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.wasRagdoll = false
  _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.enabled then return end
    if not autoStealEnabled then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
    local state = hum:GetState()
    -- Solo Physics e Ragdoll; FallingDown escluso intenzionalmente
    local isRagdolled = (state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
                         state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
    if isRagdolled and not _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.wasRagdoll then
      -- Rising edge: primo frame del ragdoll → agisci subito
      _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.wasRagdoll = true
      _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.gen = _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.gen + 1
      _doSyncAfterHit()
    elseif not isRagdolled then
      _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.wasRagdoll = false
    end
  end)
end
local function _stopSyncAfterHitWatcher()
  if _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn then
    pcall(function() _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn:Disconnect() end)
    _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.conn = nil
  end
  _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.wasRagdoll = false
end
_startSyncAfterHitWatcher()

-- ===== MEDUSA HIT WATCHER (sempre attivo, indipendente dal ragdoll countdown) =====
-- Flusso medusa: parti diventano Anchored (freeze) → poi si de-anchorano → Physics/Ragdoll.
-- Quando rileva Anchored+Transparency==1 salva il timestamp.
-- _doSyncAfterHit e beginCountdown controllano se il timestamp è entro 4s → era medusa.
do
  local _medusaWatcherConns = {}

  local function _clearMedusaWatcher()
    for _, c in ipairs(_medusaWatcherConns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    _medusaWatcherConns = {}
  end
  local function _hookPart(part)
    if not part:IsA("BasePart") then return end
    local c = part:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Anchored"):Connect(function()
      if part.Anchored and part.Transparency == 1 then
        _G._CalciumMedusaHitTime = tick()
      end
    end)
    table.insert(_medusaWatcherConns, c)
  end
  local function _attachMedusaWatcher(char)
    _clearMedusaWatcher()
    _G._CalciumMedusaHitTime = 0
    if not char then return end

    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
      _hookPart(part)
    end
    table.insert(_medusaWatcherConns, char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
      _hookPart(part)
    end))
  end
  if LP.Character then _attachMedusaWatcher(LP.Character) end
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char) _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10); _attachMedusaWatcher(char) end)
end
-- ===== FINE MEDUSA HIT WATCHER =====

  end
end)

local function getCurrentSpeedValue()
  local boost = tonumber(SPEED_FEEL_BOOST) or tonumber(_G.CalciumSpeedFeelBoost) or 1.03
  local base
  if currentSpeedMode == "Carry" then
    base = CS
  elseif currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" then
    base = LAGGER_SPEED
  elseif currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    base = LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED
  else
    base = NS
  end
  return (tonumber(base) or 16) * boost
end
-- Esposta perche' serve allo ZigZag del TP Down, che sta molto piu' in alto
-- nel file e non puo' vedere questo local.
_G.CalciumGetCurrentSpeedValue = getCurrentSpeedValue

refreshSpeedModeRows = nil

local function setSpeedMode(mode)
  if mode ~= "Normal" and mode ~= "Carry" and mode ~= "Lagger" and mode ~= "Lagger Carry" then
    mode = "Normal"
  end
  -- Blocca switch SOLO quando siamo in lock (speed bassa)
  -- Permette comunque di switchare tra Carry e Lagger Carry
  -- I restore interni dell'auto switch bypassano questo guard
  if not _G._CalciumAS.restoring and autoCarrySpeedEnabled and _G._CalciumAS.locked then
    if mode ~= "Carry" and mode ~= "Lagger Carry" then return end
  end
  currentSpeedMode = mode
  _G.CalciumCurrentSpeedMode = mode
  if refreshSpeedModeRows then
    refreshSpeedModeRows()
  end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
  saveCalciumConfig()
end
local function toggleCarryMode()
  if autoCarrySpeedEnabled and _G._CalciumAS.locked then
    -- Mentre lockati: Q porta sempre a Carry (rimuove il lato lagger)
    setSpeedMode("Carry")
    return
  end
  if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    setSpeedMode("Carry")
  elseif currentSpeedMode == "Carry" then
    setSpeedMode("Normal")
  else
    setSpeedMode("Carry")
  end
end
local function toggleLaggerMode()
  if autoCarrySpeedEnabled and _G._CalciumAS.locked then
    -- Mentre lockati: R porta sempre a Lagger Carry (aggiunge il lato lagger)
    setSpeedMode("Lagger Carry")
    return
  end
  if currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger Carry" then
    setSpeedMode("Lagger Carry")
  elseif currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    setSpeedMode("Lagger")
  else
    setSpeedMode("Lagger Carry")
  end
end

State.speedToggled = (currentSpeedMode == "Carry" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry")
State.laggerEnabled = (currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry")

function setCarry(on)
  if on then
    setSpeedMode("Carry")
  else
    if currentSpeedMode == "Carry" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
      setSpeedMode("Normal")
    end
  end
  State.speedToggled = on == true
end
function setLagger(on)
  if on then
    setSpeedMode("Lagger")
  else
    if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
      setSpeedMode("Normal")
    end
  end
  State.laggerEnabled = on == true
end

-- ===== NEAREST ANIMAL PER AUTO CARRY SPEED (SOFT) =====
-- Stessa logica di scan usata dall'Auto Steal (Plots > AnimalPodiums > Base > Spawn),
-- esclude la propria base tramite PlotSign.YourBase.
function _G.CalciumAutoCarryScanAnimals()
  local S = _G._CalciumAutoCarrySoft
  local list = {}
  local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
  if not plots then S.animals = list; return end
  for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
    if plot:IsA("Model") then
      local mine = false
      local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
      local yourBase = sign and sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
      if yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled == true then mine = true end
      if not mine then
        local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
        if podiums then
          for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
            if podium:IsA("Model") then
              local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
              local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
              if spawn then table.insert(list, spawn.Position) end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
  S.animals = list
end
function _G.CalciumAutoCarryNearestAnimalDist()
  local S = _G._CalciumAutoCarrySoft
  local char = LP.Character
  local root = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
  if not root then return math.huge end
  local now = tick()
  if (now - (S.lastScan or 0)) >= (S.scanInterval or 2) then
    S.lastScan = now
    pcall(_G.CalciumAutoCarryScanAnimals)
  end
  local rp = root.Position
  local bestDist = math.huge
  for _, pos in ipairs(S.animals) do
    local d = (rp - pos).Magnitude
    if d < bestDist then bestDist = d end
  end
  return bestDist
end
function _G.CalciumAutoCarryInSoftRadius()
  local S = _G._CalciumAutoCarrySoft
  return _G.CalciumAutoCarryNearestAnimalDist() <= (tonumber(S.radius) or 9.5)
end
-- ===== FINE NEAREST ANIMAL PER AUTO CARRY SPEED (SOFT) =====

-- ===== AUTO SWITCH TO CARRY =====
local function updateAutoSwitchToCarry()
  if not autoCarrySpeedEnabled then return end
  local char = LP.Character
  if not char then return end
  local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not h then return end
  -- Durante il countdown del duello la walkspeed viene abbassata dal gioco.
  -- Non basta uscire dalla funzione: se il lock era gia' scattato (tipico, perche'
  -- il gioco rallenta prima ancora che compaia il countdown) resterebbe attivo per
  -- tutto il countdown, e con il lock attivo Q/R forzano Carry / Lagger Carry.
  -- Quindi rilasciamo il lock e ripristiniamo la mode salvata: durante il countdown
  -- sei libero di stare su Normal o Lagger senza che nulla ti switchi.
  if _G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown then
    local okCd, inCd = pcall(_G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown)
    if okCd and inCd then
      if _G._CalciumAS.locked then
        _G._CalciumAS.locked = false
        if _G._CalciumAS.savedMode then
          _G._CalciumAS.restoring = true
          setSpeedMode(_G._CalciumAS.savedMode)
          _G._CalciumAS.restoring = false
          _G._CalciumAS.savedMode = nil
        end
      end
      -- Azzerato cosi' a fine countdown l'edge-trigger rivaluta da zero:
      -- se la speed e' ancora bassa rilocka, se e' alta resta libero.
      _G._CalciumAS.wasLow = false
      return
    end
  end
  local isLow = h.WalkSpeed < 25
  -- SOFT: il lock scatta anche entrando nel raggio di 9.5 stud dall'animale piu' vicino.
  -- Uscendo dal raggio si resta lockati solo se la walkspeed e' sotto 25 (= stai portando),
  -- altrimenti si torna alla mode che era selezionata prima di entrare nel raggio.
  if _G._CalciumAutoCarryMode == "SOFT" then
    local inR = false
    local okR, resR = pcall(_G.CalciumAutoCarryInSoftRadius)
    if okR then inR = resR and true or false end
    isLow = inR or isLow
  end
  if isLow == _G._CalciumAS.wasLow then return end
  _G._CalciumAS.wasLow = isLow
  if isLow then
    _G._CalciumAS.locked = true
    -- Salva solo se non siamo gia in una carry mode (evita di salvare "Carry" come saved)
    if currentSpeedMode ~= "Carry" and currentSpeedMode ~= "Lagger Carry" then
      _G._CalciumAS.savedMode = currentSpeedMode
      if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" then
        setSpeedMode("Lagger Carry")
      else
        -- Normal (o qualsiasi altra): vai a Carry
        setSpeedMode("Carry")
      end
    end
    -- Gia in Carry o Lagger Carry: non fa nulla, ma il lock e' gia settato
  else
    -- Speed tornata sopra 25 -> UNLOCK poi ripristina la mode precedente
    _G._CalciumAS.locked = false
    if _G._CalciumAS.savedMode then
      _G._CalciumAS.restoring = true
      setSpeedMode(_G._CalciumAS.savedMode)
      _G._CalciumAS.restoring = false
      _G._CalciumAS.savedMode = nil
    end
  end
end
task.spawn(function()
  while true do
    task.wait(_G._CalciumAS.interval)
    updateAutoSwitchToCarry()
    if _G.CalciumUpdateKickWarning then pcall(_G.CalciumUpdateKickWarning) end
  end
end)
