-- ============================================================
-- ULTIMATE ANTI KICK
-- Quando compare il popup del Kick Warning, se ti trovi vicino a una
-- delle due basi, alza un muro invisibile davanti all'uscita opposta e
-- lo toglie 0.1s prima che il conto alla rovescia finisca.
--
-- Il muro e' una part creata dal client: blocca solo te, che e' proprio
-- lo scopo. Anchored e senza ombra, cosi' non pesa sulla fisica ne' sul
-- rendering; l'unica cosa che fa e' esistere e avere CanCollide.
--
-- Tutto su _G: non aggiunge nemmeno un local al chunk principale.
-- ============================================================
_G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick = _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick or {}
_G.CalciumUAKEnabled = _G.CalciumUAKEnabled == true

_G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.cfg = {
  RADIUS   = 30,    -- quanto vicino devi essere alla base perche' scatti
  LEAD     = 0.1,   -- quanto prima della scadenza il muro sparisce
  HEIGHT   = 40,    -- altezza del muro
  THICK    = 2,     -- spessore
  RISE     = 8,     -- di quanto il centro sta sopra i tuoi piedi
}

-- Ogni zona: "at" e' il punto vicino al quale devi trovarti, "wall" i due
-- estremi del muro da alzare. Le coordinate sono solo X/Z: la Y viene
-- presa dalla tua posizione al momento, cosi' il muro e' sempre alla
-- quota giusta qualunque sia il piano su cui ti trovi.
_G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.zones = {
  { at = {x = -488, z = 24},
    wall = {x1 = -478, z1 = 88, x2 = -422, z2 = 88} },
  { at = {x = -488, z = 95},
    wall = {x1 = -478, z1 = 32, x2 = -422, z2 = 32} },
}

function _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.clear()
  local w = workspace:FindFirstChild("CalciumAntiKickWall")
  while w do
    pcall(function() w:Destroy() end)
    w = workspace:FindFirstChild("CalciumAntiKickWall")
  end
end
-- Zona in cui ti trovi, o nil. La distanza si misura solo su X/Z: la Y
-- non deve contare, se no stando su una rampa o saltando la zona non
-- verrebbe riconosciuta.
function _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.zoneFor(pos)
  local U = _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick
  for _, z in ipairs(U.zones) do
    local dx = pos.X - z.at.x
    local dz = pos.Z - z.at.z
    if math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz) <= U.cfg.RADIUS then
      return z
    end
  end
  return nil
end
-- Chiamata dal Kick Warning nel momento in cui il popup appare.
-- duration = quanto dura il conto alla rovescia, per sapere quando
-- togliere il muro.
function _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.onWarning(duration)
  -- Serve che siano accesi TUTTI E DUE: il muro e' una reazione al popup
  -- del Kick Warning, senza quello non ha nemmeno un momento in cui
  -- alzarsi. Il controllo sta qui e non solo nella UI, cosi' vale anche
  -- se lo stato viene cambiato da config o da codice.
  if _G.CalciumUAKEnabled ~= true then return end
  if not (_G._CalciumKickWarn and _G._CalciumKickWarn.enabled == true) then return end
  local U = _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick
  local char = LP.Character
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not hrp then return end

  local zone = U.zoneFor(hrp.Position)
  if not zone then return end

  U.clear()

  local w = zone.wall
  local mx = (w.x1 + w.x2) / 2
  local mz = (w.z1 + w.z2) / 2
  local dx = w.x2 - w.x1
  local dz = w.z2 - w.z1
  local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
  if length < 0.1 then return end

  local part = Instance.new("Part")
  part.Name        = "CalciumAntiKickWall"
  part.Anchored    = true
  part.CanCollide  = true
  part.CanQuery    = false   -- non deve intercettare i raycast del hub
  part.CanTouch    = false
  part.CastShadow  = false
  part.Transparency = 1
  part.Size = Vector3.new(length, U.cfg.HEIGHT, U.cfg.THICK)
  -- CFrame.lookAt allinea la faccia lunga lungo la congiungente dei due
  -- punti, quindi il muro copre esattamente il tratto indicato anche se
  -- un domani i due estremi non fossero piu' allineati sull'asse X.
  local a = Vector3.new(w.x1, hrp.Position.Y + U.cfg.RISE, w.z1)
  local b = Vector3.new(w.x2, hrp.Position.Y + U.cfg.RISE, w.z2)
  local mid = Vector3.new(mx, hrp.Position.Y + U.cfg.RISE, mz)
  part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(mid, b) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
  part.Parent = workspace

  -- Rimozione programmata. Il token evita che un vecchio timer cancelli
  -- il muro di un avviso successivo.
  U.token = (U.token or 0) + 1
  local myToken = U.token
  local wait_s = math.max((tonumber(duration) or 2.35) - U.cfg.LEAD, 0.05)
  task.delay(wait_s, function()
    if U.token ~= myToken then return end
    U.clear()
  end)
end
-- ===== KICK WARNING (DONT COLLECT / COLLECT NOW) =====
function _G.CalciumDestroyKickWarning()
  local KW = _G._CalciumKickWarn
  KW.gen = (KW.gen or 0) + 1
  KW.active = false
  local g = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubKickWarning")
  if g then pcall(function() g:Destroy() end) end
  -- Popup distrutto a mano: il muro non deve restare in piedi.
  if _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick then pcall(_G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.clear) end
end
function _G.CalciumShowKickWarning()
  local KW = _G._CalciumKickWarn
  if KW.active then return end
  if HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubKickWarning") then return end
  -- Doppio check: non mostrare il popup durante il countdown del duello
  if _G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown then
    local okCd, inCd = pcall(_G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown)
    if okCd and inCd then return end
  end
  -- Il Kick Warning ha la precedenza: se c'e' un Ping Warning a schermo
  -- gli si fa fare un'uscita rapida e il rosso entra appena e' sparito.
  -- Il conto alla rovescia del kick parte comunque SUBITO: quando entra
  -- e' gia' a tempo, non riparte da zero.
  local KW_ENTER_DELAY = 0
  do
    local pw = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubPingWarning")
    if pw then
      local pwFrame = pw:FindFirstChild("WarningFrame")
      KW_ENTER_DELAY = 0.12
      pcall(function()
        TweenService:Create(pwFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
          Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0, -60)
        }):Play()
      end)
      task.delay(0.13, function() pcall(function() pw:Destroy() end) end)
    end
  end
  KW.active = true
  KW.gen = (KW.gen or 0) + 1
  local myGen = KW.gen

  local FRAME_W, FRAME_H = 340, 64
  local DURATION = 2.35
  if _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick then
    pcall(_G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.onWarning, DURATION)
  end
  local COL_RED   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 90)
  local COL_GREEN = Color3.fromRGB(45, 220, 120)

  local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
  gui.Name = "CalciumHubKickWarning"
  gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
  gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
  gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
  gui.DisplayOrder = 99999
  gui.Parent = HubGui

  local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
  frame.Name = "WarningFrame"
  frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, FRAME_W, 0, FRAME_H)
  frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -FRAME_W/2, 0, -80)
  frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 12, 16)
  frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
  frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
  frame.ClipsDescendants = true
  frame.ZIndex = 1
  frame.Parent = gui
  Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
  local fst = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
  fst.Color = COL_RED
  fst.Thickness = 1.4
  fst.Transparency = 0.2

  -- progress track at bottom
  local track = Instance.new("Frame")
  track.Name = "Track"
  track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 4)
  track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -10)
  track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 28, 34)
  track.BorderSizePixel = 0
  track.ZIndex = 2
  track.Parent = frame
  Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

  local fillFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
  fillFrame.Name = "FillFrame"
  fillFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
  fillFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  fillFrame.BackgroundColor3 = COL_RED
  fillFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
  fillFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
  fillFrame.ZIndex = 3
  fillFrame.Parent = track
  Instance.new("UICorner", fillFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

  local icon = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  icon.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
  icon.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 10)
  icon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 16, 22)
  icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
  icon.Text = "!"
  icon.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  icon.TextSize = 16
  icon.TextColor3 = COL_RED
  icon.ZIndex = 4
  icon.Parent = frame
  Instance.new("UICorner", icon).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

  local warnText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  warnText.Name = "WarningText"
  warnText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 22)
  warnText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 8)
  warnText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  warnText.Text = "HOLD — don't collect yet"
  warnText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(250, 245, 248)
  warnText.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  warnText.TextSize = 14
  warnText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  warnText.ZIndex = 4
  warnText.Parent = frame

  local subText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  subText.Name = "SubText"
  subText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 14)
  subText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 30)
  subText.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  subText.Text = "safe window charging"
  subText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 150, 160)
  subText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
  subText.TextSize = 11
  subText.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  subText.ZIndex = 4
  subText.Parent = frame

  -- Slide in: ritardato solo se deve aspettare l'uscita del ping warning.
  -- L'animazione del riempimento parte comunque subito, quindi il popup
  -- entra gia' al punto giusto invece di ricominciare.
  local function slideIn()
    if KW.gen ~= myGen or not gui.Parent then return end
    TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -FRAME_W/2, 0, 18)
    }):Play()
  end
  if KW_ENTER_DELAY > 0 then
    task.delay(KW_ENTER_DELAY, slideIn)
  else
    slideIn()
  end
  local function stillLow()
    if _G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown then
      local okCd, inCd = pcall(_G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown)
      if okCd and inCd then return false end
    end
    local c = LP.Character
    local hh = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hh then return false end
    return hh.WalkSpeed < 25
  end
local function closeKW()
    TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -FRAME_W/2, 0, -60)
        -- Niente BackgroundTransparency
    }):Play()
    -- Rimuovi i tween su warnText e fillFrame
    task.wait(0.35)
    pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
    KW.active = false
    -- Chiusura anticipata (walkspeed risalita): via il muro.
    if _G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick then pcall(_G.CalciumUltimateAntiKick.clear) end
end
  task.spawn(function()
    local t0 = tick()
    -- Fase 1: fill da 0 a FRAME_W in DURATION secondi esatti
    while true do
      if KW.gen ~= myGen or not gui.Parent then KW.active = false; return end
      if not stillLow() then closeKW(); return end
      local elapsed = tick() - t0
      local p = math.clamp(elapsed / DURATION, 0, 1)
      fillFrame.Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 1, 0)
      if p >= 1 then break end
      RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
    end
    if KW.gen ~= myGen or not gui.Parent then KW.active = false; return end

    -- Fase 2: testo cambia
    warnText.Text = "CLEAR — collect now"
    if subText then subText.Text = "window open" end
    if icon then icon.Text = "OK"; icon.TextColor3 = COL_GREEN; icon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 40, 28) end
    if fillFrame then fillFrame.BackgroundColor3 = COL_GREEN end
    if fst then fst.Color = COL_GREEN end

    -- Fase 3: resta finche walkspeed non risale
    while true do
      if KW.gen ~= myGen or not gui.Parent then KW.active = false; return end
      if not stillLow() then break end
      task.wait(0.05)
    end
    if KW.gen ~= myGen or not gui.Parent then KW.active = false; return end
    closeKW()
  end)
end
-- Stesso check dell'Auto Switch To Carry: walkspeed sotto 25 (edge-triggered)
function _G.CalciumUpdateKickWarning()
  local KW = _G._CalciumKickWarn
  local char = LP.Character
  local h = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  if not h then return end
  -- Durante il countdown del duello la walkspeed viene abbassata dal gioco:
  -- ignora completamente il check e distruggi il popup se fosse aperto.
  if _G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown then
    local okCd, inCd = pcall(_G.CalciumSafeModeInDuelCountdown)
    if okCd and inCd then
      -- Siamo nel countdown: chiudi il popup se aperto e resetta wasLow
      if KW.active then pcall(_G.CalciumDestroyKickWarning) end
      KW.wasLow = false  -- resettiamo cosi' al termine del countdown riparte da zero
      return
    end
  end
  local isLow = h.WalkSpeed < 25
  if not KW.enabled then
    KW.wasLow = isLow
    return
  end
  if isLow == KW.wasLow then return end
  KW.wasLow = isLow
  if isLow then
    _G.CalciumShowKickWarning()
  end
end
-- ===== FINE KICK WARNING =====


-- ============================================================
-- PATHFINDING
-- Due strategie diverse, perche' i due casi d'uso sono diversi.
--
-- AUTO LEFT / AUTO RIGHT vanno verso punti FISSI e conosciuti: li' si
-- puo' usare il PathfindingService vero, che restituisce dei waypoint
-- che rispettano la geometria camminabile. ComputeAsync pero' cede il
-- controllo (yield) e costa parecchio, quindi non puo' girare dentro un
-- Heartbeat: il calcolo va in un task a parte e il loop legge il
-- risultato quando e' pronto. Nel frattempo si continua ad andare
-- diretti, esattamente come prima.
--
-- I BAT AIMBOT inseguono un bersaglio che si muove: ricalcolare un
-- percorso a ogni spostamento introdurrebbe un ritardo che
-- sull'inseguimento si sente subito. Li' si usa invece un evitamento a
-- raggi, che costa pochissimo e risponde nello stesso frame: si guarda
-- avanti, e se c'e' un muro si sterza dell'angolo minimo che libera la
-- strada.
--
-- Tutto sotto _G per non aggiungere local al chunk principale, che e'
-- al limite dei 200 registri di Luau.
-- ============================================================
_G.CalciumPathfind = _G.CalciumPathfind or {}

_G.CalciumPathfind.cfg = {
  PROBE      = 14,    -- quanto avanti si guarda per gli aimbot (studs)
  ANGLES     = {18, 36, 54, 72, 90},  -- sterzate provate, in ordine
  WALL_Y     = 0.6,   -- sopra questo la superficie e' una rampa, non un muro
  WP_REACH   = 4,     -- quando un waypoint si considera raggiunto
  RECOMPUTE  = 1.25,  -- ogni quanto al massimo si ricalcola un percorso
  GOAL_DRIFT = 6,     -- se la meta si sposta di piu', si ricalcola subito
}

-- Parametri del raycast: si ignorano il proprio personaggio e quelli
-- degli altri giocatori. Gli altri player NON sono ostacoli da aggirare:
-- l'aimbot ci deve andare addosso, sterzare per evitarli sarebbe
-- esattamente il contrario di quello che serve.
function _G.CalciumPathfind.rayParams()
  local params = RaycastParams.new()
  local ignore = {}
  local ch = LP.Character
  if ch then ignore[#ignore + 1] = ch end
  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr ~= LP and plr.Character then ignore[#ignore + 1] = plr.Character end
  end
  params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore
  params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
  params.IgnoreWater = true
  return params
end
-- true se in quella direzione, entro dist, c'e' qualcosa che blocca
-- davvero il passaggio. Una rampa o un gradino non bloccano: ci si
-- cammina sopra, e sterzare per evitarli farebbe girare a vuoto.
function _G.CalciumPathfind.blocked(origin, dir, dist, params)
  local res = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir * dist, params)
  if not res then return false end
  if math.abs(res.Normal.Y) > _G.CalciumPathfind.cfg.WALL_Y then return false end
  return true
end
-- Sterzata minima che libera la strada.
-- Si prova prima l'angolo piu' piccolo, e per ogni angolo entrambi i
-- lati: cosi' la deviazione resta la minore possibile e non si prende
-- il giro largo quando ne basta uno stretto. Se nessuna sterzata libera
-- (vicolo cieco) si tiene la direzione originale, che e' meglio di
-- fermarsi: la fisica ci fa comunque strisciare lungo il muro.
function _G.CalciumPathfind.steer(origin, dir, dist)
  if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then return dir end
  dir = dir.Unit
  local C = _G.CalciumPathfind.cfg
  dist = dist or C.PROBE
  local params = _G.CalciumPathfind.rayParams()

  -- Due altezze: una all'altezza del torso e una piu' bassa, se no i
  -- muretti bassi passano sotto al raggio e non vengono visti.
  local low = origin - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
  if not _G.CalciumPathfind.blocked(origin, dir, dist, params)
     and not _G.CalciumPathfind.blocked(low, dir, dist, params) then
    return dir
  end
  for _, deg in ipairs(C.ANGLES) do
    for _, sign in ipairs({1, -1}) do
      local rot = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(deg * sign), 0)
      local cand = rot:VectorToWorldSpace(dir)
      cand = Vector3.new(cand.X, 0, cand.Z)
      if cand.Magnitude > 0.01 then
        cand = cand.Unit
        if not _G.CalciumPathfind.blocked(origin, cand, dist, params)
           and not _G.CalciumPathfind.blocked(low, cand, dist, params) then
          return cand
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return dir
end
-- ---------- percorsi veri, per Auto Left / Auto Right ----------
_G.CalciumPathfind.paths = _G.CalciumPathfind.paths or {}

function _G.CalciumPathfind.reset(key)
  _G.CalciumPathfind.paths[key] = nil
end
-- Ritorna la direzione verso il prossimo waypoint, oppure nil se un
-- percorso non c'e' (ancora, o proprio non calcolabile). Chi chiama in
-- quel caso va diretto: il pathfinding aggiunge, non sostituisce.
-- opts (facoltativo): { recompute = secondi, drift = studs }
-- Serve per i bersagli in MOVIMENTO. Con i punti fissi di Auto Left/Right
-- un ricalcolo ogni 1.25s va benissimo; dietro a un giocatore che corre
-- quel percorso e' vecchio dopo pochi metri, quindi chi insegue passa
-- valori piu' stretti.
function _G.CalciumPathfind.dirTo(key, from, goal, opts)
  local C = _G.CalciumPathfind.cfg
  local st = _G.CalciumPathfind.paths[key]
  local now = os.clock()
  local recompute = (opts and tonumber(opts.recompute)) or C.RECOMPUTE
  local drift     = (opts and tonumber(opts.drift))     or C.GOAL_DRIFT

  if st and st.goal and (st.goal - goal).Magnitude > drift then
    st = nil
  end
  if not st then
    st = {goal = goal, wp = nil, i = 1, computing = false, last = 0}
    _G.CalciumPathfind.paths[key] = st
  end
  -- Calcolo in un task a parte: ComputeAsync cede il controllo e dentro
  -- un Heartbeat bloccherebbe il frame.
  if not st.computing and (not st.wp or (now - st.last) > recompute) then
    st.computing = true
    st.last = now
    st.goal = goal
    local origin = from
    task.spawn(function()
      local ok, path = pcall(function()
        -- Servizio preso al volo e messo in cache: dichiararlo come local
        -- in cima al file costerebbe un registro al chunk principale, che
        -- e' gia' al limite.
        _G.CalciumPathfind.svc = _G.CalciumPathfind.svc
          or game:GetService("PathfindingService")
        local p = _G.CalciumPathfind.svc:CreatePath({
          AgentRadius = 2.5,
          AgentHeight = 5,
          AgentCanJump = true,
          WaypointSpacing = 6,
        })
        p:ComputeAsync(origin, goal)
        return p
      end)
      local cur = _G.CalciumPathfind.paths[key]
      if cur ~= st then return end   -- nel frattempo la meta e' cambiata
      st.computing = false
      if ok and path and path.Status == Enum.PathStatus.Success then
        local pts = path:GetWaypoints()
        -- Il primo waypoint e' sempre il punto di partenza: inutile.
        st.wp = pts
        st.i = math.min(2, #pts)
      else
        st.wp = nil   -- si torna alla linea diretta
      end
    end)
  end
  local wp = st.wp
  if not wp or #wp == 0 then return nil end

  -- Avanzamento: si salta al waypoint successivo quando quello corrente
  -- e' stato raggiunto. Il confronto e' solo su X/Z perche' la Y di un
  -- waypoint sta a terra e la nostra e' all'altezza del torso.
  while st.i <= #wp do
    local p = wp[st.i].Position
    local d = Vector3.new(p.X - from.X, 0, p.Z - from.Z)
    if d.Magnitude > C.WP_REACH then
      if d.Magnitude < 0.01 then return nil end
      return d.Unit
    end
    st.i = st.i + 1
  end
  -- Waypoint finiti: si e' arrivati, da qui in poi linea diretta.
  return nil
end
_G.CalciumAutoPathState = _G.CalciumAutoPathState or {leftConn=nil,rightConn=nil,leftPhase=1,rightPhase=1}
_G.CalciumAutoPathPoints = _G.CalciumAutoPathPoints or {
  L1=Vector3.new(-476.48,-6.28,92.73), L2=Vector3.new(-483.12,-4.95,94.80), L3=Vector3.new(-475.92,-6.99,25.36),
  LFace=Vector3.new(-482.25,-4.96,92.09),
  R1=Vector3.new(-476.16,-6.52,25.62), R2=Vector3.new(-483.04,-5.09,23.14), R3=Vector3.new(-475.99,-6.99,96.00),
  RFace=Vector3.new(-482.06,-6.93,35.47),
}
-- Adrast: Full = 4-phase path with L3/R3 return; Semi/Simple = 2-phase out only
-- Full return route is the default for the new single Auto Play control.
-- A saved false setting may still select Semi on subsequent executions.

_G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled = _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true
autoPlayFullEnabled = _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled
AUTO_PLAY_FREEZE = 0.25


function _G.CalciumAutoPathSpeed()
  if currentSpeedMode == "Lagger" or currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry" then
    return LAGGER_SPEED
  end
  return NS
end
function _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft()
  local S = _G.CalciumAutoPathState
  if S.leftConn then S.leftConn:Disconnect(); S.leftConn = nil end
  S.leftPhase = 1
  -- Percorsi buttati: alla prossima accensione si riparte dalla posizione
  -- di allora, non da waypoint calcolati chissa' dove.
  if _G.CalciumPathfind then
    _G.CalciumPathfind.reset("L1"); _G.CalciumPathfind.reset("L2")
  end
  local char = LP.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if hum then hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end
  if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0) end
end
function _G.CalciumStopAutoRight()
  local S = _G.CalciumAutoPathState
  if S.rightConn then S.rightConn:Disconnect(); S.rightConn = nil end
  S.rightPhase = 1
  if _G.CalciumPathfind then
    _G.CalciumPathfind.reset("R1"); _G.CalciumPathfind.reset("R2")
  end
  local char = LP.Character
  local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
  local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if hum then hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false) end
  if hrp then hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0) end
end
function _G.CalciumSetAutoLeft(on, skipSave)
  if on and _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart and not _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart("fullAutoPath") then
    autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    if not skipSave then saveCalciumConfig() end
    return false
  end
  autoLeftEnabled = on and true or false
  if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(autoLeftEnabled) end
  if autoLeftEnabled then
    autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(false) end
    if _G.CalciumStopAutoRight then _G.CalciumStopAutoRight() end
    if _G.CalciumStartAutoLeft then _G.CalciumStartAutoLeft() end
  else
    if _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft then _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft() end
  end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
  if not skipSave then saveCalciumConfig() end
end
function _G.CalciumSetAutoRight(on, skipSave)
  if on and _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart and not _G.CalciumSafeModeTryStart("fullAutoPath") then
    autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(false) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
    if not skipSave then saveCalciumConfig() end
    return false
  end
  autoRightEnabled = on and true or false
  if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(autoRightEnabled) end
  if autoRightEnabled then
    autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
    if _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft then _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft() end
    if _G.CalciumStartAutoRight then _G.CalciumStartAutoRight() end
  else
    if _G.CalciumStopAutoRight then _G.CalciumStopAutoRight() end
  end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
  if not skipSave then saveCalciumConfig() end
end
function _G.CalciumStartAutoLeft()
  local S = _G.CalciumAutoPathState
  if S.leftConn then S.leftConn:Disconnect(); S.leftConn = nil end
  S.leftPhase = 1
  local useFull = (_G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true) or (autoPlayFullEnabled == true)
  local function isRag(hum)
    if not hum then return true end
    local st = hum:GetState()
    return hum.PlatformStand or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
  end
  local function walkZero(hum)
    return hum and hum.WalkSpeed == 0
  end
  local function applyMove(hrp, hum, target, spd)
    local d = target - hrp.Position
    local mv = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
    if mv.Magnitude < 0.05 then return false end
    mv = mv.Unit
    hum:Move(mv, false)
    local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    VelocityBypass = VelocityBypass or { applyingSpeed = false }
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = true
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = true
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(mv.X * spd, y, mv.Z * spd)
    _G._CalciumAntiBatDesiredXZ = Vector3.new(mv.X * spd, 0, mv.Z * spd)
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = false
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
    -- Show speed on head while Auto L / Auto R is running
    pcall(function()
      if type(_G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed) == "function" then
        _G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed(spd)
      else
        _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = tonumber(spd) or 0
        if overheadSpeedLabel and overheadSpeedLabel.Parent then
          overheadSpeedLabel.Text = string.format("Speed: %.1f", tonumber(spd) or 0)
        end
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
  local function pathSpd()
    local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
    if mode == "Lagger" or mode == "Lagger Carry" then return tonumber(LAGGER_SPEED) or 40 end
    return tonumber(NS) or 60
  end
  local function carrySpd()
    local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
    if mode == "Lagger" or mode == "Lagger Carry" then return tonumber(LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) or 20 end
    return tonumber(CS) or 30
  end
  local P = _G.CalciumAutoPathPoints
  S.leftConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not autoLeftEnabled then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    if walkZero(hum) then
      autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
      _G.CalciumStopAutoLeft()
      if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
      if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
      return
    end
    if isRag(hum) then
      hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
      return
    end
    -- SEMI (simple 2-phase)
    if not useFull then
      local spd = pathSpd()
      if S.leftPhase == 1 then
        local tgt = Vector3.new(P.L1.X, hrp.Position.Y, P.L1.Z)
        if (tgt - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 1 then S.leftPhase = 2
        else applyMove(hrp, hum, P.L1, spd) end
      elseif S.leftPhase == 2 then
        local tgt = Vector3.new(P.L2.X, hrp.Position.Y, P.L2.Z)
        if (tgt - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
          hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
          hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
          autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
          if S.leftConn then S.leftConn:Disconnect(); S.leftConn = nil end
          S.leftPhase = 1
          if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
          if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
        else
          applyMove(hrp, hum, P.L2, spd)
        end
      end
      return
    end
    -- FULL (4-phase Adrast)
    if S.leftPhase == 1 then
      local spd = pathSpd()
      local flatPos = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)
      local l1 = Vector3.new(P.L1.X, 0, P.L1.Z)
      if (flatPos - l1).Magnitude < 2.8 then S.leftPhase = 2 end
      applyMove(hrp, hum, P.L1, spd)
    elseif S.leftPhase == 2 then
      local spd = pathSpd()
      local tgt = Vector3.new(P.L2.X, hrp.Position.Y, P.L2.Z)
      if (tgt - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
        hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
        S.leftPhase = 0
        if S.leftConn then S.leftConn:Disconnect(); S.leftConn = nil end
        task.spawn(function()
          task.wait(tonumber(AUTO_PLAY_FREEZE) or 0.25)
          if not autoLeftEnabled then return end
          S.leftPhase = 3
          S.leftConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not autoLeftEnabled then return end
            local c2 = LP.Character
            if not c2 then return end
            local h2 = c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum2 = c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not h2 or not hum2 then return end
            if isRag(hum2) or walkZero(hum2) then
              hum2:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
              return
            end
            local spd2 = carrySpd()
            if S.leftPhase == 3 then
              local tp = Vector3.new(P.L1.X, h2.Position.Y, P.L1.Z)
              if (tp - h2.Position).Magnitude < 1 then S.leftPhase = 4 end
              local target = (S.leftPhase == 4) and P.L3 or P.L1
              applyMove(h2, hum2, target, spd2)
            elseif S.leftPhase == 4 then
              local tp = Vector3.new(P.L3.X, h2.Position.Y, P.L3.Z)
              if (tp - h2.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
                hum2:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
                autoLeftEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoLeftOn = false
                if S.leftConn then S.leftConn:Disconnect(); S.leftConn = nil end
                S.leftPhase = 1
                if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeftVisual(false) end
                if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
              else
                applyMove(h2, hum2, P.L3, spd2)
              end
            end
          end)
        end)
      else
        applyMove(hrp, hum, P.L2, spd)
      end
    end
  end)
end

function _G.CalciumStartAutoRight()
  local S = _G.CalciumAutoPathState
  if S.rightConn then S.rightConn:Disconnect(); S.rightConn = nil end
  S.rightPhase = 1
  local useFull = (_G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true) or (autoPlayFullEnabled == true)
  local function isRag(hum)
    if not hum then return true end
    local st = hum:GetState()
    return hum.PlatformStand or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
  end
  local function walkZero(hum)
    return hum and hum.WalkSpeed == 0
  end
  local function applyMove(hrp, hum, target, spd)
    local d = target - hrp.Position
    local mv = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
    if mv.Magnitude < 0.05 then return false end
    mv = mv.Unit
    hum:Move(mv, false)
    local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
    VelocityBypass = VelocityBypass or { applyingSpeed = false }
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = true
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = true
    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(mv.X * spd, y, mv.Z * spd)
    _G._CalciumAntiBatDesiredXZ = Vector3.new(mv.X * spd, 0, mv.Z * spd)
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = false
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
    -- Show speed on head while Auto L / Auto R is running
    pcall(function()
      if type(_G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed) == "function" then
        _G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed(spd)
      else
        _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = tonumber(spd) or 0
        if overheadSpeedLabel and overheadSpeedLabel.Parent then
          overheadSpeedLabel.Text = string.format("Speed: %.1f", tonumber(spd) or 0)
        end
      end
    end)
    return true
  end
  local function pathSpd()
    local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
    if mode == "Lagger" or mode == "Lagger Carry" then return tonumber(LAGGER_SPEED) or 40 end
    return tonumber(NS) or 60
  end
  local function carrySpd()
    local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
    if mode == "Lagger" or mode == "Lagger Carry" then return tonumber(LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) or 20 end
    return tonumber(CS) or 30
  end
  local P = _G.CalciumAutoPathPoints
  S.rightConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if not autoRightEnabled then return end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end
    if walkZero(hum) then
      autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
      _G.CalciumStopAutoRight()
      if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(false) end
      if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
      return
    end
    if isRag(hum) then
      hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
      return
    end
    if not useFull then
      local spd = pathSpd()
      if S.rightPhase == 1 then
        local tgt = Vector3.new(P.R1.X, hrp.Position.Y, P.R1.Z)
        if (tgt - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 1 then S.rightPhase = 2
        else applyMove(hrp, hum, P.R1, spd) end
      elseif S.rightPhase == 2 then
        local tgt = Vector3.new(P.R2.X, hrp.Position.Y, P.R2.Z)
        if (tgt - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
          hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
          hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
          autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
          if S.rightConn then S.rightConn:Disconnect(); S.rightConn = nil end
          S.rightPhase = 1
          if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(false) end
          if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
        else
          applyMove(hrp, hum, P.R2, spd)
        end
      end
      return
    end
    if S.rightPhase == 1 then
      local spd = pathSpd()
      local flatPos = Vector3.new(hrp.Position.X, 0, hrp.Position.Z)
      local r1 = Vector3.new(P.R1.X, 0, P.R1.Z)
      if (flatPos - r1).Magnitude < 2.8 then S.rightPhase = 2 end
      applyMove(hrp, hum, P.R1, spd)
    elseif S.rightPhase == 2 then
      local spd = pathSpd()
      local tgt = Vector3.new(P.R2.X, hrp.Position.Y, P.R2.Z)
      if (tgt - hrp.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
        hum:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
        S.rightPhase = 0
        if S.rightConn then S.rightConn:Disconnect(); S.rightConn = nil end
        task.spawn(function()
          task.wait(tonumber(AUTO_PLAY_FREEZE) or 0.25)
          if not autoRightEnabled then return end
          S.rightPhase = 3
          S.rightConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not autoRightEnabled then return end
            local c2 = LP.Character
            if not c2 then return end
            local h2 = c2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum2 = c2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not h2 or not hum2 then return end
            if isRag(hum2) or walkZero(hum2) then
              hum2:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
              return
            end
            local spd2 = carrySpd()
            if S.rightPhase == 3 then
              local tp = Vector3.new(P.R1.X, h2.Position.Y, P.R1.Z)
              if (tp - h2.Position).Magnitude < 1 then S.rightPhase = 4 end
              local target = (S.rightPhase == 4) and P.R3 or P.R1
              applyMove(h2, hum2, target, spd2)
            elseif S.rightPhase == 4 then
              local tp = Vector3.new(P.R3.X, h2.Position.Y, P.R3.Z)
              if (tp - h2.Position).Magnitude < 1 then
                hum2:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
                h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, h2.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
                autoRightEnabled = false; _G.CalciumAutoRightOn = false
                if S.rightConn then S.rightConn:Disconnect(); S.rightConn = nil end
                S.rightPhase = 1
                if _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoRightVisual(false) end
                if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() end
              else
                applyMove(h2, hum2, P.R3, spd2)
              end
            end
          end)
        end)
      else
        applyMove(hrp, hum, P.R2, spd)
      end
    end
  end)
end

-- ============================================================
-- AUTO PLAY: SINGLE CONTROL / OWN PLOT DIRECTION
-- The original four-phase movement workers above stay unchanged.
-- The plot model NAME is the plot ID; it is not a world-space waypoint.
-- ============================================================
_G.CalciumAutoPlay = _G.CalciumAutoPlay or {}
do
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end) end
  A.conn = nil
  A.side = nil
  A.cachedPlot = nil
  A.plotUUID = nil
  A.cfg = {RADIUS=10, AT=2, PLACE=99606176102979}
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.placeOk()
  return game.PlaceId == _G.CalciumAutoPlay.cfg.PLACE
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.updateVisual()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if _G.CalciumAutoPlayDestinationLabel then
    _G.CalciumAutoPlayDestinationLabel.Text = tostring(A.plotUUID or (A.side and ("PLOT " .. A.side) or "Waiting for plot"))
  end
  if _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual then _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual(A.running()) end
  if _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates then pcall(_G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates) end
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.ownedPlot()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if A.cachedPlot and A.cachedPlot.Parent then return A.cachedPlot end
  local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
  if not plots then return nil end
  local user = LP.Name:lower()
  local display = LP.DisplayName:lower()
  for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
    if plot:IsA("Model") then
      local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
      if sign then
        local mine = false
        -- This is the same own-base indicator already used by Auto Steal.
        local yourBase = sign:FindFirstChild("YourBase")
        if yourBase and yourBase:IsA("BillboardGui") and yourBase.Enabled then
          mine = true
        end
        -- Fallback: the game's existing SurfaceGui.Frame.TextLabel owner.
        if not mine then
          local surface = sign:FindFirstChild("SurfaceGui")
          local frame = surface and surface:FindFirstChild("Frame")
          local label = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("TextLabel")
          if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
            local owner = label.Text:gsub("<.->", ""):gsub("'[sS]%s+[Bb]ase$", ""):gsub("^@", ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):lower()
            mine = owner == user or owner == display
          end
        end
        if mine then
          A.cachedPlot = plot
          A.plotUUID = plot.Name
          return plot
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return nil
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.detectPlot()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  local plot = A.ownedPlot()
  if not plot then return nil end
  local sign = plot:FindFirstChild("PlotSign")
  local pos = sign and sign:IsA("BasePart") and sign.Position or plot:GetPivot().Position
  local dLeft = (Vector3.new(pos.X,0,pos.Z) - Vector3.new(-476.752,0,7.107)).Magnitude
  local dRight = (Vector3.new(pos.X,0,pos.Z) - Vector3.new(-476.752,0,114.107)).Magnitude
  A.side = (dLeft <= dRight) and "L" or "R"
  A.updateVisual()
  return A.side
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.zoneDir()
  local c = LP.Character
  local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
  if not hrp then return nil end
  local p = hrp.Position
  local function near(x,z)
    local dx, dz = p.X - x, p.Z - z
    return dx*dx + dz*dz <= _G.CalciumAutoPlay.cfg.RADIUS^2
  end
  if near(-466.48,6.65) then return "L" end
  if near(-466.90,113.56) then return "R" end
  return nil
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.running()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  return (A.side == "L" and autoLeftEnabled == true)
      or (A.side == "R" and autoRightEnabled == true)
end
function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.active() return _G.CalciumAutoPlay.running() end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.save()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if not A.placeOk() or not A.side then return end
  local job = tostring(game.JobId or "")
  if job == "" then return end
  A.saveJob, A.saveSide = job, A.side
  if saveCalciumConfig then pcall(saveCalciumConfig) end
end

-- stop() only tears down the detection listener, not an active route.
function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.stop()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if A.conn then pcall(function() A.conn:Disconnect() end); A.conn = nil end
end

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.set(on)
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if on then
    local side = A.detectPlot() or A.side
    if not side then
      side = A.zoneDir() -- last-resort detection if the plot has not replicated
      if side then A.side = side end
    end
    if not side then
      if _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify then
        _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify("AUTO PLAY WAITING", "Your plot has not loaded yet. Try again shortly.", true)
      end
      A.updateVisual()
      return false
    end
    -- Do not alter path checkpoints: just invoke the ORIGINAL Left/Right worker.
    if side == "L" then
      _G.CalciumSetAutoLeft(true)
    else
      _G.CalciumSetAutoRight(true)
    end
    if A.running() then A.save() end
  else
    if autoLeftEnabled then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeft(false) end
    if autoRightEnabled then _G.CalciumSetAutoRight(false) end
  end
  A.updateVisual()
  return A.running()
end
function _G.CalciumAutoPlayToggle()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  return A.set(not A.running())
end
_G.CalciumAutoPlay.toggle = _G.CalciumAutoPlayToggle

function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.restore()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  if A.side or not A.placeOk() then return end
  local job = tostring(game.JobId or "")
  if job ~= "" and _G._AmbAutoPlaySavedJob == job then
    local dir = _G._AmbAutoPlaySavedSide
    if dir == "L" or dir == "R" then
      A.side, A.saveSide, A.saveJob = dir, dir, job
    end
  end
end
function _G.CalciumAutoPlay.watch()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  A.stop()
  -- Plot ownership can take a moment to replicate. Poll only briefly.
  task.spawn(function()
    for _ = 1, 12 do
      if A.detectPlot() then return end
      task.wait(1)
    end
  end)
  -- Existing countdown-side fallback, throttled to prevent FPS loss.
  local elapsed = 0
  A.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if A.side then A.stop(); return end
    elapsed = elapsed + (dt or 0)
    if elapsed < 0.2 then return end
    elapsed = 0
    local ok, n = pcall(_G.CalciumSafeModeCountdownValue)
    if not ok or n == nil or n > A.cfg.AT then return end
    local side = A.zoneDir()
    if side then
      A.side = side
      A.stop()
      A.save()
      A.updateVisual()
    end
  end)
end
function _G.CalciumAutoPlayStatus()
  local A = _G.CalciumAutoPlay
  return "AutoPlay=" .. tostring(A.running()) .. " | side=" .. tostring(A.side or "unknown") .. " | plotUUID=" .. tostring(A.plotUUID or "not loaded")
end
pcall(_G.CalciumAutoPlay.restore)
pcall(_G.CalciumAutoPlay.watch)

LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
  _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10)
  -- Auto-left/right remain off after respawn unless manually re-enabled.
end)

overheadGui = nil
overheadSpeedLabel = nil

local function setupOverheadInfo(char)
    if overheadGui then overheadGui:Destroy() end
    overheadGui, overheadSpeedLabel, ragdollCountdownLabel = nil, nil, nil
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
    if not head or char ~= LP.Character then return end
    local old = head:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubOverheadInfo")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    overheadGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    overheadGui.Name = "CalciumHubOverheadInfo"
    overheadGui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(284, 122)
    overheadGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.65, 0)
    overheadGui.AlwaysOnTop, overheadGui.LightInfluence = true, 0
    overheadGui.Adornee, overheadGui.Parent = head, head
    local function text(name, value, y, h, size, color)
      local label = Instance.new("TextLabel", overheadGui)
      label.Name, label.Text = name, value
      label.Position, label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
      label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      label.Font, label.TextSize = Enum.Font.GothamBold, size
      label.TextColor3 = color
      label.TextStrokeColor3, label.TextStrokeTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(5, 9, 14), 0.35
      label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
      return label
    end
    ragdollCountdownLabel = text("RagdollCountdown", "", 0, 24, 20, Color3.fromRGB(115, 244, 167))
    ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible = false
    local tagline = text("Tagline", "BEST DUEL SCRIPT", 27, 22, 17, Color3.fromRGB(240, 247, 250))
    local invite = text("Discord", "discord.gg/calciumhub", 50, 20, 14, Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241))
    invite.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    local line = Instance.new("Frame", overheadGui)
    line.Name, line.BorderSizePixel = "DividerLine", 0
    line.Position, line.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -30, 0, 77), UDim2.fromOffset(60, 1)
    line.BackgroundColor3, line.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241), 0.25
    overheadSpeedLabel = text("Speed", "Speed: 0", 86, 28, 20, Color3.fromRGB(235, 241, 246))
end
_G._CalciumRCD = _G._CalciumRCD or {conn=nil, charConn=nil, endTime=0, seconds=2.6}
-- Flag alzato quando il ragdoll corrente è causato da medusa (rilevato via Anchored+Transparency==1)
-- Usa 'or 0' invece di reset incondizionato: preserva un hit recente in caso di re-inject.
_G._CalciumMedusaHitTime = _G._CalciumMedusaHitTime or 0
-- _isMedusaHit è definita prima di _doSyncAfterHit (sezione SYNC AFTER HIT) per essere una upvalue valida.

function stopRagdollCountdown()
  if _G._CalciumRCD.conn then _G._CalciumRCD.conn:Disconnect(); _G._CalciumRCD.conn = nil end
  if _G._CalciumRCD.charConn then _G._CalciumRCD.charConn:Disconnect(); _G._CalciumRCD.charConn = nil end
  if ragdollCountdownLabel then
    ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible = false
    ragdollCountdownLabel.Text = ""
  end
end
-- ============================================================
-- ENEMY RAGDOLL COUNTDOWN SYSTEM
-- Shows countdown above enemies when they get ragdolled
-- ============================================================
enemyRagdollData = {}
-- Esposto per il Bat Counter V2 (deve restare la STESSA tabella: mai riassegnarla)
_G.CalciumEnemyRagdollData = enemyRagdollData
enemyCountdownConns = {}
enemyCountdownUpdateLoop = nil
ENEMY_RAGDOLL_SECONDS = 2.6
_G._CalciumRCD.seconds = 2.6

function _G.CalciumStartEnemyRagdollCountdown()
    if enemyRagdollConn then return end  -- usiamo enemyRagdollConn come flag

    -- Loop di aggiornamento countdown (ogni 0.05 sec, non ogni frame)
    enemyCountdownUpdateLoop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local now = tick()
        for plr, data in pairs(enemyRagdollData) do
            if not data or not data.gui or not data.gui.Parent then
                enemyRagdollData[plr] = nil
                continue
            end
            if data.endTime and data.endTime > now then
                local left = data.endTime - now
                local label = data.gui:FindFirstChild("Countdown")
                if label then
                    label.Text = string.format("RAGDOLL %.1f", left)
                    label.TextColor3 = left <= 1 and Color3.fromRGB(255,230,90) or Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
                end
            else
                -- Il timer è scaduto: nascondi la GUI e rimuovi il dato
                pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end)
                enemyRagdollData[plr] = nil
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Rilevamento ragdoll tramite DescendantAdded
    local function setupEnemyRagdollDetector(enemyChar, plr)
        -- Pulisci vecchie connessioni per questo giocatore
        if enemyCountdownConns[plr] then
            local old = enemyCountdownConns[plr]
            pcall(function() if old.ragdollDetect then old.ragdollDetect:Disconnect() end end)
            pcall(function() if old.stateChange   then old.stateChange:Disconnect()   end end)
            -- NON disconnettiamo charAdded qui: viene gestita in watchEnemyPlayer
            enemyCountdownConns[plr] = nil
        end
        -- Connessione per rilevare l'inizio del ragdoll
        local conn = enemyChar.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
            if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
                -- Rilevato ragdoll: imposta il countdown
                local now = tick()
                local data = enemyRagdollData[plr]
                if not data then
                    -- Crea la GUI se non esiste
                    local head = enemyChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    if head then
                        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                        bb.Name = "CalciumEnemyRagdollCountdown"
                        bb.Adornee = head
                        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
                        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
                        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
                        bb.LightInfluence = 0
                        -- Parent to PlayerGui so it survives character resets/destruction
                        bb.Parent = HubGui

                        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        label.Name = "Countdown"
                        label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
                        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        label.Text = ""
                        label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,255,120)
                        label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0)
                        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        label.TextSize = 20
                        label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
                        label.ZIndex = 10
                        label.Parent = bb

                        enemyRagdollData[plr] = {
                            gui = bb,
                            endTime = now + ENEMY_RAGDOLL_SECONDS
                        }
                    end
                else
                    -- Se il ragdoll è già attivo, resetta il timer
                    data.endTime = now + ENEMY_RAGDOLL_SECONDS
                end
            end
        end)

        -- Connessione per rilevare la fine del ragdoll (quando lo stato non è più ragdoll)
        local hum = enemyChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local stateConn
        if hum then
            stateConn = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
                local stillRagdoll = (newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
                                      newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll)
                if not stillRagdoll then
                    -- Uscito dal ragdoll: rimuovi la GUI solo se il countdown è già scaduto
                    local data = enemyRagdollData[plr]
                    if data then
                        if tick() >= (data.endTime or 0) then
                            if data.gui then pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end) end
                            enemyRagdollData[plr] = nil
                        end
                        -- Se il timer è ancora in corso, il loop Heartbeat gestirà la rimozione
                    end
                end
            end)
        else
            -- Se non c'è Humanoid, pulisci quando il personaggio viene distrutto
            stateConn = enemyChar.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
                if not parent then
                    local data = enemyRagdollData[plr]
                    if data and data.gui then
                        pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end)
                    end
                    enemyRagdollData[plr] = nil
                end
            end)
        end
        enemyCountdownConns[plr] = {ragdollDetect = conn, stateChange = stateConn}
    end
    -- Applica a tutti i giocatori esistenti e futuri
    local function watchEnemyPlayer(plr)
        if plr == LP then return end
        -- Disconnetti la vecchia CharacterAdded se esiste
        if enemyCountdownConns[plr] and enemyCountdownConns[plr].charAdded then
            pcall(function() enemyCountdownConns[plr].charAdded:Disconnect() end)
        end
        local charConn = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            if char then setupEnemyRagdollDetector(char, plr) end
        end)
        -- Salva la conn nel record del player (merge con ragdollDetect/stateChange)
        if not enemyCountdownConns[plr] then enemyCountdownConns[plr] = {} end
        enemyCountdownConns[plr].charAdded = charConn
        if plr.Character then setupEnemyRagdollDetector(plr.Character, plr) end
    end
    -- Pulisci vecchie connessioni prima di ricreare
    for _, conns in pairs(enemyCountdownConns) do
        pcall(function()
            if conns.ragdollDetect then conns.ragdollDetect:Disconnect() end
            if conns.stateChange then conns.stateChange:Disconnect() end
            if conns.charAdded then conns.charAdded:Disconnect() end
        end)
    end
    enemyCountdownConns = {}

    -- Attiva il watcher
    enemyRagdollConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchEnemyPlayer)
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        watchEnemyPlayer(plr)
    end
    -- Pulisci alla rimozione del giocatore. La connessione sta in una
    -- variabile sua: messa dentro enemyCountdownConns (indicizzata per
    -- giocatore) la pulizia non la trovava e restava appesa per sempre.
    if _G._CalciumEnemyCountdownRemovingConn then
        pcall(function() _G._CalciumEnemyCountdownRemovingConn:Disconnect() end)
    end
    _G._CalciumEnemyCountdownRemovingConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        local data = enemyRagdollData[plr]
        if data and data.gui then
            pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end)
        end
        enemyRagdollData[plr] = nil
        if enemyCountdownConns[plr] then
            pcall(function()
                if enemyCountdownConns[plr].ragdollDetect then enemyCountdownConns[plr].ragdollDetect:Disconnect() end
                if enemyCountdownConns[plr].stateChange then enemyCountdownConns[plr].stateChange:Disconnect() end
                if enemyCountdownConns[plr].charAdded then enemyCountdownConns[plr].charAdded:Disconnect() end
            end)
            enemyCountdownConns[plr] = nil
        end
    end)
end
function _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown()
    if enemyRagdollConn then
        enemyRagdollConn:Disconnect()
        enemyRagdollConn = nil
    end
    if enemyCountdownUpdateLoop then
        enemyCountdownUpdateLoop:Disconnect()
        enemyCountdownUpdateLoop = nil
    end
    if _G._CalciumEnemyCountdownRemovingConn then
        pcall(function() _G._CalciumEnemyCountdownRemovingConn:Disconnect() end)
        _G._CalciumEnemyCountdownRemovingConn = nil
    end
    for _, conns in pairs(enemyCountdownConns) do
        pcall(function()
            if conns.ragdollDetect then conns.ragdollDetect:Disconnect() end
            if conns.stateChange then conns.stateChange:Disconnect() end
            -- Senza questa la CharacterAdded restava viva e ad ogni respawn
            -- rimetteva in piedi rilevatore e GUI a funzione spenta.
            if conns.charAdded then conns.charAdded:Disconnect() end
        end)
    end
    enemyCountdownConns = {}
    for plr, data in pairs(enemyRagdollData) do
        if data and data.gui then
            pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
    -- Pulizia IN-PLACE: se riassegnassimo la tabella, _G.CalciumEnemyRagdollData
    -- resterebbe agganciato a quella vecchia e il Bat Counter V2 leggerebbe dati morti.
    for plr in pairs(enemyRagdollData) do enemyRagdollData[plr] = nil end
end
_originalStopRagdoll = stopRagdollCountdown
function stopRagdollCountdown()
  _originalStopRagdoll()
  _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown()
end
function hookRagdollCountdown(char)
  stopRagdollCountdown()
  if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then return end
  -- Avvia il rilevamento ragdoll nemici
  _G.CalciumStartEnemyRagdollCountdown()
  char = char or LP.Character
  if not char then return end
  local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 4)
  if not hum then return end

  local function beginCountdown()
    local duration = _isMedusaHit() and 3.6 or _G._CalciumRCD.seconds
    _G._CalciumRCD.endTime = tick() + duration
    if ragdollCountdownLabel then
      ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible = true
    end
  end
  local function isRagdollStateForCountdown()
    local st = hum:GetState()
    return hum.PlatformStand
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
  end
  _G._CalciumRCD.charConn = hum.StateChanged:Connect(function(_, newState)
    if newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or newState == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll then
      beginCountdown()
    end
  end)

  _G._CalciumRCD.conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not ragdollCountdownEnabled then stopRagdollCountdown(); return end
    if not ragdollCountdownLabel or not ragdollCountdownLabel.Parent then return end
    if isRagdollStateForCountdown() and _G._CalciumRCD.endTime < tick() then
      beginCountdown()
    end
    local left = math.max(0, _G._CalciumRCD.endTime - tick())
    if left > 0 then
      ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible = true
      ragdollCountdownLabel.Text = string.format("RAGDOLL %.1f", left)
      if left <= 1 then
        ragdollCountdownLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90)
      else
        ragdollCountdownLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120)
      end
    else
      ragdollCountdownLabel.Visible = false
      ragdollCountdownLabel.Text = ""
    end
  end)

end
if LP.Character then
  task.spawn(function()
    setupOverheadInfo(LP.Character)
  end)
end
LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
  _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10)
  setupOverheadInfo(char)
  if ragdollCountdownEnabled then hookRagdollCountdown(char) end
end)


-- ========== SPEED BOOSTER (classic / pre-S2) ==========
do
  VelocityBypass = VelocityBypass or { applyingSpeed = false }
  _G.VelocityBypass = VelocityBypass
  _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
  _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = 0

  -- Head speed readout (works during Auto L / Auto R too)
  function _G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed(spd, displayOnly)
    spd = tonumber(spd)
    if spd and spd > 0.05 and not displayOnly then
      _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = spd
    end
    local label = overheadSpeedLabel
    if not (label and label.Parent) then return end
    local shown = 0
    if displayOnly then
      -- Configured speed readout: do not replace it with the boosted value.
      shown = math.max(tonumber(spd) or 0, 0)
    elseif spd and spd > 0.05 then
      shown = spd
    elseif _S2_lastAppliedSpeed and _S2_lastAppliedSpeed > 0.5 then
      shown = _S2_lastAppliedSpeed
    else
      -- fallback: real horizontal velocity
      pcall(function()
        local char = LP.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
          local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
          shown = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
        end
      end)
    end
    label.Text = string.format("Speed: %.1f", shown)
  end

  local MOVE_KEYS = {
    [Enum.KeyCode.W] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.A] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.S] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.D] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.Up] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Down] = true,
    [Enum.KeyCode.Left] = true, [Enum.KeyCode.Right] = true,
  }

  -- Roblox's PlayerModule control vector covers keyboard, gamepad and the
  -- mobile thumbstick. Humanoid.MoveDirection alone isn't proof of live input:
  -- other automation or a stale control state can leave it non-zero.
  local _CalciumPlayerControls = nil
  local _CalciumControlModuleTried = false
  local function hasManualMoveInput()
    local focused = false
    pcall(function() focused = UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() ~= nil end)
    if focused then return false end

    if not _CalciumPlayerControls then
      pcall(function()
        local ps = LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
        local moduleScript = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        if moduleScript then
          local module = require(moduleScript)
          if type(module) == "table" and type(module.GetControls) == "function" then
            _CalciumPlayerControls = module:GetControls()
          end
        end
      end)
    end

    if _CalciumPlayerControls then
      local ok, moveVector = pcall(function() return _CalciumPlayerControls:GetMoveVector() end)
      if ok and typeof(moveVector) == "Vector3" then
        if Vector3.new(moveVector.X, 0, moveVector.Z).Magnitude > 0.08 then return true end
      end
    end

    local keyboardActive = false
    pcall(function()
      for key in pairs(MOVE_KEYS) do
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) then keyboardActive = true; break end
      end
    end)
    if keyboardActive then return true end

    local gamepadActive = false
    pcall(function()
      for _, input in ipairs(UserInputService:GetGamepadState(Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1)) do
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 then
          local pos = input.Position
          if Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y).Magnitude > 0.15 then gamepadActive = true; break end
        end
      end
    end)
    return gamepadActive
  end

  local function getSpd()
    local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")
    local v = nil
    if mode == "Carry" then
      v = tonumber(CS) or tonumber(_G.CS)
    elseif mode == "Lagger" then
      v = tonumber(LAGGER_SPEED) or tonumber(_G.LAGGER_SPEED)
    elseif mode == "Lagger Carry" then
      v = tonumber(LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED) or tonumber(_G.LAGGER_CARRY_SPEED)
    else
      v = tonumber(NS) or tonumber(_G.NS)
    end
    if not v and type(getCurrentSpeedValue) == "function" then
      v = tonumber(getCurrentSpeedValue())
    end
    if not v and type(_G.CalciumGetCurrentSpeedValue) == "function" then
      v = tonumber(_G.CalciumGetCurrentSpeedValue())
    end
    return v or 16
  end


  -- ============================================================
  -- VX7 SPEED METHOD V2 (ported)
  -- Direct AssemblyLinearVelocity from move dir * configured speed.
  -- No 1.08 boost, no ApplyImpulse, no WalkSpeed writes.
  -- Y axis preserved so jumps / fall still work.
  -- ============================================================
  _G.CalciumSpeedMethod = "V2" -- VX7 V2
  local function applySpeedMethod(hrp, hum, dir, spd)
    if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
    spd = tonumber(spd) or 0
    VelocityBypass = VelocityBypass or { applyingSpeed = false }
    if not dir or (typeof(dir) == "Vector3" and dir.Magnitude < 0.05) or spd <= 0 then
      VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = true
      _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = true
      pcall(function()
        local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
      end)
      VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = false
      _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
      _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = 0
      _G._S2_lastAppliedSpeed = 0
      return
    end
    pcall(function()
      if hrp.SetNetworkOwner then hrp:SetNetworkOwner(LP) end
    end)
    local unit = dir.Unit
    local y = 0
    pcall(function() y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y end)
    -- Adrast S2: real studs/s via AssemblyLinearVelocity
    local target = Vector3.new(unit.X * spd, y, unit.Z * spd)
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = true
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = true
    pcall(function()
      hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = target
      hrp.Velocity = target
    end)
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = false
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
    _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = spd
    _G._S2_lastAppliedSpeed = spd
  end

  local function applyClassicSpeed(hrp, hum, dir, spd)
    if not hrp or not hrp.Parent or not hum then return end
    spd = tonumber(spd) or 0
    if spd <= 0 or not dir or dir.Magnitude < 0.05 then
      _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = true
      VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = true
      pcall(function()
        local y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
        hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
      end)
      _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
      VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = false
      _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = 0
      return
    end
    local unit = dir.Unit
    local y = 0
    pcall(function() y = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y end)
    local target = Vector3.new(unit.X * spd, y, unit.Z * spd)
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = true
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = true
    pcall(function() hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = target end)
    pcall(function() hrp.Velocity = Vector3.new(target.X, y, target.Z) end)
    _G._CalciumAntiBatDesiredXZ = Vector3.new(target.X, 0, target.Z)
    -- no WalkSpeed write — avoids AC flags / resets
    _G._CalciumAllowVelWrite = false
    VelocityBypass.applyingSpeed = false
    _S2_lastAppliedSpeed = spd
  end

  local function isRagdolledState(hum)
    if not hum then return false end
    local st = hum:GetState()
    if hum.PlatformStand then return true end
    if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
      return true
    end
    local et = LP and LP:GetAttribute("RagdollEndTime")
    if typeof(et) == "number" then
      local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
      if et > now then return true end
    end
    return false
  end

  local function tickSpeed()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end

    local st = hum:GetState()
    local rag = isRagdolledState(hum)
    local mode = tostring(currentSpeedMode or "Normal")


    if hum.PlatformStand
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
      or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
      lastMoveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
      return
    end

    -- don't fight dedicated systems (still refresh head speed for Auto L/R)
    if autoLeftEnabled or autoRightEnabled then
      pcall(function()
        if type(_G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed) == "function" then
          _G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed(_S2_lastAppliedSpeed)
        elseif overheadSpeedLabel and overheadSpeedLabel.Parent then
          local shown = tonumber(_S2_lastAppliedSpeed) or 0
          if shown < 0.5 then
            local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            shown = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z).Magnitude
          end
          overheadSpeedLabel.Text = string.format("Speed: %.1f", shown)
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn or _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then return end
    if _G._CalciumAntiBatSpiking or _G._CalciumSlowFallActive then return end
    if tpBatEnabled or (_G.CalciumTPBatOn == true) then return end

    local spd = getSpd()
    local md = hum.MoveDirection
    local dir = nil
    local manualInput = hasManualMoveInput()
    if manualInput and md.Magnitude > 0.05 then
      dir = Vector3.new(md.X, 0, md.Z)
      if dir.Magnitude > 0 then dir = dir.Unit end
      lastMoveDir = dir
    elseif manualInput and lastMoveDir and lastMoveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
      -- Keyboard fallback only while a movement key is physically held.
      pcall(function()
        for key in pairs(MOVE_KEYS) do
          if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(key) then
            dir = lastMoveDir
            break
          end
        end
      end)
    else
      -- Clear cached direction when no real keyboard/gamepad/touch input exists.
      lastMoveDir = Vector3.zero
    end

    if dir and spd > 0 then
      applySpeedMethod(hrp, hum, dir, spd)
    else
      applySpeedMethod(hrp, hum, nil, 0)
    end

    if type(_G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed) == "function" then
      local shown = (dir and spd and spd > 0.5) and spd or 0
      pcall(_G.CalciumUpdateOverheadSpeed, shown, true)
    elseif overheadSpeedLabel and overheadSpeedLabel.Parent then
      local shown = (dir and spd and spd > 0.5) and spd or 0
      overheadSpeedLabel.Text = string.format("Speed: %.1f", shown)
    end
  end

  local conn
  local function start()
    if conn then pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end) end
    -- Match the uploaded build: apply requested velocity before physics simulation.
    local sig = RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Heartbeat
    conn = sig:Connect(function()
      pcall(tickSpeed)
    end)
  end

  _G.CalciumApplySpeedMethod = applyClassicSpeed
  _G.CalciumSpeedBoosterStart = start
  task.defer(function()
    pcall(function()
      if not LP.Character then LP.CharacterAdded:Wait() end
      task.wait(0.1)
      start()
    end)
  end)
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.defer(function()
      task.wait(0.1)
      pcall(start)
    end)
  end)
end
-- ========== FINE SPEED BOOSTER (classic / pre-S2) ==========

local COLORS = {
  bg = Color3.fromRGB(12, 15, 20),
  row = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 38),
  row2 = Color3.fromRGB(19, 24, 31),
  stroke = Color3.fromRGB(56, 68, 82),
  strokeSoft = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 78),
  white = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248),
  textDim = Color3.fromRGB(150, 152, 160),
  toggleBg = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 38),
  knob = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248),
  accent = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241),
  purple = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241),
  pumpkin = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241),
}

function corner(parent, radius)
  local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
  -- everything stays soft / phone-like
  local r = radius or 14
  if r < 10 then r = 12 end
  c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)
  c.Parent = parent
  return c
end
function stroke(parent, color, thickness, transparency)
  local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  s.Color = color or COLORS.stroke
  s.Thickness = thickness or 1
  s.Transparency = transparency or 0.35
  s.Parent = parent
  local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  g.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(155, 160, 185)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
  })
  g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.1),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.55),
  })
  g.Parent = s
  return s
end
function tween(obj, props, time)
  TweenService:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(time or 0.06, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end
-- Due glifi sovrapposti (su / giu) che si scambiano in dissolvenza.
-- Ruotare un singolo glifo lo spostava fuori asse, perche' la punta
-- non e' centrata dentro la riga di testo del font.
_G._CalciumArrowGlyph = function(arrow)
  if not arrow then return nil, nil end
  if type(_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable) == "function" then
    pcall(_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable, arrow)
  end
  local up = arrow:FindFirstChild("GlyphUp")
  local down = arrow:FindFirstChild("GlyphDown")
  if not up then
    local function mk(name, char)
      local g = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      g.Name = name
      g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      g.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      g.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      g.Text = char
      g.TextColor3 = arrow.TextColor3
      g.TextStrokeColor3 = arrow.TextStrokeColor3
      g.TextStrokeTransparency = arrow.TextStrokeTransparency
      g.TextSize = arrow.TextSize
      g.Font = arrow.Font
      g.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
      g.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
      g.ZIndex = (arrow.ZIndex or 1) + 1
      g.Parent = arrow
      return g
    end
    up = mk("GlyphUp", "^")
    down = mk("GlyphDown", "v")
    -- default CLOSED: show V only (down), hide ^
    up.TextTransparency = 1
    up.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
    down.TextTransparency = 0
    down.TextStrokeTransparency = arrow.TextStrokeTransparency
    arrow.Text = ""  -- glyphs only
  end
  return up, down
end
