  return false
end
-- Palette shifts with selected background index for cohesive look
_G._CalciumBgPalette = function()
  local i = tonumber(_G._CalciumBgIndex) or 1
  local pals = {
    { Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30), Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190), Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 90), Color3.fromRGB(200, 85, 25) },
    { Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 100), Color3.fromRGB(220, 100, 30), Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 15), Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 130), Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 30) },
    { Color3.fromRGB(255, 160, 200), Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 140), Color3.fromRGB(140, 30, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 210), Color3.fromRGB(180, 70, 120) },
    { Color3.fromRGB(160, 255, 200), Color3.fromRGB(40, 200, 140), Color3.fromRGB(20, 120, 80), Color3.fromRGB(160, 240, 200), Color3.fromRGB(40, 160, 110) },
    { Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120), Color3.fromRGB(230, 140, 40), Color3.fromRGB(160, 80, 20), Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 150), Color3.fromRGB(200, 120, 40) },
    { Color3.fromRGB(220, 140, 255), Color3.fromRGB(210, 70, 255), Color3.fromRGB(50, 30, 140), Color3.fromRGB(230, 160, 255), Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 200) },
  }
  return pals[((i - 1) % #pals) + 1]
end
_G.CalciumThemeChanged = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
_G._CalciumApplyAccent = function()
  local p = _G._CalciumBgPalette and _G._CalciumBgPalette() or nil
  local c0, c1, c2, edge, soft, base
  if p then
    c0, c1, c2, edge, soft = p[1], p[2], p[3], p[4], p[5]
    base = c1
  else
    c0   = Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)
    c1   = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
    c2   = Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)
    edge = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 90)
    soft = Color3.fromRGB(200, 85, 25)
    base = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
  end
  pcall(function()
    if COLORS then
      COLORS.accent = base
      COLORS.stroke = edge
      COLORS.strokeSoft = soft
      COLORS.row = Color3.fromRGB(
        math.floor(base.R * 40 + 12),
        math.floor(base.G * 40 + 14),
        math.floor(base.B * 40 + 18)
      )
    end
  end)
  -- tint main phone chrome from background palette
  pcall(function()
    if Main then
      local st = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if st then st.Color = soft end
    end
    if Content then
      Content.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(
        math.floor(c2.R * 30 + 6),
        math.floor(c2.G * 30 + 8),
        math.floor(c2.B * 30 + 12)
      )
    end
    if CalciumTitleText then
      CalciumTitleText.TextColor3 = edge
    end
    if homeHeader then
      homeHeader.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 255)
    end
    -- mini island follows palette
    if MiniFrame then
      MiniFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      local mst = MiniFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if mst then mst.Color = edge end
    end
    if MiniCalciumText then
      MiniCalciumText.TextColor3 = edge
    end
  end)
  local cs = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, c0),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, c1),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c2),
  })
  local slideAlpha = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  local pickAlpha = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.12),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.05),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.12),
  })

  local list = _G._CalciumAccentList
  for i = #list, 1, -1 do
    local e = list[i]
    if not (e and e.obj and e.obj.Parent) then
      table.remove(list, i)
    else
      local st = e.obj:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if e.kind == "soft" then
        if st then st.Color = soft end
      elseif e.kind == "button" then
        -- Se il gradiente e' spento il bottone e' in uno stato speciale
        -- (conferma / done): non ci mettiamo mano.
        if not (e.grad and e.grad.Enabled == false) then
          e.obj.BackgroundColor3 = base
          e.obj.BackgroundTransparency = 0
          if e.grad then e.grad.Color = cs end
          if st then st.Color = edge end
        end
      elseif e.kind == "toggle" then
        -- Fill del toggle: colore e gradiente, ma la trasparenza la gestisce
        -- setVisual (acceso = visibile, spento = invisibile). Non toccarla.
        local toggleBase, toggleEdge = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241), Color3.fromRGB(207, 246, 255)
        e.obj.BackgroundColor3 = toggleBase
        if e.grad then e.grad.Color = cs; e.grad.Enabled = false end
        local isOn = (e.obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5)
        if e.track then
          e.track.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and toggleBase or Color3.fromRGB(43, 46, 57)
          local tst = e.track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if tst and isOn then tst.Color = toggleEdge end
        end
        if e.knob and isOn then
          local kst = e.knob:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if kst then kst.Color = toggleEdge end
        end
        if e.row and isOn then
          local rst = e.row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if rst then rst.Color = toggleBase end
        end
      else
        e.obj.BackgroundColor3 = base
        e.obj.BackgroundTransparency = (e.kind == "slide") and 0.1 or 0.28
        if e.grad then
          e.grad.Color = cs
          e.grad.Transparency = (e.kind == "slide") and slideAlpha or pickAlpha
        end
        if st then st.Color = edge end
      end
    end
  end
  _G.CalciumThemeChanged:Fire()
end
_G._CalciumRegAccent = function(obj, grad, kind, track, knob, row)
  if not obj then return end
  table.insert(_G._CalciumAccentList,
    {obj = obj, grad = grad, kind = kind or "pick", track = track, knob = knob, row = row})
  pcall(_G._CalciumApplyAccent)
end
-- Colore acceso/spento del toggle, richiesto da setVisual
_G._CalciumToggleOnColor = function()
  return Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241), Color3.fromRGB(207, 246, 255)
end
-- Dopo che una tendina si chiude il canvas si accorcia, ma Roblox lascia
-- la CanvasPosition dov'era: si continua a scrollare nel vuoto. Qui la riallineiamo.
_G._CalciumClampCanvas = function(page)
  if not page or not page.Parent then return end
  if not page:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then return end
  task.defer(function()
    if not page or not page.Parent then return end
    local maxY = math.max(0, page.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - page.AbsoluteWindowSize.Y)
    local cp = page.CanvasPosition
    if cp.Y > maxY then
      page.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(cp.X, maxY)
    end
  end)
end
-- Apertura/chiusura a tendina, altezza fissa nota

-- Ensure dropdown arrows always receive clicks above the toggle switch
_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable = function(arrow)
  if not arrow then return end
  pcall(function()
    arrow.Active = true
    arrow.Selectable = true
    arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
    arrow.ZIndex = math.max(tonumber(arrow.ZIndex) or 0, 30)
    for _, d in ipairs(arrow:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("GuiObject") then
        d.ZIndex = math.max(tonumber(d.ZIndex) or 0, 31)
      end
    end
  end)
  return arrow
end

_G._CalciumExpand = function(holder, open, fullHeight, arrow)
  if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
  if arrow and type(_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable) == "function" then
    pcall(_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable, arrow)
  end
  holder.ClipsDescendants = true
  local info = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,
    open and Enum.EasingDirection.Out or Enum.EasingDirection.In)
  holder:SetAttribute("_expandToken", (holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken") or 0) + 1)
  local myToken = holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken")

  local gUp, gDown = _G._CalciumArrowGlyph(arrow)
  if gUp and gDown then
    local st = arrow.TextStrokeTransparency
    -- Closed: show V (down). Open: show ^ (up) so user knows they can close
    TweenService:Create(gUp, info, {TextTransparency = open and 0 or 1, TextStrokeTransparency = open and st or 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(gDown, info, {TextTransparency = open and 1 or 0, TextStrokeTransparency = open and 1 or st}):Play()
  end
  local page = holder.Parent
  local sx, ox = holder.Size.X.Scale, holder.Size.X.Offset
  if open then
    holder.Visible = true
    if holder.Size.Y.Offset >= fullHeight then
      holder.Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, 0)
    end
    TweenService:Create(holder, info, {Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, fullHeight)}):Play()
  else
    local closeTween = TweenService:Create(holder, info, {Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, 0)})
    closeTween.Completed:Connect(function()
      if holder and holder.Parent and holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken") == myToken then
        holder.Visible = false
      end
      _G._CalciumClampCanvas(page)
    end)
    closeTween:Play()
  end
end
-- Variante per contenitori ad altezza automatica (Avatar Changer)
_G._CalciumExpandAuto = function(holder, open, layout, arrow)
  if not holder or not holder.Parent then return end
  if arrow and type(_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable) == "function" then
    pcall(_G._CalciumMakeArrowClickable, arrow)
  end
  holder.ClipsDescendants = true
  local info = TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart,
    open and Enum.EasingDirection.Out or Enum.EasingDirection.In)
  holder:SetAttribute("_expandToken", (holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken") or 0) + 1)
  local myToken = holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken")

  local gUp, gDown = _G._CalciumArrowGlyph(arrow)
  if gUp and gDown then
    local st = arrow.TextStrokeTransparency
    TweenService:Create(gUp, info, {TextTransparency = open and 0 or 1, TextStrokeTransparency = open and st or 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(gDown, info, {TextTransparency = open and 1 or 0, TextStrokeTransparency = open and 1 or st}):Play()
  end
  -- Altezza del contenuto in unita' LOCALI (non absolute): AbsoluteContentSize e
  -- AbsoluteSize sono moltiplicati dalla UIScale della GUI, mentre Size.Y.Offset no.
  -- Mischiare le due cose lasciava un buco vuoto sotto la lista con GUI Scale > 1.
  local function contentHeight()
    local total, n = 0, 0
    for _, ch in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
      if ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.Visible then
        total = total + ch.Size.Y.Offset
        n = n + 1
      end
    end
    if layout and layout:IsA("UIListLayout") and n > 1 then
      total = total + layout.Padding.Offset * (n - 1)
    end
    if total <= 0 and layout then total = layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y end
    local pad = holder:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIPadding")
    if pad then
      total = total + pad.PaddingTop.Offset + pad.PaddingBottom.Offset
    end
    return total
  end
  local sx, ox = holder.Size.X.Scale, holder.Size.X.Offset
  if open then
    holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    holder.Visible = true
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, 0)
    local openTweenAuto = TweenService:Create(holder, info, {Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, contentHeight())})
    -- Agganciato al Completed del tween, non a un task.delay a tempo fisso,
    -- cosi' il ripristino avviene esattamente alla fine dell'animazione.
    openTweenAuto.Completed:Connect(function()
      if holder and holder.Parent and holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken") == myToken then
        -- Azzera l'offset PRIMA di riattivare AutomaticSize: con AutomaticSize il Size
        -- funziona da altezza minima, quindi un offset residuo troppo grande resterebbe
        -- come spazio vuoto in fondo. Con 0 la frame si adatta esattamente al contenuto.
        holder.Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, 0)
        holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
        holder.ClipsDescendants = false
        _G._CalciumClampCanvas(holder.Parent)
      end
    end)
    openTweenAuto:Play()
  else
    holder.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, contentHeight())
    local page = holder.Parent
    local closeTweenAuto = TweenService:Create(holder, info, {Size = UDim2.new(sx, ox, 0, 0)})
    closeTweenAuto.Completed:Connect(function()
      if holder and holder.Parent and holder:GetAttribute("_expandToken") == myToken then
        holder.Visible = false
      end
      _G._CalciumClampCanvas(page)
    end)
    closeTweenAuto:Play()
  end
end
function makeDraggable(frame)
  -- Main GUI is always draggable. LOCK only freezes mobile buttons.
  local dragging = false
  local dragStart
  local startPos
  local dragInput
  frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragging = true
      dragStart = input.Position
      startPos = frame.Position
      input.Changed:Connect(function()
        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
          dragging = false
        end
      end)
    end
  end)
  frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragInput = input
    end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
      local delta = input.Position - dragStart
      frame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPos.X.Scale,
        startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPos.Y.Scale,
        startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
      )
    end
  end)
end

  if not Gui or not Gui.Parent then return end
  local enhanced = 0

    if enhanced >= 70 then break end
    if obj:IsA("Frame") and obj.BackgroundTransparency < 0.8 and obj.AbsoluteSize.X > 110 and obj.AbsoluteSize.Y > 35 then
      if not obj:FindFirstChild("CalciumAuroraFinish") then
        local grad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
        grad.Name = "CalciumAuroraFinish"

        grad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
          ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)),
          ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(155,206,230))
        })
        grad.Parent = obj
        enhanced += 1
      end
    end
  end
end)
  pcall(function() if _G.CalciumProtectGui then _G.CalciumProtectGui(Gui) end end)

local _vp = (workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(800, 600)
local _isMobileVP = (_vp.X < 900) or (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled)
local _phoneW, _phoneH, _fit
if _isMobileVP then
  -- Mobile: fit phone to viewport, leave room for side action buttons
  local maxH = math.floor(_vp.Y * 0.84)
  local maxW = math.floor(_vp.X * 0.62) -- more width so row labels aren't crushed
  maxW = math.clamp(maxW, 250, 340)
  maxH = math.clamp(maxH, 420, 720)
  local aspect = 9 / 19.5
  _phoneW = maxW
  _phoneH = math.floor(_phoneW / aspect)
  if _phoneH > maxH then
    _phoneH = maxH
    _phoneW = math.floor(_phoneH * aspect)
  end
  -- Design width is 300; never let UI scale go wild on tiny screens
  _fit = math.clamp(_phoneW / 300, 0.72, 1.05)
else
  -- PC: larger phone chrome so UI is readable (was 300x640, felt tiny)
  local _baseW, _baseH = 380, 760
  _fit = math.min(1.12, (_vp.X * 0.55) / (_baseW + 16), (_vp.Y * 0.88) / (_baseH + 16))
  _fit = math.clamp(_fit, 0.9, 1.12)
  _phoneW = math.floor(_baseW * _fit)
  _phoneH = math.floor(_baseH * _fit)
end
local FULL_MAIN_SIZE = UDim2.new(0, _phoneW, 0, _phoneH)
_G._CalciumPhoneInnerSize = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
_G._CalciumPhoneW = _phoneW
_G._CalciumPhoneH = _phoneH
_G._CalciumPhoneFit = _fit
-- Master UI scale for rows / text / status chrome (device-perfect)
local _uiS = _fit
_G._CalciumUIS = _uiS
local function _S(n) return math.max(1, math.floor((tonumber(n) or 0) * _uiS + 0.5)) end
_G._CalciumS = _S
_G.CalciumIsMobile = _isMobileVP and true or false

-- COOL PHONE FX (screen + subtle ambient)
-- ============================================================
pcall(function()
  -- soft color wash over wallpaper
  local ambient = Instance.new("Frame")
  ambient.Name = "ScreenAmbient"
  ambient.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
  ambient.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 50, 15)
  ambient.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
  ambient.BorderSizePixel = 0
  ambient.ZIndex = 4
  ambient.Parent = Main
  local ag = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  ag.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 40)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(30, 20, 60)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 180)),
  })
  ag.Rotation = 130
  ag.Parent = ambient
  task.spawn(function()
    while ambient and ambient.Parent do
      ag.Rotation = (ag.Rotation + 0.35) % 360
      task.wait(0.08)
    end
  end)

  -- vignette edges (depth)
  local vig = Instance.new("Frame")
  vig.Name = "Vignette"
  vig.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
  vig.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  vig.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  vig.BorderSizePixel = 0
  vig.ZIndex = 5
  vig.Parent = Main
  local vg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  vg.Rotation = 90
  vg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, 1),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, 1),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.6),
  })
  vg.Parent = vig

  -- top glass highlight
  local glass = Instance.new("Frame")
  glass.Name = "GlassShine"
  glass.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 90)
  glass.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  glass.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 255)
  glass.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
  glass.BorderSizePixel = 0
  glass.ZIndex = 5
  glass.Parent = Main
  local gg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  gg.Rotation = 90
  gg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.35),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, 0.85),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
  })
  gg.Parent = glass

  -- rim light border (inner)
  local rim = Instance.new("Frame")
  rim.Name = "InnerRim"
  rim.Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6)
  rim.Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, 3)
  rim.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  rim.BorderSizePixel = 0
  rim.ZIndex = 6
  rim.Parent = Main
  local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 155, 70)
  rs.Thickness = 1.2
  rs.Transparency = 0.55
  rs.Parent = rim
  Instance.new("UICorner", rim).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 40)
  task.spawn(function()
    local t0 = tick()
    while rim and rim.Parent do
      local t = tick() - t0
      rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
        90 + math.floor(math.sin(t * 1.1) * 40 + 40),
        140 + math.floor(math.cos(t * 0.9) * 50 + 40),
        220 + math.floor(math.sin(t * 1.4) * 25 + 20)
      )
      rs.Transparency = 0.45 + math.sin(t * 1.6) * 0.15
      task.wait(0.06)
    end
  end)
end)

pcall(function()
  -- scanning light sweep across the glass
  local scan = Instance.new("Frame")
  scan.Name = "ScanLine"
  scan.Size = UDim2.new(1.15, 0, 0, 48)
  scan.Position = UDim2.new(-0.08, 0, -0.2, 0)
  scan.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 100)
  scan.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
  scan.BorderSizePixel = 0
  scan.ZIndex = 3
  scan.Parent = Main
  local sg = Instance.new("UIGradient", scan)
  sg.Rotation = 90
  sg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.45),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
  })
  task.spawn(function()
    while scan and scan.Parent do
      scan.Position = UDim2.new(-0.08, 0, -0.25, 0)
      TweenService:Create(scan, TweenInfo.new(2.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
        Position = UDim2.new(-0.08, 0, 1.15, 0)
      }):Play()
      task.wait(2.8)
    end
  end)

  -- floating sparkles + comets (inside only)
  for i = 1, 38 do
    local sp = Instance.new("Frame")
    local sz = 1 + (i % 3)
    sp.Name = "Spark" .. i
    sp.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)
    sp.Position = UDim2.new(math.random() * 0.9 + 0.05, 0, math.random() * 0.9 + 0.05, 0)
    sp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150 + (i % 70), 210, 255)
    sp.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + math.random() * 0.4
    sp.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sp.ZIndex = 2
    sp.Parent = Main
    Instance.new("UICorner", sp).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    task.spawn(function()
      local speed = 0.0008 + (i % 5) * 0.00035
      while sp and sp.Parent do
        local y = sp.Position.Y.Scale - speed
        local x = sp.Position.X.Scale + math.sin(tick() * 1.4 + i) * 0.0007
        if y < -0.02 then
          y = 1.05
          x = math.random() * 0.9 + 0.05
          if math.random() < 0.18 then
            pcall(function()
              local streak = Instance.new("Frame")
              streak.Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 0, 22)
              streak.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, y, 0)
              streak.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 230, 255)
              streak.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
              streak.BorderSizePixel = 0
              streak.Rotation = 20 + math.random(0, 25)
              streak.ZIndex = 3
              streak.Parent = Main
              Instance.new("UICorner", streak).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
              TweenService:Create(streak, TweenInfo.new(0.5), {
                Position = UDim2.new(x + 0.1, 0, y - 0.25, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1
              }):Play()
              task.delay(0.55, function() if streak then streak:Destroy() end end)
            end)
          end
        end
        sp.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(x, 0, 1), 0, y, 0)
        sp.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + math.abs(math.sin(tick() * 2.5 + i)) * 0.5
        task.wait(0.032)
      end
    end)
  end

  -- solid rim color pulse (no transparency haze)
  pcall(function()
    local rim = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if not rim then
      rim = Instance.new("UIStroke")
      rim.Parent = Main
    end
    rim.Transparency = 0
    rim.Thickness = 2
    task.spawn(function()
      local t0 = tick()
      while rim and rim.Parent do
        local t = tick() - t0
        rim.Color = Color3.fromRGB(
          60 + math.floor(math.sin(t * 1.1) * 40 + 40),
          120 + math.floor(math.cos(t * 0.85) * 35 + 35),
          200
        )
        rim.Transparency = 0
        task.wait(0.06)
      end
    end)
  end)

  -- home-screen only: soft particle ring that expands slowly from center
  task.spawn(function()
    while Main and Main.Parent do
      if _G._CalciumPhoneOnHome then
        local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
        ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        ring.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.48, 0)
        ring.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
        ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        ring.ZIndex = 2
        ring.Parent = Main
        Instance.new("UICorner", ring).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke", ring)
        rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 70)
        rs.Thickness = 1.5
        rs.Transparency = 0.4
        TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
          Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 220)
        }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(rs, TweenInfo.new(1.8), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
        task.delay(1.85, function() if ring then ring:Destroy() end end)
      end
      task.wait(2.4)
    end
  end)
end)

      islandStroke.Transparency = 0.5
      local busy = false
      local tag = nil
      pcall(function()
        local tags = {}
        if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn or _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On or (_G.CalciumNormalAimbot and _G.CalciumNormalAimbot.conn) then
          tags[#tags + 1] = "Aimbot"
        end
        if _G.CalciumTPBatOn == true then
          tags[#tags + 1] = "TP Bat"
        end
        local sm = tostring(_G.CalciumCurrentSpeedMode or _G.CalciumSpeedMode or "")
        if sm == "Carry" or sm == "Lagger" or sm == "Lagger Carry" then
          tags[#tags + 1] = sm
        end
        if #tags > 0 then

          tag = tags[(math.floor(t * 0.7) % #tags) + 1]
        end
      end)
      if busy then
        _G._CalciumIslandSetActivity(true, tag)
        activityLed.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
      else
        _G._CalciumIslandSetActivity(false)
        activityLed.BackgroundTransparency = 0
      end
      task.wait(waitSec)
    end
  end)

  -- home indicator
  local home = Instance.new("Frame")
  home.Name = "HomeIndicator"
  home.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
  home.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8)
  home.Size = UDim2.new(0, 134, 0, 5)
  home.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  home.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
  home.BorderSizePixel = 0
  home.ZIndex = 40
  home.Parent = Main
  corner(home, 4)

  -- PhoneRim removed (black corner lines)

  -- live clock + simulated battery drain
  -- Real device battery when the executor/platform exposes it
  local function readDeviceBattery()
    local pct = nil
    pcall(function()
      if type(getbattery) == "function" then pct = tonumber(getbattery()) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      if pct == nil and type(get_battery) == "function" then pct = tonumber(get_battery()) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      if pct == nil and type(getbatterypercent) == "function" then pct = tonumber(getbatterypercent()) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      if pct == nil and _G.getbattery then pct = tonumber(_G.getbattery()) end
    end)
    -- some executors put it on syn
    pcall(function()
      if pct == nil and syn and type(syn.getbattery) == "function" then pct = tonumber(syn.getbattery()) end
    end)
    if type(pct) == "number" then
      if pct <= 1 and pct > 0 then pct = pct * 100 end -- 0-1 scale
      return math.clamp(math.floor(pct + 0.5), 0, 100)
    end
    return nil
  end
  local realBat = readDeviceBattery()
  local hasRealBattery = realBat ~= nil
  _G._CalciumPhoneBattery = realBat or (tonumber(_G._CalciumPhoneBattery) or 100)
  local function paintBat()
    local live = readDeviceBattery()
    if live ~= nil then
      hasRealBattery = true
      _G._CalciumPhoneBattery = live
    end
    local pct = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(_G._CalciumPhoneBattery) or 100), 0, 100)
    batPct.Text = tostring(pct) .. "%"
    batFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(pct / 100, 0.08, 1), -3, 1, -3)
    if pct <= 15 then
      batFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70)
    elseif pct <= 30 then
      batFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60)
    else
      batFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
    end
  end
  paintBat()
  task.spawn(function()
    while status and status.Parent do
      local t = os.date("*t")
      local h, m = t.hour, t.min
      local h12 = h % 12
      if h12 == 0 then h12 = 12 end
      timeLbl.Text = string.format("%d:%02d", h12, m)
      paintBat()
      task.wait(1)
    end
  end)
  -- only fake-drain if device has no battery API (desktop)
  task.spawn(function()
    while status and status.Parent do
      task.wait(60)
      if not hasRealBattery and readDeviceBattery() == nil then
        -- desktop: keep full / stable
        _G._CalciumPhoneBattery = 100
      end
      paintBat()
    end
  end)
end

-- live time + battery on island (phone vs laptop)

task.spawn(function()
  while true do
    pcall(function()
      local t = os.date("*t")
      local h, m = t.hour or 0, t.min or 0
      local isPhone = false
      pcall(function()
        isPhone = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
      end)
      -- 12h on phone, 24h on laptop/desktop
      if isPhone then
        local h12 = h % 12
        if h12 == 0 then h12 = 12 end
        MiniTimeLbl.Text = string.format("%d:%02d", h12, m)
      else
        MiniTimeLbl.Text = string.format("%02d:%02d", h, m)
      end
      -- never truncate / always full clock string
      if MiniTimeLbl then MiniTimeLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None end
      local pct = math.clamp(math.floor((_G._CalciumPhoneBattery or 80) + 0.5), 1, 100)
      if isPhone then
        MiniBatLbl.Text = tostring(pct) .. "%"
      else
        MiniBatLbl.Text = tostring(pct) .. "%" -- charge readout
      end
      if pct <= 20 then
        MiniBatLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
      elseif pct <= 40 then
        MiniBatLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 190, 80)
      else
        MiniBatLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 230, 150)
      end
    end)
    task.wait(1)
    if math.random() < 0.08 then
      _G._CalciumPhoneBattery = math.max(5, (_G._CalciumPhoneBattery or 80) - 0.4)
    end
  end
end)

do
  local miniDragging = false
  local miniDragStart = nil
  local miniStartPos = nil
  local miniMoved = false
  local miniHeldInput = nil
  local DRAG_DEADZONE = 6
  MiniButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      miniDragging = true
      miniMoved = false
      miniHeldInput = input
      miniDragStart = input.Position
      miniStartPos = MiniFrame.Position
    end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not miniDragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    if not miniDragStart or not miniStartPos then return end
    local delta = input.Position - miniDragStart
    if math.abs(delta.X) > DRAG_DEADZONE or math.abs(delta.Y) > DRAG_DEADZONE then
      miniMoved = true
    end
    MiniFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
      miniStartPos.X.Scale,
      miniStartPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
      miniStartPos.Y.Scale,
      miniStartPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
  end)
  UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input ~= miniHeldInput then return end
    local wasDrag = miniMoved
    miniDragging = false
    miniHeldInput = nil
    miniDragStart = nil
    miniStartPos = nil
    if wasDrag then
      return
    end
    if _G.CalciumHubOpen then
      pcall(playClick)
      -- NIENTE salvataggio della posizione qui: CalciumHubOpen sposta
      -- subito Main FUORI schermo per farla rientrare animata. Leggere
      -- Main.Position in questo istante significa salvare la posizione
      -- fuori schermo, e alla sessione dopo la hub si riapriva fuori dal
      -- monitor: era quello il bug della "GUI sparita". La posizione di
      -- riposo resta gia' in savedMainPositionTable, non va toccata.
      _G.CalciumHubOpen()
    else
      Main.Visible = true
      MiniFrame.Visible = false
      Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
      savedMainPositionTable = udim2ToTable((PhoneChassis and PhoneChassis.Position) or Main.Position)
    end
  end)
end
-- >>> HUB OPEN/CLOSE ANIMATION BEGIN
-- La finestra esce ed entra dal bordo dello schermo a cui e' piu' vicina:
-- a sinistra esce a sinistra, a destra a destra, in alto verso l'alto, in
-- basso verso il basso. Uscita con accelerazione (Quint In) e leggera
-- rimpicciolita + inclinazione; entrata con frenata elastica (Back Out).
--
-- NOTA LOCAL: nessun local a livello di chunk, il main e' a ridosso del
-- limite di 200. Tutto su _G, e Main/MiniFrame/FULL_MAIN_SIZE arrivano
-- come upvalue.
_G._CalciumHubAnimating = false
_G._CalciumHubAnimToken = 0

-- Centro della finestra ricavato dalla Position (AnchorPoint e' 0.5, 0.5),
-- non da AbsolutePosition: cosi' e' esatto anche nel frame in cui la
-- finestra viene resa visibile.
_G._CalciumHubEdgeFor = function(pos)
  local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
  local vp  = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
  if vp.X < 1 or vp.Y < 1 then vp = Vector2.new(1920, 1080) end
  local cx = pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset
  local cy = pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset
  -- distanze normalizzate: cosi' il confronto regge anche su schermi molto
  -- piu' larghi che alti
  local dLeft, dTop = cx / vp.X, cy / vp.Y
  local dRight, dBottom = 1 - dLeft, 1 - dTop
  local best, dir = dLeft, "Left"
  if dRight  < best then best, dir = dRight,  "Right"  end
  if dTop    < best then best, dir = dTop,    "Top"    end
  if dBottom < best then best, dir = dBottom, "Bottom" end
  return dir
end
-- Posizione fuori schermo sul bordo scelto, partendo da una Position data.
_G._CalciumHubOffscreen = function(pos, dir)
  local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
  local vp  = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
  if vp.X < 1 or vp.Y < 1 then vp = Vector2.new(1920, 1080) end
  local hostSz = (PhoneChassis and PhoneChassis.AbsoluteSize) or Main.AbsoluteSize
  local sw = (hostSz.X > 1) and hostSz.X or 300
  local sh = (hostSz.Y > 1) and hostSz.Y or 640
  local cx = pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset
  local cy = pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset
  local dx, dy = 0, 0
  if dir == "Left" then
    dx = -(cx + sw * 0.8)
  elseif dir == "Right" then
    dx = (vp.X - cx) + sw * 0.8
  elseif dir == "Top" then
    dy = -(cy + sh * 0.8)
  else
    dy = (vp.Y - cy) + sh * 0.8
  end
  return UDim2.new(pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset + dx, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset + dy)
end
-- Inclinazione in uscita: segue il verso della fuga, da' peso al movimento
_G._CalciumHubTilt = function(dir)
  if dir == "Left"  then return -7 end
  if dir == "Right" then return  7 end
  if dir == "Top"   then return -4 end
  return 4
end
-- Pop del mini popup (comparsa/sparizione)
_G._CalciumMiniPop = function(show)
  if not MiniFrame then return end
  local full = UDim2.new(0, 148, 0, 38)
  MiniFrame.Position = MINI_DEFAULT_POSITION or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 10)
  if show then
    MiniFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
    MiniFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    MiniFrame.Visible = true
    TweenService:Create(MiniFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
      { Size = full, BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play()
  else
    TweenService:Create(MiniFrame,
      TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
      { Size = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8), BackgroundTransparency = 0.6 }):Play()
    task.delay(0.24, function()
      MiniFrame.Visible = false
      MiniFrame.Size = full
      MiniFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    end)
  end
end
-- POSIZIONE DI RIPOSO.
-- Prima sia la chiusura sia l'apertura facevano "restPos = Main.Position".
-- Va bene solo se la finestra e' ferma: se spammi chiudi/apri, la seconda
-- chiamata legge la Position mentre il tween e' gia' a meta' strada FUORI
-- schermo e se la porta a casa come posizione di riposo. Al giro dopo
-- l'offset fuori schermo viene calcolato a partire da quella, e cosi' via:
-- ogni spam raddoppia la distanza, finche' la hub non si pianta a
-- coordinate negative enormi e non rientra piu'.
-- Qui la posizione di riposo NON si legge mai da Main.Position: e' un valore
-- a se', scritto solo quando l'utente trascina la finestra (l'handler su
-- Position, che durante l'animazione si tira fuori). L'animazione quindi non
-- puo' piu' inquinarla, per quanto la si spammi.
-- In piu' la posizione viene riportata dentro lo schermo: se per qualunque
-- motivo fosse gia' finita fuori, al primo uso torna raggiungibile.
_G._CalciumHubRest = function()
  local p = _G._CalciumHubRestPos or (PhoneChassis and PhoneChassis.Position) or Main.Position
  local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
  local vp  = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
  if vp.X < 1 or vp.Y < 1 then vp = Vector2.new(1920, 1080) end
  local hostSz = (PhoneChassis and PhoneChassis.AbsoluteSize) or Main.AbsoluteSize
  local sw = (hostSz.X > 1) and hostSz.X or 300
  local sh = (hostSz.Y > 1) and hostSz.Y or 640
  local cx = p.X.Scale * vp.X + p.X.Offset
  local cy = p.Y.Scale * vp.Y + p.Y.Offset
  -- almeno un quarto di finestra dentro lo schermo, su ogni lato
  local ncx = math.clamp(cx, sw * 0.25, math.max(vp.X - sw * 0.25, sw * 0.25))
  local ncy = math.clamp(cy, sh * 0.15, math.max(vp.Y - sh * 0.15, sh * 0.15))
  if math.abs(ncx - cx) > 0.5 or math.abs(ncy - cy) > 0.5 then
    p = UDim2.new(p.X.Scale, p.X.Offset + (ncx - cx), p.Y.Scale, p.Y.Offset + (ncy - cy))
    _G._CalciumHubRestPos = p
    savedMainPositionTable = udim2ToTable(p)
  end
  return p
end
-- CHIUSURA: scivola fuori dal bordo piu' vicino
_G.CalciumHubClose = function(showMini)
  _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized = true
  local host = PhoneChassis or Main
  if host and host.Visible == false then
    if showMini then _G._CalciumMiniPop(true) end
    return
  end
  _G._CalciumHubAnimToken = (_G._CalciumHubAnimToken or 0) + 1
  local token = _G._CalciumHubAnimToken
  _G._CalciumHubAnimating = true

  local restPos = _G._CalciumHubRest()
  -- target: top-center dynamic island slot
  local islandPos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8)

  pcall(function()
    Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
    Main.Rotation = 0
    Main.Visible = true
  end)

  -- shrink + move host into the island point
  local shrink = TweenService:Create(host,
    TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
    { Position = islandPos, Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 36) })
  shrink:Play()
  pcall(function()
    if Main then
      TweenService:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 28),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
      }):Play()
    end
  end)

  if showMini then
    task.delay(0.28, function()
      if token ~= _G._CalciumHubAnimToken then return end
      _G._CalciumMiniPop(true)
    end)
  end
  task.delay(0.48, function()
    if token ~= _G._CalciumHubAnimToken then return end
    host.Visible = false
    host.Position = restPos
    pcall(function()
      if PhoneChassis then
        local w = _G._CalciumPhoneW or 300
        local h = _G._CalciumPhoneH or 640
        PhoneChassis.Size = (_G.CalciumGuiType == "Normal" and _G.CalciumNormalSize and _G.CalciumNormalSize()) or UDim2.new(0, w + 12, 0, h + 12)
      end
      Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
      Main.Rotation = 0
      Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0
      Main.Visible = true
    end)
    _G._CalciumHubRestPos = restPos
    _G._CalciumHubAnimating = false
  end)
end
-- APERTURA: rientra dallo stesso bordo con frenata elastica
_G.CalciumHubOpen = function()
  _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized = false
  if _G.CalciumIdleWake then _G.CalciumIdleWake() end
  _G._CalciumHubAnimToken = (_G._CalciumHubAnimToken or 0) + 1
  local token = _G._CalciumHubAnimToken
  _G._CalciumMiniPop(false)

  local host = PhoneChassis or Main
  local restPos = _G._CalciumHubRest()
  local islandPos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8)

  _G._CalciumHubAnimating = true
  local w = _G._CalciumPhoneW or 300
  local h = _G._CalciumPhoneH or 640
  local fullHost = (_G.CalciumGuiType == "Normal" and _G.CalciumNormalSize and _G.CalciumNormalSize()) or UDim2.new(0, w + 12, 0, h + 12)

  pcall(function()
    Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 28)
    Main.Rotation = 0
    Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    Main.Visible = true
  end)
  host.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 36)
  host.Position = islandPos
  host.Visible = true
  pcall(function() if Gui then Gui.Enabled = true end end)

  -- expand out of the island into full phone
  TweenService:Create(host,
    TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
    { Position = restPos, Size = fullHost }):Play()
  pcall(function()
    TweenService:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE,
      BackgroundTransparency = 0
    }):Play()
  end)

  task.delay(0.62, function()
    if token ~= _G._CalciumHubAnimToken then return end
    host.Position = restPos
    host.Size = fullHost
    pcall(function()
      Main.Rotation = 0
      Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
      Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0
      Main.Visible = true
    end)
    _G._CalciumHubRestPos = restPos
    _G._CalciumHubAnimating = false
  end)
end
-- <<< HUB OPEN/CLOSE ANIMATION END
task.defer(function()
  pcall(function()
    if Gui then Gui.Enabled = true end
    local host = PhoneChassis or Main
    if host then
      host.Visible = true
      local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
      local vp = cam and cam.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
      local pos, sz = host.AbsolutePosition, host.AbsoluteSize
      if sz.X < 10 or pos.X + sz.X < 8 or pos.Y + sz.Y < 8 or pos.X > vp.X or pos.Y > vp.Y then
        host.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      end
    end
    if Main then
      Main.Visible = true
      Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE
      Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    end
    if MiniFrame and _introEnabled == false then MiniFrame.Visible = false end
  end)
end)


-- >>> IDLE FADE BEGIN
-- 5 secondi senza toccare la hub -> tutto il contenuto va a 0.7 di
-- trasparenza. Al primo contatto torna com'era. Lo sfondo non si tocca.
--
-- COME, e perche' cosi': i tentativi precedenti scrivevano la trasparenza su
-- ogni singolo elemento, cioe' sulle STESSE proprieta' che usa l'effetto
-- hover delle righe. I due si pestavano i piedi e le righe restavano
-- inchiodate sullo stato di hover. Qui invece il contenuto viene messo
-- dentro un CanvasGroup e si anima solo la sua GroupTransparency: una
-- proprieta' sola, sul contenitore. Nessuna proprieta' dei figli viene mai
-- toccata, quindi l'hover continua a funzionare per conto suo e il
-- ripristino e' esatto per definizione.
--
-- NOTA LOCAL: niente local a livello di chunk, il main e' al limite.
_G._CalciumIdle = {
  delay    = 5,      -- secondi di inattivita'
  value    = 0.55,   -- screen dim (not fully gone)
  fadeOut  = 0.45,   -- soft dim
  fadeIn   = 0.12,   -- snap awake
  last     = os.clock(),
  faded    = false,
  group    = nil,
  started  = false,
}

-- Cosa NON va spostato dentro il gruppo: lo sfondo e i modificatori di
-- layout, che devono restare figli diretti di Main.
_G._CalciumIdleStays = function(ch)
  if ch.Name == "CustomBackground" then return true end
  -- phone chrome stays sharp while content dims
  if ch.Name == "PhoneStatusBar" or ch.Name == "Notch" or ch.Name == "IslandGlow"
     or ch.Name == "HomeIndicator" or ch.Name == "PhoneRim" or ch.Name == "ScanLine" then
    return true
  end
  if ch:IsA("UICorner") or ch:IsA("UIStroke") or ch:IsA("UIScale")
     or ch:IsA("UIPadding") or ch:IsA("UIListLayout") or ch:IsA("UIGradient")
     or ch:IsA("UIAspectRatioConstraint") or ch:IsA("UISizeConstraint") then
    return true
  end
  return false
end
_G._CalciumIdleEnsureGroup = function()
  local S = _G._CalciumIdle
  if S.group and S.group.Parent then return S.group end

  local ok, g = pcall(function() return Instance.new("CanvasGroup") end)
  if not ok or not g then return nil end   -- client vecchio: si rinuncia, meglio che rompere

  g.Name = "CalciumFadeGroup"
  g.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  g.BorderSizePixel = 0
  g.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  g.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  g.ZIndex = 2                -- sopra lo sfondo (ZIndex 1), sotto niente
  g.GroupTransparency = 0
  g.Active = false            -- non intercetta input: il drag di Main resta com'e'
  g.Parent = Main

  for _, ch in ipairs(Main:GetChildren()) do
    if ch ~= g and not _G._CalciumIdleStays(ch) then
      ch.Parent = g
    end
  end
  -- Se qualcosa viene creato dopo e appeso a Main, entra anche lui.
  Main.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
    if ch == g or _G._CalciumIdleStays(ch) then return end
    task.defer(function()
      if ch.Parent == Main then ch.Parent = g end
    end)
  end)

  S.group = g
  return g
end
_G._CalciumIdleSet = function(fade)
  local S = _G._CalciumIdle
  local g = _G._CalciumIdleEnsureGroup()
  if not g then return end
  S.faded = fade and true or false
  TweenService:Create(g,
    TweenInfo.new(fade and S.fadeOut or S.fadeIn,
                  Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
                  fade and Enum.EasingDirection.Out or Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
    { GroupTransparency = fade and S.value or 0 }):Play()
end
_G.CalciumIdleWake = function()
  local S = _G._CalciumIdle
  S.last = os.clock()
  if S.faded then _G._CalciumIdleSet(false) end
end
_G.CalciumIdleStart = function()
  local S = _G._CalciumIdle
  if S.started then return end
  S.started = true

  -- mouse e touch sulla finestra
  Main.InputBegan:Connect(_G.CalciumIdleWake)
  Main.InputChanged:Connect(_G.CalciumIdleWake)
  Main.MouseEnter:Connect(_G.CalciumIdleWake)

  -- controller: non ha puntatore, si sveglia su qualsiasi input gamepad
  UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    local t = input.UserInputType
    if t == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad2
       or t == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad3 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Gamepad4 then
      _G.CalciumIdleWake()
    end
  end)

  task.spawn(function()
    while true do
      task.wait(0.25)
      if Main.Visible and not _G._CalciumHubAnimating then
        if not S.faded and (os.clock() - S.last) >= S.delay then
          _G._CalciumIdleSet(true)
        end
      elseif S.faded then
        _G._CalciumIdleSet(false)
        S.last = os.clock()
      end
    end
  end)
end
task.defer(function()
  pcall(_G.CalciumIdleStart)
end)
-- <<< IDLE FADE END

STEAL_BAR_ONLY_BG = "121980779513853" -- reserved for steal bar only, not gallery
-- Meowl wallpaper (bundled image via getcustomasset)
_G._CalciumMeowlAsset = nil
pcall(function()
  local b64 = ""
  local raw = nil
  if type(crypt) == "table" and crypt.base64decode then
    raw = crypt.base64decode(b64)
  elseif type(base64_decode) == "function" then
    raw = base64_decode(b64)
  elseif type(syn) == "table" and syn.crypt and syn.crypt.base64 and syn.crypt.base64.decode then
    raw = syn.crypt.base64.decode(b64)
  else
    -- minimal base64 decode
    local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    raw = b64:gsub("[^" .. b .. "=]", "")
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #raw, 4 do
      local a = b:find(raw:sub(i,i), 1, true) or 1
      local c2 = b:find(raw:sub(i+1,i+1), 1, true) or 1
      local c3 = b:find(raw:sub(i+2,i+2), 1, true) or 1
      local c4 = b:find(raw:sub(i+3,i+3), 1, true) or 1
      a, c2, c3, c4 = a - 1, c2 - 1, c3 - 1, c4 - 1
      local n = a * 262144 + c2 * 4096 + c3 * 64 + c4
      local x1 = math.floor(n / 65536) % 256
      local x2 = math.floor(n / 256) % 256
      local x3 = n % 256
      out[#out+1] = string.char(x1)
      if raw:sub(i+2,i+2) ~= "=" then out[#out+1] = string.char(x2) end
      if raw:sub(i+3,i+3) ~= "=" then out[#out+1] = string.char(x3) end
    end
    raw = table.concat(out)
  end
  if type(raw) == "string" and #raw > 100 then
    local fname = "calcium_meowl_bg.jpg"
    if writefile then writefile(fname, raw) end
    if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
      _G._CalciumMeowlAsset = getcustomasset(fname)
    elseif type(getcustomasset) == "nil" and type(getsynasset) == "function" then
      _G._CalciumMeowlAsset = getsynasset(fname)
    end
  end
end)


-- Winged potato / nugget wallpaper
_G._CalciumPotatoAsset = nil
pcall(function()
  local b64 = ""
  local raw = nil
  if type(crypt) == "table" and crypt.base64decode then
    raw = crypt.base64decode(b64)
  elseif type(base64_decode) == "function" then
    raw = base64_decode(b64)
  else
    local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
    local data = b64:gsub("[^"..b.."=]", "")
    local out = {}
    for i = 1, #data, 4 do
      local function idx(ch)
        local p = b:find(ch, 1, true)
        return p and (p - 1) or 0
      end
      local n = idx(data:sub(i,i))*262144 + idx(data:sub(i+1,i+1))*4096 + idx(data:sub(i+2,i+2))*64 + idx(data:sub(i+3,i+3))
      out[#out+1] = string.char(math.floor(n/65536)%256)
      if data:sub(i+2,i+2) ~= "=" then out[#out+1] = string.char(math.floor(n/256)%256) end
      if data:sub(i+3,i+3) ~= "=" then out[#out+1] = string.char(n%256) end
    end
    raw = table.concat(out)
  end
  if type(raw) == "string" and #raw > 50 then
    local fname = "calcium_potato_bg.jpg"
    if writefile then writefile(fname, raw) end
    if type(getcustomasset) == "function" then
      _G._CalciumPotatoAsset = getcustomasset(fname)
    elseif type(getsynasset) == "function" then
      _G._CalciumPotatoAsset = getsynasset(fname)
    end
  end
end)

function _G.CalciumNextBackground()
  local n = #(BackgroundIDs or {})
  if n < 1 then return end
  local i = (tonumber(currentBackground) or 1) + 1
  if i > n then i = 1 end
  applyBackground(i)
  if showActionNotification then pcall(function() showActionNotification("BG " .. tostring(i) .. "/" .. tostring(n)) end) end
end
function _G.CalciumPrevBackground()
  local n = #(BackgroundIDs or {})
  if n < 1 then return end
  local i = (tonumber(currentBackground) or 1) - 1
  if i < 1 then i = n end
  applyBackground(i)
  if showActionNotification then pcall(function() showActionNotification("BG " .. tostring(i) .. "/" .. tostring(n)) end) end
end
function applyBackground(index)
  customBgSelected = nil  -- deseleziona custom quando si sceglie un built-in
  currentBackground = (tonumber(index) and tonumber(index) >= 1) and tonumber(index) or 1
  local id = BackgroundIDs[currentBackground]
  if id then
    local img = id
    if id == "MEOWL_CUSTOM" then
      img = _G._CalciumMeowlAsset or ""
      pcall(function()
        if (not img or img == "") and type(getcustomasset) == "function" and isfile and isfile("calcium_meowl_bg.jpg") then
          _G._CalciumMeowlAsset = getcustomasset("calcium_meowl_bg.jpg")
          img = _G._CalciumMeowlAsset
        end
      end)
      if not img or img == "" then img = "rbxassetid://129085053275432" end
    elseif id == "POTATO_CUSTOM" then
      img = _G._CalciumPotatoAsset or ""
      pcall(function()
        if (not img or img == "") and type(getcustomasset) == "function" and isfile and isfile("calcium_potato_bg.jpg") then
          _G._CalciumPotatoAsset = getcustomasset("calcium_potato_bg.jpg")
          img = _G._CalciumPotatoAsset
        end
      end)
      if not img or img == "" then img = "rbxassetid://129085053275432" end
    else
      img = "rbxassetid://" .. id
    end
    BgImage.Image = img
    BgImage.Visible = true
    BgImage.ImageTransparency = 0.08
    BgImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    BgImage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 8, 14)
    BgImage.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    MiniBg.Image = img
    MiniBg.ImageTransparency = 0.08
    MiniBg.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    saveCalciumConfig()
    if _G.CalciumCustomBgPreviewUpdate then pcall(_G.CalciumCustomBgPreviewUpdate) end
    _G._CalciumBgIndex = currentBackground
    _G._CalciumBgCustom = false
    if _G._CalciumApplyAccent then pcall(_G._CalciumApplyAccent) end
    -- soft color wash from palette
    pcall(function()
      local p = _G._CalciumBgPalette and _G._CalciumBgPalette()
      if p and BgImage then
        BgImage.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(
          0.85 + p[2].R * 0.15,
          0.85 + p[2].G * 0.15,
          0.85 + p[2].B * 0.15
        )
      end
    end)
    return "Image " .. tostring(currentBackground)
  end
  currentBackground = 1
  local fallback = BackgroundIDs[1]
  if fallback then
    BgImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. fallback
    BgImage.Visible = true
    MiniBg.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. fallback
  end
  saveCalciumConfig()
  if _G.CalciumCustomBgPreviewUpdate then pcall(_G.CalciumCustomBgPreviewUpdate) end
  _G._CalciumBgIndex = currentBackground
  _G._CalciumBgCustom = false
  if _G._CalciumApplyAccent then pcall(_G._CalciumApplyAccent) end
  return "Image 1"
end
function applyCustomBackground(assetId)
  customBgSelected = assetId
  currentBackground = 0  -- indica che il custom è selezionato
  BgImage.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. assetId
  BgImage.Visible = true
  MiniBg.Image = "rbxassetid://" .. assetId
  saveCalciumConfig()
  if _G.CalciumCustomBgPreviewUpdate then pcall(_G.CalciumCustomBgPreviewUpdate) end
  _G._CalciumBgIndex = 0
  _G._CalciumBgCustom = true
  if _G._CalciumApplyAccent then pcall(_G._CalciumApplyAccent) end
  -- Deseleziona i 4 built-in buttons
  if updateBackgroundButtons then pcall(updateBackgroundButtons) end
end
-- Custom background UI removed; ignore saved custom selection
if false and customBgSelected and customBgSelected ~= "" then
  applyCustomBackground(customBgSelected)
else
  applyBackground(currentBackground)
end
_G._CalciumBgIndex = currentBackground
_G._CalciumBgCustom = (customBgSelected ~= nil and customBgSelected ~= "")
if _G._CalciumApplyAccent then pcall(_G._CalciumApplyAccent) end

-- Minimize / restore
do
  local lastMinClick = 0
  local function doMinimize()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastMinClick < 0.25 then return end
    lastMinClick = now
    if _G._CalciumHubAnimating then return end
    local host = PhoneChassis or Main
    local open = host and host.Visible ~= false and not (_G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized == true)
    if open then
      if _G.CalciumHubClose then
        _G.CalciumHubClose(true)
      else
        host.Visible = false
        if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = true end
        _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized = true
      end
    else
      if _G.CalciumHubOpen then
        _G.CalciumHubOpen()
      else
        host.Visible = true
        if Main then Main.Visible = true; Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0) end
        if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = false end
        _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized = false
      end
    end
  end
  pcall(function() Close.Activated:Connect(doMinimize) end)
  pcall(function() Close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doMinimize) end)
end

  if setLockGuiVisual then pcall(setLockGuiVisual, _G.CalciumGuiLocked == true) end
end

local function setHomePage(idx, animate)
  idx = math.clamp(idx, 1, _homePageCount)
  _homePageIndex = idx
  for i = 1, _homePageCount do
    local page = homePages:FindFirstChild("Page" .. i)
    if page then
      local goal = UDim2.new(i - idx, 0, 0, 0)
      if animate then
        TweenService:Create(page, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = goal }):Play()
      else
        page.Position = goal
      end
    end
  end
  for i, dot in ipairs(_pageDotButtons) do
    if dot and dot.Parent then
      local on = (i == idx)
      -- dark dots so they show on bright background images
      if on then
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 172, 96)
        dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22, 8)
      else
        dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(195, 201, 214)
        dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
        dot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8)
      end
    end
  end
end

for i = 1, _homePageCount do
  -- Large invisible hitbox, visible dot centered inside
  local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
  hit.Name = "Dot" .. i
  hit.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28)
  hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  hit.Text = ""
  hit.AutoButtonColor = false
  hit.ZIndex = 21
  hit.Parent = pageDots
  local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
  dot.Name = "Visual"

  Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  hit.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

  end)
  _pageDotButtons[i] = dot
end
setHomePage(1, false)

-- swipe / drag to change page
do
  local dragging, startX, startPage = false, 0, 1
  Tabs.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
      dragging = true
      startX = input.Position.X
      startPage = _homePageIndex
    end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    local dx = input.Position.X - startX
    for i = 1, _homePageCount do
      local page = homePages:FindFirstChild("Page" .. i)
      if page then
        page.Position = UDim2.new(i - startPage, dx, 0, 0)
      end
    end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if not dragging then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
    dragging = false
    local dx = input.Position.X - startX
    if dx < -40 then
      setHomePage(startPage + 1, true)
    elseif dx > 40 then
      setHomePage(startPage - 1, true)
    else
      setHomePage(startPage, true)
    end
  end)
end

_G.CalciumHomeSetPage = setHomePage

function addPage(name)
  local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
  page.Name = name
  page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  page.BorderSizePixel = 0
  page.ScrollBarThickness = 3
  page.ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.35
  page.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 40)
  page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
  page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  page.ZIndex = 8
  page.Visible = false
  page.Parent = appBody
  local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
  layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
  layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
  layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
  layout.Parent = page
  local pagePadding = Instance.new("UIPadding")
  pagePadding.Name = "PagePad"
  do
    local S = _G._CalciumS or function(n) return n end
    local mobile = (_G.CalciumIsMobile == true)
    -- Extra bottom so last toggles clear home bar + MB pill on mobile
    pagePadding.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, mobile and math.clamp(S(56), 48, 72) or 20)
    pagePadding.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, S(4))
    pagePadding.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, S(2))
    pagePadding.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, S(2))
  end
  pagePadding.Parent = page
  pages[name] = page
  if _G._CalciumApplyPagePadding then _G._CalciumApplyPagePadding() end
  return page
end
-- >>> PAGE PADDING PER POSIZIONE TAB BEGIN
-- Il respiro sopra e sotto le righe dipende da dove stanno le tab:
--   Up     -> sopra ci sono le tab, sotto serve il margine
--   Bottom -> sotto ci sono le tab, sopra serve il margine
--   Left/Right -> le tab sono di lato, quindi serve sia sopra che sotto
-- Prima era fisso (solo 12 sotto per tutti) e su Left/Right l'ultima riga
-- finiva incollata al bordo inferiore.
_G._CalciumApplyPagePadding = function()
  local mode = _G._CalciumTabPosition or "Up"
  local top, bottom
  if mode == "Up" then
    top, bottom = 0, 12
  elseif mode == "Bottom" then
    top, bottom = 10, 0
  else
    -- Left/Right: stesso margine di Up sotto, piu' il pizzico d'aria sopra
    top, bottom = 10, 12
  end
  for _, page in pairs(pages) do
    local pad = page:FindFirstChild("PagePad")
    if pad then
      pad.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, top)
      pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bottom)
    end
  end
end
-- <<< PAGE PADDING PER POSIZIONE TAB END

function _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome(instant)
  _G._CalciumPhoneOnHome = true
  activeTab = nil
  if Tabs then Tabs.Visible = true end
  if homeHeader then homeHeader.Visible = true end
  if homeSub then homeSub.Visible = true end
  if Content then
    if instant then
      Content.Visible = false
      Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 82)
    else
      local t = TweenService:Create(Content, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, 20),
      })
      t:Play()
      t.Completed:Connect(function()
        if _G._CalciumPhoneOnHome and Content then
          Content.Visible = false
          Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 82)
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  for _, page in pairs(pages) do
    page.Visible = false
  end
  pcall(function() if _G.CalciumIdleWake then _G.CalciumIdleWake() end end)
end

function setTab(name, instant)
  if name == "PANELS" then name = "SETTINGS" end
  if not name or not pages[name] then
    _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome(instant)
    return
  end
  _tabAnimToken += 1
  local myTok = _tabAnimToken
  activeTab = name
  _G._CalciumPhoneOnHome = false

  -- hide home
  if Tabs then Tabs.Visible = false end
  if homeHeader then homeHeader.Visible = false end
  if homeSub then homeSub.Visible = false end

  -- show only this page
  for pageName, page in pairs(pages) do
    page.Visible = (pageName == name)
    page.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
    if pageName == name then page.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0) end
  end

  local meta = APP_META[name] or { label = name, color = COLORS.accent }
  if appTitle then appTitle.Text = meta.label or name end

  if Content then
    Content.Visible = true
    if instant then
      Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 82)
    else
      Content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, 20)
      TweenService:Create(Content, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 82),
      }):Play()
    end
  end
  pcall(function() if _G.CalciumIdleWake then _G.CalciumIdleWake() end end)
end

_G.CalciumPhoneOpenApp = setTab

  if gridLayout then
    gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 76, 0, 100)
    gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 18)
    gridLayout.FillDirectionMaxCells = 3
  end
end)

for i, name in ipairs(tabNames) do
  if name ~= "SPOTIFY" and name ~= "MESSAGES" then addPage(name) end
  local meta = APP_META[name] or {
    label = name,
    color = COLORS.accent,
    color2 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 40, 80),
    icon = name:sub(1, 1),
    sub = "",
  }

  local cell = Instance.new("Frame")
  cell.Name = name
  cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  cell.Size = UDim2.new(0, _cellW or 78, 0, _cellH or 108)
  -- Hidden Panels tile must not occupy a visible grid slot.
  local visibleIndex = (i > 5) and (i - 1) or i
  local pageIdx = math.ceil(visibleIndex / APPS_PER_PAGE)
  cell.LayoutOrder = ((visibleIndex - 1) % APPS_PER_PAGE) + 1
  local pageParent = _appPages[pageIdx] or appPage1
  cell.Parent = pageParent or appGrid
  -- Keep internal PANELS page available, but hide its app tile.
  if name == "PANELS" then cell.Visible = false end

  -- soft shadow under icon
  local shadow = Instance.new("Frame")
  shadow.Name = "Shadow"
  local isz2 = _iconSz or 60
  shadow.Size = UDim2.new(0, isz2 - 2, 0, isz2 - 2)
  shadow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor((isz2-2)/2), 0, 5)
  shadow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
  shadow.BorderSizePixel = 0
  shadow.ZIndex = 4
  shadow.Parent = cell
  corner(shadow, 22)

  local icon = Instance.new("TextButton")
  icon.Name = "Icon"
  local isz = _iconSz or 60
  icon.Size = UDim2.new(0, isz, 0, isz)
  icon.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -math.floor(isz/2), 0, 2)
  icon.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  icon.BorderSizePixel = 0
  icon.Text = ""
  icon.AutoButtonColor = false
  icon.ZIndex = 5
  icon.Parent = cell
  corner(icon, 22)
  local ig = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  ig.Rotation = 135
  ig.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, meta.color),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, meta.color2 or meta.color),
  })
  ig.Parent = icon
  local ist = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  ist.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  ist.Transparency = 0.65
  ist.Thickness = 1.2
  ist.Parent = icon

  -- app icons (emoji / symbol matching the app)
  local glyph = Instance.new("Frame")
  glyph.Name = "Glyph"
  glyph.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  glyph.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
  glyph.ZIndex = 6
  glyph.Parent = icon

  local emoji = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  emoji.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  emoji.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
  emoji.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  emoji.TextSize = 30
  emoji.Text = tostring(meta.icon or "●")
  emoji.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  emoji.ZIndex = 7
  emoji.Parent = glyph

  -- tiny shine on icon
  local shine = Instance.new("Frame")
  shine.Size = UDim2.new(0.55, 0, 0.35, 0)
  shine.Position = UDim2.new(0.08, 0, 0.06, 0)
  shine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  shine.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  shine.BorderSizePixel = 0
  shine.ZIndex = 8
  shine.Parent = icon
  local sc = Instance.new("UICorner")
  sc.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  sc.Parent = shine

  local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, 6, 0, 16)
  lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, -3, 0, (_iconSz or 60) + 6)
  lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  lbl.TextSize = 12
  lbl.TextScaled = true
  lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 248, 255)
  lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
  lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  lbl.Text = meta.label or name
  lbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
  local lblConstraint = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
  lblConstraint.MaxTextSize = 13
  lblConstraint.MinTextSize = 9
  lblConstraint.Parent = lbl
  lbl.ZIndex = 5
  lbl.Parent = cell

  local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12)
  sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, (_iconSz or 60) + 22)
  sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
  sub.TextSize = 9
  sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 170, 195)
  sub.Text = meta.sub or ""
  sub.ZIndex = 5
  sub.Parent = cell

  tabButtons[name] = icon
  local function openApp()
    pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    local sc = icon:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
    if not sc then sc = Instance.new("UIScale", icon) sc.Scale = 1 end
    sc.Scale = 0.78
    TweenService:Create(sc, TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
    -- flash + expanding ripple
    pcall(function()
      local st = icon:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if st then
        local oldT, oldC = st.Transparency, st.Color
        st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 100)
        st.Transparency = 0
        task.delay(0.25, function()
          if st and st.Parent then st.Transparency = oldT; st.Color = oldC end
        end)
      end
      local rip = Instance.new("Frame")
      rip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      rip.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      rip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
      rip.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      rip.ZIndex = (icon.ZIndex or 5) + 3
      rip.Parent = icon
      Instance.new("UICorner", rip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
      local rs = Instance.new("UIStroke", rip)
      rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 185, 110)
      rs.Thickness = 2
      rs.Transparency = 0.15
      TweenService:Create(rip, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 78)
      }):Play()
      TweenService:Create(rs, TweenInfo.new(0.45), { Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5 }):Play()
      -- second delayed ripple
      task.delay(0.12, function()
        local rip2 = Instance.new("Frame")
        rip2.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        rip2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        rip2.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
        rip2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        rip2.ZIndex = (icon.ZIndex or 5) + 3
        rip2.Parent = icon
        Instance.new("UICorner", rip2).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local rs2 = Instance.new("UIStroke", rip2)
        rs2.Color = Color3.fromRGB(220, 130, 255)
        rs2.Thickness = 1.5
        rs2.Transparency = 0.25
        TweenService:Create(rip2, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64) }):Play()
        TweenService:Create(rs2, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
        task.delay(0.42, function() if rip2 then rip2:Destroy() end end)
      end)
      task.delay(0.48, function() if rip then rip:Destroy() end end)
    end)
    if name == "SPOTIFY" then
      pcall(function()
        if type(_G.CalciumOpenSpotify) == "function" then
          _G.CalciumOpenSpotify()
        elseif type(_G.DelSpotifyToggle) == "function" then
          _G.DelSpotifyToggle()
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    if name == "MESSAGES" then
      pcall(function()
        if type(_G.CalciumOpenMessages) == "function" then
          _G.CalciumOpenMessages()
        end
      end)
      return
    end
    setTab(name)
  end
  if _G.CalciumBindButton then
    _G.CalciumBindButton(icon, openApp)
  else
    icon.MouseButton1Click:Connect(openApp)
  end
end

      _G.CalciumBindButton(appBack, function() _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome() end)

      appBack.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome() end)

  local homeBar = Main:FindFirstChild("HomeIndicator")
  if homeBar then
    homeBar.Active = true

    hit.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    hit.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -2)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.ZIndex = 46
    hit.Parent = Main
    if _G.CalciumBindButton then
      _G.CalciumBindButton(hit, function() _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome() end)
