-- Start on home screen (not inside an app)
pcall(function() _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome(true) end)
-- >>> TAB POSITION BEGIN
-- ============================================================
-- POSIZIONE DELLE TAB
-- Riposiziona la barra delle tab e ridimensiona il Content di conseguenza.
-- Main e' 324 x 576; l'header arriva a y=88, quindi tutte e quattro le
-- disposizioni partono da y=97 in giu'.
-- IIFE e non do-end: un do-end NON apre un nuovo budget di registri e qui
-- il main chunk e' gia' vicino al limite di 200.
-- ============================================================
;(function()
  local H = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
  local V = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical

  -- Larghezze della finestra. In Left/Right la colonna delle tab si prende
  -- spazio a lato, e se Main restasse a 324 il Content si stringerebbe di
  -- una sessantina di pixel: le row hanno i bottoni posizionati con offset
  -- assoluti dal bordo destro, quindi si sovrappongono alle label e finiscono
  -- tagliati. Per questo la finestra si allarga: il Content resta a 298 di
  -- larghezza in tutte e quattro le disposizioni, e dentro le pagine non
  -- cambia assolutamente niente.
  local W_NARROW = 324   -- Up / Bottom
  local W_WIDE   = 359   -- Left / Right (324 + 35 di colonna)
  -- Col testo ruotato la colonna deve contenere solo l'ALTEZZA di una riga
  -- di testo, non la larghezza di una lettera: 30 bastano e avanzano.
  local BAR_W    = 30    -- larghezza della colonna verticale

  local LAYOUTS = {
    Up = {
      wide       = false,
      tabsPos    = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 97),
      tabsSize   = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34),
      dir        = H,
      pad        = UDim.new(0, 5),
      hAlign     = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
      vAlign     = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
      contentPos = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 138),
      contentSize= UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, -137),
    },
    Bottom = {
      wide       = false,
      tabsPos    = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -46),
      tabsSize   = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 34),
      dir        = H,
      pad        = UDim.new(0, 5),
      hAlign     = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
      vAlign     = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
      contentPos = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 97),
      contentSize= UDim2.new(1, -26, 1, -153),
    },
    Left = {
      wide       = true,
      tabsPos    = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 97),
      tabsSize   = UDim2.new(0, BAR_W, 1, -109),
      dir        = V,
      pad        = UDim.new(0, 3),
      hAlign     = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
      -- Centrata, non incollata in alto: le cinque tab occupano circa 430
      -- dei 467 pixel della colonna, e da Top lasciavano tutto il vuoto in
      -- fondo. Da Center il margine si divide sopra e sotto.
      vAlign     = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
      rot        = -90,   -- a sinistra si legge dal basso verso l'alto
      -- L'area contenuti arriva in fondo come con le tab in alto: con -109
      -- si fermava 12px prima e l'ultima riga restava sospesa a mezz'aria.
      contentPos = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 97),
      contentSize= UDim2.new(1, -61, 1, -96),
    },
    Right = {
      wide       = true,
      tabsPos    = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 97),
      tabsSize   = UDim2.new(0, BAR_W, 1, -109),
      dir        = V,
      pad        = UDim.new(0, 3),
      hAlign     = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
      vAlign     = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
      rot        = 90,    -- a destra si legge dall'alto verso il basso
      contentPos = UDim2.new(0, 13, 0, 97),
      contentSize= UDim2.new(1, -61, 1, -96),
    },
  }

  -- ============================================================
  -- TESTO RUOTATO
  -- ============================================================
  -- Una sola TextLabel per tab, con la parola scritta NORMALE e poi
  -- ruotata di 90 gradi. Le lettere stanno su un'unica linea di base con
  -- la crenatura decisa dal font, quindi non c'e' niente da allineare:
  -- e' dritto per costruzione, non per correzione. Tutti i tentativi
  -- precedenti impilavano una label per lettera, e li' ogni glifo veniva
  -- centrato per conto suo con il suo arrotondamento.
  --
  -- Il verso segue la convenzione delle sidebar:
  --   Left  -> -90, si legge dal basso verso l'alto
  --   Right -> +90, si legge dall'alto verso il basso
  local LETTER_FONT = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  local WORD_SIZE   = 15   -- TextSize della parola
  local WORD_PAD    = 14   -- aria sopra e sotto, nel senso della colonna

  -- La rotazione NON cambia lo spazio che l'oggetto occupa nel layout:
  -- il bottone va quindi alto quanto la parola e' LARGA da orizzontale.
  local TextServiceRef = game:GetService("TextService")
  local wordLenCache = {}
  local function wordLength(word)
    local n = wordLenCache[word]
    if not n then
      local ok, sz = pcall(function()
        return TextServiceRef:GetTextSize(word, WORD_SIZE, LETTER_FONT, Vector2.new(4000, 100))
      end)
      n = (ok and sz and math.ceil(sz.X)) or (#word * WORD_SIZE * 0.62)
      wordLenCache[word] = n
    end
    return n
  end
  local function buildWord(btn, name, rot)
    local lbl = btn:FindFirstChild("VWord")
    if lbl and lbl:GetAttribute("Word") == name and lbl.Rotation == rot then
      return lbl
    end
    if lbl then lbl:Destroy() end

    local len = wordLength(name)

    lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Name = "VWord"
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = name
    lbl.Font = LETTER_FONT
    lbl.TextSize = WORD_SIZE
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
    lbl.TextWrapped = false
    -- Dimensioni da orizzontale; ruotando, la larghezza diventa l'altezza.
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, len, 0, WORD_SIZE + 6)
    lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    lbl.Rotation = rot
    lbl.ZIndex = 5
    lbl:SetAttribute("Word", name)
    lbl.Parent = btn
    return lbl
  end
  -- Le lettere non ereditano il colore dal bottone: va propagato a mano
  -- ogni volta che setTab cambia lo stato attivo.
  local function syncLetters()
    for _, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
      local lbl = btn:FindFirstChild("VWord")
      if lbl and lbl.Visible then lbl.TextColor3 = btn.TextColor3 end
    end
  end
  _G._CalciumSyncTabLetters = syncLetters

  function _G.CalciumApplyTabPosition(pos)
    pos = _G.CalciumValidTabPosition(pos)
    local L = LAYOUTS[pos]
    if not L then return end
    _G._CalciumTabPosition = pos

    -- La finestra si allarga/restringe. FULL_MAIN_SIZE e' la misura che tutti
    -- i ripristini della hub usano (minimize, intro, duels), quindi va
    -- aggiornata anche lei: altrimenti al primo ripristino tornerebbe stretta
    -- con le tab ancora di lato.
    FULL_MAIN_SIZE = UDim2.new(0, L.wide and W_WIDE or W_NARROW, 0, 640)
    Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE

    Tabs.Position = L.tabsPos
    Tabs.Size     = L.tabsSize

    TabLayout.FillDirection       = L.dir
    TabLayout.Padding             = L.pad
    TabLayout.HorizontalAlignment = L.hAlign
    TabLayout.VerticalAlignment   = L.vAlign

    for name, btn in pairs(tabButtons) do
      -- Padding interno riusato tra un cambio di modalita' e l'altro.
      local pad = btn:FindFirstChild("TabPad")
      if not pad then
        pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
        pad.Name = "TabPad"
        pad.Parent = btn
      end
      if L.dir == V then
        -- Il bottone non scrive niente: il testo e' la label ruotata.
        -- Alto quanto la parola e' larga da orizzontale, piu' l'aria.
        btn.Text = ""
        btn.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
        pad.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 0)
        pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, wordLength(name) + WORD_PAD)
        local lbl = buildWord(btn, name, L.rot or 90)
        lbl.Visible = true
      else
        btn.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.None
        local lbl = btn:FindFirstChild("VWord")
        if lbl then lbl.Visible = false end
        btn.Text = name
        btn.TextSize = 8
        btn.TextWrapped = false
        btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        btn.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
        pad.PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 0)
        pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 0)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 34)
      end
    end
    Content.Position = L.contentPos
    Content.Size     = L.contentSize

    -- >>> PAGE PADDING <<< il respiro sopra/sotto cambia col lato delle tab
    if _G._CalciumApplyPagePadding then _G._CalciumApplyPagePadding() end

    syncLetters()
  end
end)()

-- setTab colora i bottoni ma non sa delle lettere: si aggancia qui.
do
  local _oldSetTab = setTab
  function setTab(name, instant)
    _oldSetTab(name, instant)
  end
end
-- Applica quello caricato dal config (o il default "Up").
-- phone mode: tab positions disabled (home screen apps)
pcall(function() if _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome then _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome(true) end end)
-- <<< TAB POSITION END

function section(parent, text, order)
  -- Section title row: readable, matches hub style (not neon / not tiny)
  local wrap = Instance.new("Frame")
  wrap.Name = "Section_" .. tostring(text)
  wrap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  wrap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 28)
  wrap.LayoutOrder = order
  wrap.ZIndex = 8
  wrap.Parent = parent

  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.Name = "Title"
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = string.upper(tostring(text or ""))
  label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241)
  label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
  label.TextSize = 11
  label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 16)
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
  label.ZIndex = 9
  label.Parent = wrap

  local line = Instance.new("Frame")
  line.Name = "Underline"
  line.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(54, 57, 65)
  line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.65
  line.BorderSizePixel = 0
  line.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 1)
  line.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -2)
  line.ZIndex = 9
  line.Parent = wrap

  return wrap
end
function baseRow(parent, labelText, order)
  local row = Instance.new("Frame")
  row.Name = labelText
  row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(19, 24, 31)
  row.BackgroundTransparency = 0.04
  do local S = _G._CalciumS or function(n) return n end
  local _rh = 58
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, _rh)
  row.BorderSizePixel = 0
  row.LayoutOrder = order
  row.ZIndex = 4
  row.Parent = parent
  corner(row, math.clamp(S(14), 12, 16)) end
  row:SetAttribute("CalciumFlatRow", true)
  local rowStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
  rowStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(39, 49, 62)
  rowStroke.Thickness = 1
  rowStroke.Transparency = 0.65
  local accent = Instance.new("Frame", row)
  accent.Name = "RowAccent"
  accent.Visible = false
  accent.Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)
  accent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.25, 0)
  accent.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241)
  accent.BorderSizePixel = 0
  accent.ZIndex = 5
  Instance.new("UICorner", accent).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local sheen = Instance.new("UIGradient", row)
  sheen.Rotation = 90
  sheen.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(220, 233, 245)),
  })

  local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  label.Name = "Label"
  label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  label.Text = labelText
  label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 240)
  label.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
  label.TextSize = 15
  label:SetAttribute("CalciumReadableSize", 15)
  label.TextWrapped = true
  label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
  label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
  label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0)
  label.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
  label.ZIndex = 5
  label.Parent = row
  return row
end
function _G.CalciumPanelLauncher(parent, title, description, order, callback)
  local row = baseRow(parent, title, order)
  row:SetAttribute("CalciumPanelLauncher", true)
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 62)
  row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  local titleLabel = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
  titleLabel.Position, titleLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 10), UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 20)
  titleLabel.Font, titleLabel.TextSize = Enum.Font.GothamBold, 13
  local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
  sub.Name = "Description"
  sub.BackgroundTransparency, sub.ZIndex = 1, 5
  sub.Position, sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 32), UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 16)
  sub.Text, sub.TextSize, sub.Font = description, 10, Enum.Font.Gotham
  sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(165, 173, 192)
  sub.TextXAlignment, sub.TextTruncate = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
  local button = Instance.new("TextButton", row)
  button.Name = "PanelOpenButton"
  button.Position, button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -94, 0.5, -18), UDim2.fromOffset(82, 36)
  button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(29, 45, 54)
  button.BackgroundTransparency, button.BorderSizePixel = 0.1, 0
  button.Text, button.TextSize, button.Font = "OPEN", 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold
  button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 233, 248)
  button.AutoButtonColor, button.ZIndex = false, 10
  corner(button, 11)
  local border = Instance.new("UIStroke", button)
  border.Color, border.Thickness, border.Transparency = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241), 1, 0.65
  button.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(button, {BackgroundTransparency = 0}, 0.15) end)
  button.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(button, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.1}, 0.15) end)
  button.Activated:Connect(function()
    pcall(playClick)
    if callback then callback() end
  end)
  return row, button
end

function textboxRow(parent, labelText, value, order)
  local row = baseRow(parent, labelText, order)
  local S = _G._CalciumS or function(n) return math.floor((n or 0) + 0.5) end
  local mobile = (_G.CalciumIsMobile == true) or (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled)
  local rh = math.clamp(S(mobile and 50 or 46), 40, 54)
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, rh)
  local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
  box.Name = "ValueBox"
  box.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 30)
  box.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
  box.Text = tostring(value or "")
  box.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
  box.TextSize = math.clamp(S(mobile and 14 or 12), 11, 15)
  box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
  box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
  box.TextScaled = false
  box.TextWrapped = false
  local bw = math.clamp(S(mobile and 78 or 58), 52, 88)
  local bh = math.clamp(S(mobile and 30 or 24), 22, 34)
  box.Size = UDim2.new(0, bw, 0, bh)
  box.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(bw + S(8)), 0.5, -math.floor(bh / 2))
  box.BorderSizePixel = 0
  box.ZIndex = 6
  box.Parent = row
  corner(box, math.clamp(S(10), 8, 12))
  stroke(box, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)
  pcall(function()
    box.ReturnPressedFromOnScreenKeyboard:Connect(function()
      pcall(function() box:ReleaseFocus() end)
    end)
  end)
  return row, box
end

function toggleRow(parent, labelText, default, order)
  local row = baseRow(parent, labelText, order)
  local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
  button.Name = "ToggleButton"
  button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  button.Text = ""
  -- Switch area on the right (arrows sit near 1,-90 and stay clickable)
  do local S = _G._CalciumS or function(n) return n end
  local bw = 66
  button.Size = UDim2.new(0, bw, 1, 0)
  button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -bw, 0, 0)
  end
  button.Active = true
  button.AutoButtonColor = false
  button.ZIndex = 12
  button.Parent = row
  local track = Instance.new("Frame")
  track.Name = "Track"
  track.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.toggleBg
  track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
  do local S = _G._CalciumS or function(n) return n end
  local tw, th = 48, 28
  track.Size = UDim2.new(0, tw, 0, th)
  track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -(tw + 10), 0.5, -math.floor(th/2))
  end
  track.BorderSizePixel = 0
  track.ClipsDescendants = false
  track.ZIndex = 5
  track.Parent = button
  corner(track, 14)
  stroke(track, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1.3, 0.4)

  -- Riempimento viola che sfuma quando il toggle e' acceso
  local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
  fill.Name = "Fill"
  fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241)
  fill.BackgroundTransparency = default and 0 or 1
  fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
  fill.ZIndex = 5
  fill.Parent = track
  corner(fill, 14)
  local fillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  fillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(179, 235, 250)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(63, 167, 200)),
  })
  fillGrad.Rotation = 0
  fillGrad.Parent = fill

  local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
  knob.Name = "Knob"
  knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22)
  knob.Position = default and UDim2.new(1, -(knob.Size.X.Offset + 3), 0.5, -math.floor(knob.Size.Y.Offset/2)) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -math.floor(knob.Size.Y.Offset/2))
  knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
  knob.ZIndex = 7
  knob.Parent = track
  corner(knob, 999)
  local grip = Instance.new("Frame", knob)
  grip.Name = "ThumbGrip"
  grip.AnchorPoint, grip.Position = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
  grip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 8)
  grip.BackgroundColor3, grip.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(76, 91, 100), 0.2
  grip.BorderSizePixel, grip.ZIndex = 0, 8
  corner(grip, 2)
  local knobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  knobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  knobStroke.Color = default and Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241) or Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 98)
  knobStroke.Thickness = 1.4
  knobStroke.Transparency = 0.15
  knobStroke.Parent = knob
  local shine = Instance.new("Frame")
  shine.Name = "Shine"
  shine.Visible = false
  shine.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.white
  shine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
  shine.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 5)
  shine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, 2.5)
  shine.BorderSizePixel = 0
  shine.ZIndex = 8
  shine.Parent = knob
  corner(shine, 5)
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(fill, fillGrad, "toggle", track, knob, row)
  local state = default and true or false
  local trackStroke = track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  local rowStroke = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  -- UIScale on knob for bounce
  local knobScale = knob:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
  if not knobScale then
    knobScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
    knobScale.Scale = 1
    knobScale.Parent = knob
  end
  local switchTweens = {}
  local function switchTween(object, info, goal)
    local old = switchTweens[object]
    if old then old:Cancel() end
    local nextTween = TweenService:Create(object, info, goal)
    switchTweens[object] = nextTween
    nextTween:Play()
  end
  local function setVisual(on, instant)
    state = on and true or false
    row:SetAttribute("CalciumToggleOn", state)
    local accent = row:FindFirstChild("RowAccent")
    if accent then accent.Visible = false end
    local _onBg, _onEdge = _G._CalciumToggleOnColor()
    local goalPos = state and UDim2.new(1, -(knob.Size.X.Offset + 3), 0.5, -math.floor(knob.Size.Y.Offset/2)) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -math.floor(knob.Size.Y.Offset/2))
    if instant then
      knob.Position = goalPos
      track.BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 0.12
      track.BackgroundColor3 = state and _onBg or COLORS.toggleBg
      fill.BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 1
      knobStroke.Color = state and _onEdge or Color3.fromRGB(112, 119, 138)
    else
      local info = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
      local soft = TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
      switchTween(knob, info, { Position = goalPos })
      switchTween(track, soft, {
        BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 0.12,
        BackgroundColor3 = state and _onBg or COLORS.toggleBg
      })
      switchTween(fill, soft, { BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 1 })
      switchTween(knobStroke, soft, {
        Color = state and _onEdge or Color3.fromRGB(112, 119, 138)
      })
      knobScale.Scale = 1
    end
    if trackStroke then
      tween(trackStroke, {
        Color = state and _onEdge or COLORS.strokeSoft,
        Transparency = state and 0 or 0.4,
        Thickness = state and 1.6 or 1.4
      })
    end
    if rowStroke then
      tween(rowStroke, {
        Color = state and _onBg or COLORS.strokeSoft,
        Transparency = state and 0.08 or 0.38,
        Thickness = 1.25
      })
    end
  end
  setVisual(state, true)
  _G.CalciumThemeChanged.Event:Connect(function() if row.Parent then setVisual(state, true) end end)
  -- Free-executor safe toggles (Delta / Medium / Real / mobile)
  button.Active = true
  button.Selectable = true
  button.AutoButtonColor = false
  button.ZIndex = 12
  pcall(function()
    for _, d in ipairs(button:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("GuiObject") then d.Active = false end
    end
  end)
  -- Bridge: feature scripts Connect to Activated; we also fire this from click/touch
  local bridge = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
  bridge.Name = "CalciumToggleBridge"
  bridge.Parent = button
  local lastRelay = 0
  local function fireToggle()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastRelay < 0.12 then return end
    lastRelay = now
    pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    pcall(function() bridge:Fire() end)
  end
  button.Activated:Connect(fireToggle)
  -- Expose bridge so we can dual-bind without getconnections
  button:SetAttribute("HasToggleBridge", true)
  return row, setVisual, button
end
_G.CalciumSyncToggleVisuals = function()
  pcall(function() if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled == true) end end)
  pcall(function() if _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.setVisual then _G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.setVisual(_G._CalciumSyncAfterHit.enabled == true) end end)
  pcall(function() if setInfJumpVisual then setInfJumpVisual(infJumpEnabled == true) end end)
  pcall(function() if _SV.setLookAtVisual then _SV.setLookAtVisual(_G.CalciumLookAtEnabled == true) end end)
  pcall(function() if setAntiRagdollVisual then setAntiRagdollVisual(antiRagdollEnabled == true) end end)
  pcall(function() if setAutoCarrySpeedVisual then setAutoCarrySpeedVisual(autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true) end end)
  pcall(function() if _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector() end end)
  pcall(function() if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled == true) end end)
end
_G.CalciumActionToggleRow = function(parent, labelText, default, order)
  local row = baseRow(parent, labelText, order)
  local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
  button.Name = "ToggleButton"
  button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  button.Text = ""
  -- Switch area only — do not cover dropdown arrows
  button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 1, 0)
  button.Position = UDim2.new(1, -66, 0, 0)
  button.AutoButtonColor = false
  button.ZIndex = 12
  button.Parent = row
  local track = Instance.new("Frame")
  track.Name = "Track"
  track.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.toggleBg
  track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.12
  track.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22)
  track.Position = UDim2.new(1, -54, 0.5, -11)
  track.BorderSizePixel = 0
  track.ClipsDescendants = false
  track.ZIndex = 5
  track.Parent = button
  corner(track, 11)
  stroke(track, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1.3, 0.4)

  -- Riempimento viola che sfuma quando il toggle e' acceso
  local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
  fill.Name = "Fill"
  fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(104, 213, 241)
  fill.BackgroundTransparency = default and 0 or 1
  fill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
  fill.ZIndex = 5
  fill.Parent = track
  corner(fill, 11)
  local fillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  fillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(179, 235, 250)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(63, 167, 200)),
  })
  fillGrad.Rotation = 0
  fillGrad.Parent = fill

  local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
  knob.Name = "Knob"
  knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
  knob.Position = default and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
  knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
  knob.ZIndex = 7
  knob.Parent = track
  corner(knob, 999)
  local knobStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  knobStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  knobStroke.Color = default and Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(100, 70, 55)
  knobStroke.Thickness = 1.4
  knobStroke.Transparency = 0.15
  knobStroke.Parent = knob
  local shine = Instance.new("Frame")
  shine.Name = "Shine"
  shine.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.white
  shine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
  shine.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 0, 5)
  shine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 2.5, 0, 2.5)
  shine.BorderSizePixel = 0
  shine.ZIndex = 8
  shine.Parent = knob
  corner(shine, 5)
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(fill, fillGrad, "toggle", track, knob, row)
  local trackStroke = track:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  local rowStroke = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
  local function setVisual(on)
    local state = on and true or false
    knob.Position = state and UDim2.new(1, -19, 0.5, -8) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, -8)
    local _onBg, _onEdge = _G._CalciumToggleOnColor()
    tween(track, {
      BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 0.12,
      BackgroundColor3 = state and _onBg or COLORS.toggleBg
    })
    tween(fill, { BackgroundTransparency = state and 0 or 1 })
    tween(knobStroke, {
      Color = state and _onEdge or Color3.fromRGB(100, 70, 55)
    })
    if trackStroke then
      tween(trackStroke, {
        Color = state and _onEdge or COLORS.strokeSoft,
        Transparency = state and 0 or 0.4,
        Thickness = 1.4
      })
    end
    if rowStroke then
      tween(rowStroke, {
        Color = state and _onBg or COLORS.strokeSoft,
        Transparency = state and 0.08 or 0.38,
        Thickness = 1.25
      })
    end
  end
  setVisual(default)
  button.Active = true
  button.Selectable = true
  button.ZIndex = 12
  pcall(function()
    for _, d in ipairs(button:GetDescendants()) do
      if d:IsA("GuiObject") then d.Active = false end
    end
  end)
  local function invokeActionHandlers()
    local ran = false
    pcall(function()
      if typeof(getconnections) ~= "function" then return end
      local conns = getconnections(button.Activated)
      if not conns or #conns == 0 then return end
      for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
        pcall(function()
          if type(c.Function) == "function" then
            c.Function()
            ran = true
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
    if not ran then
      pcall(function()
        if typeof(firesignal) == "function" then
          firesignal(button.Activated)
        end
      end)
    end
  end
  local lastRelayA = 0
  local function fireAction()
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastRelayA < 0.08 then return end
    lastRelayA = now
    invokeActionHandlers()
  end
  pcall(function() button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(fireAction) end)
  pcall(function()
    button.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        fireAction()
      end
    end)
  end)
  return row, setVisual, button
end

end
-- RIMOSSA TUTTA LA LOGICA ANIMATION PACK

function keyName(key)
  if not key then return "None" end
  if key == "MB3" then return "MB3" end
  local name = tostring(key):gsub("Enum.KeyCode.", "")
  name = name:gsub("Button", "BTN ")
  name = name:gsub("DPad", "DPad ")
  return name
end
function refreshSpeedKeybindButton(keyId)
  local btn = speedKeybindButtons[keyId]
  if btn then
    if listeningForSpeedKey == keyId then
      btn.Text = "Press..."
    else
      btn.Text = keyName(speedKeybinds[keyId])
    end
  end
end
function refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
  for keyId in pairs(speedKeybindButtons) do
    refreshSpeedKeybindButton(keyId)
  end
end
function refreshTPDownKeybind()
  if tpDownKeybindButton then
    tpDownKeybindButton.Text = listeningForTPDownKey and "Press..." or keyName(tpDownKeybind)
  end
end
function tpDownKeybindRow(parent, order)
  local row = baseRow(parent, "TP Down", order)
  row.Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -152, 1, 0)
  local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  btn.Name = "TPDownKeybindButton"
  btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 30)
  btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
  btn.Text = keyName(tpDownKeybind)
  btn.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
  btn.TextSize = 11
  btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
  btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(84, 36)
  btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -94, 0.5, -18)
  btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
  btn.ZIndex = 6
  btn.AutoButtonColor = false
  btn.Parent = row
  corner(btn, 10)
  stroke(btn, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)
  local clearBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  clearBtn.Name = "ClearKeybindButton"
  clearBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 30)
  clearBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
  clearBtn.Text = "×"
  clearBtn.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
  clearBtn.TextSize = 14
  clearBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  clearBtn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 36)
  clearBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -128, 0.5, -18)
  clearBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
  clearBtn.ZIndex = 6
  clearBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
  clearBtn.Parent = row
  corner(clearBtn, 7)
  stroke(clearBtn, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)
  tpDownKeybindButton = btn
  btn.Activated:Connect(function()
    listeningForSpeedKey = nil
    listeningForTPDownKey = true
    keybindListenStartedAt = tick()
    refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
    refreshTPDownKeybind()
  end)
  clearBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    listeningForSpeedKey = nil
    listeningForTPDownKey = false
    tpDownKeybind = nil
    if tpDownKeybindButton then tpDownKeybindButton.Text = "None" end
    refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
    refreshTPDownKeybind()
    if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then
      _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow()
    else
      saveCalciumConfig()
    end
  end)
  return row, btn
end

    listeningForTPDownKey = false
    keybindListenStartedAt = tick()

    if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then
      _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow()
    else
      saveCalciumConfig()
    end
  end)

normalModeValueLabel = nil
aimbotButtonLabel = nil
aimbotSpeedLabel = nil
laggerAimbotSpeedLabel = nil
combatAimbotKeybindLabel = nil


function getAimbotModeDisplay()
  return "Bat Aimbot"
end
function refreshAimbotButtonLabel()
  if aimbotButtonLabel then
    aimbotButtonLabel.Text = getAimbotModeDisplay()
  end
end
function refreshAimbotModeLabels()
  local modeName = getAimbotModeDisplay()
  if aimbotSpeedLabel then
    aimbotSpeedLabel.Text = modeName .. " Speed"
  end
  if laggerAimbotSpeedLabel then
    laggerAimbotSpeedLabel.Text = modeName .. " Lagger Speed"
  end
  if combatAimbotKeybindLabel then
    combatAimbotKeybindLabel.Text = modeName
  end
  refreshAimbotButtonLabel()
  -- Aggiorna il testo del bottone mobile aimbot
  pcall(function()
    local mobileButtons = _G.CalciumMobileButtonRefs
    local aimbotEntry = mobileButtons and mobileButtons.aimbot
    local aimbotMobileBtn = aimbotEntry and aimbotEntry.btn
    if aimbotMobileBtn then
      aimbotMobileBtn.Text = (selectedAimbotMode == "V2") and "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV2" or "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV1"
    end
  end)
  -- Stessa versione anche nella lista Hide Mobile Buttons
  if _G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot then pcall(_G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot) end
  -- ...e nel segmento di sinistra dell'Auto After Drop
  if _G.CalciumRefreshAfterDropSelector then pcall(_G.CalciumRefreshAfterDropSelector) end
end
refreshSpeedModeRows = function()
  if normalModeValueLabel then
    -- Mostra la modalità corrente completa
    normalModeValueLabel.Text = currentSpeedMode
  end
end
-- MODE ROW COMBINATA (rimossa la seconda)
function modeDisplayRow(parent, order)
  local row = baseRow(parent, "Mode", order)
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
  -- Qui c'era BackgroundTransparency = 0.42, che sovrascriveva lo 0.3 di
  -- baseRow: la riga nasceva piu' chiara di tutte le altre e diventava
  -- uguale solo dopo il primo passaggio del mouse, perche' e' il MouseLeave
  -- di baseRow a riportarla a 0.3.
  local label = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
  if label then
    label.Text = "Mode"
    label.TextSize = 13
    label.Size = UDim2.new(0, 110, 1, 0)
    label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 255)
  end
  local value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  value.Name = "ModeValue"
  value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  value.Text = currentSpeedMode
  value.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  value.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  value.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
  value.TextSize = 12
  value.Font = Enum.Font.GothamSemibold
  value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
  value.Position = UDim2.new(1, -132, 0, 0)
  value.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 1, 0)
  value.ZIndex = 6
  value.Parent = row
  local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
  click.Name = "ModeClick"
  click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  click.Text = ""
  click.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  click.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  click.AutoButtonColor = false
  click.ZIndex = 8
  click.Parent = row
  normalModeValueLabel = value
  click.Activated:Connect(function()
    local mode = currentSpeedMode
    -- Cycle: Normal -> Carry -> Lagger -> Lagger Carry -> Normal
    if mode == "Normal" then
      setSpeedMode("Carry")
    elseif mode == "Carry" then
      setSpeedMode("Lagger")
    elseif mode == "Lagger" then
      setSpeedMode("Lagger Carry")
    else
      setSpeedMode("Normal")
    end
  end)
  refreshSpeedModeRows()
  return row, value
end
function aimbotModeButtonRow(parent, order)
  local row, setVisual = toggleRow(parent, getAimbotModeDisplay(), false, order)
  aimbotButtonLabel = row and row:FindFirstChild("Label")
  _G.CalciumAimbotSetVisual = setVisual
  refreshAimbotButtonLabel()
  if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  _calciumBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() if _G.CalciumToggleSelectedAimbot then _G.CalciumToggleSelectedAimbot() end end)
  end
  return row, setVisual
end

  normalClick.ZIndex = 10
  normalClick.Parent = holder

  local semiClick = Instance.new("TextButton")
  semiClick.Name = "SemiClick"
  semiClick.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  semiClick.Text = ""
  semiClick.AutoButtonColor = false
  semiClick.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  semiClick.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  semiClick.ZIndex = 10
  semiClick.Parent = holder

  local function setMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "Semi" then
      mode = "Normal"
    end
    _G.CalciumStealRadii = _G.CalciumStealRadii or {Normal = 62, Semi = 60, SemiV2Radius = 60, SemiV2SemiRadius = 8}
    -- Salva il radius corrente nel slot giusto prima di cambiare modo
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      -- non sovrascriviamo autoStealRadius per V2 (usa SemiV2Radius separato)
    else
      _G.CalciumStealRadii[selectedStealMode] = tonumber(autoStealRadius) or _G.CalciumStealRadii[selectedStealMode]
    end
    selectedStealMode = mode
    pcall(function() if _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    -- Aggiorna il radiusBox con il valore corretto per il nuovo modo
    if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
      end
    else
      autoStealRadius = _G.CalciumStealRadii[selectedStealMode] or ((selectedStealMode == "Semi") and 60 or 62)
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius)
      end
    end
    -- Tween visivo PRIMA delle operazioni pesanti, cosi il rettangolo si muove subito
    local onSemi = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
    tween(slide, {
      Position = onSemi and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(normalText, {
      TextTransparency = onSemi and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onSemi and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(semiText, {
      TextTransparency = onSemi and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onSemi and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
    -- Mostra/nasconde subito i row Semi (sincrono, prima dello spawn)
    if _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows then _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows() end
    -- Operazioni pesanti in background (saveConfig + sync con possibili WaitForChild/InvokeServer)
    -- cosi non bloccano il thread e non ritardano il tween
    task.spawn(function()
      saveCalciumConfig()
      if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSetRadius then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSetRadius(_G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal or 62) end
      if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSetRadius then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSetRadius(_G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi or 60) end
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius then _G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius(_G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60) end
      if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumAutoStealSync() end
    end)
  end
  normalClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setMode("Normal")
  end)
  semiClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setMode("Semi")
  end)
  setMode(selectedStealMode)
  _G.CalciumSetStealMode = setMode
  return holder, setMode
end

    local isSoft = (mode == "SOFT")
    tween(acSlide, {
      Position = isSoft and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(acNormalText, {
      TextTransparency = isSoft and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isSoft and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(acSoftText, {
      TextTransparency = isSoft and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isSoft and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end
  local function setACMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "SOFT" then mode = "NORMAL" end
    if _G._CalciumAutoCarryMode ~= mode then
      -- Cambio mode: sblocca e ripristina la mode salvata, cosi' non resta stato sporco
      _G._CalciumAS.locked = false
      _G._CalciumAS.wasLow = false
      if _G._CalciumAS.savedMode then
        _G._CalciumAS.restoring = true
        pcall(function() setSpeedMode(_G._CalciumAS.savedMode) end)
        _G._CalciumAS.restoring = false
        _G._CalciumAS.savedMode = nil
      end
      _G._CalciumAutoCarrySoft.lastScan = 0
    end
    _G._CalciumAutoCarryMode = mode
    applyACModeVisual(mode)
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end
  _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector = function()
    applyACModeVisual(_G._CalciumAutoCarryMode or "NORMAL")
  end
  local function setExpandedAC(expanded)
    acModeExpanded = expanded
    _G._CalciumExpand(acHolder, expanded, 42, acArrow)
  end
  acArrow.Activated:Connect(function()
    setExpandedAC(not acModeExpanded)
  end)
  acNormalClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setACMode("NORMAL")
  end)
  acSoftClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setACMode("SOFT")
  end)

  applyACModeVisual(_G._CalciumAutoCarryMode or "NORMAL")
end
-- ===== FINE AUTO CARRY SPEED MODE SELECTOR BUILDER =====

-- Auto Carry Speed toggle (ordine 6, prima di Mode)
_, setAutoCarrySpeedVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Auto Carry Speed", autoCarrySpeedEnabled, 6)
do
  local row = Movement:FindFirstChild("Auto Carry Speed")
  _calciumBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() autoCarrySpeedEnabled = not autoCarrySpeedEnabled
      if autoCarrySpeedEnabled ~= true then
        if _G.AutoCarrySpeed and _G.AutoCarrySpeed.Disable then
          _G.AutoCarrySpeed.Disable()
        end
        -- Reset stato auto switch to carry
        _G._CalciumAS.locked = false
        _G._CalciumAS.wasLow = false
        if _G._CalciumAS.savedMode then
          _G._CalciumAS.restoring = true
          setSpeedMode(_G._CalciumAS.savedMode)
          _G._CalciumAS.restoring = false
          _G._CalciumAS.savedMode = nil
        end
      end
      if setAutoCarrySpeedVisual then setAutoCarrySpeedVisual(autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true) end
      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
  if row then
    _G._CalciumBuildAutoCarryModeSelector(row, Movement)
  end
end
modeDisplayRow(Movement, 7)   -- modalità combinata

section(Movement, "TELEPORT", 8)
autoTPRow = nil
autoTPRow, _SV.setAutoTPVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Auto TP Down", autoTPEnabled, 9)
do
  local autoTPButton = autoTPRow and autoTPRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if autoTPButton then
    autoTPButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if autoTPClickDebounce then return end
      autoTPClickDebounce = true
      local nextState = not autoTPEnabled
      toggleAutoTP(nextState)
      task.delay(0.15, function()
        autoTPClickDebounce = false
        if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled) end
      end)
    end)
  end
  if autoTPEnabled then
    startAutoTP()
  else
    stopAutoTP()
  end
end

-- Riga "TP Down Method": solo etichetta + freccetta, nessun toggle.
-- Aprendola compare lo slider NORMAL / SLOW FALL / ZIGZAG.
_G._CalciumBuildTPDownMethodSelector = function(parentFrame, rowOrder, holderOrder)
  local row = baseRow(parentFrame, "TP Down Method", rowOrder)

  local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
  arrow.Name = "TPDownMethodArrow"
  arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 30)
  arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
  arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
  arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 24)
  arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -12)
  arrow.Text = "^"
  arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
  arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
  arrow.TextSize = 15
  arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
  arrow.ZIndex = 30
  arrow.Parent = row
  corner(arrow, 7)
  stroke(arrow, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)

  local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
  holder.Name = "TP Down Method Selector"
  holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
  holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
  holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  holder.LayoutOrder = holderOrder
  holder.ZIndex = 4
  holder.ClipsDescendants = true
  holder.Visible = false
  holder.Parent = parentFrame
  corner(holder, 14)
  stroke(holder, Color3.fromRGB(200, 85, 25), 1.4, 0.32)
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(holder, nil, "soft")

  -- Two modes only: NORMAL and V2 (slowfall)
  local TPM_MODES = {"NORMAL", "V2"}
  local TPM_TEXT  = {"NORMAL", "V2"}
  local TPM_N = #TPM_MODES
  local tpmW = 1 / TPM_N

  local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
  slide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
  slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
  slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
  slide.Size = UDim2.new(tpmW, -8, 1, -8)
  slide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
  slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
  slide.ZIndex = 5
  slide.Parent = holder
  corner(slide, 13)
  local slideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  slideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  slideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 45)
  slideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  slideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  slideStroke.Parent = slide
  local slideGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  slideGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
  })
  slideGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  slideGrad.Rotation = 22
  slideGrad.Parent = slide
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(slide, slideGrad, "slide")

  local tpmTexts = {}

  local function applyVisual(mode)
    if mode == "SLOW" or mode == "ZIGZAG" then mode = "V2" end
    local idx = 1
    for i, m in ipairs(TPM_MODES) do if m == mode then idx = i break end end
    tween(slide, {
      Position = UDim2.new(tpmW * (idx - 1), 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    for i, t in ipairs(tpmTexts) do
      local sel = (i == idx)
      tween(t, {
        TextTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.5,
        TextStrokeTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.38
      }, 0.14)
    end
  end
  local function setMode(mode)
    local ok = false
    for _, m in ipairs(TPM_MODES) do if m == mode then ok = true break end end
    if not ok then mode = "NORMAL" end
    _G._CalciumTPDownMethod = mode
    applyVisual(mode)
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end
  for i, mode in ipairs(TPM_MODES) do
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = TPM_TEXT[i]
    t.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
    t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    t.TextSize = 11
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    t.Size = UDim2.new(tpmW, 0, 1, 0)
    t.Position = UDim2.new(tpmW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    t.ZIndex = 8
    t.Parent = holder
    tpmTexts[i] = t

    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    b.Text = ""
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.Size = UDim2.new(tpmW, 0, 1, 0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(tpmW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    b.ZIndex = 10
    b.Parent = holder
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode(mode) end)
  end
  local expanded = false
  arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
    expanded = not expanded
    _G._CalciumExpand(holder, expanded, 42, arrow)
  end)

  _G.CalciumRefreshTPDownMethodSelector = function()
    applyVisual(_G._CalciumTPDownMethod or "NORMAL")
  end
  applyVisual(_G._CalciumTPDownMethod or "NORMAL")
end
-- La riga vive nella sezione TELEPORT (LayoutOrder 10.5/10.6), ma la
-- chiamata deve stare DOPO la definizione del builder, non prima.
-- Sopra Auto TP Down (9): riga 8 + holder 8, subito dopo la sezione TELEPORT (8).
_G._CalciumBuildTPDownMethodSelector(Movement, 8, 8)
-- only NORMAL TP down — hide method picker
pcall(function()
  _G._CalciumTPDownMethod = "NORMAL"
  for _, ch in ipairs(Movement:GetChildren()) do
    if ch.Name and (ch.Name:find("TP Down Method") or ch.Name:find("TPDownMethod")) then
      ch.Visible = false
      ch.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0)
    end
  end
end)

    tween(jumpModeSlide, {
      Position = isManual and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(holdText, {
      TextTransparency = isManual and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isManual and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(manualText, {
      TextTransparency = isManual and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isManual and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end
  local function setJumpMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "MANUAL" then mode = "HOLD" end
    infJumpMode = mode
    if infJumpMode == "MANUAL" then
      _G.CalciumStopNormalInfJumpHoldState()
    end
    applyJumpModeVisual(infJumpMode)
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end

    applyJumpModeVisual(infJumpMode)
  end

    jumpModeExpanded = expanded

  end

  end)
  manualClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setJumpMode("MANUAL")
  end)

  applyJumpModeVisual(infJumpMode)
end

      Position = isV2 and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(arV1Text, {
      TextTransparency = isV2 and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isV2 and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(arV2Text, {
      TextTransparency = isV2 and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isV2 and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end
  local function setARMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "V2" then mode = "V1" end
    local wasEnabled = antiRagdollEnabled
    if wasEnabled then stopAntiRagdoll() end
    _G._CalciumAntiRagdollMode = mode
    applyARModeVisual(mode)
    if wasEnabled then startAntiRagdoll() end
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end
  _G.CalciumRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector = function()
    applyARModeVisual(_G._CalciumAntiRagdollMode or "V1")
  end
  local function setExpandedAR(expanded)
    arModeExpanded = expanded
    _G._CalciumExpand(arHolder, expanded, 42, arArrow)
  end
  arArrow.Activated:Connect(function()
    setExpandedAR(not arModeExpanded)
  end)
  arV1Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setARMode("V1")
  end)
  arV2Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    setARMode("V2")
  end)

  applyARModeVisual(_G._CalciumAntiRagdollMode or "V1")
end
-- ===== FINE ANTI RAGDOLL MODE SELECTOR BUILDER =====

_, setAntiRagdollVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Anti Ragdoll", antiRagdollEnabled, 16)
do
  local row = Movement:FindFirstChild("Anti Ragdoll")
  _calciumBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() setAntiRagdoll(not antiRagdollEnabled)
      if setAntiRagdollVisual then setAntiRagdollVisual(antiRagdollEnabled == true) end
      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
  if row then
    _G._CalciumBuildAntiRagdollModeSelector(row, Movement)
  end
end
-- Anti Die is shown only in the Combat tab (single, authoritative toggle).
-- Spostati da Combat: No Player Collision,Safe Mode
_, _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "No Player Collision", _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled, 18)
do
  _calciumBtn = Movement:FindFirstChild("No Player Collision") and Movement:FindFirstChild("No Player Collision"):FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled = not _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled
      if _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual then _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual(_G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled) end
      if _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled then
        if enableNoPlayerCollision then enableNoPlayerCollision() end
      else
        if disableNoPlayerCollision then disableNoPlayerCollision() end
      end
      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
end
_, _SV.setUnwalkVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Unwalk", unwalkEnabled, 19)
do
  _calciumBtn = Movement:FindFirstChild("Unwalk") and Movement:FindFirstChild("Unwalk"):FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() if unwalkEnabled then stopUnwalk() else startUnwalk() end
      if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(unwalkEnabled) end
      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
end
_, _SV.setSafeModeVisual = toggleRow(Movement, "Safe Mode", antiKickEnabled, 20)
do
  _calciumBtn = Movement:FindFirstChild("Safe Mode") and Movement:FindFirstChild("Safe Mode"):FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() antiKickEnabled = not antiKickEnabled
      if _SV.setSafeModeVisual then _SV.setSafeModeVisual(antiKickEnabled) end
      if antiKickEnabled and _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop then _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE") end
      if _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify then
        _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify(antiKickEnabled and "SAFE MODE ENABLED" or "SAFE MODE DISABLED",
          antiKickEnabled and "Full Auto Play allowed; risky actions guarded." or "Movement safeguards are off.", false)
      end
      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
end
-- Full Auto Play belongs to Movement, alongside Safe Mode and other paths.
section(Movement, "AUTO PLAY", 21)
do
  local pathRow, pathVisual = _G.CalciumActionToggleRow(Movement, "Full Auto Play Route", _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true, 22)
  _G.CalciumSetFullAutoPathVisual = pathVisual
  local pathButton = pathRow and pathRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if pathButton then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(pathButton, function()
      _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled = not (_G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled == true)
      autoPlayFullEnabled = _G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled
      pathVisual(_G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled)
      if _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify then
        _G.CalciumSafeModeNotify(_G.CalciumAutoPlayFullEnabled and "FULL ROUTE ENABLED" or "SEMI ROUTE ENABLED",
          "Auto Play uses the selected route on the next activation.", false)
      end
      if saveCalciumConfig then saveCalciumConfig() end
    end)
  end
  local playRow, playVisual = _G.CalciumActionToggleRow(Movement, "Auto Play", false, 23)
  _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual = playVisual
  local playButton = playRow and playRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if playButton then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(playButton, function()
      if _G.CalciumAutoPlayToggle then _G.CalciumAutoPlayToggle() end
    end)
  end
  local plotRow = baseRow(Movement, "Destination Plot", 24)
  plotRow.Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.40, 0, 1, 0)
  local value = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  value.Name = "PlotUUID"
  value.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  value.Size = UDim2.new(0.57, 0, 0, 34)
  value.Position = UDim2.new(0.41, 0, 0.5, -17)
  value.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
  value.TextSize = 10
  value.TextScaled = true
  value.TextWrapped = false
  value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
  value.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(245, 175, 85)
  value.Text = "Waiting for plot"
  value.Parent = plotRow
  _G.CalciumAutoPlayDestinationLabel = value
  if _G.CalciumAutoPlay and _G.CalciumAutoPlay.updateVisual then
    _G.CalciumAutoPlay.updateVisual()
  end
end

-- Palette unica e ORDINATA, usata da tutti i color picker dell'hub.
-- Ordine: neutri (marrone compreso, cosi' non finisce vicino al rosso),
-- poi rossi/arancioni/gialli, verdi, ciano/blu, viola/rosa.
_G.CalciumColorPresets = {
  -- neutri
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
  Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230),
  Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50),
  Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
  Color3.fromRGB(139, 69, 19),
  -- rossi / arancioni / gialli
  Color3.fromRGB(220, 20, 60),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0),
  -- verdi
  Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
  Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 120),
  Color3.fromRGB(0, 128, 128),
  Color3.fromRGB(64, 224, 208),
  -- ciano / blu
  Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 25),
  Color3.fromRGB(200, 80, 255),
  -- viola / rosa
  Color3.fromRGB(160, 40, 255),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180),
  Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 200),
}

-- Costruisce una riga "<nome> Color" a tendina, identica a quella del
-- Tracker Color: freccetta sulla riga indicata, pallino di anteprima e
-- bottone PICK che apre il popup con la palette + i campi RGB.
--
-- cfg = {
--   parent    = frame della tab
--   anchorRow = riga su cui mettere la freccetta
--   rowName   = testo della riga (es. "Tracker Color")
--   rowOrder  = LayoutOrder della riga
--   title     = titolo del popup (es. "TRACKER COLOR")
--   getColor  = function() -> Color3      (colore corrente)
--   onColor   = function(Color3)          (applica il nuovo colore)
-- }
-- Ritorna: row, setPreview(Color3)
_G._CalciumBuildColorPickerRow = function(cfg)
  local row = baseRow(cfg.parent, cfg.rowName, cfg.rowOrder)
  row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
  row.ClipsDescendants = true
  row.Visible = false

  -- ---- FRECCETTA SULLA RIGA PADRE ----
  if cfg.anchorRow then
    local expanded = false
    local arrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
    arrow.Name = "ColorArrow"
    arrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 30)
    arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
    arrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 24)
    arrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, -12)
    arrow.Text = "^"
    arrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
    arrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    arrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    arrow.TextSize = 15
    arrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    arrow.AutoButtonColor = false
    arrow.ZIndex = 30
    arrow.Parent = cfg.anchorRow
    corner(arrow, 7)
    stroke(arrow, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)
    arrow.Activated:Connect(function()
      expanded = not expanded
      _G._CalciumExpand(row, expanded, 42, arrow)
    end)
  end
  -- ---- PALLINO DI ANTEPRIMA ----
  local preview = Instance.new("Frame")
  preview.Name = "ColorPreview"
  preview.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28)
  preview.Position = UDim2.new(1, -114, 0.5, -14)
  preview.BackgroundColor3 = cfg.getColor() or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
  preview.BorderSizePixel = 0
  preview.ZIndex = 6
  preview.Parent = row
  Instance.new("UICorner", preview).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  local previewStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  previewStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  previewStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  previewStroke.Transparency = 0.3
  previewStroke.Parent = preview

  -- ---- BOTTONE PICK ----
  local btnHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
  btnHolder.Name = "ColorButtonHolder"
  btnHolder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
  btnHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  btnHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  btnHolder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 30)
  btnHolder.Position = UDim2.new(1, -73, 0.5, -15)
  btnHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
  btnHolder.ZIndex = 6
  btnHolder.Parent = row
  corner(btnHolder, 15)
  stroke(btnHolder, Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 90), 1.5, 0.15)

  local pickGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  pickGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
  })
  pickGrad.Rotation = 18
  pickGrad.Parent = btnHolder
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(btnHolder, pickGrad, "pick")

  local pickBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
  pickBtn.Name = "ColorButton"
  pickBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  pickBtn.Text = "PICK"
  pickBtn.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
  pickBtn.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  pickBtn.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
  pickBtn.TextSize = 12
  pickBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  pickBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  pickBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  pickBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  pickBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
  pickBtn.ZIndex = 8
  pickBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
  pickBtn.Parent = btnHolder

  pickBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
    tween(btnHolder, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 32), Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0.5, -16)}, 0.12)
  end)
  pickBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
    tween(btnHolder, {Size = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 30), Position = UDim2.new(1, -73, 0.5, -15)}, 0.12)
  end)

  local function setPreview(c)
    if c then preview.BackgroundColor3 = c end
  end
  -- ---- POPUP ----
  local pickerGui = nil

  local function closePicker()
    if pickerGui and pickerGui.Parent then
      TweenService:Create(pickerGui.Frame, TweenInfo.new(0.2), {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
      task.delay(0.25, function()
        if pickerGui and pickerGui.Parent then pickerGui:Destroy() end
        pickerGui = nil
      end)
    end
  end
  local function applyColor(c)
    setPreview(c)
    if cfg.onColor then cfg.onColor(c) end
  end
  pickBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
    if pickerGui and pickerGui.Parent then
      closePicker()
      return
    end
    pickerGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    pickerGui.Name = "CalciumHubColorPicker"
    pickerGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    pickerGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    pickerGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    pickerGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
    pickerGui.Parent = HubGui

    local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
    backdrop.Name = "Backdrop"
    backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
    backdrop.ZIndex = 1
    backdrop.Parent = pickerGui

    local pickerFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    pickerFrame.Name = "Frame"
    pickerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 420)
    pickerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -210)
    pickerFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
    pickerFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pickerFrame.ZIndex = 2
    pickerFrame.Parent = pickerGui
    corner(pickerFrame, 16)
    stroke(pickerFrame, Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 35), 1.2, 0.3)

    local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
    titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
    titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
    titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 17)
    titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    titleBar.ZIndex = 3
    titleBar.Parent = pickerFrame
    corner(titleBar, 16)

    local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    titleLabel.Name = "Title"
    titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
    titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
    titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    titleLabel.Text = cfg.title or "COLOR"
    titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    titleLabel.TextSize = 15
    titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    titleLabel.ZIndex = 4
    titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

    local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    closeBtn.Name = "CloseBtn"
    closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
    closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 6)
    closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 10)
    closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    closeBtn.Text = "X"
    closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    closeBtn.TextSize = 13
    closeBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
    closeBtn.ZIndex = 4
    closeBtn.Parent = titleBar
    corner(closeBtn, 8)
    stroke(closeBtn, Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 35), 1, 0.4)
    closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
      tween(closeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)}, 0.12)
    end)
    closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
      tween(closeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 10)}, 0.12)
    end)
    closeBtn.Activated:Connect(closePicker)

    local currentPreview = Instance.new("Frame")
    currentPreview.Name = "CurrentPreview"
    currentPreview.Size = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 64)
    currentPreview.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -32, 0, 60)
    currentPreview.BackgroundColor3 = preview.BackgroundColor3
    currentPreview.BorderSizePixel = 0
    currentPreview.ZIndex = 3
    currentPreview.Parent = pickerFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", currentPreview).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local cpStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    cpStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    cpStroke.Thickness = 2
    cpStroke.Transparency = 0.2
    cpStroke.Parent = currentPreview

    local colorGrid = Instance.new("Frame")
    colorGrid.Name = "ColorGrid"
    colorGrid.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 240)
    colorGrid.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 140)
    colorGrid.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    colorGrid.BorderSizePixel = 0
    colorGrid.ZIndex = 3
    colorGrid.Parent = pickerFrame

    local gridLayout = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
    gridLayout.CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
    gridLayout.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
    gridLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    gridLayout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    gridLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    gridLayout.Parent = colorGrid

    for i, color in ipairs(_G.CalciumColorPresets) do
      local cBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      cBtn.Name = "Color_" .. i
      cBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      cBtn.BackgroundColor3 = color
      cBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
      cBtn.Text = ""
      cBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
      cBtn.LayoutOrder = i
      cBtn.ZIndex = 4
      cBtn.Parent = colorGrid
      Instance.new("UICorner", cBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)

      local cGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
      cGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, color),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, color),
      })
      cGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0),
      })
      cGrad.Rotation = 125
      cGrad.Parent = cBtn

      local cStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
      cStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
      cStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      cStroke.Thickness = 1.5
      cStroke.Transparency = 0.65
      cStroke.Parent = cBtn

      cBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(cBtn, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8), Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0, -4)}, 0.12)
        tween(cStroke, {Transparency = 0, Thickness = 2.6}, 0.12)
      end)
      cBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(cBtn, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}, 0.12)
        tween(cStroke, {Transparency = 0.65, Thickness = 1.5}, 0.12)
      end)
      cBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
        applyColor(color)
        currentPreview.BackgroundColor3 = color
        closePicker()
      end)
    end
    local rgbFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    rgbFrame.Name = "RGBFrame"
    rgbFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 36)
    rgbFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 1, -52)
    rgbFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    rgbFrame.ZIndex = 3
    rgbFrame.Parent = pickerFrame

    local rBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    rBox.Name = "R"
    rBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)
    rBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    rBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
    rBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(preview.BackgroundColor3.R * 255))
    rBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    rBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    rBox.TextSize = 13
    rBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    rBox.ZIndex = 4
    rBox.Parent = rgbFrame
    corner(rBox, 8)
    stroke(rBox, Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100), 1, 0.4)

    local gBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    gBox.Name = "G"
    gBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)
    gBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -40, 0, 0)
    gBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
    gBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(preview.BackgroundColor3.G * 255))
    gBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    gBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    gBox.TextSize = 13
    gBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    gBox.ZIndex = 4
    gBox.Parent = rgbFrame
    corner(gBox, 8)
    stroke(gBox, Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100), 1, 0.4)

    local bBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
    bBox.Name = "B"
    bBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 80, 1, 0)
    bBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 0)
    bBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24)
    bBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(preview.BackgroundColor3.B * 255))
    bBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255)
    bBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    bBox.TextSize = 13
    bBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    bBox.ZIndex = 4
    bBox.Parent = rgbFrame
    corner(bBox, 8)
    stroke(bBox, Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 255), 1, 0.4)

    local function applyRGB()
      local r = math.clamp(tonumber(rBox.Text) or 0, 0, 255)
      local g = math.clamp(tonumber(gBox.Text) or 0, 0, 255)
      local b = math.clamp(tonumber(bBox.Text) or 0, 0, 255)
      local newColor = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
      applyColor(newColor)
      currentPreview.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
      rBox.Text = tostring(r)
      gBox.Text = tostring(g)
      bBox.Text = tostring(b)
    end
    rBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)
    gBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)
    bBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyRGB)

    backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
      if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
         or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        closePicker()
      end
    end)

    pickerFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    pickerFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    TweenService:Create(pickerFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 420),
      Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -210)
    }):Play()
  end)

  return row, setPreview
end

section(Combat, "AUTO STEAL", 1)
autoStealSelectorRow(Combat, 2)
_calciumRow, setAutoStealVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Auto Steal", autoStealEnabled, 3)
do
  _calciumBtn = _calciumRow and _calciumRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _calciumBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() autoStealEnabled = not autoStealEnabled
      -- User intent is authoritative, even if ragdoll suspension is active.
      if not autoStealEnabled then _ragdollStealWasOn = false end
      if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled) end
      if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumAutoStealSync() end
      if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then
        _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow()
      else
        saveCalciumConfig()
      end end)
  end
end
_, radiusBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Radius", tostring(autoStealRadius), 4)
autoStealRadiusBox = radiusBox
-- Corregge il valore iniziale del box in base al modo caricato dal config
if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
  radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
elseif selectedStealMode == "Semi" then
  radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi or 60)
else
  radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal or 62)
end
radiusBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
  local v = tonumber(radiusBox.Text)
  _G.CalciumStealRadii = _G.CalciumStealRadii or {Normal = 62, Semi = 60, SemiV2Radius = 60, SemiV2SemiRadius = 8}
  if selectedStealMode == "Semi" and selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
    -- In V2: Radius = prime range (PRIME_RANGE)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius = v
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius then _G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius(v) end
    end
    radiusBox.Text = tostring(_G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
  else
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      autoStealRadius = v
    end
    _G.CalciumStealRadii[selectedStealMode] = autoStealRadius
    radiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius)
    if _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSetRadius then _G.CalciumNormalAutoStealSetRadius(_G.CalciumStealRadii.Normal or 62) end
    if _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSetRadius then _G.CalciumSemiAutoStealSetRadius(_G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi or 60) end
  end
  if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumAutoStealSync() end
  saveCalciumConfig()
end)

  local n1 = Instance.new("TextLabel")

  n1.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)

  n1.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  n1.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  n1.ZIndex = 8
  n1.Parent = nvHolder

  local n2 = Instance.new("TextLabel")
  n2.Name = "NormalV2Text"
  n2.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  n2.Text = "NORMAL V2"
  n2.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
  n2.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  n2.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
  n2.TextSize = 11
  n2.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  n2.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
  n2.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  n2.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  n2.ZIndex = 8
  n2.Parent = nvHolder

  local n1Click = Instance.new("TextButton")
  n1Click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  n1Click.Text = ""
  n1Click.AutoButtonColor = false
  n1Click.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  n1Click.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  n1Click.ZIndex = 10
  n1Click.Parent = nvHolder

  local n2Click = Instance.new("TextButton")
  n2Click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  n2Click.Text = ""
  n2Click.AutoButtonColor = false
  n2Click.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
  n2Click.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
  n2Click.ZIndex = 10
  n2Click.Parent = nvHolder

  local function setN(mode)
    if mode ~= "V2" then mode = "V1" end
    selectedNormalMode = mode
    pcall(function() if _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    local onV2 = mode == "V2"
    tween(nvSlide, {
      Position = onV2 and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(n1, {
      TextTransparency = onV2 and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onV2 and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(n2, {
      TextTransparency = onV2 and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = onV2 and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
    if mode == "V2" then
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius then
        pcall(_G.CalciumSemiV2SetRadius, _G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius or 60)
      end
    end
    if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then pcall(_G.CalciumAutoStealSync) end
