      ctGui.Parent = HubGui

      local backdrop = Instance.new("Frame")
      backdrop.Name = "Backdrop"
      backdrop.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
      backdrop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
      backdrop.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
      backdrop.BorderSizePixel = 0
      backdrop.ZIndex = 1
      backdrop.Parent = ctGui

      local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
      frame.Name = "Frame"
      frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 470)
      frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -235)
      frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
      frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
      frame.ZIndex = 2
      frame.Parent = ctGui
      corner(frame, 16)
      stroke(frame, Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 35), 1.2, 0.3)

      local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
      titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 44)
      titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 17)
      titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
      titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
      titleBar.ZIndex = 3
      titleBar.Parent = frame
      corner(titleBar, 16)

      local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
      titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
      titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 0)
      titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      titleLabel.Text = "CUSTOM TOOLS SELECTOR"
      titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
      titleLabel.TextSize = 15
      titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
      titleLabel.ZIndex = 4
      titleLabel.Parent = titleBar

      local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
      closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32, 0, 32)
      closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 6)
      closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 10)
      closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
      closeBtn.Text = "X"
      closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
      closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
      closeBtn.TextSize = 13
      closeBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
      closeBtn.ZIndex = 4
      closeBtn.Parent = titleBar
      corner(closeBtn, 8)
      stroke(closeBtn, Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 35), 1, 0.4)
      closeBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        tween(closeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 50, 50)}, 0.12)
      end)
      closeBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(closeBtn, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 10)}, 0.12)
      end)
      closeBtn.Activated:Connect(closeCTPicker)

      -- ---------- due sezioni: Bat | Medusa ----------
      -- Selettore sezioni: barra piena, niente cornice e niente riquadro
      -- interno. La meta' attiva viene riempita del tutto dal gradiente,
      -- bordo a bordo, cosi' non somiglia agli slider del pannello.
      local tabsHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
      tabsHolder.Name = "Sections"
      tabsHolder.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 23)
      tabsHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
      tabsHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 38)
      tabsHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 58)
      tabsHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
      tabsHolder.ZIndex = 3
      tabsHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
      tabsHolder.Parent = frame
      corner(tabsHolder, 10)

      -- Colore fuori dalla palette della hub: la meta' attiva e' chiara con
      -- testo scuro, cosi' il selettore si distingue e non sembra l'ennesimo
      -- slider viola.
      local slide = Instance.new("Frame")
      slide.Name = "Slide"
      slide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
      slide.BackgroundTransparency = 0
      slide.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      slide.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)   -- riempie l'intera meta'
      slide.Position = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 0.5, 0)
      slide.BorderSizePixel = 0
      slide.ZIndex = 4
      slide.Parent = tabsHolder
      corner(slide, 10)
      local slideGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
      slideGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(206, 210, 224)),
      })
      slideGrad.Rotation = 90
      slideGrad.Parent = slide

      local CATS = { {key = "Bat", text = "BAT"}, {key = "Medusa", text = "MEDUSA"} }
      local catLabels = {}
      for i, c in ipairs(CATS) do
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = c.text
        lbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        lbl.TextSize = 12
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.25 + 0.5 * (i - 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
        lbl.ZIndex = 6
        lbl.Parent = tabsHolder
        catLabels[i] = lbl
      end
      -- ---------- area anteprime ----------
      local page = Instance.new("Frame")
      page.Name = "Page"
      page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, -118)
      page.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 106)
      page.ClipsDescendants = true
      page.ZIndex = 3
      page.Parent = frame

      local cards = {}      -- [i] = {card, cat, key}
      local spinConn = nil

      local function buildCard(def, key, idx)
        local card = Instance.new("Frame")
        card.Name = "Skin_" .. key
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
        card.Size = UDim2.new(0, 148, 0, 172)
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.ZIndex = 4
        card.Visible = false
        card.Parent = page
        corner(card, 14)
        local cStroke = stroke(card, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1.3, 0.5)

        -- Anteprima 3D: ViewportFrame con la mesh vera che ruota
        local vp = Instance.new("ViewportFrame")
        vp.Name = "Preview"
        vp.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 11)
        vp.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25
        vp.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 116)
        vp.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 8)
        vp.BorderSizePixel = 0
        vp.ZIndex = 5
        vp.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 200)
        vp.LightColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        vp.LightDirection = Vector3.new(-0.4, -1, -0.6)
        vp.Parent = card
        corner(vp, 12)

        local part = Instance.new("Part")
        part.Name = "Preview"
        part.Anchored = true
        part.CanCollide = false
        part.Size = Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
        part.Parent = vp

        local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        mesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        mesh.MeshId = def.mesh
        mesh.TextureId = def.tex
        mesh.Scale = def.scale
        mesh.Parent = part

        local cam = Instance.new("Camera")
        cam.FieldOfView = 45
        cam.Parent = vp
        vp.CurrentCamera = cam

        local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLbl.Text = def.label
        nameLbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
        nameLbl.TextSize = 12
        nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        nameLbl.TextWrapped = true
        nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 36)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 130)
        nameLbl.ZIndex = 6
        nameLbl.Parent = card

        local click = Instance.new("TextButton")
        click.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        click.Text = ""
        click.AutoButtonColor = false
        click.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        click.ZIndex = 8
        click.Parent = card

        local entry = { card = card, cat = def.cat, key = key,
                        part = part, stroke = cStroke, idx = idx,
                        vp = vp, cam = cam, def = def }

        -- Distanza fissa per skin, com'era prima: def.view.
        local dist = def.view or 4
        cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, dist * 0.35, dist), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0))


        local function refreshSel()
          local sel = (_G.CalciumCustomToolSkins[def.cat] == key)
          tween(cStroke, {
            -- lo stesso bianco del resto della GUI, non il viola
            Color = sel and COLORS.white or COLORS.strokeSoft,
            Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.5,
            Thickness = sel and 2.2 or 1.3,
          }, 0.14)
          tween(card, {BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0 or 0.15}, 0.14)
        end
        entry.refresh = refreshSel

        -- Hover: la card cresce di 4px in TUTTE le direzioni, cioe' 2 per
        -- lato, spostando anche la posizione di -2/-2. Prima cresceva solo
        -- verso destra e verso il basso, e di 6px: si vedeva lo scarto.
        click.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
          local w = entry.baseW or card.Size.X.Offset
          local x = entry.baseX or card.Position.X.Offset
          tween(card, {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, w + 4, 0, 176),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x - 2, 0, 8),
          }, 0.12)
        end)
        click.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
          local w = entry.baseW or card.Size.X.Offset
          local x = entry.baseX or card.Position.X.Offset
          tween(card, {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 172),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 10),
          }, 0.12)
        end)
        click.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
          if _G.CalciumSetCustomToolSkin then
            _G.CalciumSetCustomToolSkin(def.cat, key)
          end
          for _, e in ipairs(cards) do e.refresh() end
        end)

        refreshSel()
        return entry
      end
      for key, def in pairs(_G.CalciumCustomToolAssets or {}) do
        cards[#cards + 1] = buildCard(def, key, #cards + 1)
      end
      -- Rotazione continua delle anteprime
      spinConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do
          if e.card.Visible and e.part.Parent then
            e.part.CFrame = e.part.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, dt * 1.2, 0)
          end
        end
      end)
      ctGui.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent and spinConn then
          pcall(function() spinConn:Disconnect() end)
          spinConn = nil
        end
      end)

      -- ---------- cambio sezione con scorrimento ----------
      local current = "Bat"

      -- La larghezza si prende dalla misura NOTA del popup, non da
      -- AbsoluteSize: quando il layout gira il riquadro sta ancora crescendo
      -- dall'animazione di apertura e AbsoluteSize e' praticamente zero.
      -- Era per quello che le card finivano incollate a sinistra col bordo
      -- tagliato e lo spazio a destra vuoto.
      local PAGE_W = 420 - 24
      local GAP = 14
      -- Margine interno. Lo UIStroke e' disegnato FUORI dal bordo della card
      -- e la pagina ha ClipsDescendants: se le card arrivavano a filo, la
      -- cornice della prima e dell'ultima veniva tagliata. In piu' l'hover
      -- allarga la card di 6px, che devono avere dove andare.
      local INSET = 9
      -- Le card si dividono tutta la larghezza disponibile: con due riempiono
      -- la riga, con una sola occupa tutto. Quando aggiungeremo altre skin
      -- basta cambiare questa formula (o passare a una griglia su piu' righe).
      local function layoutCat(cat, fromRight, animate)
        local list = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do
          if e.cat == cat then list[#list + 1] = e end
        end
        local n = #list
        if n == 0 then return list end
        local cardW = math.floor((PAGE_W - INSET * 2 - GAP * (n - 1)) / n)
        for i, e in ipairs(list) do
          local targetX = INSET + (i - 1) * (cardW + GAP)
          e.card.Size = UDim2.new(0, cardW, 0, 172)
          e.baseW = cardW
          e.baseX = targetX
          e.card.Visible = true
          if animate then
            e.card.Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX + (fromRight and 300 or -300), 0, 10)
            tween(e.card, {Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, 10)}, 0.24)
          else
            e.card.Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, 10)
          end
        end
        return list
      end
      local switchToken = 0
      local function setCat(cat, animate)
        if cat == current and animate then return end
        local goingRight = (cat == "Medusa")
        switchToken = switchToken + 1
        local myToken = switchToken

        local outList = {}
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do
          if e.cat ~= cat and e.card.Visible then outList[#outList + 1] = e end
        end
        current = cat

        if animate then
          -- Le card che escono vengono nascoste NON appena sono fuori dal
          -- riquadro, non a fine animazione: prima restavano visibili per
          -- tutta la durata dello scorrimento e si vedeva la Katana ferma
          -- mentre gia' entrava la sezione Medusa.
          for _, e in ipairs(outList) do
            local x = e.card.Position.X.Offset
            tween(e.card, {Position = UDim2.new(0, x + (goingRight and -300 or 300), 0, 10)}, 0.18)
          end
          task.delay(0.14, function()
            if myToken ~= switchToken then return end
            for _, e in ipairs(outList) do
              if e.card.Parent then e.card.Visible = false end
            end
          end)
        else
          for _, e in ipairs(outList) do e.card.Visible = false end
        end
        layoutCat(cat, goingRight, animate)
        -- slide + etichette
        local idx = (cat == "Bat") and 1 or 2
        tween(slide, {Position = UDim2.new(0.25 + 0.5 * (idx - 1), 0, 0.5, 0)}, 0.2)
        for i, lbl in ipairs(catLabels) do
          -- sulla meta' chiara il testo va scuro, sull'altra resta chiaro
          tween(lbl, {
            TextColor3 = (i == idx) and Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28) or Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
            TextTransparency = (i == idx) and 0 or 0.35,
          }, 0.16)
        end
      end
      for i, c in ipairs(CATS) do
        local clickTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
        clickTab.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        clickTab.Text = ""
        clickTab.AutoButtonColor = false
        clickTab.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        clickTab.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
        clickTab.Position = UDim2.new(0.25 + 0.5 * (i - 1), 0, 0.5, 0)
        clickTab.ZIndex = 8
        clickTab.Parent = tabsHolder
        local key = c.key
        clickTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setCat(key, true) end)
      end
      backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
           or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeCTPicker()
        end
      end)

      -- stato iniziale, senza animazione
      task.defer(function()
        for _, e in ipairs(cards) do e.card.Visible = false end
        setCat("Bat", false)
      end)

      frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 470),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -210, 0.5, -235)
      }):Play()
    end)
  end
  -- <<< CUSTOM TOOLS + SELETTORE SKIN END

  do
    local rowRT, setVisualRT = toggleRow(Utility, "Rainbow Tools", _G.CalciumRainbowToolsEnabled == true, 12)
    _SV.setRainbowToolsVisual = setVisualRT
    local btn = rowRT and rowRT:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if btn then
      btn.Activated:Connect(function()
        local on = not (_G.CalciumRainbowToolsEnabled == true)
        if _G.CalciumRainbowTools then _G.CalciumRainbowTools.setEnabled(on) end
        if setVisualRT then setVisualRT(on) end
        saveCalciumConfig()
      end)
    end
  end
  do
    local rowTT, setVisualTT = toggleRow(Utility, "Transparent Tools", _G.CalciumTransparentToolsEnabled == true, 12)
    _SV.setTransparentToolsVisual = setVisualTT
    local btn = rowTT and rowTT:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if btn then
      btn.Activated:Connect(function()
        local on = not (_G.CalciumTransparentToolsEnabled == true)
        if _G.CalciumTransparentTools then _G.CalciumTransparentTools.setEnabled(on) end
        if setVisualTT then setVisualTT(on) end
        saveCalciumConfig()
      end)
    end
  end
  do
    -- Custom Sounds removed from GUI
    _G.CalciumCustomSoundsEnabled = false
    pcall(function()
      if _G.CalciumCustomSounds and _G.CalciumCustomSounds.setEnabled then
        _G.CalciumCustomSounds.setEnabled(false)
      end
    end)
  end
-- ===== CAMERA (STRETCH REZ, FOV, FOV VALUE, NO CAM COLLISION) =====
section(Utility, "CAMERA", 13)

-- >>> STRETCH REZ: toggle + tendina BEGIN
-- Il toggle decide se lo stretch e' attivo: spento significa X1, acceso
-- applica il valore scelto nella tendina. La freccetta (stile Infinite Jump)
-- apre lo slider con SOLO i tre valori veri: X1.5, X2, X3 — X1 non e' piu'
-- un'opzione della lista, e' semplicemente "toggle spento".
do
    local STRETCH_PICKS = { {idx = 2, name = "X1.5"}, {idx = 3, name = "X2"}, {idx = 4, name = "X3"} }
    local SEG_N = #STRETCH_PICKS

    -- Valore scelto quando il toggle e' acceso (indice dentro stretchPresetOrder)
    _G.CalciumStretchPick = _G.CalciumStretchPick
        or ((stretchCurrentIndex and stretchCurrentIndex > 1) and stretchCurrentIndex or 2)

    local row, setStretchVisual = toggleRow(Utility, "Stretch Rez", stretchEnabled == true, 14)

    -- ---------- tendina con i tre valori ----------
    local segHolder = Instance.new("Frame")
    segHolder.Name = "Stretch Rez Options"
    segHolder.BackgroundColor3 = COLORS.row
    segHolder.BackgroundTransparency = 0.28
    segHolder.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 46)
    segHolder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    segHolder.LayoutOrder = 14
    segHolder.ZIndex = 4
    segHolder.ClipsDescendants = true
    segHolder.Visible = false
    segHolder.Parent = Utility
    corner(segHolder, 14)
    stroke(segHolder, Color3.fromRGB(200, 85, 25), 1.4, 0.32)
    _G._CalciumRegAccent(segHolder, nil, "soft")

    local segSlide = Instance.new("Frame")
    segSlide.Name = "SelectedSlide"
    segSlide.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)
    segSlide.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    segSlide.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    segSlide.Size = UDim2.new(1 / SEG_N, -4, 1, -8)
    segSlide.Position = UDim2.new(0.5 / SEG_N, 0, 0.5, 0)
    segSlide.BorderSizePixel = 0
    segSlide.ZIndex = 5
    segSlide.Parent = segHolder
    corner(segSlide, 13)
    local segSlideStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    segSlideStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    segSlideStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 90)
    segSlideStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    segSlideStroke.Transparency = 0.1
    segSlideStroke.Parent = segSlide
    local segSlideGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    segSlideGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(202, 148, 255)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 30)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(101, 31, 190)),
    })
    segSlideGrad.Rotation = 22
    segSlideGrad.Parent = segSlide
    _G._CalciumRegAccent(segSlide, segSlideGrad, "slide")

    local segLabels = {}
    local segW = 1 / SEG_N
    for i, p in ipairs(STRETCH_PICKS) do
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Text = p.name
        lbl.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
        lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.2
        lbl.TextSize = 11
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(segW, 0, 1, 0)
        lbl.Position = UDim2.new(segW * (i - 0.5), 0, 0.5, 0)
        lbl.ZIndex = 8
        lbl.Parent = segHolder
        segLabels[i] = lbl

        local clk = Instance.new("TextButton")
        clk.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        clk.Text = ""
        clk.AutoButtonColor = false
        clk.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
        clk.Size = UDim2.new(segW, 0, 1, 0)
        clk.Position = UDim2.new(segW * (i - 0.5), 0, 0.5, 0)
        clk.ZIndex = 10
        clk.Parent = segHolder
        local picked = p.idx
        clk.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            _G.CalciumStretchPick = picked
            -- Se il toggle e' acceso il nuovo valore parte subito;
            -- se e' spento resta memorizzato per la prossima accensione.
            if stretchEnabled then applyStretchPreset(picked) end
            if _G.CalciumRefreshStretchSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshStretchSelector() end
            saveCalciumConfig()
        end)
    end
    local function refreshStretchSelector()
        -- Quale segmento evidenziare: quello scelto, non stretchCurrentIndex,
        -- che a toggle spento vale 1 e non corrisponde a nessun segmento.
        local pick = _G.CalciumStretchPick or 2
        local segIdx = 1
        for i, p in ipairs(STRETCH_PICKS) do
            if p.idx == pick then segIdx = i break end
        end
        tween(segSlide, {
            Position = UDim2.new(segW * (segIdx - 0.5), 0, 0.5, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(segW, -4, 1, -8),
        }, 0.18)
        for i, lbl in ipairs(segLabels) do
            tween(lbl, {
                TextTransparency = (i == segIdx) and 0 or 0.45,
                TextStrokeTransparency = (i == segIdx) and 0.2 or 0.45,
            }, 0.14)
        end
        if setStretchVisual then pcall(setStretchVisual, stretchEnabled == true) end
    end
    _G.CalciumRefreshStretchSelector = refreshStretchSelector

    local sBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if sBtn then
        sBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
            if stretchEnabled then
                applyStretchPreset(1)                       -- spento = X1
            else
                applyStretchPreset(_G.CalciumStretchPick or 2)
            end
            refreshStretchSelector()
            saveCalciumConfig()
        end)
    end
    local sArrow = Instance.new("TextButton")
    sArrow.Name = "StretchRezArrow"
    sArrow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(23, 25, 30)
    sArrow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.18
    sArrow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    sArrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 24)
    sArrow.Position = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0.5, -12)
    sArrow.Text = "^"
    sArrow.TextColor3 = COLORS.white
    sArrow.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    sArrow.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
    sArrow.TextSize = 15
    sArrow.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    sArrow.AutoButtonColor = false
    sArrow.ZIndex = 30
    sArrow.Active = true
    sArrow.Parent = row
    corner(sArrow, 7)
    stroke(sArrow, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.45)

    local sExpanded = false
    sArrow.Activated:Connect(function()
        sExpanded = not sExpanded
        _G._CalciumExpand(segHolder, sExpanded, 42, sArrow)
    end)

    refreshStretchSelector()
end
-- <<< STRETCH REZ: toggle + tendina END

-- ===== MOTION BLUR =====
do
    local function _startMotionBlur()
        if _motionBlurConn then pcall(function() _motionBlurConn:Disconnect() end); _motionBlurConn = nil end
        -- Crea o recupera il BlurEffect in Lighting
        if not _motionBlurEffect or not _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
            _motionBlurEffect = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("BlurEffect")
            if not _motionBlurEffect then
                _motionBlurEffect = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
                _motionBlurEffect.Name = "CalciumMotionBlur"
            end
        end
        _motionBlurEffect.Size = 0
        _motionBlurEffect.Enabled = true
        _motionBlurEffect.Parent = Lighting
        local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
        local lastCFrame = camera.CFrame
        _motionBlurCurrentValue = 0
        _motionBlurConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
            if not motionBlurEnabled then
                if _motionBlurConn then pcall(function() _motionBlurConn:Disconnect() end); _motionBlurConn = nil end
                if _motionBlurEffect and _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
                    _motionBlurEffect.Size = 0
                    _motionBlurEffect.Enabled = false
                end
                return
            end
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if not cam then return end
            local currentCF = cam.CFrame
            local dot = currentCF.LookVector:Dot(lastCFrame.LookVector)
            local angleRad = math.acos(math.clamp(dot, -1, 1))
            local angleDeg = math.deg(angleRad)
            local speed = angleDeg * 20
            local targetBlur = math.min(speed, 7)
            _motionBlurCurrentValue = _motionBlurCurrentValue + (targetBlur - _motionBlurCurrentValue) * math.min(1, deltaTime * 10)
            if _motionBlurEffect and _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
                _motionBlurEffect.Size = _motionBlurCurrentValue
            end
            lastCFrame = currentCF
        end)
    end
    local function _stopMotionBlur()
        if _motionBlurConn then pcall(function() _motionBlurConn:Disconnect() end); _motionBlurConn = nil end
        if _motionBlurEffect and _motionBlurEffect.Parent then
            _motionBlurEffect.Size = 0
            _motionBlurEffect.Enabled = false
        end
        _motionBlurCurrentValue = 0
    end
    local row, setVisual = toggleRow(Utility, "Motion Blur", motionBlurEnabled, 15)
    _SV.setMotionBlurVisual = setVisual
    local _mblurBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if _mblurBtn then
        _mblurBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
            motionBlurEnabled = not motionBlurEnabled
            if motionBlurEnabled then
                _startMotionBlur()
            else
                _stopMotionBlur()
            end
            if setVisual then setVisual(motionBlurEnabled) end
            saveCalciumConfig()
        end)
    end
    -- Ripristina lo stato al load
    if motionBlurEnabled then
        _startMotionBlur()
    end
end
-- ORDINE CAMERA: Stretch Rez (14) -> FOV (14) -> Motion Blur (15) -> No Cam Collision (16)
do
    local row, setVisual = toggleRow(Utility, "No Cam Collision", noCamCollisionEnabled, 16)
    _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual = setVisual
    _calciumBtn = row and row:FindFirstChild("ToggleButton")
    if _calciumBtn then
        _G.CalciumWireToggle(_calciumBtn, function() if noCamCollisionEnabled then disableNoCamCollision() else enableNoCamCollision() end
            if setVisual then setVisual(noCamCollisionEnabled) end
            saveCalciumConfig() end)
    end
end

local function applyCalciumProgressBarScale()
  local sg = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubStealBarGui")
  local bar = sg and sg:FindFirstChild("StealBar")
  if not bar then return end
  local sc = bar:FindFirstChild("CalciumProgressBarScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
  sc.Name = "CalciumProgressBarScale"
  sc.Scale = calciumProgressBarScaleValue
  sc.Parent = bar

  -- UIScale ridimensiona i frame ma NON il TextSize fisso: senza questo
  -- le scritte restavano sempre della stessa grandezza. La misura di
  -- partenza di ogni label si salva una volta in un attributo, cosi' lo
  -- scaling parte sempre dal valore originale e non si accumula.
  for _, d in ipairs(bar:GetDescendants()) do
    if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") or d:IsA("TextBox") then
      local base = d:GetAttribute("AmbBaseTextSize")
      if not base then
        base = d.TextSize
        d:SetAttribute("AmbBaseTextSize", base)
      end
      pcall(function()
        d.TextSize = math.max(1, math.floor(base * calciumProgressBarScaleValue + 0.5))
      end)
    end
  end
end
_G.CalciumApplyProgressBarScale = applyCalciumProgressBarScale

  -- ===== FINE CUSTOM BACKGROUND ROW =====

-- ============================================================
-- LIGHTWEIGHT BUILT-IN FONT PICKER
-- Starborn/custom asset loading and the hundreds-entry font variant
-- catalog were removed to avoid startup stutter and background text scans.
-- Default keeps each control's original font. Other options are Roblox's
-- built-in Enum.Font families only; no web requests, asset downloads, or
-- TextService measurement loops run automatically.
-- ============================================================
do
  local F = _G.CalciumFonts or {}

  -- Disconnect font listeners left behind by an older execution of this script.
  for _, c in ipairs(F.conns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
  for _, c in pairs(F.aconns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
  for _, c in pairs(F.tconns or {}) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
  if F.charConn then pcall(function() F.charConn:Disconnect() end) end
  F.charConn = nil

  F.conns = {}
  F.aconns = {}
  F.tconns = {}
  F.orig = F.orig or {}
  F.size = F.size or {}
  F.cache = nil
  F.starborn = nil
  F.starbornLoading = nil
  F.starbornError = nil
  _G.CalciumFonts = F
  if _G.CalciumFontChoice == "Starborn" or type(_G.CalciumFontChoice) ~= "string" then
    _G.CalciumFontChoice = "Default"
  end

  function F.list()
    if F.cache then return F.cache end
    local out = {{key = "Default", label = "Default", font = nil}}
    for _, item in ipairs(Enum.Font:GetEnumItems()) do
      if item.Name ~= "Unknown" then
        local ok, font = pcall(function() return Font.fromEnum(item) end)
        if ok and font then
          out[#out + 1] = {key = item.Name, label = item.Name, font = font}
        end
      end
    end
    F.cache = out
    return out
  end

  function F.byKey(key)
    for _, entry in ipairs(F.list()) do
      if entry.key == key then return entry end
    end
    return nil
  end

  function F.roots()
    local roots = {}
    if HubGui then roots[#roots + 1] = HubGui end
    local playerGui = LP and LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    if playerGui then
      for _, root in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
        if root ~= HubGui and root:IsA("ScreenGui") and root.Name:sub(1, 7) == "Calcium"
          and (not HubGui or not root:IsDescendantOf(HubGui)) then
          roots[#roots + 1] = root
        end
      end
    end
    local char = LP and LP.Character
    local head = char and char:FindFirstChild("Head")
    local overhead = head and head:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubOverheadInfo")
    if overhead then roots[#roots + 1] = overhead end
    return roots
  end

  function F.current()
    local key = _G.CalciumFontChoice or "Default"
    if key == "Default" then return nil end
    local entry = F.byKey(key)
    return entry and entry.font or nil
  end

  function F.applyOne(obj, font)
    if not obj or not (obj:IsA("TextLabel") or obj:IsA("TextButton") or obj:IsA("TextBox")) then return end
    if obj:GetAttribute("AmbFontLock") then return end
    if tostring(obj.FontFace.Family):find("BuilderIcons", 1, true) then return end
    if F.orig[obj] == nil then F.orig[obj] = obj.FontFace end
    pcall(function()
      obj.FontFace = font or F.orig[obj]
    end)
  end

  function F.applyAll()
    local font = F.current()
    for _, root in ipairs(F.roots()) do
      if root:IsA("TextLabel") or root:IsA("TextButton") or root:IsA("TextBox") then
        F.applyOne(root, font)
      end
      for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        F.applyOne(obj, font)
      end
    end
  end

  function F.hook()
    for _, c in ipairs(F.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    F.conns = {}
    if (_G.CalciumFontChoice or "Default") == "Default" then return end
    local font = F.current()
    for _, root in ipairs(F.roots()) do
      F.conns[#F.conns + 1] = root.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
        if (_G.CalciumFontChoice or "Default") ~= "Default" then
          F.applyOne(obj, F.current())
        end
      end)
    end
  end

  function F.set(key, skipSave)
    if type(key) ~= "string" or not F.byKey(key) then key = "Default" end
    _G.CalciumFontChoice = key
    F.applyAll()
    F.hook()
    if not skipSave and type(saveCalciumConfig) == "function" then
      pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
    end
  end

  -- Validate a persisted choice without even building the font list on
  -- startup when Default is selected. Old custom-family keys and Starborn
  -- are unsupported and fall back to Default.
  local choice = _G.CalciumFontChoice or "Default"
  if choice == "Starborn" then choice = "Default" end
  if choice ~= "Default" and not F.byKey(choice) then choice = "Default" end
  _G.CalciumFontChoice = choice

  if not F.charConn and LP then
    F.charConn = LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
      task.delay(1.5, function()
        if (_G.CalciumFontChoice or "Default") ~= "Default" then
          pcall(F.applyAll)
          pcall(F.hook)
        end
      end)
    end)
  end
end

      end)
      fpClose.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        tween(fpClose, {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 10)}, 0.12)
      end)
      fpClose.Activated:Connect(closeFontPicker)

      local fpScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
      fpScroll.Name = "Scroll"
      fpScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -64)
      fpScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 56)
      fpScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      fpScroll.BorderSizePixel = 0
      fpScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
      fpScroll.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 35)
      fpScroll.ZIndex = 3
      fpScroll.Parent = fpFrame

      -- RIUSO DELLE CARD (niente UIGridLayout)
      -- I font sono centinaia: creare una card per ognuno vuol dire
      -- migliaia di istanze in un colpo solo, ed e' quello lo scatto
      -- all'apertura. Qui le card create sono solo quelle che entrano
      -- nello schermo piu' una riga di margine: scorrendo non se ne
      -- creano altre, si riscrive il contenuto di quelle che ci sono.
      -- La griglia viene calcolata a mano perche' un UIGridLayout
      -- pretenderebbe che tutte le celle esistessero davvero: le misure
      -- pero' sono identiche a quelle dello Sky Picker (108 + 10 di gap).
      local FP_COLS, FP_CELL, FP_GAP = 3, 108, 10
      local FP_STEP = FP_CELL + FP_GAP
      local fpList = _G.CalciumFonts.list()
      local fpRows = math.ceil(#fpList / FP_COLS)
      -- L'altezza del canvas e' quella che avrebbero TUTTE le righe: la
      -- barra di scorrimento resta giusta anche se le card non esistono.
      fpScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 16 + fpRows * FP_STEP)

      local fpPool = {}

      local function fpEntryOf(card)
        local idx = card:GetAttribute("FontIdx")
        return idx and fpList[idx] or nil
      end
      local function fpPaint()
        for _, c in ipairs(fpPool) do
          local e = fpEntryOf(c)
          local sel = (e ~= nil and _G.CalciumFontChoice == e.key)
          local st = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
          if st then
            tween(st, {
              Color = sel and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(45, 28, 22),
              Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.55,
              Thickness = sel and 2.4 or 1.2,
            }, 0.12)
          end
        end
      end
      local function fpBind(card, idx)
        local e = fpList[idx]
        if not e then
          card:SetAttribute("FontIdx", nil)
          card.Visible = false
          return
        end
        local row = math.floor((idx - 1) / FP_COLS)
        local col = (idx - 1) % FP_COLS
        card.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10 + col * FP_STEP, 0, 8 + row * FP_STEP)
        card:SetAttribute("FontIdx", idx)
        local prv = card:FindFirstChild("Preview")
        if prv then
          if e.font then prv.FontFace = e.font else prv.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold end
        end
        local nl = card:FindFirstChild("FontName")
        if nl then nl.Text = e.label end
        card.Visible = true
      end
      -- Quante card servono davvero: le righe visibili piu' due di
      -- margine, cosi' scorrendo non si vede mai un buco.
      for j = 1, (math.ceil(456 / FP_STEP) + 2) * FP_COLS do
        local card = Instance.new("TextButton")
        card.Name = "FontCard_" .. tostring(j)
        card.Size = UDim2.new(0, FP_CELL, 0, FP_CELL)
        card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18)
        card.BackgroundTransparency = 0
        card.BorderSizePixel = 0
        card.Text = ""
        card.AutoButtonColor = false
        card.Visible = false
        card.ZIndex = 4
        card.ClipsDescendants = true
        card.Parent = fpScroll
        corner(card, 18)

        local cardStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
        cardStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
        cardStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 28, 22)
        cardStroke.Thickness = 1.2
        cardStroke.Transparency = 0.55
        cardStroke.Parent = card

        -- ANTEPRIMA. L'attributo la mette fuori dalla portata del motore
        -- dei font: senza, il font appena scelto verrebbe applicato anche
        -- a lei — sta dentro la hub come tutto il resto — e i campioni
        -- diventerebbero tutti uguali.
        local prv = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        prv.Name = "Preview"
        prv.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        prv.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 58)
        prv.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 8)
        prv.Text = "Aa"
        prv.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        prv.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        prv.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        prv.TextSize = 34
        prv.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        prv.ZIndex = 5
        prv.Parent = card
        prv:SetAttribute("AmbFontLock", true)

        local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        nameLbl.Name = "FontName"
        nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 32)
        nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 1, -36)
        nameLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nameLbl.Text = ""
        nameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        nameLbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        nameLbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
        nameLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        nameLbl.TextSize = 9
        nameLbl.TextWrapped = true
        nameLbl.ZIndex = 6
        nameLbl.Parent = card
        nameLbl:SetAttribute("AmbFontLock", true)

        card.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
          tween(cardStroke, {Transparency = 0, Thickness = 2.4}, 0.12)
          tween(prv, {TextSize = 40}, 0.12)
        end)
        card.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
          local e = fpEntryOf(card)
          local sel = (e ~= nil and _G.CalciumFontChoice == e.key)
          tween(cardStroke, {
            Transparency = sel and 0 or 0.55,
            Thickness = sel and 2.4 or 1.2,
          }, 0.12)
          tween(prv, {TextSize = 34}, 0.12)
        end)

        card.Activated:Connect(function()
          local e = fpEntryOf(card)
          if not e then return end
          _G.CalciumFonts.set(e.key)
          fpPaint()
        end)

        fpPool[#fpPool + 1] = card
      end
      -- Si ridisegna solo quando cambia la prima riga visibile: durante
      -- uno scorrimento fluido la maggior parte dei frame non fa nulla.
      local fpFirstRow = -1
      local function fpRender()
        local first = math.max(0, math.floor((fpScroll.CanvasPosition.Y - 8) / FP_STEP) - 1)
        if first == fpFirstRow then return end
        fpFirstRow = first
        for j, card in ipairs(fpPool) do
          fpBind(card, first * FP_COLS + j)
        end
        fpPaint()
      end
      fpScroll:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"):Connect(fpRender)
      fpRender()

      fpBack.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeFontPicker()
        end
      end)

      fpFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
      fpFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
      TweenService:Create(fpFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 380, 0, 520),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -190, 0.5, -260)
      }):Play()
    end)
  end)()

    stroke(plus, COLORS.strokeSoft, 1, 0.5)

    local function setValue(nextValue)
      value = math.clamp(math.floor((nextValue * 100) + 0.5) / 100, minValue or 0.50, maxValue or 1.50)
      valueBox.Text = string.format("%.2f", value)
      if callback then callback(value) end
    end
    minus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      setValue(value - 0.05)
    end)
    plus.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      setValue(value + 0.05)
    end)
    return row
  end

      -- REFRESH UI
      local function refresh()
        if not (mpGui and mpGui.Parent) then return end
        nameLbl.Text = getMusicSongName()
        counterLbl.Text = "TRACK " .. tostring(selectedMusicSong) .. " / " .. tostring(#MUSIC_PLAYER_OPTIONS)
        volValue.Text = string.format("%.2f", musicPlayerVolume)
        spdValue.Text = string.format("%.1fx", musicPlayerSpeed)
        -- Le pill rispecchiano sempre lo stato reale delle variabili
        if applyAutoNext then applyAutoNext(musicAutoPlayNext == true) end
        if applyShuffle then applyShuffle(musicShuffleEnabled == true) end
        if applyLoop then applyLoop(musicLoopEnabled == true) end
        local s = _musicPlayerSound
        local alive = s and s.Parent
        playBtn.Text = (alive and s.IsPlaying) and "PAUSE" or "PLAY"
        if alive then
          -- Durata e posizione mostrate come tempo REALE di ascolto: a 2x
          -- la canzone dura la meta', a 0.5x il doppio. TimeLength e
          -- TimePosition di Roblox sono sempre in tempo della traccia, non
          -- tengono conto di PlaybackSpeed, quindi si divide qui.
          local sp = tonumber(musicPlayerSpeed) or 1
          if sp <= 0 then sp = 1 end
          local len = (s.TimeLength or 0) / sp
          local pos = (s.TimePosition or 0) / sp
          if len > 0 then
            barFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
            curLbl.Text = _mpFmtTime(pos)
            totLbl.Text = _mpFmtTime(len)
          else
            barFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
            curLbl.Text = "0:00"
            totLbl.Text = "--:--"
          end
        else
          barFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
          curLbl.Text = "0:00"
          totLbl.Text = "0:00"
        end
      end
      _G.CalciumMusicRefreshUI = refresh
      refresh()

      task.spawn(function()
        while mpGui and mpGui.Parent do
          pcall(refresh)
          task.wait(0.2)
        end
      end)

      backdrop.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          closeMusicPlayer()
        end
      end)

      frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
      frame.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
      if _G.CalciumStylePanel then _G.CalciumStylePanel(frame) end

        if not frame.Parent then return end
        local scale = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
        local target = scale and scale.Scale or 1
        if scale then
          scale.Scale = target * 0.96
          TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = target}):Play()
        end
        TweenService:Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(0.22), {GroupTransparency = 0}):Play()
      end)
    end)
  end

_G.CalciumHandleBoundInput = function(input, gameProcessed)
  local isControllerInput = tostring(input.UserInputType):find("Gamepad") ~= nil
  local isMB3 = input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3

  -- Helper: verifica se un keybind (KeyCode o "MB3") corrisponde all'input corrente
  local function isKeyMatch(boundKey)
    if not boundKey then return false end
    if boundKey == "MB3" then return isMB3 end
    return (not isMB3) and input.KeyCode == boundKey
  end
  if gameProcessed and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not listeningForSpeedKey and not listeningForTPDownKey then return end
  if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
  -- Lascia passare: tastiera, gamepad, oppure MB3 (durante listening o come tasto bindato)
  if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not isControllerInput and not isMB3 then return end
  if isControllerInput and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick1 or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Thumbstick2) then return end
  -- Blocca KeyCode.Unknown solo per input che NON sono MB3
  if not isMB3 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end


  if listeningForSpeedKey then
    if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
    local targetKey = listeningForSpeedKey
    -- Escape annulla il listening (solo tastiera)
    if not isMB3 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
      listeningForSpeedKey = nil
      refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
      return
    end
    -- Backspace/Delete rimuove il binding (solo tastiera)
    if not isMB3 and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete) then
      speedKeybinds[targetKey] = nil
    else
      -- Il tasto da bindare: "MB3" oppure il KeyCode premuto
      local pressedKey = isMB3 and "MB3" or input.KeyCode
      -- Rimuove eventuali duplicati su altri keybind
      for otherKeyId, boundKey in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
        if otherKeyId ~= targetKey and boundKey == pressedKey then
          speedKeybinds[otherKeyId] = nil
        end
      end
      if tpDownKeybind == pressedKey then
        tpDownKeybind = nil
        refreshTPDownKeybind()
      end
      speedKeybinds[targetKey] = pressedKey
    end
    listeningForSpeedKey = nil
    refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
    if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then
      _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow()
    else
      saveCalciumConfig()
    end
    return
  end
  if listeningForTPDownKey then
    if tick() - (keybindListenStartedAt or 0) < 0.18 then return end
    if not isMB3 and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
      listeningForTPDownKey = false
      refreshTPDownKeybind()
      return
    end
    if not isMB3 and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backspace or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Delete) then
      tpDownKeybind = nil
    else
      local pressedKey = isMB3 and "MB3" or input.KeyCode
      for keyId, boundKey in pairs(speedKeybinds) do
        if boundKey == pressedKey then
          speedKeybinds[keyId] = nil
        end
      end
      tpDownKeybind = pressedKey
    end
    listeningForTPDownKey = false
    refreshAllSpeedKeybinds()
    refreshTPDownKeybind()
    if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then
      _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow()
    else
      saveCalciumConfig()
    end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.ToggleUI) then
    local host = PhoneChassis or Main
    local open = host and host.Visible ~= false and not (_G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized == true)
    if open then
      if _G.CalciumHubClose then _G.CalciumHubClose(true)
      else host.Visible = false; if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = true end end
    else
      if _G.CalciumHubOpen then _G.CalciumHubOpen()
      else
        host.Visible = true
        if Main then Main.Visible = true; Main.Size = FULL_MAIN_SIZE; Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.5,0) end
        if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = false end
        _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized = false
      end
    end
    pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.SpeedToggle) then
    toggleCarryMode()
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.LaggerToggle) then
    toggleLaggerMode()
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.Aimbot) then
    if _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked and _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked() then
      if _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop then _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
      return
    end
    if _G.CalciumToggleSelectedAimbot then
      _G.CalciumToggleSelectedAimbot()
    elseif selectedAimbotMode == "V2" and _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2 and _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 then
      if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On then _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2() else _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2() end
    elseif _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot and _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot then
      if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn then _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot() else _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot() end
    end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.TPBat) then
    if _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked and _G.CalciumSafeModeIsLocked() then
      if _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop then _G.CalciumSafeModeForceStop("SAFE MODE LOCK") end
      return
    end
    if _G.CalciumToggleTPBatManual then
      _G.CalciumToggleTPBatManual()
    elseif _G.CalciumToggleTPBat then
      _G.CalciumToggleTPBat()
    end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.DropBrainrot) then
    if selectedDropMode == "Stand Still" then
      runDropStandStill()
    else
      runDropBrainrot()
    end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.AutoPlay) then
    if _G.CalciumAutoPlayToggle then _G.CalciumAutoPlayToggle() end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(speedKeybinds.InstantReset) then
    -- Explicit keyboard/controller bind; preserve the stationary reset guard.
    if gameProcessed then return end
    if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and not isControllerInput then return end
    local kc = input.KeyCode
    if not kc or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then return end
    local forbidden = {
      [Enum.KeyCode.W]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.A]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.S]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.D]=true,
      [Enum.KeyCode.Up]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.Down]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.Left]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.Right]=true,
      [Enum.KeyCode.Space]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.RightShift]=true,
      [Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl]=true,[Enum.KeyCode.RightControl]=true,
    }
    if forbidden[kc] then return end
    -- sanitize bind if config corrupted it into a movement key
    local bound = speedKeybinds.InstantReset
    if forbidden[bound] then
      speedKeybinds.InstantReset = Enum.KeyCode.G
      return
    end
    if bound ~= kc then return end
    local hum = LP.Character and LP.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.08 then return end
    local token = _G._CalciumArmInstantReset and _G._CalciumArmInstantReset("keybind")
    if token and _G.CalciumInstantReset then _G.CalciumInstantReset("keybind", token) end
    return
  end
  if isKeyMatch(tpDownKeybind) then
    runTPFloor()
    return
  end
end
do
  local held = {}
  local function analog(input)
    return input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonL2 or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.ButtonR2
  end
  local function trigger(input, processed)
    local id = tostring(input.UserInputType) .. ":" .. input.KeyCode.Name
    if input.Position.Z >= 0.55 and not held[id] then
      held[id] = true
      _G.CalciumHandleBoundInput(input, processed)
    elseif input.Position.Z <= 0.2 then held[id] = nil end
  end
  UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if analog(input) then trigger(input, processed)
    else _G.CalciumHandleBoundInput(input, processed) end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if analog(input) then trigger(input, processed) end
  end)
  UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    held[tostring(input.UserInputType) .. ":" .. input.KeyCode.Name] = nil
  end)
  UserInputService.GamepadDisconnected:Connect(function() table.clear(held) end)
  UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() table.clear(held) end)
end

      if pingConn then pcall(function() pingConn:Disconnect() end) pingConn = nil end
      if on then
        pingConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
          local t0 = os.clock()
          while os.clock() - t0 < 0.02 do end
        end)
      end
      return on
    end

      -- Prefer full Duels V2 panel

        _G.CalciumOpenBypass()

        if showActionNotification then showActionNotification("SPEED BYPASS loading...") end

          task.wait(0.3)
          if type(_G.SpeedOpenBypass) == "function" then _G.SpeedOpenBypass()
          elseif type(_G.CalciumOpenBypass) == "function" then _G.CalciumOpenBypass() end
        end)
      end
    end)

    -- Persistent ping lag state (Duels-style)
    if calciumPingOn == nil then calciumPingOn = false end
    if calciumPingPower == nil then calciumPingPower = 80000 end
    local function applyPingLag(on)
      calciumPingOn = on and true or false
      if calciumPingConn then pcall(function() calciumPingConn:Disconnect() end) calciumPingConn = nil end
      if calciumPingOn and (_G._CalciumPingPanelOpen == true) then
        calciumPingConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
          local t0 = os.clock()
          local budget = math.clamp((tonumber(calciumPingPower) or 80000) / 4000000, 0.008, 0.04)
          while os.clock() - t0 < budget do end
        end)
      end
      return calciumPingOn
    end
    setPingLag = applyPingLag

    makeOpenRow("PING LAGGER", 54.2, function()
      -- Exact Duels V2 panel
      if type(_G.CalciumOpenPingLagger) == "function" then
        _G.CalciumOpenPingLagger()
      else
        task.defer(function()
          task.wait(0.25)
          if type(_G.CalciumOpenPingLagger) == "function" then _G.CalciumOpenPingLagger() end
        end)
      end
    end)

    makeOpenRow("LAGGER PANEL", 54.3, function()
      -- Exact Duels V2 Calcium Lagger panel
      if type(_G.CalciumOpenLagger) == "function" then
        _G.CalciumOpenLagger()
      else
        task.defer(function()
          task.wait(0.25)
          if type(_G.CalciumOpenLagger) == "function" then _G.CalciumOpenLagger() end
        end)
      end
    end)
  end
end
