-- Shared panel presentation. Gameplay callbacks are owned by the original panels.
;(function()
  local registered = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
  local function round(object, radius)
    local c = object:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner", object)
    c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
  end
  local function sync(frame, entry)
    if not frame.Parent then return end
    entry.image.Image, entry.image.ImageColor3 = BgImage.Image, BgImage.ImageColor3
    entry.image.Visible = BgImage.Visible
    entry.image.ImageTransparency = math.max(0.15, BgImage.ImageTransparency)
    if frame.Parent.Name == "CalciumHubMusicPlayer" then
      local palette = _G._CalciumBgPalette()
      local edge = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if edge then edge.Color, edge.Transparency = palette[4], 0.65 end
    end
  end
  local function fit(frame, entry)
    if not frame.Parent then return end
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    local w, h = math.max(1, frame.Size.X.Offset), math.max(1, frame.Size.Y.Offset)
    local touch = UserInputService:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or (UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled)
    local desired = frame.Parent.Name == "SpeedBypassGui" and 1.5 or (touch and 1.08 or 1)
    entry.scale.Scale = math.min(desired, math.max(100, vp.X - 24) / w, math.max(100, vp.Y - 48) / h)
    local width, height = w * entry.scale.Scale, h * entry.scale.Scale
    local x = frame.Position.X.Scale * vp.X + frame.Position.X.Offset
    local y = frame.Position.Y.Scale * vp.Y + frame.Position.Y.Offset
    x = math.clamp(x, 8 + width * frame.AnchorPoint.X, math.max(8 + width * frame.AnchorPoint.X, vp.X - width * (1 - frame.AnchorPoint.X) - 8))
    y = math.clamp(y, 8 + height * frame.AnchorPoint.Y, math.max(8 + height * frame.AnchorPoint.Y, vp.Y - height * (1 - frame.AnchorPoint.Y) - 8))
    frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
  end
  _G._CalciumApplyPanelBg = function(frame)
    if not frame or not frame.Parent then return end
    if registered[frame] then sync(frame, registered[frame]); fit(frame, registered[frame]); return end
    for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
      if child.Name == "PanelBgImage" or child.Name == "PanelDim" then child:Destroy() end
    end
    frame.BackgroundColor3, frame.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(15, 17, 24), 0
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    round(frame, 18)
    local edge = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke") or Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    edge.Color, edge.Thickness, edge.Transparency = Color3.fromRGB(80, 126, 146), 1, 0.45
    local image = Instance.new("ImageLabel", frame)
    image.Name, image.Size = "PanelBgImage", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    image.BackgroundTransparency, image.ScaleType, image.ZIndex = 1, Enum.ScaleType.Crop, 0
    round(image, 18)
    local dim = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    dim.Name, dim.Size = "PanelDim", UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    dim.BackgroundColor3, dim.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(8, 11, 19), frame.Parent.Name == "CalciumHubMusicPlayer" and 0.6 or 0.22
    dim.BorderSizePixel, dim.ZIndex = 0, 1
    round(dim, 18)
    local tint = Instance.new("UIGradient", dim)
    tint.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.35)})
    tint.Rotation = 100
    local entry = {image = image, scale = frame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", frame)}
    registered[frame] = entry
    local styled = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
    local function style(control)
      if styled[control] or control == image or control == dim then return end
      styled[control] = true
      if control:IsA("TextLabel") or control:IsA("TextButton") or control:IsA("TextBox") then
        control.TextStrokeTransparency = 1
        control.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
      end
      if frame.Parent.Name == "CalciumHubMusicPlayer" then
        if control:IsA("UIStroke") and control.Parent ~= frame then
          control.Transparency = 0.85
        elseif control:IsA("Frame") and control.Parent == frame and control.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then
          control.BackgroundColor3, control.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(30, 34, 46), 0.45
        elseif control:IsA("TextLabel") and (control.Name == "Title" or control.Name == "SongName") then
          control.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        end
      end
      if control:IsA("TextButton") then
        if control.BackgroundTransparency < 1 and control.Name ~= "PreferenceSwitch" then
          control.BackgroundColor3, control.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(34, 37, 49), 0.12
          control.BorderSizePixel = 0
          round(control, 10)
        end
        control.Activated:Connect(function() pcall(playClick) end)
      elseif control:IsA("TextBox") then
        control.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 23, 32)
        control.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 235, 226)
        control.BorderSizePixel = 0
        round(control, 9)
      elseif control:IsA("Frame") and control.Parent == frame and control.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and control.Position.Y.Offset <= 8 and control.Size.Y.Offset >= 24 then
        control.BackgroundColor3, control.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(24, 26, 36), 0.25
        round(control, 14)
      end
    end
    for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetDescendants()) do style(child) end
    frame.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(child) task.defer(function() if child.Parent then style(child) end end) end)
    sync(frame, entry)
    if frame.Parent.Name == "CalciumHubMusicPlayer" then
      fit(frame, entry)
    else
      task.defer(function() fit(frame, entry) end)
    end
  end
  _G.CalciumStylePanel = _G._CalciumApplyPanelBg
  _G._CalciumRefreshAllPanelBgs = function()
    for frame, entry in pairs(registered) do
      if frame.Parent then sync(frame, entry) else registered[frame] = nil end
    end
  end
  for _, property in ipairs({"Image", "ImageColor3", "ImageTransparency", "Visible"}) do
    BgImage:GetPropertyChangedSignal(property):Connect(_G._CalciumRefreshAllPanelBgs)
  end
  _G.CalciumThemeChanged.Event:Connect(function()
    for frame, entry in pairs(registered) do
      if frame.Parent and frame.Parent.Name == "CalciumHubMusicPlayer" then sync(frame, entry) end
    end
  end)
  UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function()
    for frame, entry in pairs(registered) do
      if frame.Parent then fit(frame, entry) end
    end
  end)
  local connection
  local function watchCamera()
    if connection then connection:Disconnect() end
    if workspace.CurrentCamera then
      connection = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
        for frame, entry in pairs(registered) do fit(frame, entry) end
      end)
    end
  end
  workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(watchCamera)
  watchCamera()
end)()

_G.__CalciumDuelsSetupStealBar = function()
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    local parentGui = HubGui or Gui or PlayerGui
    if not parentGui then return end
    for _, p in ipairs({HubGui, Gui, PlayerGui}) do
      if p then
        for _, n in ipairs({"CalciumStealBar", "CalciumInfoBar", "CalciumHubStealBarGui", "CalciumStealBarHost"}) do
          local o = p:FindFirstChild(n)
          if o then pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
        end
      end
    end
    local host = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    host.Name = "CalciumStealBarHost"
    host.ResetOnSpawn = false
    host.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    host.DisplayOrder = 50
    host.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    host.Parent = parentGui

    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Name = "CalciumStealBar"
    bar.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
    bar.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -18)
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 390, 0, 78)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(6, 8, 14)
    bar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.05
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Active = true
    bar.ClipsDescendants = false -- headshot stroke must not get clipped
    bar.ZIndex = 70
    bar.Parent = host
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 20)
    -- Drag the bar from any empty surface; mouse and touch both supported.
    -- Keep only one drag state per bar, and disconnect listeners when destroyed.
    do
      local dragging, dragStart, startPos, dragInput = false, nil, nil, nil
      local dragChanged, dragEnded
      local function clampPosition(pos)
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local vp = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
        local w, h = bar.AbsoluteSize.X, bar.AbsoluteSize.Y
        local centerX = math.clamp(pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset, w / 2 + 6, vp.X - w / 2 - 6)
        local bottomY = math.clamp(pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset, h + 6, vp.Y - 6)
        return UDim2.fromOffset(centerX, bottomY)
      end
      bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragInput = input
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = bar.Position
      end)
      dragChanged = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging or not dragStart or not startPos then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= dragInput then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        bar.Position = clampPosition(UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y))
        _G.CalciumStealBarUserMoved = true
      end)
      dragEnded = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not dragging then return end
        if input == dragInput or (dragInput and dragInput.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
          dragging = false
          savedStealBarPositionTable = udim2ToTable(bar.Position)
          pcall(function() if type(saveConfig) == "function" then saveConfig() end end)
        end
      end)
      bar.Destroying:Connect(function()
        if dragChanged then dragChanged:Disconnect() end
        if dragEnded then dragEnded:Disconnect() end
      end)
    end

    local barStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", bar)
    barStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 135, 45)
    barStroke.Thickness = 1.6
    barStroke.Transparency = 0.2
    -- Clean charcoal + warm amber: no rainbow/Aurora edge.
    local barGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    barGradient.Rotation = 90
    barGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(22, 23, 29)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(8, 10, 15))
    })
    barGradient.Parent = bar
    barStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 156, 73)
    barStroke.Transparency = 0.27
    -- headshot
    -- Headshot in padded holder so stroke never clips
    local hsHold = Instance.new("Frame", bar)
    hsHold.Name = "HeadshotHold"
    hsHold.Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 0, 48)
    hsHold.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -24)
    hsHold.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hsHold.BorderSizePixel = 0
    hsHold.ZIndex = 76
    hsHold.ClipsDescendants = false
    local headshot = Instance.new("ImageLabel", hsHold)
    headshot.Name = "Headshot"
    headshot.Size = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 42)
    headshot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -21, 0.5, -21)
    headshot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 28, 44)
    headshot.BorderSizePixel = 0
    headshot.ZIndex = 77
    headshot.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Crop
    Instance.new("UICorner", headshot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local hsStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", headshot)
    hsStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 155, 70)
    hsStroke.Thickness = 1.5
    hsStroke.Transparency = 0.1
    pcall(function()
      headshot.Image = string.format("rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=%s&w=150&h=150", tostring(LP.UserId))
    end)
    -- falling stars: calm normally, go crazy within 15 studs of a brainrot
    local starParts = {}
    local starIntensity = 0 -- 0 calm .. 1 crazy
    for i = 1, 10 do
      local p = Instance.new("Frame", bar)
      local sz = 1 + (i % 4)
      p.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)
      p.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, math.random(), 0)
      local hue = i % 3
      if hue == 0 then
        p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120 + (i % 80), 200, 255)
      elseif hue == 1 then
        p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 140 + (i % 60), 255)
      else
        p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120 + (i % 40))
      end
      p.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + math.random() * 0.3
      p.BorderSizePixel = 0
      p.ZIndex = 72
      Instance.new("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
      starParts[i] = p
      task.spawn(function()
        local drift = 0.0008 + (i % 5) * 0.00015
        local baseHue = i % 3
        while p.Parent do
          local it = starIntensity
          local spd = drift + it * (0.018 + (i % 4) * 0.006)
          local fall = 0.0006 + it * 0.028
          local x = (p.Position.X.Scale + spd * (1 + it * 3)) % 1.08
          local y = (p.Position.Y.Scale + fall) % 1.1
          p.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, y, 0)
          local pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(tick() * (3 + it * 8) + i)
          p.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.6 - it * 0.45 - pulse * it * 0.15, 0.02, 0.9)
          if it > 0.35 then
            local t = tick() * 6 + i
            if baseHue == 0 then
              p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100 + math.floor(it * 155), 200, 255)
            elseif baseHue == 1 then
              p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 120 + math.floor(80 * math.sin(t)), 255)
            else
              p.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 100 + math.floor(it * 80))
            end
            p.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1 + (i % 4) + math.floor(it * 3 * pulse), 0, 1 + (i % 4) + math.floor(it * 3 * pulse))
          end
          task.wait(it > 0.35 and 0.065 or 0.12)
        end
      end)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
      while bar and bar.Parent do
        local near = false
        pcall(function()
          local char = LP.Character
          local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
          if not hrp then return end
          local origin = hrp.Position
          local R = 15
          -- 1) animals tracked by auto-steal scanner (real brainrots on podiums)
          local lists = {}
          if _G.CalciumNormalSteal and _G.CalciumNormalSteal.animals then
            table.insert(lists, _G.CalciumNormalSteal.animals)
          end
          if _G.CalciumSemiSteal and _G.CalciumSemiSteal.animals then
            table.insert(lists, _G.CalciumSemiSteal.animals)
          end
          for _, animals in ipairs(lists) do
            for _, data in pairs(animals) do
              if type(data) == "table" and data.pos then
                local p = data.pos
                if typeof(p) == "Vector3" and (p - origin).Magnitude <= R then
                  near = true
                  return
                end
              end
            end
          end
          -- 2) ProximityPrompt under Plots/AnimalPodiums within range
          local plots = workspace:FindFirstChild("Plots")
          if plots then
            for _, plot in ipairs(plots:GetChildren()) do
              local podiums = plot:FindFirstChild("AnimalPodiums")
              if podiums then
                for _, podium in ipairs(podiums:GetChildren()) do
                  local base = podium:FindFirstChild("Base")
                  local spawn = base and base:FindFirstChild("Spawn")
                  local attach = spawn and spawn:FindFirstChild("PromptAttachment")
                  if attach then
                    local pos = attach:IsA("BasePart") and attach.Position
                      or (attach.Parent and attach.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and attach.Parent.Position)
                    if not pos then
                      local pp = attach:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
                      local par = pp and pp.Parent
                      if par and par:IsA("BasePart") then pos = par.Position end
                    end
                    if pos and (pos - origin).Magnitude <= R then
                      if attach:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) then
                        near = true
                        return
                      end
                    end
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
          -- 3) name-based brainrot only (no random NPC humanoids)
          local params = OverlapParams.new()
          params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
          params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
          for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(origin, R, params)) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
              local model = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
              local label = ((part.Name or "") .. " " .. (model and model.Name or "")):lower()
              if label:find("brainrot", 1, true)
                or label:find("dinosauro", 1, true)
                or label:find("nuclearo", 1, true)
                or (part:GetAttribute("IsBrainrot") or (model and model:GetAttribute("IsBrainrot"))) then
                near = true
                return
              end
            end
          end
        end)
        local target = near and 1 or 0
        starIntensity = starIntensity + (target - starIntensity) * 0.4
        task.wait(0.45)
      end
    end)
    -- shift content right for headshot (pct label offset)
    _G._CalciumStealBarHasHeadshot = true

    local layoutStealBarText
    local timeExec -- forward declaration used by responsive layout
    local track -- declared here so responsive sizing can update it later
    local compactTouchLayout = false

    -- Size by the active input type as well as actual device capabilities.
    -- Touch devices get a genuinely compact layout; mouse/keyboard and console
    -- layouts retain the wider version. Re-evaluate when input changes.
    local function applyStealBarDeviceSize()
      local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
      local vp = (cam and cam.ViewportSize) or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
      local lastInput = nil
      pcall(function() lastInput = UserInputService:GetLastInputType() end)
      local activeTouch = lastInput == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
      local touchOnlyDevice = false
      pcall(function()
        touchOnlyDevice = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
      end)
      compactTouchLayout = activeTouch or touchOnlyDevice or vp.X < 560

      local w, h, bottom, cornerRadius
      if compactTouchLayout then
        -- Phones: ~72% of narrow viewports, capped at 270 px; tablets cap at 320.
        local maxW = math.max(200, math.min(vp.X - 20, (vp.X < 460 and 270 or 320)))
        local minW = math.min(220, maxW)
        local ratio = (vp.X < 460) and 0.72 or 0.48
        w = math.floor(math.clamp(vp.X * ratio, minW, maxW))
        h, bottom = 54, 9
        cornerRadius = 15
      else
        w = math.floor(math.clamp(vp.X * 0.31, 300, 400))
        h, bottom = 70, 18
        cornerRadius = 20
      end
      bar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
      if not _G.CalciumStealBarUserMoved then
        bar.Position = tableToUDim2(savedStealBarPositionTable, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -bottom))
      end

      pcall(function()
        local corner = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner")
        if corner then corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, cornerRadius) end
        barStroke.Thickness = compactTouchLayout and 1.2 or 1.6
        hsHold.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compactTouchLayout and 36 or 48, compactTouchLayout and 36 or 48)
        hsHold.Position = UDim2.new(0, compactTouchLayout and 7 or 12, 0.5, compactTouchLayout and -18 or -24)
        headshot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(compactTouchLayout and 30 or 42, compactTouchLayout and 30 or 42)
        headshot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, compactTouchLayout and -15 or -21, 0.5, compactTouchLayout and -15 or -21)
        hsStroke.Thickness = compactTouchLayout and 1.1 or 1.5
      end)
      if layoutStealBarText then layoutStealBarText() end
    end
    applyStealBarDeviceSize()
    pcall(function()
      local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
      if cam then
        cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
          if bar and bar.Parent then applyStealBarDeviceSize() end
        end)
      end
      UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function()
        if bar and bar.Parent then applyStealBarDeviceSize() end
      end)
      workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(function()
        task.defer(function()
          if bar and bar.Parent then applyStealBarDeviceSize() end
          local newCam = workspace.CurrentCamera
          if newCam then
            newCam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
              if bar and bar.Parent then applyStealBarDeviceSize() end
            end)
          end
        end)
      end)
    end)

    -- Steal bar text layout (headshot left ~60px, then text columns)
    -- [HS]  35%                         FPS 86  PING 23ms
    --       discord.gg/calciumhub
    --       7:23 PM · Synapse Z
    --       [======== progress ========]
    -- Compact, collision-free rows: percentage + FPS/PING, Discord, time/executor.
    progressPct = Instance.new("TextLabel", bar)
    progressPct.Name = "Pct"
    progressPct.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    progressPct.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 5)
    progressPct.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 16)
    progressPct.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    progressPct.Text = "0%"
    progressPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    progressPct.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    progressPct.TextSize = 12
    progressPct.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    progressPct.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    progressPct.ZIndex = 74

    -- Compact centered Discord tag between percentage and FPS / ping.
    local discLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bar)
    discLbl.Name = "Discord"
    discLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    discLbl.Text = "discord.gg/calciumhub"
    discLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 187, 105)
    discLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    discLbl.TextSize = 9
    discLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    discLbl.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    discLbl.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    discLbl.ZIndex = 74

    -- Original clean percentage text (no badge, border or glow).
    progressPct.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    progressPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    progressPct.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    progressPct.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local metaRight = Instance.new("TextLabel", bar)
    metaRight.Name = "MetaRight"
    metaRight.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    metaRight.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 5)
    metaRight.Size = UDim2.new(0, 112, 0, 16)
    metaRight.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    metaRight.Text = "·  FPS --  ·  PING --"
    metaRight.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    metaRight.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    metaRight.TextSize = 9
    metaRight.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    metaRight.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    metaRight.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    metaRight.ZIndex = 74

    -- Responsive, collision-free rows: percent + FPS/PING / Discord / time + executor.
    layoutStealBarText = function()
      if not (bar and bar.Parent and progressPct and discLbl and metaRight and timeExec) then return end
      local width = tonumber(bar.AbsoluteSize.X) or 0
      if width < 1 then width = tonumber(bar.Size.X.Offset) or 380 end
      local leftPad = compactTouchLayout and 44 or 64
      local rightPad = compactTouchLayout and 8 or 12
      if compactTouchLayout then
        -- Three short metadata rows, compact avatar, and a slim progress track.
        local pctWidth = 32
        local metaWidth = math.max(88, math.min(148, width - leftPad - pctWidth - 12 - rightPad))
        progressPct.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        progressPct.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(leftPad, 3)
        progressPct.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pctWidth, 14)
        progressPct.TextSize = 10
        metaRight.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
        metaRight.Position = UDim2.new(1, -rightPad, 0, 3)
        metaRight.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(metaWidth, 13)
        metaRight.TextSize = 8
        local gap = math.max(30, width - leftPad - pctWidth - metaWidth - rightPad - 6)
        discLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(leftPad + pctWidth + 3, 3)
        discLbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gap, 13)
        discLbl.TextSize = gap < 105 and 7 or 8
        timeExec.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        timeExec.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(leftPad, 29)
        timeExec.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(leftPad + rightPad), 0, 10)
        timeExec.TextSize = 8
        if track then
          track.Position = UDim2.new(0, leftPad, 1, -8)
          track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -(leftPad + rightPad), 0, 4)
        end
      else
        local metaWidth
        if width >= 430 then
          metaWidth = 148
        elseif width >= 380 then
          metaWidth = 126
        elseif width >= 340 then
          metaWidth = 104
        else
          metaWidth = 84
        end
        progressPct.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        progressPct.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 5)
        progressPct.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(38, 16)
        metaRight.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
        metaRight.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 5)
        metaRight.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(metaWidth, 16)
        local gap = math.max(40, width - 64 - 48 - metaWidth - 16)
        discLbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 5)
        discLbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gap, 16)
        progressPct.TextSize = 12
        discLbl.TextSize = gap < 125 and 8 or 9
        metaRight.TextSize = 9
        timeExec.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        timeExec.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 37)
        timeExec.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 12)
        timeExec.TextSize = 9
        if track then
          track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 1, -12)
          track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 6)
        end
      end
    end
    layoutStealBarText()

    -- SECOND ROW: time · executor
    timeExec = Instance.new("TextLabel", bar)
    timeExec.Name = "TimeExec"
    timeExec.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
    timeExec.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 0, 37)
    timeExec.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 12)
    timeExec.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    timeExec.Text = ""
    timeExec.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 180, 195)
    timeExec.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    timeExec.TextSize = 9
    timeExec.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    timeExec.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
    timeExec.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
    timeExec.ZIndex = 74
    layoutStealBarText()
    pcall(function()
      bar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
        if bar and bar.Parent then task.defer(layoutStealBarText) end
      end)
    end)

    local execName = "Unknown"
    pcall(function()
      if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
        execName = tostring(identifyexecutor() or "Unknown")
      elseif type(getexecutorname) == "function" then
        execName = tostring(getexecutorname() or "Unknown")
      end
    end)
    if #execName > 16 then execName = execName:sub(1, 15) .. "…" end

    -- Accurate FPS: count real rendered frames via RenderStepped (not task.wait)
    do
      local frames, last, fps = 0, tick(), 60
      local lastClock = 0
      local conn
      conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not bar or not bar.Parent then
          if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
          return
        end
        frames = frames + 1
        local now = tick()
        if now - last >= 0.5 then
          fps = math.floor(frames / (now - last) + 0.5)
          frames = 0
          last = now
          local ping = 0
          pcall(function()
            if LP and LP.GetNetworkPing then
              local rtt = LP:GetNetworkPing()
              if type(rtt) == "number" and rtt >= 0 then
                ping = math.floor(rtt * 1000 + 0.5)
              end
            end
          end)
          -- prefer engine physics FPS as cross-check when available
          pcall(function()
            if workspace.GetRealPhysicsFPS then
              local pf = workspace:GetRealPhysicsFPS()
              if type(pf) == "number" and pf > 0 then
                -- blend slightly toward physics FPS if render sample is wild
                if math.abs(pf - fps) > 40 then
                  fps = math.floor((fps + pf) * 0.5 + 0.5)
                end
              end
            end
          end)
          local pingTxt = (ping > 0) and (tostring(ping) .. "ms") or "--"
          metaRight.Text = string.format("·  FPS %d  ·  PING %s", fps, pingTxt)
        end
        -- clock update ~1Hz (don't thrash text every frame)
        if now - lastClock >= 1 then
          lastClock = now
          pcall(function()
            local t = os.date("*t")
            local h, m = t.hour or 0, t.min or 0
            local h12 = h % 12
            if h12 == 0 then h12 = 12 end
            local ampm = (h >= 12) and "PM" or "AM"
            timeExec.Text = string.format("%d:%02d %s  ·  %s", h12, m, ampm, execName)
          end)
        end
      end)
    end

    -- solid blue progress bar (simple)
    track = Instance.new("Frame", bar)
    track.Position = UDim2.new(0, 64, 1, -12)
    track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 6)
    track.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
    track.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track.ZIndex = 72
    track.ClipsDescendants = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    layoutStealBarText()

        progressFill = Instance.new("Frame", track)
    progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    progressFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 218, 244)
    local fillGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient", progressFill)
    fillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(24, 225, 250)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.55, Color3.fromRGB(91, 123, 255)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(130, 246, 225))
    })
    progressFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    progressFill.ZIndex = 73
    Instance.new("UICorner", progressFill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    -- animated sheen on the fill
    pcall(function()
      local sheen = Instance.new("Frame", progressFill)
      sheen.Name = "Sheen"
      sheen.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, 0, 1, 0)
      sheen.Position = UDim2.new(-0.3, 0, 0, 0)
      sheen.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 220, 255)
      sheen.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
      sheen.BorderSizePixel = 0
      sheen.ZIndex = 74
      Instance.new("UICorner", sheen).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
      local sg = Instance.new("UIGradient", sheen)
      sg.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.2),
        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
      })
      task.spawn(function()
        while sheen and sheen.Parent do
          sheen.Position = UDim2.new(-0.35, 0, 0, 0)
          local tw = TweenService:Create(sheen, TweenInfo.new(1.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
            Position = UDim2.new(1.1, 0, 0, 0)
          })
          tw:Play()
          task.wait(1.8)
        end
      end)
    end)

    -- keep state label API (hidden simple)
    progressRadLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", bar)
    progressRadLbl.Visible = false
    progressRadLbl.Text = "READY"

    -- drag
    do
      local dragging, dragStart, startPosition = false, nil, nil
      bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
          dragging = true
          dragStart = input.Position
          startPosition = bar.Position
          input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
          end)
        end
      end)
      UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
          local d = input.Position - dragStart
          bar.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + d.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + d.Y)
        end
      end)
    end

    autoStealBar = bar
    local StealBar = {}
    function StealBar.SetProgress(p)
      p = math.clamp(tonumber(p) or 0, 0, 1)
      pcall(function()
        if progressFill then
          local col = Color3.fromRGB(30, 90, 255)
          if p >= 0.85 then
            col = Color3.fromRGB(80, 255, 160)
          elseif p >= 0.55 then
            col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 145, 55)
          elseif p >= 0.25 then
            col = Color3.fromRGB(50, 130, 255)
          end
          game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(progressFill, TweenInfo.new(0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 1, 0),
            BackgroundColor3 = col
          }):Play()
          -- pulse bar stroke when almost full
          if p >= 0.9 and bar then
            local st = bar:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
            if st then
              st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 180)
              task.delay(0.2, function()
                if st and st.Parent then st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 135, 45) end
              end)
            end
          end
        end
        if progressPct then
          progressPct.Text = tostring(math.floor(p * 100 + 0.5)) .. "%"
          if p >= 0.9 then
            progressPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 180)
          else
            progressPct.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          end
        end
      end)
    end
    function StealBar.SetState(state)
      pcall(function()
        if progressRadLbl then progressRadLbl.Text = tostring(state or "READY") end
      end)
    end
    function StealBar.Reset()
      StealBar.SetProgress(0)
      StealBar.SetState("READY")
    end
    _G.StealBar = StealBar
  end)
  if not ok then warn("[Calcium] steal bar:", err) end
end
_G.__CalciumDuelsSetupStealBar()

_G.__CalciumDuelsRunIntro = function()
  -- single intro only (CalciumCoolIntro) — skip duplicate cinematic
  pcall(function()
    if Main then Main.Visible = true end
    if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = false end
  end)
  if true then return end
  if not _introEnabled then
    return
  end
  local TS = TweenService
  local RS = RunService
  local parent = (Gui and Gui.Parent) or HubGui or PlayerGui
  local origSize = FULL_MAIN_SIZE or (Main and Main.Size) or UDim2.new(0, 324, 0, 576)
  local wasMin = (_G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized == true)
  pcall(function()
    if Main then Main.Visible = false end
    if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = false end
  end)
  pcall(playIntroMusic)

  local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
  sg.Name = "CalciumCinematicIntroGui"
  -- cooler intro pass
  sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
  sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
  sg.DisplayOrder = 100000
  sg.Parent = parent

  local root = Instance.new("Frame")
  root.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
  root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 4, 2)
  root.BorderSizePixel = 0
  root.ClipsDescendants = true
  root.Parent = sg

  -- aurora gradient sweep
  local aurora = Instance.new("Frame", root)
  aurora.Size = UDim2.new(2, 0, 2, 0)
  aurora.Position = UDim2.new(-0.5, 0, -0.5, 0)
  aurora.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  aurora.BorderSizePixel = 0
  local ag = Instance.new("UIGradient", aurora)
  ag.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(40, 12, 5)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 15)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.7, Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(25, 8, 4)),
  })
  ag.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0.35),
    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.7),
  })
  ag.Rotation = 25

  -- hex grid dots
  for i = 1, 50 do
    local d = Instance.new("Frame", root)
    local s = 1 + (i % 3)
    d.Size = UDim2.new(0, s, 0, s)
    d.Position = UDim2.new(math.random(), 0, math.random(), 0)
    d.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50)
    d.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + math.random() * 0.5
    d.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Instance.new("UICorner", d).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
  end

  -- orbital rings
  local rings = {}
  for i, base in ipairs({100, 160, 230}) do
    local r = Instance.new("Frame", root)
    r.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    r.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.36, 0)
    r.Size = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 12)

    st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(60 + i * 40, 180, 255)
    st.Thickness = 2.2
    st.Transparency = 0.2 + i * 0.1
    Instance.new("UICorner", r).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    rings[i] = {r = r, st = st, base = base}
  end

  -- nucleus
  local core = Instance.new("Frame", root)
  core.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
  core.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.36, 0)
  core.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
  core.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 130)
  core.BorderSizePixel = 0
  Instance.new("UICorner", core).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

  card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
  card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.62, 0)
  card.Size = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
  card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 10, 18)
  card.BackgroundTransparency = 0.02
  card.BorderSizePixel = 0
  Instance.new("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 22)
  local cardSt = Instance.new("UIStroke", card)
  cardSt.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 50)
  cardSt.Thickness = 1.8
  cardSt.Transparency = 0.2

  local tag = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
  tag.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  tag.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 16)
  tag.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 24)
  tag.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  tag.TextSize = 11
  tag.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255)
  tag.TextTransparency = 1
  tag.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  tag.Text = "SYS.CALCIUM  //  ELEMENT 20  //  ONLINE"

  local title = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
  title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 80)
  title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 44)
  title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  title.TextSize = 68
  title.Text = "CALCIUM"
  title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
  title.TextTransparency = 1
  title.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
  title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.25
  title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
  local tg = Instance.new("UIGradient", title)
  tg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.4, Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 130)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(30, 130, 255)),
  })
  tg.Rotation = 90

  local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel", card)
  sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
  sub.Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0, 18)
  sub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 128)
  sub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham

  sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 195, 240)
  sub.TextTransparency = 1
  sub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

  local barBg = Instance.new("Frame", card)
  barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 6)
  barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 28, 1, -32)
  barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 24, 40)
  barBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
  Instance.new("UICorner", barBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

  bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
  bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 215, 255)
  bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
  Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

  local skip = Instance.new("TextButton", root)
  skip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
  skip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24)
  skip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 84, 0, 32)
  skip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(8, 16, 30)
  skip.Text = "SKIP"
  skip.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
  skip.TextSize = 12
  skip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 210, 255)
  skip.AutoButtonColor = false
  Instance.new("UICorner", skip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

  local alive = true
  local function finish()
    if not alive then return end
    alive = false
    pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
    pcall(function()
      if wasMin then
        if Main then Main.Visible = false end
        if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = true end
      else
        if Main then
          Main.Size = UDim2.new(origSize.X.Scale, origSize.X.Offset * 0.88, origSize.Y.Scale, origSize.Y.Offset * 0.88)
          Main.Visible = true
          TS:Create(Main, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = origSize}):Play()
        end
        if MiniFrame then MiniFrame.Visible = false end
      end
    end)
  end
  skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(finish)

  task.spawn(function()
    TS:Create(core, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18)}):Play()
    for i, info in ipairs(rings) do
      TS:Create(info.r, TweenInfo.new(0.55 + i * 0.12, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, info.base, 0, info.base)
      }):Play()
    end
    TS:Create(card, TweenInfo.new(0.65, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 200)
    }):Play()
    task.wait(0.3)
    if not alive then return end
    TS:Create(title, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TS:Create(tag, TweenInfo.new(0.4), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    TS:Create(sub, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
    task.spawn(function()
      local t0 = tick()
      while tick() - t0 < 0.4 and alive and card.Parent do
        local p = 1 - ((tick() - t0) / 0.4)
        card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 8 * p, 0.62, (math.random() * 2 - 1) * 5 * p)
        RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
      end
      if card and card.Parent then card.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.62, 0) end
    end)
    TS:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(1.9, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)}):Play()
    task.spawn(function()
      while alive and ag and ag.Parent do
        ag.Rotation = (ag.Rotation + 0.4) % 360
        RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
      end
    end)
    task.wait(1.2)
    if not alive then return end
    local f = TweenInfo.new(0.55, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TS:Create(root, f, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(card, f, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(cardSt, f, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(title, f, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(tag, f, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TS:Create(sub, f, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    for _, info in ipairs(rings) do
      TS:Create(info.st, f, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
    end
    TS:Create(skip, f, {TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.2)
    finish()
  end)
end

_G.CalciumDuelsForceSyncLoadedButtons = function()
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled) end
    if autoTPEnabled then startAutoTP() else stopAutoTP() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setInfJumpVisual then setInfJumpVisual(infJumpEnabled) end
    if setInfJumpInternal then setInfJumpInternal(infJumpEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshInfJumpModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshInfJumpModeSelector() end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshTPDownMethodSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshTPDownMethodSelector() end   -- >>> TP DOWN METHOD <<<

      pcall(_G.CalciumFonts.applyAll)

  end)

      if _G.CalciumStartLookAt then _G.CalciumStartLookAt() end
    else
      if _G.CalciumStopLookAt then _G.CalciumStopLookAt() end
    end
  end)

    if _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector() end
  end)

    if _G.CalciumRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector() end
    setAntiRagdoll(antiRagdollEnabled)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local wanted = _G._CalciumAntiDieUserWanted == true
    -- Loading config is not a user toggle: never disable an auto-armed system.
    if wanted then pcall(setAntiDie, true) end
    if _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync then _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync() end
    if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(antiDieEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoLeft then _G.CalciumSetAutoLeft(autoLeftEnabled, true) end
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoRight then _G.CalciumSetAutoRight(autoRightEnabled, true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumAutoStealSync() end
    -- >>> RADIUS CIRCLE <<<
    if _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircle then _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircle(_G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumRadiusCircleSetVisual then _G.CalciumRadiusCircleSetVisual(_G.CalciumRadiusCircleEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircleColor then _G.CalciumSetRadiusCircleColor(_G.CalciumRadiusCircleColor) end
    if _G.CalciumRadiusCircleSetColorPreview then _G.CalciumRadiusCircleSetColorPreview(_G.CalciumRadiusCircleColor) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.CalciumNormalAutoSwingSetVisual then _G.CalciumNormalAutoSwingSetVisual(autoSwingEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumMirrorTPDownSetVisual then _G.CalciumMirrorTPDownSetVisual(mirrorTPDownEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumTPBatAutoSwingSetVisual then _G.CalciumTPBatAutoSwingSetVisual(tpBatAutoSwingEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumTPBatCameraLockSetVisual then _G.CalciumTPBatCameraLockSetVisual(_G._CalciumGetTPBatCameraLock and _G._CalciumGetTPBatCameraLock() or false) end
    -- >>> TP BAT VERSIONS: allinea lo slider al valore caricato <<<
    _G.CalciumTPBatVersion = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.CalciumTPBatVersion) or 1, 1, 2)
    if _G._CalciumTPBatSetVersionVisual then _G._CalciumTPBatSetVersionVisual(_G.CalciumTPBatVersion) end
    if _G.CalciumTPBatSetVisual then _G.CalciumTPBatSetVisual(_G.CalciumTPBatOn == true) end
    if _G.CalciumTPBatOn and _G.CalciumStartTPBat then
      _G.CalciumStartTPBat()
    elseif _G.CalciumStopTPBat then
      _G.CalciumStopTPBat()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if selectedAimbotMode == "V2" then
      if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStop then _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStop() end
      if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On and _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Start then
        _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Start()
      elseif _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop then
        _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop()
      end
    else
      if _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop then _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop() end
      if _G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn and _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStart then
        _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStart()
      elseif _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStop then
        _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStop()
      end
    end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshAimbotVisual() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setBatCounterVisual then setBatCounterVisual(batCounterEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshBatCounterModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshBatCounterModeSelector() end
    if setMedCounterVisual then setMedCounterVisual(medCounterEnabled) end
    if _SV.setSafeModeVisual then _SV.setSafeModeVisual(antiKickEnabled) end
    if batCounterEnabled then
      if _G.CalciumStartBatCounter then _G.CalciumStartBatCounter() end
    else
      if _G.CalciumStopBatCounter then _G.CalciumStopBatCounter() end
    end
    if medCounterEnabled then
      if _G.CalciumStartMedCounter then _G.CalciumStartMedCounter(LP.Character) end
    else
      if _G.CalciumStopMedCounter then _G.CalciumStopMedCounter() end
    end
    if _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual then _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual(_G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled) end
    if _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled then
      if enableNoPlayerCollision then enableNoPlayerCollision() end
    else
      if disableNoPlayerCollision then disableNoPlayerCollision() end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setPlayerESPVisual then _SV.setPlayerESPVisual(espEnabled) end
    if espEnabled then if startPlayerESP then startPlayerESP() end; if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.box = true end else if stopPlayerESP then stopPlayerESP() end; if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.box = false end end
    if _SV.setTrackerESPVisual then _SV.setTrackerESPVisual(showTrackerEnabled) end
    if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.tracker = showTrackerEnabled end
    if refreshBoxedESP then refreshBoxedESP() end
    if _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual then _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual(ragdollCountdownEnabled) end
    -- Forza restart: stopRagdollCountdown + StopEnemy azzerano i flag-guard interni prima di riavviare
    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      if _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown then _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown() end
      hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character)
      if _G.CalciumStartEnemyRagdollCountdown then _G.CalciumStartEnemyRagdollCountdown() end
    else
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      if _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown then _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown() end
    end
    if _SV.setFPSBoostVisual then _SV.setFPSBoostVisual(fpsBoostEnabled) end
    if fpsBoostEnabled then enableStretchRez() else disableStretchRez() end
    if _SV.setAntiLagVisual then _SV.setAntiLagVisual(antiLagVisualEnabled) end
    if antiLagVisualEnabled then enableAntiLag() else disableAntiLag() end
    if _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual then _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual(vividGraphicsEnabled) end
    if vividGraphicsEnabled then enableVividGraphics() else disableVividGraphics() end
    if _SV.setXRayVisual then _SV.setXRayVisual(xrayEnabled) end
    if setXRay then pcall(setXRay, xrayEnabled) end
    if _SV.setHighPingWarningVisual then _SV.setHighPingWarningVisual(highPingWarningEnabled) end
    if _SV.setKickWarningVisual then _SV.setKickWarningVisual(_G._CalciumKickWarn.enabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshUAKVisual then _G.CalciumRefreshUAKVisual() end
    if _SV.setFOVVisual then _SV.setFOVVisual(fovEnabled) end
    if fovEnabled then enableCustomFov() else disableCustomFov() end
    if _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual then _SV.setNoCamCollisionVisual(noCamCollisionEnabled) end
    if noCamCollisionEnabled then enableNoCamCollision() else disableNoCamCollision() end
    if type(applyCustomSky) == "function" then
      applyCustomSky((skyTheme and skyTheme ~= "") and skyTheme or "Off")
    end
    if skyValueLabel then skyValueLabel.Text = skyTheme or "Off" end
  end)
  pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
end

  customFontVisualEnabled = false
  if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end

  customFontVisualEnabled = false
  if V then V.customFontEnabled = false end

_G.CalciumDuelsApplySavedGameplayStates = function()
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(autoTPEnabled == true) end
    if autoTPEnabled then startAutoTP() else stopAutoTP() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setInfJumpVisual then setInfJumpVisual(infJumpEnabled == true) end
    if setInfJumpInternal then setInfJumpInternal(infJumpEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshInfJumpModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshInfJumpModeSelector() end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshTPDownMethodSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshTPDownMethodSelector() end   -- >>> TP DOWN METHOD <<<
    -- >>> CUSTOM FONTS <<< la GUI a questo punto esiste: si applica il
    -- font salvato e si agganciano i listener per quello che nascera' dopo.
    if _G.CalciumFonts then
      pcall(_G.CalciumFonts.applyAll)
      pcall(_G.CalciumFonts.hook)
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setLookAtVisual then _SV.setLookAtVisual(_G.CalciumLookAtEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumLookAtRadiusBox then _G.CalciumLookAtRadiusBox.Text = tostring(tonumber(_G.CalciumLookAtRadius) or 20) end
    if _G.CalciumLookAtEnabled then
      if _G.CalciumStartLookAt then _G.CalciumStartLookAt() end
    else
      if _G.CalciumStopLookAt then _G.CalciumStopLookAt() end
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoCarrySpeedVisual then setAutoCarrySpeedVisual(autoCarrySpeedEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshAutoCarryModeSelector() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAntiRagdollVisual then setAntiRagdollVisual(antiRagdollEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshAntiRagdollModeSelector() end
    if setAntiRagdoll then setAntiRagdoll(antiRagdollEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local wanted = _G._CalciumAntiDieUserWanted == true
    -- Loading config is not a user toggle: never disable an auto-armed system.
    if wanted then pcall(setAntiDie, true) end
    if _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync then _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync() end
    if _SV.setAntiDieVisual then _SV.setAntiDieVisual(antiDieEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setAutoStealVisual then setAutoStealVisual(autoStealEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumAutoStealSync then _G.CalciumAutoStealSync() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setBatCounterVisual then setBatCounterVisual(batCounterEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumRefreshBatCounterModeSelector then _G.CalciumRefreshBatCounterModeSelector() end
    if batCounterEnabled and _G.CalciumStartBatCounter then _G.CalciumStartBatCounter() elseif _G.CalciumStopBatCounter then _G.CalciumStopBatCounter() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if setMedCounterVisual then setMedCounterVisual(medCounterEnabled == true) end
    if medCounterEnabled and _G.CalciumStartMedCounter then
      _G.CalciumStartMedCounter(LP.Character)
    elseif _G.CalciumStopMedCounter then
      _G.CalciumStopMedCounter()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual then _G.CalciumSetNoPlayerCollisionVisual(_G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumNoPlayerCollisionEnabled then enableNoPlayerCollision() else disableNoPlayerCollision() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setUnwalkVisual then _SV.setUnwalkVisual(unwalkEnabled == true) end
    -- Forza il restart dal load: i guard interni di startUnwalk/stopUnwalk controllano
    -- la variabile unwalkEnabled, quindi temporaneamente la resettiamo per bypassarli.
    if unwalkEnabled then
      unwalkEnabled = false  -- adesso stopUnwalk passa il suo guard e pulisce il loop
      stopUnwalk()           -- pulisce unwalkLoopConnection residua
      -- unwalkEnabled è rimasto false dopo stopUnwalk (lo setta lui stesso)
      startUnwalk()          -- il guard "if unwalkEnabled then return end" non scatta → avvia il loop
    else
      unwalkEnabled = true   -- forza stopUnwalk a passare il suo guard e fare pulizia
      stopUnwalk()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setSafeModeVisual then _SV.setSafeModeVisual(antiKickEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setPlayerESPVisual then _SV.setPlayerESPVisual(espEnabled == true) end
    if espEnabled then if startPlayerESP then startPlayerESP() end else if stopPlayerESP then stopPlayerESP() end end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setTrackerESPVisual then _SV.setTrackerESPVisual(showTrackerEnabled == true) end
    if BoxedESPOptions then BoxedESPOptions.tracker = showTrackerEnabled == true end
    if refreshBoxedESP then refreshBoxedESP() end
    pcall(function()
      local gui = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHub")
      if gui then
        for _, obj in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
          if obj.Name == "ColorPreview" and obj.Parent and obj.Parent.Name == "Tracker Color" then
            obj.BackgroundColor3 = (BoxedESPOptions and BoxedESPOptions.trackerColor) or Color3.fromRGB(230,230,230)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual then _SV.setRagdollCountdownVisual(ragdollCountdownEnabled == true) end
    if ragdollCountdownEnabled then
      -- Forza il restart dal load: stopRagdollCountdown pulisce le connessioni residue,
      -- poi hookRagdollCountdown parte da zero senza guard che blocchino.
      -- Per il sistema enemy, StopEnemy azzera enemyRagdollConn (il flag-guard di StartEnemy).
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown()
      hookRagdollCountdown(LP.Character)
      _G.CalciumStartEnemyRagdollCountdown()
    else
      stopRagdollCountdown()
      _G.CalciumStopEnemyRagdollCountdown()
    end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setFPSBoostVisual then _SV.setFPSBoostVisual(fpsBoostEnabled == true) end
    if fpsBoostEnabled then enableStretchRez() else disableStretchRez() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setAntiLagVisual then _SV.setAntiLagVisual(antiLagVisualEnabled == true) end
    if antiLagVisualEnabled then enableAntiLag() else disableAntiLag() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual then _SV.setVividGraphicsVisual(vividGraphicsEnabled == true) end
    if vividGraphicsEnabled then enableVividGraphics() else disableVividGraphics() end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setXRayVisual then _SV.setXRayVisual(xrayEnabled == true) end
    if setXRay then setXRay(xrayEnabled) end
    -- >>> BRAINROT X-RAY <<<
    if _SV.setBrainrotXRayVisual then _SV.setBrainrotXRayVisual(_G.CalciumBrainrotXRayEnabled == true) end
    if _G.CalciumSetBrainrotXRay then _G.CalciumSetBrainrotXRay(_G.CalciumBrainrotXRayEnabled == true) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if _SV.setFOVVisual then _SV.setFOVVisual(fovEnabled == true) end

  end)

    if _SV.setKorbloxVisual then _SV.setKorbloxVisual(korbloxEnabled == true) end
    if korbloxEnabled then enableKorblox() else disableKorblox() end

  pcall(function()

      _G.CalciumAntiTPBat.setSpam(_G.CalciumAntiTPBatSpam == true, true)
      _G.CalciumAntiTPBat.setVersion(_G.CalciumAntiTPBatVersion or 1, true)
      _G.CalciumAntiTPBat.setEnabled(_G.CalciumAntiTPBatEnabled == true, true)
    end
    if _G._CalciumAntiTPBatRefreshUI then _G._CalciumAntiTPBatRefreshUI() end

  pcall(function()

    if _SV.setAntiVoidVisual then _SV.setAntiVoidVisual(on) end
    if _G.CalciumAntiVoid then _G.CalciumAntiVoid.setEnabled(on) end

  -- <<< ANTI VOID END

    if _SV.setRainbowToolsVisual then _SV.setRainbowToolsVisual(on) end
    if _G.CalciumRainbowTools then _G.CalciumRainbowTools.setEnabled(on) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.CalciumTransparentToolsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setTransparentToolsVisual then _SV.setTransparentToolsVisual(on) end
    if _G.CalciumTransparentTools then _G.CalciumTransparentTools.setEnabled(on) end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.CalciumCustomToolsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setCustomToolsVisual then _SV.setCustomToolsVisual(on) end
    if _G.CalciumCustomTools then _G.CalciumCustomTools.setEnabled(on) end

  pcall(function()
    local on = _G.CalciumCustomSoundsEnabled == true
    if _SV.setCustomSoundsVisual then _SV.setCustomSoundsVisual(on) end
    if _G.CalciumCustomSounds then _G.CalciumCustomSounds.setEnabled(on) end
  end)

  pcall(function()
    if type(applyCustomSky) == "function" then applyCustomSky((skyTheme and skyTheme ~= "") and skyTheme or "Off") end
    if skyValueLabel then skyValueLabel.Text = skyTheme or "Off" end
  end)
  pcall(function()
    if selectedAnimPackIndex and selectedAnimPackIndex ~= 1 and _G.CalciumSetAnimPack then
      _G.CalciumSetAnimPack(selectedAnimPackIndex)
    end
    if setAnimPackVisual then setAnimPackVisual(selectedAnimPackIndex or 1) end
    -- >>> VISIBILE SOLO CON CUSTOM <<< allineamento dopo il load config
    if _G.CalciumCustomAnimSetRowVisible then
      _G.CalciumCustomAnimSetRowVisible((selectedAnimPackIndex or 1) == 7, false)
    end
  end)
end

_G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreWanted = false
-- Respect the explicit preference loaded above. Runtime interruptions do not
-- count as a user turning the saved toggle off.
_G.CalciumAutoTPUserDisabled = (_G.CalciumAutoTPSavedPreference ~= true)
_G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = 0

function calciumAnyAimbotActive()
  return (_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true) or (_G.CalciumTPBatOn == true)
end
_G.CalciumStopAutoTPForAction = function()
  if autoTPEnabled and not _G.CalciumAutoTPUserDisabled then
    _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreWanted = true
    _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.35
    stopAutoTP()
    if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(false) end
  end
end
function calciumTryRestoreAutoTP()
  if _G.CalciumAutoTPUserDisabled then return end
  if not _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreWanted then return end
  if tick() < (_G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil or 0) then return end
  if calciumAnyAimbotActive() then return end
  if dropBrainrotActive then return end
  _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreWanted = false
  startAutoTP()
  if _SV.setAutoTPVisual then _SV.setAutoTPVisual(true) end
  saveCalciumConfig()
end
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(calciumTryRestoreAutoTP)

_G._oldCalciumStopNormalAimbot = _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot
_G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot = function(...)
  local r = {_G._oldCalciumStopNormalAimbot(...)}
  _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
  task.delay(0.08, calciumTryRestoreAutoTP)
  return unpack(r)
end
_G.CalciumNormalAimbotStop = _G.CalciumStopNormalAimbot

_G._oldCalciumStopBatAimbotV2 = _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2
_G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2 = function(...)
  local r = {_G._oldCalciumStopBatAimbotV2(...)}
  _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
  task.delay(0.08, calciumTryRestoreAutoTP)
  return unpack(r)
end
_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop = _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2

-- >>> ANTI DIE AUTO BEGIN
-- Wrapper sui punti che accendono/spengono i moduli: qui le funzioni
-- esistono gia' tutte, quindi si possono avvolgere in blocco.
do
  -- L'armamento dell'Anti Die NON sta piu' qui: e' la prima riga dentro le
  -- funzioni di avvio stesse, cosi' vale per qualunque chiamante e anche
  -- prima che questi wrapper esistano. Qui resta solo la sync a valle, che
  -- tiene i conti (chi l'ha acceso) e si occupa dello spegnimento.
  local function wrap(name)
    local old = _G[name]
    if type(old) ~= "function" then return end
    _G[name] = function(...)
      local r = {old(...)}
      if _G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync then pcall(_G.CalciumAntiDieAutoSync) end
      return unpack(r)
    end
  end
  wrap("CalciumStartTPBat")
  wrap("CalciumStopTPBat")
  wrap("CalciumStartNormalAimbot")
  wrap("CalciumStopNormalAimbot")
  wrap("CalciumStartBatAimbotV2")
  wrap("CalciumStopBatAimbotV2")

  -- Gli alias erano stati presi PRIMA di questo punto, quindi puntavano
  -- ancora alle funzioni originali e chi li usava (il ripristino dello
  -- stato dal config) scavalcava sia l'armamento sia la sync. Si
  -- ripuntano alle versioni avvolte.
  _G.CalciumNormalAimbotStart = _G.CalciumStartNormalAimbot
  _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Start  = _G.CalciumStartBatAimbotV2
  _G.CalciumBatAimbotV2Stop   = _G.CalciumStopBatAimbotV2
end
-- <<< ANTI DIE AUTO END

_G._oldCalciumStopTPBat = _G.CalciumStopTPBat
_G.CalciumStopTPBat = function(...)
  local r = {_G._oldCalciumStopTPBat(...)}
  _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
  task.delay(0.08, calciumTryRestoreAutoTP)
  return unpack(r)
end
task.spawn(function()
  local wasDropping = false
  while task.wait(0.05) do
    if dropBrainrotActive then
      wasDropping = true
    elseif wasDropping then
      wasDropping = false
      _G.CalciumAutoTPRestoreBlockedUntil = tick() + 0.05
      task.delay(0.08, calciumTryRestoreAutoTP)
    end
  end
end)

function calciumRepairKeybinds()
  for keyId, defaultKey in pairs(DEFAULT_SPEED_KEYBINDS) do
    if speedKeybinds[keyId] == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
      speedKeybinds[keyId] = defaultKey
    end
  end
  if tpDownKeybind == Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then tpDownKeybind = DEFAULT_TP_DOWN_KEYBIND end
  if refreshAllSpeedKeybinds then refreshAllSpeedKeybinds() end
  if refreshTPDownKeybind then refreshTPDownKeybind() end
end
_G._oldSaveCalciumConfigStable = saveCalciumConfig
saveCalciumConfig = function()
  calciumRepairKeybinds()
  return _G._oldSaveCalciumConfigStable()
end
calciumRepairKeybinds()
task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.2)
  calciumRepairKeybinds()
  -- Keep the original boot-time persistence behavior. The config collector now
  -- preserves the saved Auto TP preference until the user changes that toggle.
  saveCalciumConfig()
end)

-- ============================================================

-- Make every ToggleButton easy to click (rebind after UI builds)
task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.6)
  pcall(function()
    local parent = HubGui or Gui or PlayerGui
    if not parent then return end
    local function rebind(btn)
      if not btn or not btn:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
      if btn:GetAttribute("_CalciumToggleRebound") then return end
      btn:SetAttribute("_CalciumToggleRebound", true)
      btn.Active = true
      btn.Selectable = true
      btn.ZIndex = math.max(btn.ZIndex or 1, 20)
      local last = 0
      local fns = {}
      pcall(function()
        if typeof(getconnections) ~= "function" then return end
        for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(btn.Activated) or {}) do
          if type(c.Function) == "function" then
            table.insert(fns, c.Function)
            pcall(function() if c.Disconnect then c:Disconnect() end end)
          end
        end
      end)
      local function fire()
        local now = tick()
        if now - last < 0.22 then return end
        last = now
        pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
        if #fns > 0 then
          for _, fn in ipairs(fns) do pcall(fn) end
        end
      end
      -- Activated works for mouse + touch; do NOT also bind Touch or mobile double-toggles
      if #fns > 0 then
        btn.Activated:Connect(fire)
      end
      -- Ensure mobile can always hit this
      btn.Active = true
      btn.Selectable = true
    end
    for _, d in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
      if d.Name == "ToggleButton" then rebind(d) end
    end
    parent.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
      if d.Name == "ToggleButton" then task.defer(rebind, d) end
    end)
  end)
end)

-- MOBILE BUTTONS
