task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.35)
  local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
  local old = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubMobileButtons")
  if old then old:Destroy() end
  -- copia rimasta in PlayerGui da una versione precedente dello script
  old = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubMobileButtons")
  if old then old:Destroy() end

  local mobileGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
  mobileGui.Name = "CalciumHubMobileButtons"
  mobileGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
  mobileGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
  mobileGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
  mobileGui.DisplayOrder = 1000
  mobileGui.Enabled = true
  mobileGui.Parent = HubGui

  _G.CalciumMobileButtonRefs = {}
  local mobileButtons = _G.CalciumMobileButtonRefs

  -- >>> HIDE PER SINGOLO BOTTONE <<<
  -- Prima si spegneva l'intera ScreenGui. Ora la GUI resta accesa e si
  -- nasconde bottone per bottone, cosi' si possono fare eccezioni: nella
  -- lista un bottone spento resta visibile anche col toggle acceso.
  -- La lista e l'helper CalciumMobileHideIncluded sono definiti in cima
  -- al file, perche' la UI li usa prima che questo blocco esista.
  function _G.CalciumApplyMobileButtonsHidden()
    local g = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHubMobileButtons")
    local hideAll = (_G.CalciumHideMobileButtons == true)
    -- hide entire mobile buttons gui (no per-button picker)
    if g then g.Enabled = not hideAll end
    for key, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
      local holder = entry and entry.holder
      if holder then
        holder.Visible = not hideAll
      end
    end
    if setHideMobileButtonsVisual then pcall(setHideMobileButtonsVisual, hideAll) end
  end

  -- Expand circular mobile buttons so multi-line labels fit
  local function _fitMobileBtnText(btn)
    if not btn or not btn:IsA("TextButton") then return end
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.TextWrapped = true
    local c = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UITextSizeConstraint")
    if not c then
      c = Instance.new("UITextSizeConstraint")
      c.MaxTextSize = 11
      c.MinTextSize = 7
      c.Parent = btn
    end
  end
  function _G.CalciumApplyMobileButtonSize()
    local defScale = 0.75
    if _G.CalciumIsMobile then
      local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
      local short = vp and math.min(vp.X, vp.Y) or 400
      if short < 380 then defScale = 0.68
      elseif short < 430 then defScale = 0.72
      else defScale = 0.78 end
    end
    if _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale == nil then
      _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale = defScale
    end
    _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale = math.clamp(tonumber(_G.CalciumMobileButtonScale) or defScale, 0.30, 1.35)
    for _, entry in pairs(mobileButtons) do
      local holder = entry and entry.holder
      if holder then
        local sc = holder:FindFirstChild("MobileButtonScale") or Instance.new("UIScale")
        sc.Name = "MobileButtonScale"
        sc.Scale = _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale
        sc.Parent = holder
        local view = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if view then
          local w,h = math.max(1,holder.Size.X.Offset)*sc.Scale,math.max(1,holder.Size.Y.Offset)*sc.Scale
          local pos,anchor=holder.Position,holder.AnchorPoint
          local x,y=pos.X.Scale*view.X+pos.X.Offset,pos.Y.Scale*view.Y+pos.Y.Offset
          holder.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,8+w*anchor.X,math.max(8+w*anchor.X,view.X-w*(1-anchor.X)-8)),math.clamp(y,8+h*anchor.Y,math.max(8+h*anchor.Y,view.Y-h*(1-anchor.Y)-8)))
        end
      end
      if entry and entry.btn then _fitMobileBtnText(entry.btn) end
    end
    pcall(function()
      local gui = HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHub") or HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHub") or HubGui:FindFirstChild("CalciumHub")
      local root = gui or HubGui
      for _, obj in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "Mobile Buttons Size" then
          local valueBox = obj:FindFirstChild("Value")
          if valueBox and valueBox:IsA("TextLabel") then
            valueBox.Text = string.format("%.2f", _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale)
          end
        end
      end
    end)
  end
  local function setActive(btn, state)
    if not btn then return end
    local pressed = btn:GetAttribute("CalciumMobilePressed") == true
    state = (state == true) or pressed
    local visualState = state and "on" or "off"
    if btn:GetAttribute("CalciumMobileVisualState") == visualState then return end
    btn:SetAttribute("CalciumMobileVisualState", visualState)
    local holder = btn.Parent
    local glow = holder and holder:FindFirstChild("Glow")
    local st = btn:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    TS:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
      BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(238,238,238) or Color3.fromRGB(8,8,8),
      TextColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0) or Color3.fromRGB(225,225,225),
      TextTransparency = 0,
    }):Play()
    if st then
      TS:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.18), {
        Color = state and Color3.fromRGB(190,190,190) or Color3.fromRGB(85,85,85),
        Thickness = 1,
        Transparency = state and 0 or 0.4,
      }):Play()
    end
    if glow then
      glow.Visible = false
      glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      local gs = glow:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if gs then gs.Transparency = 1 end
    end
  end
  local function pulse(btn)
    if not btn then return end
    btn:SetAttribute("CalciumMobilePressed", true)
    setActive(btn, true)
    task.delay(0.18, function()
      if btn and btn.Parent then
        btn:SetAttribute("CalciumMobilePressed", false)
        setActive(btn, false)
      end
    end)
  end
local function makeButton(key, label, pos, onPress)
    -- Contenitore
    local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
    holder.Name = "MBH_" .. key
    holder.Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 0, 58)
    
    local savedPos = _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions and _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions[key]
    if savedPos and type(savedPos) == "table" then
        holder.Position = tableToUDim2(savedPos, pos)
    else
        holder.Position = pos
    end
    holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    holder.BorderSizePixel = 0
    holder.ZIndex = 1000
    holder.Active = true
    holder.Parent = mobileGui

    -- Pulsante principale
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", holder)
    btn.Name = "MB_" .. key
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    btn.BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset
    btn.Text = label
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 10
    btn.TextWrapped = true
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.ZIndex = 1002
    btn.Active = true
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    -- Gradiente per il TESTO (spento)
    local txtGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btn)
    txtGrad.Name = "_CalciumShimmerGradient"
    txtGrad.Rotation = 0
    txtGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
    txtGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 45)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(230, 100, 25)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(90, 30, 8)),
    })

    -- Gradiente per lo SFONDO (acceso)
    local bgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", btn)
    bgGrad.Name = "BgGradient"
    bgGrad.Rotation = 0
    bgGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
    bgGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.00, Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 45)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.50, Color3.fromRGB(230, 100, 25)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.00, Color3.fromRGB(90, 30, 8)),
    })
    bgGrad.Enabled = false  -- disabilitato di default

    -- Glow esterno (senza bordo)
    local glow = Instance.new("Frame", holder)
    glow.Name = "Glow"
    glow.Size = UDim2.new(1, 4, 1, 4)
    glow.Position = UDim2.new(0, -2, 0, -2)
    glow.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 130, 40)
    glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
    glow.BorderSizePixel = 0
    glow.ZIndex = 1000
    Instance.new("UICorner", glow).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 13)

    -- Funzione per aggiornare lo stato
    local function updateButton(state)
        if state then
            -- ON: sfondo galattico, TESTO NERO
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)  -- base per gradiente
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)              -- TESTO NERO
            txtGrad.Enabled = false                               -- disabilita gradiente testo
            bgGrad.Enabled = true                                 -- abilita gradiente sfondo
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
        else
            -- OFF: sfondo nero, TESTO GALATTICO
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0
            btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)       -- base per gradiente
            txtGrad.Enabled = true                                -- abilita gradiente testo
            bgGrad.Enabled = false                                -- disabilita gradiente sfondo
            glow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
        end
    end
    -- Funzione per ottenere lo stato logico
    local function getLogicalState()
        if key == "autoPlay" then
            return _G.CalciumAutoPlay and _G.CalciumAutoPlay.active() or false
        elseif key == "aimbot" then
            return (_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true)
        elseif key == "tpBat" then
            return _G.CalciumTPBatMobileActive and _G.CalciumTPBatMobileActive() or false
        elseif key == "carry" then
            return currentSpeedMode == "Carry"
        elseif key == "laggerNormal" then
            return currentSpeedMode == "Lagger"
        elseif key == "laggerCarry" then
            return currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry"
        else
            return false
        end
    end
    -- Gestione input
    local pressing = false
    local dragging = false
    local pressPos = nil
    local holderStart = nil

    btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            pressing = true
            dragging = false
            pressPos = i.Position
            holderStart = holder.Position
            updateButton(true)
        end
    end)

    btn.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            if pressing and not dragging then
                pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
                pcall(onPress)
            end
            if dragging then
                if _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions then
                    _G.CalciumMobileButtonPositions[key] = udim2ToTable(holder.Position)
                end
                pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
            end
            pressing = false
            dragging = false

            task.delay(0.02, function()
                if btn and btn.Parent then
                    updateButton(getLogicalState())
                end
            end)
        end
    end)

    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if _G.CalciumGuiLocked == true or not pressing then return end
        if i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        local delta = i.Position - pressPos
        local dragThresh = (key == "instantReset") and 4 or 6
        if not dragging and (math.abs(delta.X) > dragThresh or math.abs(delta.Y) > dragThresh) then
            dragging = true
        end
        if dragging then
            holder.Position = UDim2.new(
                holderStart.X.Scale,
                holderStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                holderStart.Y.Scale,
                holderStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end)

    mobileButtons[key] = {
        holder = holder,
        btn = btn,
        setActive = function(state) updateButton(state) end
    }

    -- Stato di visibilita' subito coerente col toggle e con la lista
    if _G.CalciumMobileHideIncluded then
        holder.Visible = not ((_G.CalciumHideMobileButtons == true)
                              and _G.CalciumMobileHideIncluded(key))
    end
    updateButton(getLogicalState())

    return btn
end
  local x1, x2, x3 = -218, -154, -90
  local y1, y2, y3, y4 = -150, -102, -54, -6
defaults = {
    drop         = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y1),
    autoPlay     = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y1),
    tpBat   = UDim2.new(1, x1, 0.5, y1),
    aimbot       = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y2),
    instantReset = UDim2.new(1, x1, 0.5, y2),
    tp           = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y3),
    carry        = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y3),
    laggerNormal = UDim2.new(1, x2, 0.5, y4),
    laggerCarry  = UDim2.new(1, x3, 0.5, y4),
}

  function _G.CalciumResetMobileButtons()
    _G.CalciumMobileButtonScale = 0.75
    _G.CalciumHideMobileButtons = false

  -- tramite _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates() chiamata
  -- nelle funzioni che cambiano effettivamente lo stato.
  function _G.CalciumRefreshMobileButtonStates()
    if mobileButtons.autoPlay then
      mobileButtons.autoPlay.setActive(_G.CalciumAutoPlay and _G.CalciumAutoPlay.active() or false)
    end
    if _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual then
      _G.CalciumSetAutoPlayVisual(_G.CalciumAutoPlay and _G.CalciumAutoPlay.active() or false)
    end
    if mobileButtons.aimbot then
      mobileButtons.aimbot.setActive((_G.CalciumNormalAimbotOn == true) or (_G.CalciumBatAimbotV2On == true))
      -- Aggiorna il testo in base alla versione selezionata
      local aimbotMobileBtn = mobileButtons.aimbot.btn
      if aimbotMobileBtn then
        aimbotMobileBtn.Text = (selectedAimbotMode == "V2") and "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV2" or "BAT\nAIMBOT\nV1"
      end
      -- e la stessa versione nella lista Hide Mobile Buttons
      if _G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot then pcall(_G._AmbHideOptLabel_aimbot) end
    end
    if mobileButtons.tpBat then
      mobileButtons.tpBat.setActive(_G.CalciumTPBatMobileActive and _G.CalciumTPBatMobileActive() or false)
    end
    -- antiTPBat mobile removed
    if mobileButtons.carry then mobileButtons.carry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Carry") end
    if mobileButtons.laggerNormal then mobileButtons.laggerNormal.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger") end
    if mobileButtons.laggerCarry then mobileButtons.laggerCarry.setActive(currentSpeedMode == "Lagger Carry") end
  end
end)

    _oldLoadCalciumConfig()
    -- Applica lo stato di Stretch Rez dopo il caricamento
    if _G.StretchRez and _G.StretchRez.apply then
        local idx = stretchCurrentIndex or 1
        _G.StretchRez.apply(idx)
    end
end

-- DUELS V2 SPEED BYPASS PANEL -- User supplied replacement (isolated)
-- Matches the Settings > Extra Panels opener. Hidden by default, one instance.
task.defer(function()
  task.wait(0.35)
  local ok, err = pcall(function()
    -- Calcium Speed Bypass, standalone extraction.
    -- Original core deliberately stalls local frames; it does not change server speed limits.
    -- PC/mobile powers and wallpaper are saved when executor file APIs are available.
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local RS = game:GetService("RunService")
    local TS = game:GetService("TweenService")
    local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    if type(_G.CalciumStandaloneBypassCleanup) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumStandaloneBypassCleanup) end
    local old = parent:FindFirstChild("CalciumStandaloneBypass")
    if old then old:Destroy() end
    local connections, alive, active, lagConn = {}, true, false, nil
    local config = {PC = 97000, MOBILE = 72000, background = "129085053275432", opacity = 0.65, key = "B"}
    local file = "CalciumStandaloneBypass.json"
    if type(readfile) == "function" then
      local ok, data = pcall(function() return Http:JSONDecode(readfile(file)) end)
      if ok and type(data) == "table" then
        for k in pairs(config) do if type(data[k]) == type(config[k]) then config[k] = data[k] end end
      end
    end
    local function finite(n, fallback)
      n = tonumber(n)
      return n and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge and n or fallback
    end
    config.PC = math.clamp(finite(config.PC, 97000), 10000, 300000)
    config.MOBILE = math.clamp(finite(config.MOBILE, 72000), 10000, 300000)
    config.opacity = math.clamp(finite(config.opacity, 0.65), 0, 0.9)
    local platform = UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled and "MOBILE" or "PC"
    local boundKey = Enum.KeyCode.B
    pcall(function() boundKey = Enum.KeyCode[config.key] or Enum.KeyCode.B end)
    local function save() if type(writefile) == "function" then pcall(writefile, file, Http:JSONEncode(config)) end end
    local function connect(signal, fn)
      local c = signal:Connect(fn); table.insert(connections, c); return c
    end
    local function stop()
      active = false
      if lagConn then lagConn:Disconnect(); lagConn = nil end
    end
    local function start(power)
      stop()
      power = math.clamp(math.floor(power + 0.5), 10000, 300000)
      -- Same power curve as Calcium core, but split into short micro-stalls
      -- so the game does not look frozen / delayed every frame.
      -- Old: one long busy-wait up to ~200ms per frame (destroys FPS/feel).
      -- New: total stall budget scaled by power, delivered in tiny slices.
      local intensity = (power - 10000) / 290000 -- 0..1
      local budget = intensity * 0.035 -- max ~28ms total stall per frame (was up to 200ms)
      -- At lower power, skip some frames entirely so movement stays smooth
      local frameSkip = 1
      if intensity < 0.25 then
        frameSkip = 3
      elseif intensity < 0.5 then
        frameSkip = 2
      end
      local slice = 0.0025 -- 2.5ms busy slices (CPU spin, no task.wait jitter)
      local frameCounter = 0
      active = true
      lagConn = RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not active or not alive then return end
        frameCounter = frameCounter + 1
        if frameCounter % frameSkip ~= 0 then return end
        local remaining = budget
        while active and remaining > 0 do
          local piece = remaining < slice and remaining or slice
          local began = os.clock()
          while active and os.clock() - began < piece do end
          remaining = remaining - piece
        end
      end)
    end
    local accent = Color3.fromRGB(108, 220, 235)
    local function make(class, props, into)
      local x = Instance.new(class)
      for k,v in pairs(props) do x[k] = v end
      x.Parent = into; return x
    end
    local function round(x,r) make("UICorner", {CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r)}, x) end
    local gui = make("ScreenGui", {Name="CalciumStandaloneBypass",ResetOnSpawn=false,IgnoreGuiInset=false,ZIndexBehavior=Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling},parent)
    local panel = make("Frame", {Size=UDim2.fromOffset(340,502),AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5),Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(10,15,21),BorderSizePixel=0,ClipsDescendants=true},gui)
    round(panel,20)
    make("UIStroke",{Color=Color3.fromRGB(60,100,117),Thickness=1,Transparency=0.2},panel)
    local scale = make("UIScale",{Scale=1},panel)
    local wallpaper = make("ImageLabel",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundTransparency=1,Image="",ScaleType=Enum.ScaleType.Crop,ZIndex=1},panel)
    local shade = make("Frame",{Size=UDim2.fromScale(1,1),BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(6,11,18),BackgroundTransparency=0.2,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=2},panel)
    -- Round each painted layer: a parent corner does not mask child images.
    round(wallpaper,20)
    round(shade,20)
    wallpaper.ImageColor3=Color3.fromRGB(221,236,247)
    shade.BackgroundTransparency=0.32
    local shadeGradient=make("UIGradient",{
      Rotation=90,
      Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0.28),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0.12)})
    },shade)
    -- Soft perimeter bloom. Static layers avoid an extra per-frame effects loop.
    local glow=make("Frame",{Name="WallpaperGlow",Size=panel.Size,Position=panel.Position,AnchorPoint=panel.AnchorPoint,BackgroundTransparency=1,ZIndex=0},gui)
    local glowScale=make("UIScale",{Scale=1},glow)
    local glowEdges={}
    for i=8,1,-1 do
      local spread=i*2
      local layer=make("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(-spread,-spread),Size=UDim2.new(1,spread*2,1,spread*2),BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ZIndex=0},glow)

    end

    local function syncGlow()
      glow.Size,glow.Position,glow.Visible=panel.Size,panel.Position,panel.Visible
      glowScale.Scale=scale.Scale
    end
    connect(panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"),syncGlow)
    connect(panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Size"),syncGlow)
    connect(panel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"),syncGlow)
    connect(scale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"),syncGlow)
    syncGlow()
    local textObjects = {}
    local starborn
    local function label(value,x,y,w,h,size)
      local t=make("TextLabel",{Text=value,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h),BackgroundTransparency=1,TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(230,241,246),Font=Enum.Font.GothamMedium,TextSize=size or 14,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,TextTruncate=Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,ZIndex=4},panel)

    end
    label("CALCIUM",20,18,244,26,20)
    local subtitle=label("SPEED BYPASS",21,48,250,18,12)
    subtitle.TextColor3=accent

    for i,id in ipairs(presets) do

      if UIS:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
      local isGamepad=input.UserInputType.Name:match("^Gamepad")~=nil

      -- The same bind can be a keyboard key OR a controller button.
      if waiting then
        if input.KeyCode==Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
          waiting=false
          keyButton.Text="KEY  "..boundKey.Name
          return
        end
        if input.KeyCode~=Enum.KeyCode.Unknown and
          (input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or
           (isGamepad and input.KeyCode.Name:match("^Button"))) then
          boundKey=input.KeyCode
          config.key=boundKey.Name
          waiting=false
          save()
          keyButton.Text="KEY  "..boundKey.Name
          return
        end
      end

      -- Gamepad buttons may be marked processed by Roblox's default controls,
      -- so honor the chosen controller bind even when processed is true.
      if input.KeyCode==boundKey and
        (not processed or isGamepad) then
        setActive(not active)
      end
    end)
    local minimized=false
    local function fit()
      local view=gui.AbsoluteSize
      if view.X<=0 or view.Y<=0 then return end
      scale.Scale=math.max(0.1,math.min(1,(view.X-52)/340,(view.Y-52)/(minimized and 70 or 502)))

      sizeTween=TS:Create(panel,TweenInfo.new(0.26,Enum.EasingStyle.Quint,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Size=UDim2.fromOffset(340,minimized and 70 or 502)})
      sizeTween:Play()
      task.delay(0.27,function() if alive and token==animationToken then fit() end end)
    end
    connect(collapse.Activated,function() setMinimized(not minimized) end)
    local drag=make("Frame",{Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,0),Size=UDim2.new(1,-58,0,70),BackgroundTransparency=1,Active=true,ZIndex=10},panel)
    local pointer,origin,startPosition
    connect(drag.InputBegan,function(input)
      if input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then pointer=input;origin=input.Position;startPosition=panel.Position end
    end)
    connect(UIS.InputChanged,function(input)
      if pointer and (input==pointer or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
        local d=input.Position-origin;panel.Position=startPosition+UDim2.fromOffset(d.X,d.Y)
      end
    end)
    connect(UIS.InputEnded,function(input) if input==pointer then pointer=nil;fit() end end)
    local function cleanup()
      if not alive then return end
      alive=false;stop()
      for _,c in ipairs(connections) do c:Disconnect() end
      if gui.Parent then gui:Destroy() end
    end
    _G.CalciumStandaloneBypassCleanup=cleanup
    connect(gui.Destroying,cleanup)
    if config.background=="102253425322931" or config.background=="90453834580322" then config.background="129085053275432" end
    refresh();setBackground(config.background:match("^%d+$") or "");fit()
    panel.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(340,70)
    setMinimized(false)
    -- Starborn stays enabled, with a readable fallback if the asset cannot load.
    task.spawn(function()
      local ok,font=pcall(function()
        local asset=getcustomasset or getsynasset
        if type(asset)~="function" or type(writefile)~="function" then return nil end
        local path="calcium_starborn.ttf"
        local exists=false
        if type(isfile)=="function" then local good,value=pcall(isfile,path);exists=good and value==true end
        if not exists then
          local bytes=game:HttpGet("https://files.catbox.moe/pwgdui.ttf")
          if type(bytes)~="string" or #bytes<1000 then return nil end
          local magic=bytes:sub(1,4)
          if magic~=string.char(0,1,0,0) and magic~="OTTO" and magic~="true" then return nil end
          writefile(path,bytes)
        end
        writefile("calcium_bypass_starborn.json",Http:JSONEncode({name="Starborn",faces={{name="Regular",weight=400,style="normal",assetId=asset(path)}}}))
        return Font.new(asset("calcium_bypass_starborn.json"))
      end)
      if ok and font and alive then
        starborn=font
        for _,t in ipairs(textObjects) do if t~=collapse then t.FontFace=font end end
      end
    end)

    -- Calcium integration: keep the replacement's controls, theme and keybinds.
    -- Opening from Settings does not create new render loops or duplicate GUI panels.
    gui.Enabled = false
    _G._CalciumSpeedBypassPanelOpen = false
    _G.SpeedOpenBypass = function()
      if not alive or not gui.Parent then return end
      _G._CalciumSpeedBypassPanelOpen = true
      gui.Enabled = true
      panel.Visible = true
      syncGlow()
    end
    _G.SpeedCloseBypass = function()
      _G._CalciumSpeedBypassPanelOpen = false
      setActive(false)
      if gui.Parent then gui.Enabled = false end
    end
    _G.CalciumOpenBypass = _G.SpeedOpenBypass
    _G.CalciumCloseBypass = _G.SpeedCloseBypass
  end)
  if not ok then warn("[Calcium Speed Bypass] replacement failed:", err) end
end)

        sec = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(sec) or 0))
        local m = math.floor(sec / 60)
        local s = sec % 60
        return string.format("%d:%02d", m, s)
    end

    timeRow.Name = "TimeRow"

    timeElapsed.Name = "Elapsed"
    timeElapsed.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0)
    timeElapsed.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    timeElapsed.BackgroundTransparency = 1

    timeElapsed.TextSize = 11
    timeElapsed.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local timeLength = Instance.new("TextLabel", timeRow)
    timeLength.Name = "Length"

    timeLength.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    timeLength.Text = "0:00"
    timeLength.TextColor3 = MUTED
    timeLength.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    timeLength.TextSize = 11
    timeLength.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right

    local controls = Instance.new("Frame", main)
    controls.Name = "Controls"
    controls.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 36)
    controls.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 108)
    controls.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    controls.ZIndex = 2
    local cl = Instance.new("UIListLayout", controls)
    cl.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    cl.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    cl.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    cl.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    local playBtn, loopBtn, volBtn
    local function mkCtrl(parent, label, order, width, cb)
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, 32)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 38)
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.Text = label
        b.TextColor3 = WHITE
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.TextSize = 11
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.LayoutOrder = order
        b.ZIndex = 3
        b.Parent = parent
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
        local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", b)
        st.Color = BRD
        st.Thickness = 1
        st.Transparency = 0.35
        b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 40, 52)
        end)
        b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 38)
        end)
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            pcall(cb)
        end)
        return b
    end
    local lib = (CalciumMusic and CalciumMusic.library) or CALCIUM_SONG_LIBRARY or _G.CALCIUM_SONG_LIBRARY or _G.CalciumMusicLibrary or {}
    if type(lib) ~= "table" then lib = {} end

    mkCtrl(controls, "<<", 1, 42, function()
        local n = #lib
        if n < 1 then return end
        local i = (CalciumMusic.songIdx or 1) - 1
        if i < 1 then i = n end
        if type(calciumMusicPlay) == "function" then calciumMusicPlay(i) end
        if playBtn then playBtn.Text = "Pause" end
        if type(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) == "function" then pcall(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) end
    end)
    playBtn = mkCtrl(controls, "Play", 2, 56, function()
        if CalciumMusic.sound and CalciumMusic.sound.IsPlaying then
            pcall(function() CalciumMusic.sound:Pause() end)
            playBtn.Text = "Play"
            return
        end
        if CalciumMusic.sound and not CalciumMusic.sound.IsPlaying and CalciumMusic.sound.TimePosition > 0 then
            pcall(function() CalciumMusic.sound:Resume() end)
            playBtn.Text = "Pause"
            return
        end
        local i = CalciumMusic.songIdx or 1
        if type(calciumMusicPlay) == "function" then calciumMusicPlay(i) end
        playBtn.Text = "Pause"
        if type(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) == "function" then pcall(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) end
    end)
    mkCtrl(controls, ">>", 3, 42, function()
        local n = #lib
        if n < 1 then return end
        local i = (CalciumMusic.songIdx or 1) + 1
        if i > n then i = 1 end
        if type(calciumMusicPlay) == "function" then calciumMusicPlay(i) end
        if playBtn then playBtn.Text = "Pause" end
        if type(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) == "function" then pcall(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) end
    end)
    loopBtn = mkCtrl(controls, (CalciumMusic.looped ~= false) and "Loop" or "Once", 4, 50, function()
        CalciumMusic.looped = not (CalciumMusic.looped ~= false)
        if CalciumMusic.sound then
            pcall(function() CalciumMusic.sound.Looped = CalciumMusic.looped end)
        end
        loopBtn.Text = CalciumMusic.looped and "Loop" or "Once"
        pcall(function() if type(saveConfig) == "function" then saveConfig() end end)
    end)
    volBtn = mkCtrl(controls, string.format("%.1f", CalciumMusic.volume or 1.2), 5, 46, function()
        local v = tonumber(CalciumMusic.volume) or 1.2
        v = v + 0.3
        if v > 2.4 then v = 0.3 end
        if type(calciumMusicSetVolume) == "function" then
            calciumMusicSetVolume(v)
        else
            CalciumMusic.volume = v
            if CalciumMusic.sound then pcall(function() CalciumMusic.sound.Volume = v end) end
        end
        volBtn.Text = string.format("%.1f", CalciumMusic.volume or v)
        pcall(function() if type(saveConfig) == "function" then saveConfig() end end)
    end)

    local list = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", main)
    list.Name = "SongList"
    list.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 1, -160)
    list.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 152)
    list.BackgroundColor3 = ROW
    list.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    list.BorderSizePixel = 0
    list.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    list.ScrollBarImageColor3 = ACC
    list.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    list.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    list.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
    list.ZIndex = 2
    Instance.new("UICorner", list).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
    local listStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", list)
    listStroke.Color = BRD
    listStroke.Thickness = 1
    listStroke.Transparency = 0.4
    local lay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", list)
    lay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    lay.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", list)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
    pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local function refreshList()
        for _, ch in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("TextButton") or ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
        end
        lib = (CalciumMusic and CalciumMusic.library) or CALCIUM_SONG_LIBRARY or _G.CALCIUM_SONG_LIBRARY or _G.CalciumMusicLibrary or lib or {}
        if type(lib) ~= "table" or #lib == 0 then
            local empty = Instance.new("TextLabel", list)
            empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
            empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            empty.Text = "No songs loaded"
            empty.TextColor3 = MUTED
            empty.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            empty.TextSize = 12
            return
        end
        for i, song in ipairs(lib) do
            local name = type(song) == "table" and (song.name or song.Name or ("Song " .. i)) or tostring(song)
            local row = Instance.new("TextButton", list)
            row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38)
            row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 32, 40)
            row.BorderSizePixel = 0
            row.Text = "  " .. tostring(name)
            row.TextColor3 = WHITE
            row.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
            row.TextSize = 12
            row.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            row.AutoButtonColor = false
            row.LayoutOrder = i
            row.ZIndex = 3
            Instance.new("UICorner", row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
            if CalciumMusic.songIdx == i then
                row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 55, 80)
                local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", row)
                st.Color = ACC
                st.Thickness = 1
                st.Transparency = 0.25
            end
            row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if type(calciumMusicPlay) == "function" then calciumMusicPlay(i) end
                if playBtn then playBtn.Text = "Pause" end
                if type(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) == "function" then pcall(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) end
            end)
        end
    end
    _G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI = function()
        pcall(function()
            lib = (CalciumMusic and CalciumMusic.library) or CALCIUM_SONG_LIBRARY or _G.CALCIUM_SONG_LIBRARY or _G.CalciumMusicLibrary or {}
            local idx = CalciumMusic.songIdx or 1
            local song = lib[idx]
            local name = song and (type(song) == "table" and (song.name or song.Name) or tostring(song)) or "Nothing playing"
            if nowPlaying and nowPlaying.Parent then
                nowPlaying.Text = tostring(name)
            end
            if playBtn and playBtn.Parent then
                local playing = CalciumMusic.sound and CalciumMusic.sound.IsPlaying
                playBtn.Text = playing and "Pause" or "Play"
            end
            pcall(function()
                local s = CalciumMusic and CalciumMusic.sound
                if s and s.TimeLength and s.TimeLength > 0 then
                    if timeLength and timeLength.Parent then timeLength.Text = fmtTime(s.TimeLength) end
                    if timeElapsed and timeElapsed.Parent then timeElapsed.Text = fmtTime(s.TimePosition or 0) end
                end
            end)
            refreshList()
        end)
    end
    -- progress + length ticker
    task.spawn(function()
        while gui and gui.Parent do
            pcall(function()
                local s = CalciumMusic and CalciumMusic.sound
                if s and s.TimeLength and s.TimeLength > 0 then
                    local len = s.TimeLength
                    local pos = s.TimePosition or 0
                    progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(pos / len, 0, 1), 0, 1, 0)
                    if timeElapsed and timeElapsed.Parent then
                        timeElapsed.Text = fmtTime(pos)
                    end
                    if timeLength and timeLength.Parent then
                        timeLength.Text = fmtTime(len)
                    end
                else
                    if timeElapsed and timeElapsed.Parent then timeElapsed.Text = "0:00" end
                    if timeLength and timeLength.Parent then timeLength.Text = "0:00" end
                    if progressFill and progressFill.Parent then
                        progressFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                    end
                end
            end)
            task.wait(0.15)
        end
    end)

    -- drag
    do
        local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
        header.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = true
                dragStart = input.Position
                startPos = main.Position
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if not dragging then return end
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                local d = input.Position - dragStart
                main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
            end
        end)
        UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
            if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
    refreshList()
    pcall(function() if type(_G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI) == "function" then _G._CalciumMusicRefreshUI() end end)
end
_G.openCalciumMusicPlayer = openCalciumMusicPlayer

-- ============================================================
-- PING LAGGER + LAGGER PANELS (remade glass UI)
-- ============================================================
do
  local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
  local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")

  local function parentGui()
    local p
    pcall(function()
      if typeof(gethui) == "function" then p = gethui() end
    end)
    if not p then
      pcall(function() p = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
    end
    if not p then
      p = PlayerGui or (LP and LP:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui"))
    end
    return p
  end

  local function applyBg(frame)
    if _G.CalciumStylePanel then _G.CalciumStylePanel(frame) end
  end

  local function makeDraggable(frame)
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
      if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = inp.Position
        startPos = frame.Position
        inp.Changed:Connect(function()
          if inp.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
            dragging = false
          end
        end)
      end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(inp)
      if dragging and (inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = inp.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
      end
    end)
  end

  -- PING LAGGER
  local _cplGui, _cplActive, _cplRemote = nil, false, nil
  local _cplCfg = { power = 100000, interval = 0.125, keybindKb = "F", autoBrainrot = false }
  pcall(function()
    if isfile and isfile("CalciumPingLagger.json") then
      local raw = readfile("CalciumPingLagger.json")
      local ok, data = pcall(function() return HS:JSONDecode(raw) end)
      if ok and type(data) == "table" then
        _cplCfg.power = tonumber(data.power) or _cplCfg.power
        _cplCfg.interval = tonumber(data.interval) or _cplCfg.interval
        if type(data.keybindKb) == "string" then
          _cplCfg.keybindKb = data.keybindKb
        end
        if data.autoBrainrot ~= nil then
          _cplCfg.autoBrainrot = data.autoBrainrot == true
        end
      end
    end
  end)

  local function savePingCfg()
    pcall(function()
      if writefile then
        writefile("CalciumPingLagger.json", HS:JSONEncode(_cplCfg))
      end
    end)
  end

  local function cplFindRemote()
    local found
    pcall(function()
      for _, d in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
          local n = d.Name:lower()
          if n:find("block") or n:find("ping") then
            found = d
            break
          end
        end
      end
    end)
    return found
  end

  local function runPingLoop()
    while _cplActive and (_G._CalciumPingPanelOpen == true) do
      pcall(function()
        if not _cplRemote then
          _cplRemote = cplFindRemote()
        end
        if _cplRemote then
          local n = math.clamp(math.floor((_cplCfg.power or 100000) / 5000), 1, 40)
          for _ = 1, n do
            pcall(function()
              _cplRemote:FireServer()
            end)
          end
        end
      end)
      task.wait(tonumber(_cplCfg.interval) or 0.125)
    end
  end

    local function updateState()
      status.Text = _cplActive and "ONLINE" or "OFFLINE"
      status.TextColor3 = _cplActive and C.Green or C.Text
      statusDot.BackgroundColor3 = _cplActive and C.Green or C.Red
      toggle.Text = _cplActive and "DISABLE PING LAG" or "ENABLE PING LAG"
      toggle.BackgroundColor3 = _cplActive and C.CyanDark or C.Cyan
      toggle.TextColor3 = _cplActive and C.Text or C.BG
    end

    local function setEnabled(on)
      _cplActive = on and true or false
      updateState()
      if _cplActive then
        task.spawn(runPingLoop)
      end
    end

    toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      setEnabled(not _cplActive)
    end)

    close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      setEnabled(false)
      _G._CalciumPingPanelOpen = false
      if _cplGui then _cplGui.Enabled = false end
    end)

    -- keybind capture + toggle
    pcall(function()
      UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
        if capturing then
          if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard and input.KeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
            _cplCfg.keybindKb = input.KeyCode.Name
            keyBtn.Text = input.KeyCode.Name
            capturing = false
            savePingCfg()
          end
          return
        end
        if processed then return end
        if UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then return end
        if input.KeyCode.Name == tostring(_cplCfg.keybindKb) then
          if _G._CalciumPingPanelOpen then
            setEnabled(not _cplActive)
          end
        end
      end)
    end)

    -- fps/ping
    task.spawn(function()
      local frames, elapsed = 0, 0
      RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not (dash and dash.Parent) then return end
        frames += 1
        elapsed += dt
        if elapsed >= 0.5 then
          fpsLabel.Text = "FPS  " .. tostring(math.floor(frames / elapsed + 0.5))
          frames, elapsed = 0, 0
          local ping = 0
          pcall(function()
            ping = math.floor((LP:GetNetworkPing() or 0) * 1000 + 0.5)
          end)
          pingLabel.Text = string.format("PING  %d ms", ping)
        end
      end)
    end)

    -- auto brainrot loop
    if not _G._CalciumPingAutoBRConn then
      _G._CalciumPingAutoBRConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not (_cplCfg and _cplCfg.autoBrainrot) then return end
        local carrying = false
        pcall(function()
          if _G.CalciumSafeModeHoldingBrainrot then
            carrying = _G.CalciumSafeModeHoldingBrainrot() == true
          end
        end)
        if carrying and not _cplActive then
          setEnabled(true)
          status.Text = "ONLINE (BRAINROT)"
        elseif (not carrying) and _cplActive and tostring(status.Text):find("BRAINROT") then
          setEnabled(false)
        end
      end)
    end

    updateAutoVisual()
    updateState()
  end

  _G.CalciumOpenPingLagger = function()
    _G._CalciumPingPanelOpen = true
    cplOpen()
  end

  -- LAGGER PANEL
  local _clGui
  local _clMainOn, _clLowOn = false, false
  local MAIN_CFG = { TableIncrease = 265, Tries = 1, LoopWaitTime = 0.85 }
  local LOW_CFG = { TableIncrease = 1.5, Tries = 1, LoopWaitTime = 0.155 }

  local function clBomb(tableincrease, tries, waitTime)
    pcall(function()
      local t = {}
      for i = 1, math.floor(tableincrease * 1000) do
        t[i] = string.rep("x", 50)
      end
      for _ = 1, tries do
        task.wait(waitTime)
      end
    end)
  end

	local function rndName()
		local out = ""
		for _ = 1, math.random(8, 14) do
			local n = math.random(1, 26)
			out = out .. charset:sub(n, n)
		end
		return out
	end

	local function safeParentGui(g)
		g.Name = rndName()
		g:SetAttribute("__delhub", true)
		local ok = pcall(function()
			if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(g) end
			g.Parent = (hui and hui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end)
		if not ok or not g.Parent then
			g.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		end
		return g
	end

	function NV.refreshPlaylistEditor() end

	S.radioTracks = S.radioTracks or {}
	S.libHistory = S.libHistory or {}

	S._radio = { sound=nil, playing=false, cache={}, fails=0 }
	function S._radio.http(url)
		local req = (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
		if req then
			local ok,res = pcall(req,{Url=url,Method="GET"})
			if ok and res and res.Body and #res.Body>0 then return res.Body end
		end
		local ok,body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url,true) end)
		if ok and body and #body>0 then return body end
		return nil
	end
	function S._radio.resolve(track)
		track = tostring(track or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
		if track=="" then return nil end
		if tonumber(track) then return "rbxassetid://"..tostring(math.floor(tonumber(track))) end
		if track:match("^rbxassetid://") then return track end
		if track:match("^https?://") then
			if S._radio.cache[track] then return S._radio.cache[track] end
			if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then return nil end
			local dl = track
			if track:match("api%-v2%.soundcloud%.com/media/") then dl = S._radio.scResolve(track); if not dl then return nil end end
			local body = S._radio.http(dl); if not body then return nil end
			local fn = "delhub_radio_"..(track:gsub("[^%w]","_")):sub(-44)..".mp3"
			if not pcall(writefile, fn, body) then return nil end
			local cok,asset = pcall(getcustomasset, fn)
			if cok and asset then S._radio.cache[track]=asset; return asset end
		end
		return nil
	end
	function S._radio.entryUrl(e) if type(e)=="table" then return tostring(e.url or "") end return tostring(e or "") end
	function S._radio.entryName(e) if type(e)=="table" and e.name and e.name~="" then return tostring(e.name) end return nil end
	function S._radio.entryCover(e) if type(e)=="table" and e.cover and e.cover~="" then return tostring(e.cover) end return nil end
	function S._radio.entryEnabled(e) if type(e)=="table" and e.enabled==false then return false end return true end
	function S._radio.resolveImage(src)
		src=tostring(src or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
		if src=="" then return nil end
		if tonumber(src) then return "rbxassetid://"..tostring(math.floor(tonumber(src))) end
		if src:match("^rbxassetid://") then return src end
		if src:match("^https?://") then
			if S._radio.cache[src] then return S._radio.cache[src] end
			if not (writefile and getcustomasset) then return nil end
			local body=S._radio.http(src); if not body then return nil end
			local ext=src:gsub("%?.*$",""):match("%.(%w+)$") or "png"
			local fn="delhub_radio_img_"..(src:gsub("[^%w]","_")):sub(-40).."."..ext
			if not pcall(writefile,fn,body) then return nil end
			local cok,asset=pcall(getcustomasset,fn)
			if cok and asset then S._radio.cache[src]=asset; return asset end
		end
		return nil
	end

	function S._radio.urlEncode(s)
	  s=tostring(s or "")
	  return (s:gsub("[^%w%-_%.~]", function(c) return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c)) end))
	end
	function S._radio.cleanName(s)

	  s=tostring(s or ""):lower()
	  s=s:gsub("%b()"," "):gsub("%b[]"," ")
	  for _,w in ipairs({"slowed","reverbed","reverb","sped up","spedup","hardtekk","hardstyle","phonk","nightcore","bass boosted","bassboosted","lo fi","lofi","remix","edit","drill","8d"}) do s=s:gsub(w,"") end
	  s=s:gsub("%s+x%s+"," "):gsub("[_%-]+"," "):gsub("%s+"," "):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
	  return s
	end
	function S._radio.spotifyMeta(url)

	  url=tostring(url or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
	  if url:match("^spotify:") then
	    local kind,id=url:match("spotify:(%w+):(%w+)")
	    if kind and id then url="https://open.spotify.com/"..kind.."/"..id end
	  end
	  if not url:match("open%.spotify%.com") then return nil end
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://open.spotify.com/oembed?url="..S._radio.urlEncode(url))
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" then return nil end
	  local name=(type(data.title)=="string" and data.title~="" and data.title) or nil
	  local cover=(type(data.thumbnail_url)=="string" and data.thumbnail_url~="" and data.thumbnail_url) or nil
	  if not name and not cover then return nil end
	  return {name=name, cover=cover}
	end
	function S._radio.lookup(query)

	  query=tostring(query or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
	  if query=="" then return nil end
	  if query:match("open%.spotify%.com") or query:match("^spotify:") then

	    local sp=S._radio.spotifyMeta(query)
	    if sp and sp.cover then return sp end
	    if sp and sp.name and sp.name~="" then query=sp.name else return sp end
	  end
	  local q=S._radio.cleanName(query); if q=="" then q=query end
	  local hit=S._radio.deezer(q)
	  if hit and hit.cover then return hit end
	  local it=S._radio.itunes(q)
	  if it and it.cover then return it end
	  return hit or it
	end
	function S._radio.deezer(q)
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://api.deezer.com/search?q="..S._radio.urlEncode(q).."&limit=1")
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.data)~="table" or not data.data[1] then return nil end
	  local d=data.data[1]
	  local title=d.title_short or d.title
	  local artist=(type(d.artist)=="table" and d.artist.name) or nil
	  local cover=(type(d.album)=="table" and (d.album.cover_xl or d.album.cover_big or d.album.cover_medium)) or nil
	  local album=(type(d.album)=="table" and d.album.title) or nil
	  local name; if title and artist then name=artist.." - "..title elseif title then name=title end
	  return {name=name, cover=cover, album=album}
	end
	function S._radio.itunes(q)
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://itunes.apple.com/search?media=music&limit=1&term="..S._radio.urlEncode(q))
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.results)~="table" or not data.results[1] then return nil end
	  local r=data.results[1]
	  local cover=r.artworkUrl100
	  if type(cover)=="string" then cover=cover:gsub("100x100bb","600x600bb"):gsub("100x100","600x600") else cover=nil end
	  local name; if r.artistName and r.trackName then name=r.artistName.." - "..r.trackName elseif r.trackName then name=r.trackName end
	  return {name=name, cover=cover, album=r.collectionName}
	end
	S._radio.filling=false
	function S._radio.fillCovers(force, progress)

	  if S._radio.filling then return end
	  local list=S.radioTracks; if not list or #list==0 then return end
	  S._radio.filling=true
	  task.spawn(function()
	    local total=#list; local found=0
	    for i=1,total do
	      local e=list[i]
	      if type(e)=="table" and (force or not (e.cover and e.cover~="")) then
	        local q=(e.name and e.name~="") and e.name or nil
	        if q then
	          local hit=S._radio.lookup(q)
	          if hit then
	            if hit.cover and hit.cover~="" then e.cover=hit.cover; found=found+1 end
	            if (not e.name or e.name=="") and hit.name and hit.name~="" then e.name=hit.name end
	            if hit.album and hit.album~="" and (not e.album or e.album=="") then e.album=hit.album end
	          end
	          task.wait(1.1)
	        end
	      end
	      if progress then pcall(progress,i,total,found) end
	    end
	    S._radio.filling=false
	  end)
	end

	function S._radio.scClientId()
	  if S._radio._scid then return S._radio._scid end
	  local html=S._radio.http("https://soundcloud.com/")
	  if not html then return nil end
	  local assets={}
	  for u in html:gmatch('src="(https://a%-v2%.sndcdn%.com/assets/[%w%-%._/]+%.js)"') do assets[#assets+1]=u end
	  for i=#assets,math.max(1,#assets-4),-1 do
	    local js=S._radio.http(assets[i])
	    if js then
	      local cid=js:match('client_id:"(%w+)"') or js:match('client_id=(%w+)')
	      if cid then S._radio._scid=cid; return cid end
	    end
	  end
	  return nil
	end
	function S._radio.scSearch(query)
	  local cid=S._radio.scClientId(); if not cid then return nil,"no client_id (scrape failed)" end
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/search/tracks?limit=1&q="..S._radio.urlEncode(query).."&client_id="..cid)
	  if not body then return nil,"search request failed" end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.collection)~="table" or not data.collection[1] then return nil,"no results" end
	  local tr=data.collection[1]
	  local stream
	  if type(tr.media)=="table" and type(tr.media.transcodings)=="table" then
	    for _,tc in ipairs(tr.media.transcodings) do
	      if type(tc.format)=="table" and tc.format.protocol=="progressive" then stream=tc.url; break end
	    end
	  end
	  if not stream then return nil,"no progressive stream (HLS only)" end
	  local rb=S._radio.http(stream.."?client_id="..cid); if not rb then return nil,"stream resolve failed" end
	  local ok2,rd=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(rb) end)
	  if not ok2 or type(rd)~="table" or type(rd.url)~="string" then return nil,"no cdn url" end
	  local cover=tr.artwork_url
	  if type(cover)=="string" then cover=cover:gsub("%-large%.","-t500x500.") else cover=nil end
	  local name=(type(tr.user)=="table" and type(tr.user.username)=="string" and (tr.user.username.." - "..tostring(tr.title or ""))) or tr.title
	  return { mp3=rd.url, cover=cover, name=name }
	end
	function S._radio.testFindPlay(query, cb)
	  task.spawn(function()
	    local res,err=S._radio.scSearch(query)
	    if not res then if cb then cb(false,err or "not found") end return end
	    local asset=S._radio.resolve(res.mp3)
	    if not asset then if cb then cb(false,"got the track but Roblox couldn't load the mp3") end return end
	    S._radio.stop()
	    local snd=Instance.new("Sound"); snd.SoundId=asset; snd.Volume=S.radioVolume or 0.5; snd.Looped=false; snd.Parent=workspace
	    S._radio.sound=snd; S._radio.playing=true
	    pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
	    if cb then cb(true,res.name or query,res.cover) end
	  end)
	end
	function S._radio.scResolve(stream)
	  local cid=S._radio.scClientId(); if not cid then return nil end
	  local rb=S._radio.http(stream.."?client_id="..cid); if not rb then return nil end
	  local ok,rd=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(rb) end)
	  if not ok or type(rd)~="table" or type(rd.url)~="string" then return nil end
	  return rd.url
	end
	function S._radio.scSearchList(query, limit, offset)
	  local cid=S._radio.scClientId(); if not cid then return nil,"no client_id (scrape failed)" end
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/search/tracks?limit="..tostring(limit or 12).."&offset="..tostring(offset or 0).."&q="..S._radio.urlEncode(query).."&client_id="..cid)
	  if not body then return nil,"search request failed" end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.collection)~="table" then return nil,"bad response" end
	  local out={}
	  for _,tr in ipairs(data.collection) do
	    if type(tr)=="table" and tr.streamable~=false and tr.policy~="BLOCK" and type(tr.media)=="table" and type(tr.media.transcodings)=="table" then
	      local stream
	      for _,tc in ipairs(tr.media.transcodings) do
	        if type(tc.format)=="table" and tc.format.protocol=="progressive" then stream=tc.url; break end
	      end
	      if stream then
	        local cover=tr.artwork_url; if type(cover)=="string" then cover=cover:gsub("%-large%.","-t500x500.") else cover=nil end
	        local artist=(type(tr.user)=="table" and tr.user.username) or nil
	        local title=tr.title or "?"
	        out[#out+1]={ title=title, artist=artist, name=(artist and (artist.." - "..title)) or title, cover=cover, stream=stream }
	      end
	    end
	  end
	  return out
	end
	function S._radio.previewPlay(url, cb)
	  task.spawn(function()
	    local asset=S._radio.resolve(url)
	    if not asset then if cb then cb(false) end return end
	    S._radio.stop()
	    local snd=Instance.new("Sound"); snd.SoundId=asset; snd.Volume=S.radioVolume or 0.5; snd.Looped=false; snd.Parent=workspace
	    S._radio.sound=snd; S._radio.playing=true; pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
	    if cb then cb(true) end
	  end)
	end
	function S._radio.libAdd(item)
	  if type(item)~="table" or not item.stream then return false end
	  S.radioTracks=S.radioTracks or {}
	  table.insert(S.radioTracks, {name=item.name or item.title, url=item.stream, cover=item.cover})
	  return true
	end
	function S._radio.libRemove(item)
	  if type(item)~="table" then return false end
	  local url=item.stream or item.url; if not url then return false end
	  S.radioTracks=S.radioTracks or {}
	  local removed=false
	  for i=#S.radioTracks,1,-1 do local e=S.radioTracks[i]; if type(e)=="table" and e.url==url then table.remove(S.radioTracks,i);removed=true end end
	  return removed
	end

	  S._vapeBlurSet=function(on)

	      if getcustomasset then return getcustomasset(fn) end
	      return nil

	    if ok and asset then S._vapeIconCache[nm]=asset;return asset end

	end

	S.libHistory = S.libHistory or {}
	function S._radio.pushHistory(item)
	  if type(item)~="table" or not item.stream then return end
	  S.libHistory = S.libHistory or {}
	  for k=#S.libHistory,1,-1 do if type(S.libHistory[k])=="table" and S.libHistory[k].stream==item.stream then table.remove(S.libHistory,k) end end
	  table.insert(S.libHistory,1,{title=item.title,artist=item.artist,name=item.name,cover=item.cover,stream=item.stream})
	  while #S.libHistory>25 do table.remove(S.libHistory) end
	  pcall(saveConfig)
	end
	S._radio._imgq = { list={}, active=0, max=4 }
	function S._radio.coverAsync(url, cb)
	  if not url or url=="" then return end
	  local q=S._radio._imgq
	  local function run()
	    q.active=q.active+1
	    task.spawn(function()
	      local a; pcall(function() a=S._radio.resolveImage(url) end)
	      q.active=q.active-1
	      pcall(cb,a)
	      if #q.list>0 then local nx=table.remove(q.list,1); nx() end
	    end)
	  end
	  if q.active<q.max then run() else table.insert(q.list,run) end
	end
	S._radio._pfBusy=false; S._radio._pfNext=nil
	function S._radio.prefetch(url)
	  if not url or url=="" or S._radio.cache[url] then return end
	  S._radio._pfNext=url
	  if S._radio._pfBusy then return end
	  S._radio._pfBusy=true
	  task.spawn(function()
	    while S._radio._pfNext do
	      local u=S._radio._pfNext; S._radio._pfNext=nil
	      if u and not S._radio.cache[u] then pcall(function() S._radio.resolve(u) end) end
	    end
	    S._radio._pfBusy=false
	  end)
	end
	function S._radio.scSuggest(q)
	  local cid=S._radio.scClientId(); if not cid then return nil end
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/search/queries?limit=8&q="..S._radio.urlEncode(q).."&client_id="..cid)
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.collection)~="table" then return nil end
	  local out={}
	  for _,e in ipairs(data.collection) do if type(e)=="table" and type(e.query)=="string" then out[#out+1]=e.query end end
	  return out
	end
	task.spawn(function() task.wait(1); pcall(function() S._radio.scClientId() end) end)
	function S._radio.scRelated(id,limit)
	  local cid=S._radio.scClientId(); if not cid then return nil end
	  local body=S._radio.http("https://api-v2.soundcloud.com/tracks/"..tostring(id).."/related?limit="..tostring(limit or 12).."&client_id="..cid)
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,data=pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(data)~="table" or type(data.collection)~="table" then return nil end
	  local out={}
	  for _,tr in ipairs(data.collection) do
	    if type(tr)=="table" and tr.streamable~=false and tr.policy~="BLOCK" and type(tr.media)=="table" and type(tr.media.transcodings)=="table" then
	      local stream; for _,tc in ipairs(tr.media.transcodings) do if type(tc.format)=="table" and tc.format.protocol=="progressive" then stream=tc.url; break end end
	      if stream then local cover=tr.artwork_url; if type(cover)=="string" then cover=cover:gsub("%-large%.","-t500x500.") else cover=nil end local artist=(type(tr.user)=="table" and tr.user.username) or nil; local title=tr.title or "?"; out[#out+1]={title=title,artist=artist,name=(artist and (artist.." - "..title)) or title,cover=cover,stream=stream} end
	    end
	  end
	  return out
	end
	function S._radio.b64(s)
	  local ok,r=pcall(function()
	    if crypt then if crypt.base64encode then return crypt.base64encode(s) end if crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.encode then return crypt.base64.encode(s) end end
	    if base64 and base64.encode then return base64.encode(s) end
	  end)
	  if ok and type(r)=="string" and #r>0 then return r end
	  local b='ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
	  return ((s:gsub('.',function(x) local rr,c='',x:byte() for i=8,1,-1 do rr=rr..(c%2^i-c%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end return rr end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?',function(x) if #x<6 then return '' end local c=0 for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end return b:sub(c+1,c+1) end)..({'','==','='})[#s%3+1])
	end
	function S._radio.spReq(method,url,headers,body)
	  local req=(syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request) or http_request or request
	  if not req then return nil end
	  local ok,res=pcall(req,{Url=url,Method=method,Headers=headers,Body=body})
	  if ok and res and res.Body and #res.Body>0 and (not res.StatusCode or res.StatusCode<400) then return res.Body end
	  return nil
	end
	function S._radio.spToken()
	  if not SPOTIFY_ID or SPOTIFY_ID=="" or SPOTIFY_ID=="YOUR_SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID" then return nil end
	  if S._radio._sptok and os.time()<(S._radio._sptokExp or 0) then return S._radio._sptok end
	  local body=S._radio.spReq("POST","https://accounts.spotify.com/api/token",{["Authorization"]="Basic "..S._radio.b64(SPOTIFY_ID..":"..SPOTIFY_SECRET),["Content-Type"]="application/x-www-form-urlencoded"},"grant_type=client_credentials")
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,d=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if ok and type(d)=="table" and d.access_token then
	    S._radio._sptok=d.access_token; S._radio._sptokExp=os.time()+(tonumber(d.expires_in) or 3600)-60
	    return d.access_token
	  end
	  return nil
	end
	function S._radio.spTrackId(query)
	  local tok=S._radio.spToken(); if not tok then return nil end
	  local body=S._radio.spReq("GET","https://api.spotify.com/v1/search?type=track&limit=1&q="..S._radio.urlEncode(query),{["Authorization"]="Bearer "..tok})
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,d=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if ok and type(d)=="table" and d.tracks and type(d.tracks.items)=="table" and d.tracks.items[1] then return d.tracks.items[1].id end
	  return nil
	end
	function S._radio.spRecommend(query)
	  local id=S._radio.spTrackId(query); if not id then return nil end
	  local tok=S._radio.spToken(); if not tok then return nil end
	  local body=S._radio.spReq("GET","https://api.spotify.com/v1/recommendations?limit=12&seed_tracks="..id,{["Authorization"]="Bearer "..tok})
	  if not body then return nil end
	  local ok,d=pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(body) end)
	  if not ok or type(d)~="table" or type(d.tracks)~="table" then return nil end
	  local out={}
	  for _,t in ipairs(d.tracks) do
	    local artist=(type(t.artists)=="table" and t.artists[1] and t.artists[1].name) or ""
	    local nm=(artist~="" and (artist.." - "..(t.name or "")) or (t.name or "?"))
	    local cover=(type(t.album)=="table" and type(t.album.images)=="table" and t.album.images[1] and t.album.images[1].url) or nil
	    out[#out+1]={name=nm,title=t.name,artist=artist,cover=cover}
	  end
	  return out
	end
	function S._radio.autoplayNext(item)
	  if type(item)~="table" then return nil end
	  local sp=S._radio.spRecommend(item.title or item.name or item.artist or "")
	  if sp and #sp>0 then
	    local out={}
	    for _,rec in ipairs(sp) do
	      local hit=S._radio.scSearch(rec.name)
	      if hit and hit.stream then out[#out+1]={name=rec.name,title=rec.title or hit.title,artist=rec.artist~="" and rec.artist or hit.artist,stream=hit.stream,cover=rec.cover} end
	      if #out>=6 then break end
	    end
	    if #out>0 then return out end
	  end
	  local id=item.stream and item.stream:match("soundcloud:tracks:(%d+)")
	  local more
	  if id then more=S._radio.scRelated(id,14) end
	  if (not more or #more==0) and item.artist then more=S._radio.scSearchList(item.artist,14,math.random(0,40)) end
	  if (not more or #more==0) then more=S._radio.scSearchList(item.title or item.name or item.artist or "",14,math.random(0,120)) end
	  return more
	end

	function S._radio.stop()
		S._radio.playing=false
		S._radio.gen=(S._radio.gen or 0)+1
		if S._radio.conn then pcall(function() S._radio.conn:Disconnect() end);S._radio.conn=nil end
		if S._radio.sound then pcall(function() S._radio.sound:Stop();S._radio.sound:Destroy() end);S._radio.sound=nil end
	end
	S.radioStop = function() S._radio.stop() end
	function S._radio.playCurrent()
		S._radio.preview=nil
		S._radio.stop()
		local list=S.radioTracks
		if not list or #list==0 then S._radio.playing=false; return end
		S._radio.playing=true
		S.radioIndex=(((S.radioIndex or 1)-1)%#list)+1
		local myIdx=S.radioIndex
		local gen=S._radio.gen
		local function skipDead()
			S._radio.fails=(S._radio.fails or 0)+1
			if S._radio.fails>=#list then S._radio.playing=false;S._radio.fails=0;return true end
			S.radioIndex=myIdx+1; if S.radioIndex>#list then S.radioIndex=1 end
			S._radio.playCurrent(); return true
		end
		task.spawn(function()
			local entry=list[myIdx]
			if S._radio.entryEnabled(entry)==false then
				if gen~=S._radio.gen or not S._radio.playing then return end
				skipDead(); return
			end
			local id=S._radio.resolve(S._radio.entryUrl(entry))
			if gen~=S._radio.gen or not S._radio.playing or myIdx~=S.radioIndex then return end
			if not id then skipDead(); return end
			S._radio.fails=0
			local FADE=1.4
			local s=Instance.new("Sound")
			if _rndName then s.Name=_rndName() end
			s:SetAttribute("__delhub",true)
			s.SoundId=id; s.Volume=0; s.Looped=false; s.PlaybackSpeed=S.radioSpeed or 1
			s.Parent=game:GetService("SoundService")
			S._radio.sound=s
			S._radio.conn=s.Ended:Connect(function() if S._radio.playing then S.radioNext() end end)
			pcall(function() s:Play() end)
			pcall(function() TS:Create(s,TweenInfo.new(FADE,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Volume=S.radioVolume or 0.5}):Play() end)
			task.spawn(function()
				while S._radio.sound==s and s.Parent do
					local len=s.TimeLength or 0
					if len>0 and (len-(s.TimePosition or 0))<=FADE then
						pcall(function() TS:Create(s,TweenInfo.new(FADE,Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),{Volume=0}):Play() end)
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.2)
				end
			end)
			if S._radio.resumeAt and S._radio.resumeAt>0 then
				local rp=S._radio.resumeAt; S._radio.resumeAt=nil
				task.spawn(function()
					local t0=os.clock()
					while s.Parent and s.TimeLength==0 and (os.clock()-t0)<6 do task.wait(0.1) end
					if s.Parent and s.TimeLength>0 and rp<s.TimeLength-1 then pcall(function() s.TimePosition=rp end) end
				end)
			end
		end)
	end
	S.radioPlay = function()
		if S._radio.sound and not S._radio.playing then
			S._radio.playing=true; pcall(function() S._radio.sound:Resume() end); return
		end
		S._radio.fails=0
		S._radio.playCurrent()
	end
	S.radioNext = function()
		local list=S.radioTracks
		if not list or #list==0 then return end
		S._radio.fails=0
		S._discDir=1
		S.radioIndex=(S.radioIndex or 1)+1
		if S.radioIndex>#list then S.radioIndex=1 end
		if S._radio.playing then S._radio.playCurrent() end
	end
	S.radioPrev = function()
		local list=S.radioTracks
		if not list or #list==0 then return end
		S._radio.fails=0
		S._discDir=-1
		S.radioIndex=(S.radioIndex or 1)-1
		if S.radioIndex<1 then S.radioIndex=#list end
		if S._radio.playing then S._radio.playCurrent() end
	end
	S.radioPause = function()
		S._radio.playing=false
		if S._radio.sound then pcall(function() S._radio.sound:Pause() end) end
	end
	S.radioTitle = function()
		if S._radio.preview and S._radio.preview.title then return S._radio.preview.title end
		local list=S.radioTracks; if not list or #list==0 then return "del hub radio" end
		local e=list[S.radioIndex or 1]
		local nm=S._radio.entryName(e); if nm then return nm end
		local t=S._radio.entryUrl(e)
		if tonumber(t) then return "Audio "..t end
		t=t:gsub("%?.*$","")
		local name=t:match("([^/]+)$") or t
		name=name:gsub("%.%w+$",""):gsub("%%20"," ")
		if name=="" then return "del hub radio" end
		return name
	end
	S.radioCover = function()
		if S._radio.preview and S._radio.preview.cover then return S._radio.preview.cover end
		local list=S.radioTracks; if not list or #list==0 then return nil end
		return S._radio.entryCover(list[S.radioIndex or 1])
	end
	S.radioSetVolume = function(v)
		S.radioVolume=math.clamp(v,0,1)
		if S._radio.sound then pcall(function() S._radio.sound.Volume=S.radioVolume end) end
	end
	S.radioSetSpeed = function(v)
		S.radioSpeed=math.clamp(v,1,2)
		if S._radio.sound then pcall(function() S._radio.sound.PlaybackSpeed=S.radioSpeed end) end
	end
	S.radioShuffle = function()
		local t=S.radioTracks; if not t or #t<2 then return end
		pcall(function() math.randomseed(tick()%1*1e7 + os.clock()*1e3) end)
		for i=#t,2,-1 do local j=math.random(1,i); t[i],t[j]=t[j],t[i] end
		S.radioIndex=1
	end
	function S._radio.parseEntry(text)
		text=tostring(text or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$","")
		if text=="" then return nil end
		if text:find("|") then
			local parts={}
			for p in (text.."|"):gmatch("%s*(.-)%s*|") do table.insert(parts,p) end
			local url=parts[2] or ""
			if url=="" then return nil end
			return {name=(parts[1]~="" and parts[1] or nil),url=url,cover=(parts[3] and parts[3]~="" and parts[3] or nil)}
		end
		return text
	end
	S.radioAddTrack = function(text)
		local entry=S._radio.parseEntry(text); if not entry then return false end
		S.radioTracks=S.radioTracks or {}
		table.insert(S.radioTracks,entry)
		task.spawn(function()
			S._radio.resolve(S._radio.entryUrl(entry))
			local cv=S._radio.entryCover(entry); if cv then S._radio.resolveImage(cv) end
		end)
		return true
	end
	S.radioPreload = function()
		task.spawn(function()
			local list=S.radioTracks or {}
			local n=#list; if n==0 then return end
			for k=0,n-1 do
				local idx=(((S.radioIndex or 1)-1+k)%n)+1
				local e=list[idx]
				pcall(function() S._radio.resolve(S._radio.entryUrl(e)) end)
				task.wait(0.15)
				local cv=S._radio.entryCover(e); if cv then pcall(function() S._radio.resolveImage(cv) end) end
				task.wait(k<2 and 0.2 or 0.7)
			end
		end)
	end

	  local function syncMini()
	    pcall(function()
	      local title, artist, cover = "Nothing playing", "", nil
	      if nptitle and nptitle.Text and nptitle.Text ~= "" then title = nptitle.Text end
	      if npsub and npsub.Text then artist = npsub.Text end
	      local prev = S._radio and S._radio.preview
	      if type(prev) == "table" then
	        if prev.title and prev.title ~= "" then title = prev.title end
	        if prev.artist and prev.artist ~= "" then artist = prev.artist end
	        if prev.cover and prev.cover ~= "" then cover = prev.cover end
	      end
	      -- current playlist entry
	      pcall(function()
	        local e = S.radioTracks and S.radioTracks[S.radioIndex or 1]
	        if type(e) == "table" then
	          if (not title or title == "Nothing playing" or title == "?") and e.name then title = e.name end
	          if e.cover and e.cover ~= "" then cover = cover or e.cover end
	        end
	      end)
	      if npimg and npimg.Image and npimg.Image ~= "" then
	        mCover.Image = npimg.Image
	      elseif cover and loadCover then
	        loadCover(mCover, cover)
	      elseif cover then
	        pcall(function()
	          local resolved = S._radio.resolveImage and S._radio.resolveImage(cover)
	          if resolved then mCover.Image = resolved end
	        end)
	      end
	      mTitle.Text = title
	      mArtist.Text = artist
	      local snd = S._radio and S._radio.sound
	      if snd then
	        if snd.TimeLength and snd.TimeLength > 0 then
	          local rel = math.clamp(snd.TimePosition / snd.TimeLength, 0, 1)
	          mProg.Size = UDim2.new(rel, 0, 1, 0)
	          if mCur then mCur.Text = fmt(snd.TimePosition) end
	          if mLen then mLen.Text = fmt(snd.TimeLength) end
	        end
	        local playing = (snd.Playing == true) and not (snd.IsPaused == true)
	        mPP.Text = playing and "❚❚" or "▶"
	        mPP.TextSize = playing and 13 or 15
	        if mPPIm then mPPIm.Visible = false end
	      else
	        mPP.Text = "▶"
	        mPP.TextSize = 15
	      end
	    end)
	  end
	  local function minimizeLib()
	    syncMini()
	    -- cool slide-down of full lib + mini rises from bottom
	    local mScale = mini:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", mini)
	    mScale.Scale = 0.85
	    if miniGui then miniGui.Enabled = true end
	    -- snap near phone when minimizing
	    pcall(function()
	      local ch = _G.CalciumPhoneChassis or _G.CalciumPhoneMain
	      if ch and ch.AbsoluteSize.X > 10 then
	        local cx = ch.AbsolutePosition.X + ch.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.5
	        local cy = ch.AbsolutePosition.Y + ch.AbsoluteSize.Y + 10
	        mini.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
	        mini.Position = UDim2.new(0, cx, 0, cy)
	      end
	      local w, h = miniSize()
	      mini.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, h)
	    end)
	    if S._fitLibrary then S._fitLibrary() end
	    mini.Visible = true
	    mini.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
	    Tween:Create(mScale, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
	    Tween:Create(mini, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad), {BackgroundTransparency = 0}):Play()
	    if uscale then
	      Tween:Create(uscale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.92}):Play()
	    end
	    task.delay(0.28, function()
	      win.Visible = false
	      if uscale then uscale.Scale = 1 end
	    end)
	    pcall(function() if S._hookAllClicks then S._hookAllClicks(mini) end end)
	  end

	    end)
	  end

	  playCore = function(item)
	    if not item then return end
	    S._libAdv=false
	    if S._libAuto then S._libAuto=false else S._libSeed=item end

	    if setPlay then setPlay(true) end
	    pcall(function() S._radio.pushHistory(item) end)
	    pcall(function()
	      if not item.stream or item.stream == "" then
	        if nptitle then nptitle.Text = "No stream URL" end
	        return
	      end
	      S._radio.previewPlay(item.stream, function(ok)
	        if not ok and nptitle then nptitle.Text = "Couldn't play that one" end
	      end)
	    end)
	  end

	  dsave.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() local it=results[curIdx]; if it and S._radio.libAdd(it) then dsave.Text="Saved!"; if NV.refreshPlaylistEditor then NV.refreshPlaylistEditor() end saveConfig() if NV.toast then NV.toast("Added: "..(it.name or it.title)) end task.delay(1.5,function() if dsave then dsave.Text="Save to playlist" end end) end end)
	  dremove.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() local it=results[curIdx]; if it and S._radio.libRemove(it) then dremove.Text="Removed!"; if NV.refreshPlaylistEditor then NV.refreshPlaylistEditor() end saveConfig() if NV.toast then NV.toast("Removed: "..(it.name or it.title)) end task.delay(1.5,function() if dremove then dremove.Text="Remove from playlist" end end) end end)
	  setToggle(shufDot,shufIm,S._libShuffle==true); setToggle(repDot,repIm,S._libRepeat==true)

	  if S._libProg then pcall(function() S._libProg:Disconnect() end) end
	  S._libAcc=0
	  S._libProg=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	    S._libAcc=(S._libAcc or 0)+dt; if S._libAcc<0.08 then return end; S._libAcc=0
	    if not (gui and gui.Enabled) then return end
	    local s=S._radio.sound
	    if s and s.TimeLength and s.TimeLength>0 then
	      local rel=math.clamp(s.TimePosition/s.TimeLength,0,1)
	      pfill.Size=UDim2.new(rel,0,1,0); if phandle.Visible then phandle.Position=UDim2.new(rel,0,0.5,0) end
	      tcur.Text=fmt(s.TimePosition); tlen.Text=fmt(s.TimeLength)
	      setPlay(s.Playing and not s.IsPaused)
	      if s.TimePosition>=s.TimeLength-0.3 and not S._libAdv then
	        S._libAdv=true
	        if S._libRepeat and curIdx>0 then playItem(curIdx)
	        elseif S._libShuffle and #results>1 then S._libAuto=true; playItem(math.random(1,#results))
	        elseif curIdx>0 then
	          S._libAuto=true
	          local seed=results[curIdx]
	          task.spawn(function()
	            local more=seed and S._radio.autoplayNext(seed)
	            if more and #more>0 then
	              local pick
	              for _,it in ipairs(more) do local dup=false for _,ex in ipairs(results) do if ex.stream==it.stream then dup=true break end end if not dup then pick=it break end end
	              pick=pick or more[1]
	              results[#results+1]=pick; playItem(#results)
	            end
	          end)
	        end
	      end
	    else pfill.Size=UDim2.new(0,0,1,0) end
	  end)
