	  local searching=false
	  local scQ,scOff,scGrid,scOrder,scDone,scLoading="",0,nil,0,false,false
	  local function scLoadMore()
	    if scLoading or scDone or scQ=="" or not scGrid then return end
	    scLoading=true
	    task.spawn(function()
	      local items=S._radio.scSearchList(scQ,20,scOff)
	      scLoading=false
	      if not items or #items==0 then scDone=true; return end
	      scOff=scOff+#items
	      for _,it in ipairs(items) do scOrder=scOrder+1; card(it,scGrid,scOrder) end
	    end)
	  end
	  local function doSearch(q)
	    q=tostring(q or ""):gsub("^%s+",""):gsub("%s+$",""); if q=="" then renderHome(); return end
	    if searching then return end
	    searching=true; results={}; curIdx=0; scQ=q; scOff=0; scOrder=0; scDone=false; scLoading=false; clearMain(); note("Searching...",0)
	    task.spawn(function()
	      local items,err=S._radio.scSearchList(q,20,0); searching=false; clearMain()
	      if not items or #items==0 then note((items and "No results for that") or ("Failed: "..tostring(err)),0); return end
	      scOff=#items
	      header("Results",0); scGrid=grid(1,UDim2.fromOffset(156,208),UDim2.fromOffset(14,16))
	      for _,it in ipairs(items) do scOrder=scOrder+1; card(it,scGrid,scOrder) end
	    end)
	  end

      S._fitLibrary = function()
        if not win.Parent then return end
        local view = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280,720)
        local touch = UIS:GetLastInputType() == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled)
        narrow = view.X < 900 or (touch and view.X < 1100)
        W = narrow and math.min(560, math.max(300, view.X-24)) or math.min(1080, view.X-40)
        H = math.min(700, math.max(340, view.Y-(touch and 48 or 40)))
        win.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W,H); S._libW = W
        local fit
        -- A wrapper carries device scaling; the inner UIScale is reserved for animation.
        if not S._libFitHost or not S._libFitHost.Parent then
          local host = Instance.new("Frame",gui)
          host.Name="SpotifyViewport"; host.BackgroundTransparency=1
          host.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0.5);host.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
          win.Parent=host;win.Position=UDim2.fromScale(0.5,0.5)
          S._libFitHost=host
          fit=Instance.new("UIScale",host);fit.Name="ViewportFit"
        else fit=S._libFitHost:FindFirstChild("ViewportFit") end
        S._libFitHost.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(W,H)
        fit.Scale=math.min(1,(view.X-24)/W,(view.Y-24)/H)
        for _,control in ipairs(np:GetChildren()) do if control.Name=="DesktopVolume" then control.Visible=not narrow end end
        detail.Visible=not narrow and H>=570
        rail.Visible=not narrow
        main.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and 0 or 74,0)
        main.Size=UDim2.new(1,-(narrow and 0 or (detail.Visible and 366 or 74)),1,0)
        homeBtn.Visible=not narrow
        homeBtn.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-math.floor(W*.2)-48,.5,-20)
        sw.Position=narrow and UDim2.fromOffset(52,10) or UDim2.new(0.5,-math.floor(W*.2),0,10)
        sw.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and W-152 or math.floor(W*.4),36)
        sb.PlaceholderText=narrow and "Search music" or "What do you want to play?"
        dd.Position=UDim2.new(sw.Position.X.Scale,sw.Position.X.Offset,0,58)
        dd.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(sw.Size.X.Offset,math.max(100,H-210))
        NPH=narrow and 128 or 88
        np.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,NPH);np.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,1,-NPH)
        body.Size=UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-(64+NPH))
        npimg.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(narrow and 36 or 56,narrow and 36 or 56)
        npimg.Position=narrow and UDim2.fromOffset(14,10) or UDim2.new(0,16,.5,-28)
        infoW=narrow and W-114 or math.clamp(math.floor(W*.5)-220,90,300)
        nptitle.Position=narrow and UDim2.fromOffset(60,10) or UDim2.new(0,82,.5,-16)
        npsub.Position=narrow and UDim2.fromOffset(60,29) or UDim2.new(0,82,.5,4)
        nptitle.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(infoW,16);npsub.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(infoW,14)
        addBtn.Visible=not narrow
        for _,button in ipairs({shuf,prev,ppBtn,nxt,rep}) do button.Visible=true end
        for i,button in ipairs({shuf,prev,ppBtn,nxt,rep}) do
          button.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(40,40)
          button.Position=UDim2.new(.5,(i-3)*48-20,0,narrow and 51 or 10)
        end
        BW=narrow and W-104 or math.floor(W*.3)
        pbg.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(BW,4);pbg.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-BW/2,0,narrow and 107 or 64)
        pseek.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(BW,24);pseek.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-BW/2,0,narrow and 97 or 54)
        tcur.Visible=true;tlen.Visible=true
        tcur.Position=UDim2.new(.5,-BW/2-42,0,narrow and 103 or 60)
        tlen.Position=UDim2.new(.5,BW/2+8,0,narrow and 103 or 60)
        local mw,mh=miniSize();mini.Size=UDim2.fromOffset(mw,mh)
        local x=mini.Position.X.Scale*view.X+mini.Position.X.Offset
        local y=mini.Position.Y.Scale*view.Y+mini.Position.Y.Offset
        mini.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,mw*.5+8,view.X-mw*.5-8),math.clamp(y,mh*mini.AnchorPoint.Y+8,view.Y-mh*(1-mini.AnchorPoint.Y)-8))
      end
      S._fitLibrary()
      S._libReady=true
      if S._libResize then S._libResize:Disconnect() end
      if S._libInput then S._libInput:Disconnect() end
      if S._libCamera then S._libCamera:Disconnect() end
      S._libInput=UIS.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function() S._fitLibrary() end)
      local function watchLibraryCamera()
        if S._libResize then S._libResize:Disconnect() end
        if workspace.CurrentCamera then S._libResize=workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(S._fitLibrary) end
        S._fitLibrary()
      end
      S._libCamera=workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(watchLibraryCamera)
      watchLibraryCamera()

	  pushView({kind="home"})
	  if S._radio.sound and S.radioTracks then local rt=S.radioTracks[S.radioIndex or 1]; if type(rt)=="table" then nptitle.Text=rt.name or "Track"; npsub.Text=""; if reposAdd then reposAdd() end dtitle.Text=rt.name or "Track"; dartist.Text=""; if rt.cover then loadCover(npimg,rt.cover); loadCover(dcover,rt.cover) end setPlay(S._radio.sound.Playing and not S._radio.sound.IsPaused) end end
	  gui.Enabled=true
	  pcall(function() if S._spotifyMini then S._spotifyMini.Visible=false end end)
	  pcall(function() if win then win.Visible=true end end)
	  _libOpen(win,uscale,W)
	  pcall(function() if S._hookAllClicks then S._hookAllClicks(gui) end end)
	end

	_G.DelSpotifyToggle = function()
		pcall(function()
			if type(S.showMusicLibrary) == "function" then
				S.showMusicLibrary()
			end
		end)
	end
	_G.DelSpotifyShow = function(open)
		pcall(function()
			local isOpen = S._libGui ~= nil and S._libGui.Parent and S._libGui.Enabled == true
			if open == true and isOpen then return end
			if open == false and not isOpen then return end
			if type(S.showMusicLibrary) == "function" then
				S.showMusicLibrary()
			end
		end)
	end
	_G.CalciumOpenSpotify = function()
        if S._libOpening then return end
        S._libOpening=true
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
          if S._libReady and S._libGui and S._libGui.Parent and S._libGui.Enabled and S._libWin and S._libWin.Visible then
            if S._fitLibrary then S._fitLibrary() end
            return
          end
          S.showMusicLibrary()
        end)
        S._libOpening=false
        if not ok then
          S._libReady=false
          if S._libGui then S._libGui:Destroy();S._libGui=nil end
          _G.CalciumSpotifyError=tostring(err)
          warn("[Calcium Spotify] "..tostring(err))
          pcall(NV.toast,"Music player couldn't open. Tap Spotify to retry.")
        else _G.CalciumSpotifyError=nil end
      end

	UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
		if gpe then return end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			_G.DelSpotifyToggle()
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightControl then
			if _G.CalciumOpenMessages then _G.CalciumOpenMessages() end
		end
	end)

	if _G.YZ then
		_G.YZ.spotifyToggle = _G.DelSpotifyToggle
	else
		task.spawn(function() if S.showMusicLibrary then S.showMusicLibrary() end end)
	end
end

-- Subtle hub ambient pulse (visual polish)
task.spawn(function()
  while _G.CalciumRunning do
    task.wait(2.5)
    pcall(function()
      if not Main or not Main.Visible then return end
      local st = Main:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
      if not st then return end
      local old = st.Transparency
      TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {
        Transparency = math.clamp(old - 0.12, 0, 1)
      }):Play()
      task.delay(0.65, function()
        pcall(function()
          TweenService:Create(st, TweenInfo.new(0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), { Transparency = old }):Play()
        end)
      end)
    end)
  end
end)

-- CALCIUM MESSAGES — peer bus (NO Roblox chat)
-- Only clients with Messages panel open send/receive
-- ============================================================
do
  local inbox = {}
  local listeners = {}
  local typingUntil = {}
  local msgGui = nil
  local panelOpen = false
  local selectedTo = "*"
  local BUS = "CalciumMsgBus"
  local OPEN_TAG = "CalciumMsgOpen"
  local mySeq = 0
  local seen = {}

  local function notify()
    for _, fn in ipairs(listeners) do pcall(fn) end
  end

  local function ensureBus(char)
    if not char then return nil end
    local f = char:FindFirstChild(BUS)
    if not f then
      f = Instance.new("Folder")
      f.Name = BUS
      f.Parent = char
    end
    return f
  end

  local function setListening(on)
    panelOpen = on == true
    pcall(function()
      local char = LP.Character
      if not char then return end
      local bus = ensureBus(char)
      if not bus then return end
      local flag = bus:FindFirstChild(OPEN_TAG)
      if on then
        if not flag then
          flag = Instance.new("BoolValue")
          flag.Name = OPEN_TAG
          flag.Parent = bus
        end
        flag.Value = true
      else
        if flag then flag:Destroy() end
      end
    end)
  end

  local function peerHasPanelOpen(plr)
    local char = plr and plr.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local bus = char:FindFirstChild(BUS)
    local flag = bus and bus:FindFirstChild(OPEN_TAG)
    return flag and flag.Value == true
  end

  local function pushLocal(fromName, text, userId, mine)
    text = tostring(text or ""):sub(1, 180)
    if text == "" then return end
    table.insert(inbox, {
      from = tostring(fromName or "?"),
      text = text,
      t = tick(),
      userId = tonumber(userId),
      mine = mine == true,
    })
    if #inbox > 100 then table.remove(inbox, 1) end
    notify()
  end

  local function publish(kind, toName, text)
    if not panelOpen then return false end
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local bus = ensureBus(char)
    if not bus then return false end
    mySeq = mySeq + 1
    local payload = table.concat({
      kind,
      tostring(LP.UserId),
      tostring(LP.Name),
      tostring(toName or "*"),
      tostring(text or ""),
      tostring(mySeq),
      tostring(math.floor(tick() * 1000) % 1000000),
    }, "\1")
    local sv = Instance.new("StringValue")
    sv.Name = "M" .. tostring(mySeq)
    sv.Value = payload
    sv.Parent = bus
    task.delay(4, function()
      if sv then pcall(function() sv:Destroy() end) end
    end)
    return true
  end

  local function handlePayload(payload, fromPlr)
    if not panelOpen then return end
    if type(payload) ~= "string" or payload == "" then return end
    local parts = string.split(payload, "\1")
    if #parts < 6 then return end
    local kind, uid, fromName, toName, text, seq = parts[1], parts[2], parts[3], parts[4], parts[5], parts[6]
    local key = tostring(uid) .. ":" .. tostring(seq)
    if seen[key] then return end
    seen[key] = true
    if fromName == LP.Name then return end
    if toName ~= "*" and toName ~= LP.Name then return end
    if fromPlr then
      local ch = fromPlr.Character
      if not (ch and ch:FindFirstChild(BUS)) then return end
    end
    if kind == "t" then
      typingUntil[fromName] = tick() + 2.5
      notify()
      return
    end
    if kind == "m" then
      typingUntil[fromName] = nil
      pushLocal(fromName, text, tonumber(uid), false)
    end
  end

  local function watchChar(plr, char)
    if not char or plr == LP then return end
    local function hookBus(b)
      if not b then return end
      b.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        if ch:IsA("StringValue") then
          task.defer(function() handlePayload(ch.Value, plr) end)
        end
      end)
      for _, ch in ipairs(b:GetChildren()) do
        if ch:IsA("StringValue") then handlePayload(ch.Value, plr) end
      end
    end
    local bus = char:FindFirstChild(BUS)
    if bus then hookBus(bus) end
    char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
      if c.Name == BUS then hookBus(c) end
    end)
  end

  for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if plr.Character then watchChar(plr, plr.Character) end
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(watchChar, plr, c) end)
  end
  Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
    plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(watchChar, plr, c) end)
  end)
  LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.defer(function() if panelOpen then setListening(true) end end)
  end)

  task.spawn(function()
    while true do
      task.wait(15)
      if not panelOpen then table.clear(seen) end
    end
  end)

  local function thumb(userId)
    local url = ""
    pcall(function()
      url = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100)
    end)
    return url
  end

  local function copyText(str)
    str = tostring(str or "")
    local ok = false
    pcall(function() if setclipboard then setclipboard(str) ok = true end end)
    if not ok then pcall(function() if toclipboard then toclipboard(str) ok = true end end) end
    if not ok then pcall(function() if syn and syn.write_clipboard then syn.write_clipboard(str) ok = true end end) end
    return ok
  end

  local function destroyAllMsgGuis()
    -- kill every leftover Messages overlay (re-exec / protectgui clones)
    local function wipe(container)
      if not container then return end
      for _, ch in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
        if ch.Name == "CalciumMessagesApp" then
          pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
        end
      end
    end
    pcall(function() wipe(PlayerGui) end)
    pcall(function() wipe(HubGui) end)
    pcall(function()
      local cg = game:GetService("CoreGui")
      wipe(cg)
    end)
    pcall(function()
      if gethui then wipe(gethui()) end
    end)
    if msgGui then
      pcall(function() msgGui:Destroy() end)
      msgGui = nil
    end
  end

  local function openMessages()
    if _G.CalciumGuiType ~= "Phone" then return end
    -- if we already own a live single gui, just show it
    if msgGui and msgGui.Parent and msgGui.Name == "CalciumMessagesApp" then
      -- ensure no duplicates exist alongside
      pcall(function()
        local parents = { PlayerGui, HubGui }
        pcall(function() table.insert(parents, game:GetService("CoreGui")) end)
        pcall(function() if gethui then table.insert(parents, gethui()) end end)
        for _, container in ipairs(parents) do
          if container then
            for _, ch in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
              if ch.Name == "CalciumMessagesApp" and ch ~= msgGui then
                pcall(function() ch:Destroy() end)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end)
      msgGui.Enabled = true
      panelOpen = true
      setListening(true)
      return
    end

    destroyAllMsgGuis()
    setListening(true)
    panelOpen = true

    local parent = HubGui or PlayerGui
    msgGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    msgGui.Name = "CalciumMessagesApp"
    msgGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    msgGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    msgGui.DisplayOrder = 120
    msgGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    msgGui.Parent = parent
    pcall(function() if _G.CalciumProtectGui then _G.CalciumProtectGui(msgGui) end end)

    local W = math.clamp((_G._CalciumPhoneW or 300) + 20, 300, 340)
    local H = math.clamp((_G._CalciumPhoneH or 640) - 10, 520, 660)

    local dim = Instance.new("TextButton")
    dim.Name = "Dim"
    dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
    dim.Text = ""
    dim.ZIndex = 1
    dim.Parent = msgGui

    local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    frame.Name = "MessagesPanel"
    frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, H)
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
    frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    frame.BorderSizePixel = 0
    frame.ClipsDescendants = true
    frame.ZIndex = 2
    frame.Parent = msgGui
    Instance.new("UICorner", frame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 36)
    local fStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", frame)
    fStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(56, 68, 82)
    fStroke.Thickness = 1
    fStroke.Transparency = 0.25
    -- pure dark like iMessage, subtle top wash
    local fGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", frame)
    fGrad.Rotation = 90
    fGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 24)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.12, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)),
    })

    local scale = Instance.new("UIScale", frame)
    scale.Scale = 0.92
    pcall(function()
      TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
    end)

    local function close()
      pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
      setListening(false)
      panelOpen = false
      pcall(function()
        TweenService:Create(scale, TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Scale = 0.94}):Play()
      end)
      task.delay(0.16, function()
        if msgGui then msgGui.Enabled = false end
      end)
    end
    dim.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)

    -- ===== iMessage-style header =====
    local nav = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    nav.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 72)
    nav.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 20)
    nav.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
    nav.BorderSizePixel = 0
    nav.ZIndex = 5

    local navLine = Instance.new("Frame", nav)
    navLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
    navLine.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1)
    navLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 54)
    navLine.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
    navLine.BorderSizePixel = 0
    navLine.ZIndex = 6

    local back = Instance.new("TextButton", nav)
    back.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44)
    back.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -22)
    back.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    back.Text = "‹"
    back.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    back.TextSize = 32
    back.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 25)
    back.ZIndex = 6
    back.MouseButton1Click:Connect(close)

    local avatarTop = Instance.new("ImageLabel", nav)
    avatarTop.Name = "ChatAvatar"
    avatarTop.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40)
    avatarTop.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -20, 0, 8)
    avatarTop.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 44, 48)
    avatarTop.BorderSizePixel = 0
    avatarTop.ZIndex = 6
    Instance.new("UICorner", avatarTop).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local navTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel", nav)
    navTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    navTitle.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0, 16)
    navTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0.15, 0, 0, 50)
    navTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    navTitle.TextSize = 13
    navTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    navTitle.Text = "Messages"
    navTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    navTitle.ZIndex = 6

    -- ===== horizontal contacts =====
    local contactBar = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    contactBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 82)
    contactBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 72)
    contactBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    contactBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0
    contactBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    contactBar.ZIndex = 4

    local contacts = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", contactBar)
    contacts.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, -4)
    contacts.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 2)
    contacts.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    contacts.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    contacts.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.X
    contacts.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
    contacts.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    local cLay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", contacts)
    cLay.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
    cLay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
    cLay.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center
    local cPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", contacts)
    cPad.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8)
    cPad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local function setChat(name, label, userId)
      selectedTo = name
      navTitle.Text = label or name
      if name == "*" then
        avatarTop.Image = ""
        local t = avatarTop:FindFirstChild("AllMark")
        if not t then
          t = Instance.new("TextLabel")
          t.Name = "AllMark"
          t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
          t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          t.Text = "∗"
          t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
          t.TextSize = 16
          t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89)
          t.Parent = avatarTop
        end
        t.Visible = true
      else
        local t = avatarTop:FindFirstChild("AllMark")
        if t then t.Visible = false end
        if userId then
          task.spawn(function()
            local url = thumb(userId)
            if url and avatarTop.Parent then avatarTop.Image = url end
          end)
        end
      end
      notify()
    end

    local function rebuildContacts()
      for _, c in ipairs(contacts:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("TextButton") then c:Destroy() end
      end
      local function chip(name, userId, label, force)
        if not force and name ~= "*" then
          local plr = Players:FindFirstChild(name)
          if not plr or not peerHasPanelOpen(plr) then return end
        end
        local cell = Instance.new("TextButton", contacts)
        cell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(54, 64)
        cell.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        cell.Text = ""
        local av = Instance.new("ImageLabel", cell)
        av.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44, 44)
        av.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -22, 0, 0)
        av.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 44)
        av.BorderSizePixel = 0
        Instance.new("UICorner", av).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
        local ring = Instance.new("UIStroke", av)
        ring.Thickness = 2
        ring.Color = (name == selectedTo) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 64)
        if name == "*" then
          ring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89)
          local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", av)
          t.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
          t.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          t.Text = "∗"
          t.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
          t.TextSize = 18
          t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89)
        elseif userId then
          task.spawn(function()
            local url = thumb(userId)
            if url and av.Parent then av.Image = url end
          end)
        end
        local nm = Instance.new("TextLabel", cell)
        nm.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        nm.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14)
        nm.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -14)
        nm.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        nm.TextSize = 9
        nm.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 185)
        nm.Text = label or name
        nm.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
        cell.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
          setChat(name, label or name, userId)
          rebuildContacts()
          pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
        end)
        cell.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
          if name ~= "*" and copyText(name) then
            nm.Text = "Copied"
            task.delay(0.7, function() if nm then nm.Text = label or name end end)
          end
        end)
      end
      chip("*", nil, "All", true)
      for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LP then
          chip(plr.Name, plr.UserId, plr.DisplayName, false)
        end
      end
    end
    rebuildContacts()
    task.spawn(function()
      while msgGui and msgGui.Parent do
        task.wait(1.5)
        if panelOpen and msgGui.Enabled then rebuildContacts() end
      end
    end)

    -- copy row
    local copyBar = Instance.new("TextButton", frame)
    copyBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 30)
    copyBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 158)
    copyBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30)
    copyBar.Text = ""
    copyBar.AutoButtonColor = false
    copyBar.ZIndex = 4
    Instance.new("UICorner", copyBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local copyLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", copyBar)
    copyLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    copyLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
    copyLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    copyLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    copyLbl.TextSize = 12
    copyLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 25)
    copyLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    copyLbl.Text = "Copy username"
    copyBar.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
      if selectedTo ~= "*" and copyText(selectedTo) then
        copyLbl.Text = "Copied @" .. selectedTo
        task.delay(1, function() if copyLbl then copyLbl.Text = "Copy selected username" end end)
      else
        copyLbl.Text = "Select a player first"
        task.delay(1, function() if copyLbl then copyLbl.Text = "Copy selected username" end end)
      end
    end)

    -- chat area
    local chat = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", frame)
    chat.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -248)
    chat.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 194)
    chat.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    chat.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    chat.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 45, 35)
    chat.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    chat.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    chat.ZIndex = 3
    local chatLay = Instance.new("UIListLayout", chat)
    chatLay.Padding = UDim.new(0, 6)
    chatLay.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    local chatPad = Instance.new("UIPadding", chat)
    chatPad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
    chatPad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local function refreshChat()
      for _, c in ipairs(chat:GetChildren()) do
        if c:IsA("Frame") then c:Destroy() end
      end
      if #inbox == 0 then
        local empty = Instance.new("Frame", chat)
        empty.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 80)
        empty.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        local e = Instance.new("TextLabel", empty)
        e.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        e.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        e.Text = "No Messages\nOpen on both sides to chat"
        e.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
        e.TextSize = 14
        e.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 118)
        e.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
      end
      for _, m in ipairs(inbox) do
        local show = true
        if selectedTo ~= "*" and not m.mine then
          show = (m.from == selectedTo)
        end
        if show then
          local row = Instance.new("Frame", chat)
          row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0)
          row.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
          row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          if not m.mine and m.from then
            local who = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
            who.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            who.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 12)
            who.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
            who.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
            who.TextSize = 10
            who.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 160)
            who.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
            who.Text = m.from
          end
          local bub = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
          bub.BackgroundColor3 = m.mine and Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 25) or Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 40)
          bub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
          bub.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
          bub.TextSize = 15
          bub.TextWrapped = true
          bub.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
          bub.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
          bub.Text = m.text
          bub.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY
          Instance.new("UICorner", bub).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
          local p = Instance.new("UIPadding", bub)
          p.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 8)
          p.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8)
          p.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 12)
          p.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12)
          local sc = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint", bub)
          sc.MaxSize = Vector2.new(math.floor(W * 0.7), 400)
          if m.mine then
            bub.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
            bub.Position = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0)
          else
            bub.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, m.from and 14 or 0)
          end
        end
      end
      local now = tick()
      for name, untilT in pairs(typingUntil) do
        if untilT > now and (selectedTo == "*" or selectedTo == name) then
          local row = Instance.new("Frame", chat)
          row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 36)
          row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          local tip = Instance.new("Frame", row)
          tip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 28)
          tip.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
          tip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38, 38, 40)
          Instance.new("UICorner", tip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
          local dots = Instance.new("TextLabel", tip)
          dots.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
          dots.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          dots.Text = "• • •"
          dots.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
          dots.TextSize = 14
          dots.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 200)
          local who = Instance.new("TextLabel", row)
          who.BackgroundTransparency = 1
          who.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 14)
          who.Position = UDim2.new(0, 80, 0, 10)
          who.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
          who.TextSize = 11
          who.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)
          who.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
          who.Text = name .. " is typing…"
          break
        end
      end
      task.defer(function()
        pcall(function() chat.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, chat.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y) end)
      end)
    end
    table.insert(listeners, refreshChat)
    refreshChat()
    task.spawn(function()
      while msgGui and msgGui.Parent do
        task.wait(0.45)
        if panelOpen and msgGui.Enabled then refreshChat() end
      end
    end)

    -- input bar
    local inputBar = Instance.new("Frame", frame)
    inputBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58)
    inputBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -58)
    inputBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 20)
    inputBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    inputBar.ZIndex = 5
    local inLine = Instance.new("Frame", inputBar)
    inLine.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
    inLine.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(44, 44, 48)
    inLine.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local input = Instance.new("TextBox", inputBar)
    input.Size = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0, 36)
    input.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -18)
    input.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30)
    input.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    input.PlaceholderText = "iMessage"
    input.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 140)
    input.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    input.TextSize = 16
    input.Text = ""
    input.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    input.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Instance.new("UICorner", input).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local ip = Instance.new("UIPadding", input)
    ip.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 14)
    ip.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 14)

    local lastTyping = 0
    input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
      if #input.Text > 0 and tick() - lastTyping > 1.4 then
        lastTyping = tick()
        publish("t", selectedTo, "1")
      end
    end)

    local send = Instance.new("TextButton", inputBar)
    send.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
    send.Position = UDim2.new(1, -48, 0.5, -18)
    send.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 110, 25)
    send.Text = "↑"
    send.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    send.TextSize = 20
    send.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    send.ZIndex = 6
    Instance.new("UICorner", send).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local function doSend()
      local text = input.Text
      if text == "" then return end
      if publish("m", selectedTo, text) then
        pushLocal("You", text, LP.UserId, true)
        input.Text = ""
        refreshChat()
      end
      pcall(function() if playClick then playClick() elseif _G.playClick then _G.playClick() end end)
    end
    send.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doSend)
    input.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter) if enter then doSend() end end)

    setChat("*", "Messages", nil)
    msgGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
      if not msgGui.Enabled then setListening(false) end
    end)
  end

  _G.CalciumMessages = {
    open = openMessages,
    close = function()
      setListening(false)
      panelOpen = false
      if msgGui then msgGui.Enabled = false end
    end,
    inbox = inbox,
    isOpen = function() return panelOpen end,
  }
  _G.CalciumOpenMessages = openMessages
end

  local inv = _G.__CalciumDiscordInvite or "discord.gg/calciumhub"
  if type(inv) == "string" then
    _G.CalciumDiscordInvite = inv
  end
end)

  pcall(function()
    if _introEnabled == false then return end
    local parent = HubGui or PlayerGui

      Instance.new("UICorner", p).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
      task.spawn(function()
        local spd = 0.001 + math.random() * 0.003
        while p.Parent do
          local x = (p.Position.X.Scale + spd) % 1.05
          local y = (p.Position.Y.Scale - spd * 0.6) % 1.05
          p.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, y, 0)

        end
      end)

    -- dual pulse rings
    for r = 1, 2 do
      local ring = Instance.new("Frame")

      rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 255)
      rs.Thickness = 2
      rs.Transparency = 0.4
      rs.Parent = ring
      task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(r * 0.35)
        while ring.Parent do
          ring.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
          rs.Transparency = 0.3
          local tw = TS:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(2.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
            Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 280)
          })
          local tw2 = TS:Create(rs, TweenInfo.new(2.2), { Transparency = 1 })
          tw:Play(); tw2:Play()
          task.wait(2.3)
        end
      end)
    end

    -- soft aurora gradient wash
    local wash = Instance.new("Frame")

    wash.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 60, 140)
    wash.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
    wash.BorderSizePixel = 0
    wash.Parent = bg

      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(8, 20, 50)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(30, 90, 200)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(60, 20, 120)),
    })
    wg.Rotation = 25
    wg.Parent = wash

    -- expanding ring
    local ring = Instance.new("Frame")
    ring.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    ring.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.46, 0)
    ring.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
    ring.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ring.BorderSizePixel = 0
    ring.Parent = bg

    rs.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)

    rs.Parent = ring

    logo.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    logo.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.44, 0)
    logo.Size = UDim2.new(0, 520, 0, 90)
    logo.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    logo.Text = "CALCIUM"
    logo.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
    logo.TextSize = 78
    logo.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    logo.TextTransparency = 1
    logo.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    logo.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35
    logo.Parent = bg
    local lg = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    lg.Color = ColorSequence.new({
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.45, Color3.fromRGB(160, 220, 255)),
      ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(40, 120, 255)),
    })
    lg.Rotation = 90
    lg.Parent = logo

    local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    sub.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    sub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.44, 48)

    sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    sub.Text = "ELEMENT 20  ·  UNBREAKABLE"
    sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    sub.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 200, 255)
    sub.TextTransparency = 1
    sub.Parent = bg

    local disc = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    barBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
    barBg.Parent = bg
    Instance.new("UICorner", barBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    bar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 255)
    bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    bar.Parent = barBg
    Instance.new("UICorner", bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local skip = Instance.new("TextButton")
    skip.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
    skip.Position = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 20)
    skip.Size = UDim2.new(0, 72, 0, 28)
    skip.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 16, 28)
    skip.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
    skip.Text = "SKIP"
    skip.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    skip.TextSize = 11
    skip.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 210, 255)
    skip.AutoButtonColor = false
    skip.Parent = bg
    Instance.new("UICorner", skip).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local alive = true
    local function finish()
      if not alive then return end
      alive = false
      pcall(function()
        TS:Create(bg, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(wash, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(logo, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(sub, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(disc, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(barBg, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(0.3), { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play()
        TS:Create(skip, TweenInfo.new(0.25), { BackgroundTransparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1 }):Play()
      end)
      task.delay(0.5, function()
        pcall(function() if splash then splash:Destroy() end end)
        pcall(function()
          if type(stopIntroPlayback) == "function" then stopIntroPlayback() end
        end)
      end)
    end
    skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(finish)
    task.delay(5.8, function() finish() end)

    -- particles
    for i = 1, 36 do
      local d = Instance.new("Frame", bg)
      local sz = 2 + (i % 4)
      d.Size = UDim2.new(0, sz, 0, sz)

    -- animate in
    TS:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 320)
    }):Play()
    TS:Create(ring2, TweenInfo.new(2.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Size = UDim2.new(0, 420, 0, 420)
    }):Play()
    task.spawn(function()

        rs.Transparency = 0.1 + (tick() - t0) * 0.35
        if rs2 then rs2.Transparency = 0.25 + (tick() - t0) * 0.3 end
        RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
      end
    end)

    task.wait(0.4)
    if not alive then return end
    TS:Create(logo, TweenInfo.new(0.85, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { TextTransparency = 0 }):Play()
    task.wait(0.35)
    if not alive then return end
    TS:Create(sub, TweenInfo.new(0.55), { TextTransparency = 0.05 }):Play()
    task.wait(0.2)
    if not alive then return end
    TS:Create(disc, TweenInfo.new(0.55), { TextTransparency = 0.12 }):Play()
    TS:Create(bar, TweenInfo.new(5.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
      Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    }):Play()

    task.wait(5.6)
    if alive then finish() end
  end)
end)

  end

  local function select(name)
    if name == "SPOTIFY" then
      if type(_G.CalciumOpenSpotify) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumOpenSpotify) end
      return
    elseif name == "MESSAGES" then
      if mode == "Phone" and type(_G.CalciumOpenMessages) == "function" then pcall(_G.CalciumOpenMessages) end
      return
    end
    if not pages[name] then return end
    selected = name
    panelTitle.Text = name:sub(1, 1) .. name:sub(2):lower()
    phoneTab(name, true)
    if mode ~= "Phone" then
      arrangeNormal()
      Content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
      appTopBar.Visible, appBack.Visible = false, false
      appBody.Position, appBody.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8), UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -16)
      for key, button in pairs(buttons) do
        local on = key == name
        animate(button, {
          BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.6,
          TextColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 248) or Color3.fromRGB(191, 196, 207)
        }, 0.18)
        local rail = button:FindFirstChild("SelectRail")
        if rail then rail:Destroy() end
      end
    end
  end
  local navigationNames = {}

  end

  local flattened = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
  local function flattenRow(row)
    if flattened[row] or not row:IsA("Frame") or not row:GetAttribute("CalciumFlatRow") then return end
    flattened[row] = true
    row.BackgroundColor3, row.BackgroundTransparency = Color3.fromRGB(22, 25, 31), 0
    local label = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
    if label then label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(226, 234, 241) end
    local accent = row:FindFirstChild("RowAccent")
    if accent then accent.Visible = false end
    local sheen = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
    if sheen then sheen.Enabled = false end
    local outline = row:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if outline then outline.Thickness = 1; outline.Transparency = 0.75 end
    local hoverTween
    local function focus(on)
      if hoverTween then hoverTween:Cancel() end
      hoverTween = animate(row, {BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(31, 36, 43) or Color3.fromRGB(22, 25, 31)}, 0.14)
    end
    row.MouseEnter:Connect(function() focus(true) end)
    row.MouseLeave:Connect(function() focus(false) end)
    for _, control in ipairs(row:GetDescendants()) do
      if control:IsA("GuiButton") then
        control.SelectionGained:Connect(function() focus(true) end)
        control.SelectionLost:Connect(function() focus(false) end)
      end
    end
  end
  for _, page in pairs(pages) do
    for _, row in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do flattenRow(row) end
    page.ChildAdded:Connect(function(row) task.defer(function() flattenRow(row) end) end)
  end

    PhoneChassis.Position = dragPosition + UDim2.fromOffset(delta.X, delta.Y)
  end)

  local phoneHostScale = PhoneChassis:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale") or Instance.new("UIScale", PhoneChassis)
  local function fitPhone()
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    local marginX = touchInput and 28 or 24
    local marginY = touchInput and 72 or 40
    -- leave room for mobile action buttons on the right/left
    local availW = math.max(120, vp.X - marginX - (touchInput and 88 or 0))
    local availH = math.max(160, vp.Y - marginY)
    local sx = availW / math.max(1, phoneSize.X.Offset)
    local sy = availH / math.max(1, phoneSize.Y.Offset)
    local sc = math.min(1, sx, sy)
    -- phone: prefer readable, never tiny
    if touchInput then sc = math.clamp(sc, 0.72, 1) end
    return sc
  end
  phoneHostScale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
    if switchingMotion then return end
    local expected = mode ~= "Phone" and 1 or fitPhone()
    if math.abs(phoneHostScale.Scale - expected) > 0.001 then phoneHostScale.Scale = expected end
  end)
  local normalRowStyles = {}
  local function fitNormal()
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    local availableW = math.max(100, vp.X - (touchInput and 24 or 48))
    local availableH = math.max(100, vp.Y - (touchInput and 60 or 56))
    compactNormal = true
    -- PC panel was capped at 420x548 — too small; use a larger desktop canvas
    local canvasW = touchInput and math.clamp(availableW, 300, 420) or math.clamp(math.floor(availableW * 0.42), 440, 560)
    local canvasH = touchInput and math.clamp(availableH, 320, 548) or math.clamp(math.floor(availableH * 0.78), 560, 720)
    shell.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(canvasW, canvasH)
    title.TextSize = canvasW < 400 and 18 or 22
    local scale = math.min(1, availableW / canvasW, availableH / canvasH)
    if not touchInput then scale = math.clamp(scale, 0.95, 1) end
    normalScale.Scale = scale
    for _, button in pairs(buttons) do button.TextSize = touchInput and 13 or 15 end
    for _, page in pairs(pages) do
      for _, row in ipairs(page:GetChildren()) do
        local rowLabel = row:IsA("Frame") and row:FindFirstChild("Label")
        if rowLabel and rowLabel:IsA("TextLabel") and not row:GetAttribute("CalciumPanelLauncher") and row.Size.Y.Scale == 0 and row.Size.Y.Offset >= 32 then
          normalRowStyles[row] = normalRowStyles[row] or {size = row.Size, textSize = rowLabel.TextSize}
          local rh = touchInput and 58 or 62
          row.Size = UDim2.new(row.Size.X.Scale, row.Size.X.Offset, 0, rh)
          rowLabel.TextSize = touchInput and 15 or 16
          rowLabel:SetAttribute("CalciumReadableSize", rowLabel.TextSize)
          rowLabel.TextWrapped = true
          rowLabel.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.None
        end
      end
    end
    arrangeNormal()
    return UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(canvasW * scale), math.floor(canvasH * scale))
  end
  _G.CalciumNormalSize = fitNormal

  pillAvatar.Position, pillAvatar.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 7), UDim2.fromOffset(36, 36)
  pillAvatar.Image, pillAvatar.ScaleType = portrait.Image, Enum.ScaleType.Crop
  corner(pillAvatar, 18)
  portrait:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Image"):Connect(function() pillAvatar.Image = portrait.Image end)
  local pillHint = label(MiniButton, "TAP TO OPEN", UDim2.fromOffset(54, 29), UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 12), 8)
  pillHint.TextColor3, pillHint.ZIndex = Color3.fromRGB(156, 164, 185), 56
  local pillArrow = label(MiniButton, ">", UDim2.new(1, -25, 0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, 0), 17)
  pillArrow.TextColor3, pillArrow.ZIndex = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 151), 56
  local pillScale = Instance.new("UIScale", MiniFrame)
  -- MiniFrame keeps its existing tap-versus-drag handler in both layouts.
  local function miniStyle()
    local phone = mode == "Phone"
    if MiniBg then MiniBg.Visible = false end
    if miniGlow then miniGlow.Visible = false end
    if miniGrad then miniGrad.Enabled = false end
    miniCamL.Visible, miniCamR.Visible, miniLed.Visible = phone, false, phone
    MiniFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(phone and 196 or 210, phone and 48 or 52)
    MiniFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 15, 20)
    local miniCorner = MiniFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner") or Instance.new("UICorner", MiniFrame)
    miniCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
    pillAvatar.Visible, pillHint.Visible, pillArrow.Visible = not phone, not phone, not phone
    local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
    pillScale.Scale = math.min(1, (vp.X - 20) / 200)
    MiniCalciumText.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(phone and 32 or 54, phone and 0 or 8)
    MiniCalciumText.Size = phone and UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0) or UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 20)
    MiniCalciumText.Text = "CALCIUM"
    MiniCalciumText.TextSize = 13
    pillWallpaper:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, phone and 25 or 16)
    pillShade:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, phone and 25 or 16)
    miniStroke.Color, miniStroke.Transparency = Color3.fromRGB(56, 68, 82), 0.15
  end
  local miniTween, miniToken = nil, 0
  _G._CalciumMiniPop = function(show)
    miniToken = miniToken + 1
    local token = miniToken
    if miniTween then miniTween:Cancel() end
    miniStyle()
    if show then
      local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(800, 600)
      MiniFrame.Position = mode == "Phone" and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 12) or UDim2.new(1, -116, 0, 18)
      MiniFrame.Visible = true
      local target = pillScale.Scale
      pillScale.Scale = target * 0.8
      miniTween = animate(pillScale, {Scale = target}, 0.3)
    else
      miniTween = animate(pillScale, {Scale = pillScale.Scale * 0.85}, 0.15)
      task.delay(0.16, function()
        if token ~= miniToken then return end
        MiniFrame.Visible = false
        miniStyle()
      end)
    end
  end
  _G.CalciumHubClose = function(showMini)
    if mode == "Phone" then return phoneClose(showMini) end
    transition = transition + 1
    local token = transition
    _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized, _G._CalciumHubAnimating = true, true
    _G._CalciumHubRestPos = PhoneChassis.Position
    savedMainPositionTable = udim2ToTable(PhoneChassis.Position)
    if activeTween then activeTween:Cancel() end
    activeTween = animate(PhoneChassis, {Size = _G.CalciumNormalSize() - UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16)}, 0.16)
    task.delay(0.17, function()
      if token ~= transition then return end
      PhoneChassis.Visible = false
      PhoneChassis.Size = _G.CalciumNormalSize()
      _G._CalciumHubAnimating = false
      _G._CalciumMiniPop(showMini == true)
    end)
  end
  _G.CalciumHubOpen = function()
    if mode == "Phone" then return phoneOpen() end
    transition = transition + 1
    if activeTween then activeTween:Cancel() end
    _G.__CalciumDuelsMinimized, _G._CalciumHubAnimating = false, false
    MiniFrame.Visible = false
    PhoneChassis.Position = _G._CalciumHubRestPos or PhoneChassis.Position
    PhoneChassis.Size = _G.CalciumNormalSize() - UDim2.fromOffset(20, 16)
    PhoneChassis.Visible = true
    Main.Visible = false
    Gui.Enabled = true
    activeTween = animate(PhoneChassis, {Size = _G.CalciumNormalSize()}, 0.24)
  end
  close.Activated:Connect(function() _G.CalciumHubClose(true) end)
  local function apply(value)
    transition = transition + 1
    _G._CalciumHubAnimToken = (_G._CalciumHubAnimToken or 0) + 1
    if activeTween then activeTween:Cancel() end
    mode = value == "Phone" and "Phone" or (value == "Pumpkin" and "Pumpkin" or "Normal")
    _G.CalciumGuiType = mode
    pcall(function()
      if type(_G.CalciumFlushConfigNow) == "function" then
        _G.CalciumFlushConfigNow()
      else
        saveCalciumConfig()
      end
    end)
    local normal = mode ~= "Phone"
    if normal and _G.CalciumMessages and _G.CalciumMessages.close then pcall(_G.CalciumMessages.close) end
    local pumpkin = mode == "Pumpkin"
    pumpkinArt.Visible, pumpkinInterior.Visible = pumpkin, pumpkin
    shell.BackgroundTransparency = pumpkin and 1 or 0
    shell:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke").Enabled = not pumpkin
    local host = pumpkin and pumpkinInterior or shell
    for _, control in ipairs({wall, shade, title, subtitle, profileBand, portrait, welcome, displayName, nav, panelTitle, switch, close, dragZone}) do
      control.Parent = host
    end
    wall.Position, wall.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    shade.Position, shade.Size = wall.Position, wall.Size
    wall:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, pumpkin and 26 or 20)
    shade:FindFirstChildOfClass("UICorner").CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, pumpkin and 26 or 20)
    shade.BackgroundColor3 = pumpkin and Color3.fromRGB(37, 20, 13) or Color3.fromRGB(10, 11, 16)
    shell.Visible, PhoneBezel.Visible = normal, not normal
    PhoneChassis.BackgroundTransparency = normal and 1 or 0
    for _, child in ipairs({sideBtn, sideBtn2, powerBtn}) do child.Visible = not normal end
    local chassisStroke = PhoneChassis:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
    if chassisStroke then chassisStroke.Enabled = not normal end
    if normal then
      if phoneHostScale then phoneHostScale.Scale = 1 end
      PhoneChassis.Size = _G.CalciumNormalSize()
      Main.Visible = false
      Content.Parent = host
      Content.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 21, 28)
      switch.Parent = host
      switch.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(222, 32)

      select(selected)
    else
      if phoneHostScale then phoneHostScale.Scale = fitPhone() end
      PhoneChassis.Size = phoneSize
      for row, style in pairs(normalRowStyles) do
        if row.Parent then
          row.Size = style.size
          local rowLabel = row:FindFirstChild("Label")
          if rowLabel then rowLabel.TextSize = style.textSize end
        end
      end
      Main.Visible = true
      Content.Parent = Main
      Content.Position, Content.Size = contentPosition, contentSize
      Content.BackgroundColor3, Content.BackgroundTransparency = contentColor, contentTransparency
      appTopBar.Visible, appBack.Visible = true, true
      appBody.Position, appBody.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 40), UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -48)
      switch.Parent, switch.Position = Main, UDim2.new(0.5, -111, 0, 43)
      switch.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(222, 30)

      phoneHome(true)
    end
    updateSelector()
    miniStyle()
  end
  Main:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
    if mode ~= "Phone" and Main.Visible then Main.Visible = false end
  end)
  local function changeLayout(nextMode)
    if nextMode == mode or switchingMotion or _G._CalciumHubAnimating then return end
    switchingMotion, _G._CalciumHubAnimating = true, true
    pcall(playClick)
    local rest = PhoneChassis.Position
    local outgoing = mode == "Phone" and phoneHostScale or normalScale
    animate(outgoing, {Scale = outgoing.Scale * 0.94}, 0.18)
    animate(PhoneChassis, {Position = rest + UDim2.fromOffset(0, -10)}, 0.18)
    animate(transitionGroup, {GroupTransparency = 1}, 0.17)
    task.delay(0.19, function()
      if not PhoneChassis.Parent then switchingMotion = false; _G._CalciumHubAnimating = false; return end
      apply(nextMode)
      local incoming = mode == "Phone" and phoneHostScale or normalScale
      local finalScale = incoming.Scale
      incoming.Scale = finalScale * 0.94
      PhoneChassis.Position = rest + UDim2.fromOffset(0, 12)
      animate(incoming, {Scale = finalScale}, 0.32)
      animate(PhoneChassis, {Position = rest}, 0.32)
      animate(transitionGroup, {GroupTransparency = 0}, 0.28)
      task.delay(0.33, function()
        _G._CalciumHubRestPos = rest
        switchingMotion, _G._CalciumHubAnimating = false, false
        pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
      end)
    end)
  end
  for value, choice in pairs(layoutChoices) do choice.Activated:Connect(function()
    changeLayout(value)
    _G.CalciumGuiType = value
    pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
  end) end
  _G.CalciumThemeChanged.Event:Connect(function()
    if not shell.Parent then return end
    local palette = _G._CalciumBgPalette()
    avatarRing.Color = palette[4]
    normalEdge.Color = ColorSequence.new(palette[4], palette[3])
    selectedSegment.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(38 + palette[2].R * 25, 38 + palette[2].G * 25, 46 + palette[2].B * 25)
    if mode ~= "Phone" then select(selected) end
  end)
  setTab, _G.CalciumPhoneOpenApp = select, select
  _G.CalciumPhoneShowHome = function(instant)
    if mode ~= "Phone" then select("MOVEMENT") else phoneHome(instant) end
  end
  local sounded = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
  local function hookNormalSound(button)
    if not button:IsA("GuiButton") or sounded[button] then return end
    sounded[button] = true
    if button.Name == "ToggleButton" then
      button.Activated:Connect(function()
        task.delay(0.12, function() pcall(saveCalciumConfig) end)
      end)
    end
    button.Activated:Connect(function()
      if mode ~= "Phone" then pcall(playClick) end
    end)
  end
  for _, button in ipairs(Gui:GetDescendants()) do hookNormalSound(button) end
  Gui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(button) task.defer(function() if button.Parent then hookNormalSound(button) end end) end)
  local function resizeForInput()
    if switchingMotion then return end
    if _G.CalciumApplyMobileButtonSize then pcall(_G.CalciumApplyMobileButtonSize) end
    if mode ~= "Phone" and not _G._CalciumHubAnimating then
      PhoneChassis.Size = fitNormal()
      local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
      if vp then
        local size, pos = PhoneChassis.Size, PhoneChassis.Position
        local x, y = pos.X.Scale * vp.X + pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale * vp.Y + pos.Y.Offset
        x = math.clamp(x, size.X.Offset / 2 + 6, math.max(size.X.Offset / 2 + 6, vp.X - size.X.Offset / 2 - 6))
        y = math.clamp(y, size.Y.Offset / 2 + 6, math.max(size.Y.Offset / 2 + 6, vp.Y - size.Y.Offset / 2 - 6))
        PhoneChassis.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
      end
    end
    if mode == "Phone" then
      phoneHostScale.Scale = fitPhone()
      local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
      if vp then
        local w,h = phoneSize.X.Offset*phoneHostScale.Scale,phoneSize.Y.Offset*phoneHostScale.Scale
        local pos = PhoneChassis.Position
        local x,y = pos.X.Scale*vp.X+pos.X.Offset,pos.Y.Scale*vp.Y+pos.Y.Offset
        PhoneChassis.Position=UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x,w/2+6,math.max(w/2+6,vp.X-w/2-6)),math.clamp(y,h/2+6,math.max(h/2+6,vp.Y-h/2-6)))
      end
    end
    miniStyle()
  end
  UserInputService.LastInputTypeChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then touchInput = true
    elseif input == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard or input == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then touchInput = false
    else return end
    resizeForInput()
  end)
  local cameraConnection
  local function watchCamera()
    if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
    if workspace.CurrentCamera then cameraConnection = workspace.CurrentCamera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(resizeForInput) end
    resizeForInput()
  end
  workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"):Connect(watchCamera)
  watchCamera()
  -- PillLightSweep / synthwave swipe removed (mobile FPS)

  _G.CalciumSetGuiType = function(value, instant)
    local nextMode = value == "Phone" and "Phone" or (value == "Pumpkin" and "Pumpkin" or "Normal")
    if instant then apply(nextMode) else changeLayout(nextMode) end
    pcall(saveCalciumConfig)
  end
  do
    local gt = tostring(_G.CalciumGuiType or "Normal")
    if gt ~= "Phone" and gt ~= "Pumpkin" then gt = "Normal" end
    apply(gt)
    pcall(function() if updateSelector then updateSelector() end end)
  end
end)()


-- Force Anti Lag ON for mobile (FPS)
task.defer(function()
  pcall(function()
    if not _G.CalciumIsMobile then return end
    task.wait(0.6)
    if type(_G.CalciumEnableAntiLag) == "function" then
      _G.CalciumEnableAntiLag()
    end
    _G._CalciumAntiLagOn = true
    pcall(function()
      if _SV and _SV.setAntiLagVisual then _SV.setAntiLagVisual(true) end
    end)
    pcall(function()
      local st = settings()
      if st and st.Rendering then
        st.Rendering.QualityLevel = 1
      end
    end)
    -- Cap FPS on mobile to reduce thermal/throttling stutter
    pcall(function()
      if type(setfpscap) == "function" then setfpscap(60)
      elseif type(set_fps_cap) == "function" then set_fps_cap(60) end
    end)
  end)
end)

-- Reapply after the final layout creates its text and standalone panels.
task.defer(function()
  local F = _G.CalciumFonts
  if not F then return end
  pcall(F.applyAll)
  pcall(F.hook)
  if F.screenConn then F.screenConn:Disconnect() end
  local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
  if pg then
    F.screenConn = pg.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
      if child:IsA("ScreenGui") and child.Name:sub(1, 7) == "Calcium" then
        task.defer(function() pcall(F.applyAll); pcall(F.hook) end)
      end
    end)
  end
end)
